# AGENTS.md — AntAPP

> Guide for AI coding agents. Read this before writing any code.
> **Frontend / UI işi yapacaksan:** `docs/FRONTEND.md` dosyasını oku.

## What Is This?

AntAPP is a multi-platform **route planning & social platform**.

- **Backend**: .NET 8 Clean Architecture (CQRS, MediatR, EF Core, ASP.NET Identity, JWT)
- **Web**: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tamagui)
- **Mobile**: Expo SDK 55 (React Native 0.83, React 19, Expo Router, Tamagui)
- **Shared UI**: `packages/ui` — Tamagui component library
- **Shared Logic**: `packages/app` — Platform-agnostic screens (Solito)

---

## Monorepo Structure

```
AntAPP/
├── backend/                         # .NET 8 Clean Architecture
│   └── Ant/
│       ├── Ant.Application/   # CQRS, interfaces, DTOs
│       ├── Ant.Infrastructure/ # EF Core, services, identity
│       ├── Ant.Core/          # Domain entities
│       └── Ant.WebApi/        # API controllers, Program.cs
├── web/                             # Next.js 16 (@antapp/web)
│   └── src/
│       ├── app/
│       │   ├── (user)/              # User panel → /
│       │   ├── (admin)/admin/       # Admin panel → /admin
│       │   ├── (business)/business/ # Business panel → /business
│       │   └── (auth)/login/        # Auth → /login
│       ├── features/auth/           # Auth Server Actions, types
│       ├── providers/               # TamaguiProvider
│       └── lib/api.ts               # Fetch wrapper
├── mobile/                          # Expo (@antapp/mobile-user)
├── packages/
│   ├── ui/                          # @antapp/ui — Tamagui config + components
│   └── app/                         # @antapp/app — Shared screens (Solito)
└── docs/
    └── DEVLOG.md                    # Development log
```

---

## Build & Run

### Backend
```bash
cd backend
dotnet run --project Ant/Ant.WebApi
# or
dotnet watch --project Ant/Ant.WebApi
```

### Web
```bash
npm run web          # from root (npm run dev --workspace=web)
# or
cd web && npm run dev
```

### Mobile
```bash
npm run mobile       # from root
# or
cd mobile && npx expo start
```

### Build Check
```bash
npm run build --workspace=web
cd backend && dotnet build Ant.sln
```

---

## Environment Setup

### Backend
- `backend/Ant/Ant.WebApi/appsettings.Development.json` — gitignored, put real values here
- See `appsettings.Development.json.example` for required keys
- Default: `UseInMemoryDatabase: true` (no SQL Server needed)

### Web
```bash
cp web/.env.example web/.env.local
# NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api
```

### Mobile
```bash
cp mobile/.env.example mobile/.env.local
# EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://<local-ip>:5000/api  ← use machine IP for physical device
```

---

## Auth Architecture

**Hybrid httpOnly cookie + JWT strategy:**

1. `POST /api/auth/login` → returns `jwToken` + `refreshToken` in JSON body
2. Next.js **Server Action** (`features/auth/actions.ts`) sets both as httpOnly cookies
3. `proxy.ts` (Next.js 16 middleware) checks `accessToken` cookie — redirects to `/login` if missing
4. Access token: **15 minutes**
5. Refresh token: **7 days**, rotated on use (old token revoked) via `POST /api/auth/refresh`
6. Mobile: refresh token read from JSON body, stored in `expo-secure-store`
7. `ForgotPassword` always returns 200 — SMTP errors are swallowed intentionally (anti-enumeration)

---

## Code Conventions

### General
- **Commits**: English, Conventional Commits + emoji
- **Comments**: None — code should be self-explanatory
- **Minimal changes**: Don't add what isn't asked for

### Backend (.NET)
- Follow Clean Architecture layers: Core → Application → Infrastructure → WebApi
- New features use CQRS (Command/Query + Handler)
- Secrets go in `appsettings.Development.json` only — never in `appsettings.json`

### Web (Next.js)
- Server Actions use `'use server'` directive (`features/*/actions.ts`)
- Prefer Server Components — minimize client components
- Feature-based folder structure: `features/<feature>/`

### Mobile (Expo)
- Use Expo Router file-based routing
- Import Tamagui components from `@antapp/ui`

---

## Key Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 3 web apps → 1 | Single Next.js app with route groups | Single deployment, shared state |
| Auth token storage | httpOnly cookie | XSS protection |
| CSS framework | Tamagui 2 RC | React 19 support, web+mobile |
| Navigation | Solito v5 | Shared screens (Next.js + Expo) |
| DB (dev) | In-memory | No setup required |
| Commit language | English | Standard |

---

## Gotchas

- `packages/ui/src/tamagui.config.ts` → use `defaultConfig` (not `config`)
- `web/src/proxy.ts` → Next.js 16 middleware file is `proxy.ts`, exported function must be named `proxy`
- CORS uses `WithOrigins("http://localhost:3000")` — `AllowAnyOrigin()` cannot be combined with `AllowCredentials()`
- `appsettings.Development.json` is gitignored — new devs must create it from the `.example` file
- `AuthenticationResponse.JWToken` has `[JsonPropertyName("jwToken")]` — without it, System.Text.Json emits `jWToken`
- Refresh token rotation needs `.AsTracking().Include(u => u.RefreshTokens)` — `UserManager` defaults to no-tracking
- `List<RefreshToken>` on `ApplicationUser` requires `OwnsMany` in `ApplicationDbContext.OnModelCreating`
- Mobile `.module.css` files need a matching `.d.ts` declaration (see `animated-icon.module.css.d.ts`)

using Ant.Application.Behaviours;
using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Ant.Application
{
    public static class ServiceExtensions
    {
        public static void AddApplicationLayer(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
            services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblies(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()));
            services.AddTransient(typeof(IPipelineBehavior<,>), typeof(ValidationBehavior<,>));
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Behaviours/ValidationBehaviour.cs
================================================
using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Behaviours
{
    public class ValidationBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
        where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>
    {
        private readonly IEnumerable<IValidator<TRequest>> _validators;

        public ValidationBehavior(IEnumerable<IValidator<TRequest>> validators)
        {
            _validators = validators;
        }

        public async Task<TResponse> Handle(TRequest request, RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse> next, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (_validators.Any())
            {
                var context = new FluentValidation.ValidationContext<TRequest>(request);
                var validationResults = await Task.WhenAll(_validators.Select(v => v.ValidateAsync(context, cancellationToken)));
                var failures = validationResults.SelectMany(r => r.Errors).Where(f => f != null).ToList();

                if (failures.Count != 0)
                    throw new Exceptions.ValidationException(failures);
            }
            return await next();
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Common/Caching/AppCacheKeys.cs
================================================
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

namespace Ant.Application.Common.Caching
{
    public static class AppCacheKeys
    {
        public const string RoutesPrefix = "routes:";
        public const string SpotsPrefix = "spots:";
        public const string TagsPrefix = "tags:";

        public static string RouteList(
            int pageNumber,
            int pageSize,
            string search,
            Guid? tagId,
            IEnumerable<Guid> tagIds,
            string sort,
            double? nearLat,
            double? nearLng,
            double? radiusKm,
            Guid? authorId,
            string visibility,
            string type)
        {
            var normalizedTagIds = tagIds is null
                ? string.Empty
                : string.Join(',', tagIds.OrderBy(id => id));

            return string.Join('|',
                $"{RoutesPrefix}list",
                pageNumber,
                pageSize,
                search ?? string.Empty,
                tagId?.ToString() ?? string.Empty,
                normalizedTagIds,
                sort ?? string.Empty,
                Format(nearLat),
                Format(nearLng),
                Format(radiusKm),
                authorId?.ToString() ?? string.Empty,
                visibility ?? string.Empty,
                type ?? string.Empty);
        }

        public static string RouteDetail(Guid routeId) => $"{RoutesPrefix}detail:{routeId}";

        public static string NearbyRoutes(double latitude, double longitude, double radiusInMeters, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
            => string.Join('|', $"{RoutesPrefix}nearby", Format(latitude), Format(longitude), Format(radiusInMeters), pageNumber, pageSize);

        public static string SpotList(int pageNumber, int pageSize, string search)
            => string.Join('|', $"{SpotsPrefix}list", pageNumber, pageSize, search ?? string.Empty);

        public static string SpotDetail(Guid spotId) => $"{SpotsPrefix}detail:{spotId}";

        public static string SpotRoutes(Guid spotId, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
            => string.Join('|', $"{SpotsPrefix}routes", spotId, pageNumber, pageSize);

        public static string TagList(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
            => string.Join('|', $"{TagsPrefix}list", pageNumber, pageSize);

        private static string Format(double? value)
            => value?.ToString("G17", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? string.Empty;
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

namespace Ant.Application.DTOs.Account
{
    public class ForgotPasswordRequest

namespace Ant.Application.DTOs.Account
{
    public class RefreshToken
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Token { get; set; }
        public DateTime Expires { get; set; }
        public bool IsExpired => DateTime.UtcNow >= Expires;
        public DateTime Created { get; set; }
        public string CreatedByIp { get; set; }
        public DateTime? Revoked { get; set; }
        public string RevokedByIp { get; set; }
        public string ReplacedByToken { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive => Revoked == null && !IsExpired;
    }

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Exceptions/ValidationException.cs

using FluentValidation.Results;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Ant.Application.Exceptions
{
    public class ValidationException : Exception
    {
        public ValidationException() : base("One or more validation failures have occurred.")
        {
            Errors = new List<string>();
        }
        public List<string> Errors { get; }
        public ValidationException(IEnumerable<ValidationFailure> failures)
            : this()
        {
            foreach (var failure in failures)
            {
                Errors.Add(failure.ErrorMessage);
            }
        }

    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Account/Commands/ChangePassword/ChangePasswordCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Account.Commands.ChangePassword
{
    public class ChangePasswordCommand : IRequest<Response<string>>
    {
        public string CurrentPassword { get; set; }
        public string NewPassword { get; set; }
        public string ConfirmNewPassword { get; set; }
    }

    public class ChangePasswordCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ChangePasswordCommand, Response<string>>
    {
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IIdentityService _identityService;

        public ChangePasswordCommandHandler(
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IIdentityService identityService)
        {
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _identityService = identityService;
        }

        public async Task<Response<string>> Handle(ChangePasswordCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            if (request.NewPassword != request.ConfirmNewPassword)
                throw new ApiException("New password and confirmation do not match.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            await _identityService.ChangePasswordAsync(userId, request.CurrentPassword, request.NewPassword);

            return new Response<string>("Password changed successfully.");
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Account/Commands/UpdateProfile/UpdateProfileCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Core.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Account.Commands.UpdateProfile
{
    public class UpdateProfileCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public string UserName { get; set; }
        public string ProfilePhotoUrl { get; set; }
    }

    public class UpdateProfileCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateProfileCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IGenericRepositoryAsync<User> _userRepository;

        public UpdateProfileCommandHandler(
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IGenericRepositoryAsync<User> userRepository)
        {
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _userRepository = userRepository;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(UpdateProfileCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
            if (user == null)
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(nameof(User), userId);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.UserName))
                user.UserName = request.UserName;

            if (request.ProfilePhotoUrl != null)
                user.ProfilePhotoUrl = request.ProfilePhotoUrl;

            await _userRepository.UpdateAsync(user);
            return new Response<Guid>(userId, message: "Profile updated successfully.");
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Core.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Account.Queries.GetCurrentUser
{
    public class GetCurrentUserQuery : IRequest<Response<CurrentUserViewModel>>
    {
    }

    public class CurrentUserViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string UserName { get; set; }
        public string Email { get; set; }
        public string ProfilePhotoUrl { get; set; }
        public bool IsVerified { get; set; }
        public List<string> Roles { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetCurrentUserQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetCurrentUserQuery, Response<CurrentUserViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IGenericRepositoryAsync<User> _userRepository;
        private readonly IIdentityService _identityService;

        public GetCurrentUserQueryHandler(
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IGenericRepositoryAsync<User> userRepository,
            IIdentityService identityService)
        {
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _userRepository = userRepository;
            _identityService = identityService;
        }

        public async Task<Response<CurrentUserViewModel>> Handle(GetCurrentUserQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId);
            if (user == null)
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(nameof(User), userId);

            var identity = await _identityService.GetUserIdentityAsync(userId);

            return new Response<CurrentUserViewModel>(new CurrentUserViewModel
            {
                Id = userId,
                UserName = user.UserName,
                Email = identity.Email,
                ProfilePhotoUrl = user.ProfilePhotoUrl,
                IsVerified = identity.IsVerified,
                Roles = identity.Roles
            });
        }
    }

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Admin/Queries/GetAdminStats/GetAdminStatsQuery.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Admin.Queries.GetAdminStats
{
    public class GetAdminStatsQuery : IRequest<Response<AdminStatsViewModel>>
    {
    }

    public class GetAdminStatsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetAdminStatsQuery, Response<AdminStatsViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly ITagRepositoryAsync _tagRepository;
        private readonly ISpotRepositoryAsync _spotRepository;
        private readonly IIdentityService _identityService;

        public GetAdminStatsQueryHandler(
            IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository,
            ITagRepositoryAsync tagRepository,
            ISpotRepositoryAsync spotRepository,
            IIdentityService identityService)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _tagRepository = tagRepository;
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _identityService = identityService;
        }

        public async Task<Response<AdminStatsViewModel>> Handle(GetAdminStatsQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var routesCount = await _routeRepository.GetTotalRoutesCountAsync();
            var tagsCount = await _tagRepository.GetCountAsync();
            var activeUsersCount = await _identityService.GetCountAsync(isActive: true);

            // Fetch Top 5 Latest Routes
            var latestRoutes = await _routeRepository.GetPagedRoutesAsync(1, 5, sort: "latest");
            
            // Fetch Top 5 Rated Spots (Manually since repo doesn't have rating sort)
            var topSpots = await _spotRepository.GetPagedSpotsAsync(1, 5);
            // Optimization: Filter logic can be improved but for top 5 it's fine.

            var viewModel = new AdminStatsViewModel
            {
                TotalRoutes = routesCount,
                TotalTags = tagsCount,
                ActiveUsers = activeUsersCount,
                RecentRoutes = latestRoutes.Select(r => new RecentRouteDto 
                { 
                    Id = r.Id, 
                    Title = r.Title, 
                    CreatedAt = r.CreatedAt 
                }).ToList(),
                TopSpots = topSpots.Select(s => new TopSpotDto 
                { 
                    Id = s.Id, 
                    Name = s.Name, 
                    AverageRating = s.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : (double)s.RatingSum / s.RatingCount 
                }).ToList()
            };

            return new Response<AdminStatsViewModel>(viewModel);
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Collections/Commands/AddRouteToCollection/AddRouteToCollectionCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Collections.Commands.AddRouteToCollection
{
    public class AddRouteToCollectionCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public Guid CollectionId { get; set; }
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        public Guid? UserId { get; set; }
    }

    public class AddRouteToCollectionCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AddRouteToCollectionCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly ICollectionRepositoryAsync _collectionRepository;

        public AddRouteToCollectionCommandHandler(ICollectionRepositoryAsync collectionRepository)
        {
            _collectionRepository = collectionRepository;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(AddRouteToCollectionCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var collection = await _collectionRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.CollectionId);
            if (collection == null)
                throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");

            if (request.UserId.HasValue && collection.UserId != request.UserId.Value)
                throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");

            var existing = await _collectionRepository.GetCollectionRouteAsync(request.CollectionId, request.RouteId);
            if (existing != null)
                throw new ApiException("Route is already in this collection.");

            var collectionRoute = new CollectionRoute
            {
                CollectionId = request.CollectionId,
                RouteId = request.RouteId,
                SavedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await _collectionRepository.AddCollectionRouteAsync(collectionRoute);
            return request.RouteId;
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Collections.Commands.DeleteCollection
{
    public class DeleteCollectionCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public Guid? UserId { get; set; }
    }

    public class DeleteCollectionCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteCollectionCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly ICollectionRepositoryAsync _collectionRepository;

        public DeleteCollectionCommandHandler(ICollectionRepositoryAsync collectionRepository)
        {
            _collectionRepository = collectionRepository;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(DeleteCollectionCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var collection = await _collectionRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.Id);
            if (collection == null)
                throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");

            if (request.UserId.HasValue && collection.UserId != request.UserId.Value)
                throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");

            if (collection.IsDefault)
                throw new ApiException("Default collection cannot be deleted.");

            await _collectionRepository.DeleteAsync(collection);
            return collection.Id;
        }
    }

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Collections/Commands/SaveRoute/SaveRouteCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Collections.Commands.SaveRoute
{
    public class SaveRouteCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        /// <summary>Optional. If specified, saves to this collection. Otherwise saves to default.</summary>
        public Guid? CollectionId { get; set; }
    }

    public class SaveRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SaveRouteCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly ICollectionRepositoryAsync _collectionRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;

        public SaveRouteCommandHandler(ICollectionRepositoryAsync collectionRepository, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser)
        {
            _collectionRepository = collectionRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(SaveRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);

            Collection targetCollection;
            if (request.CollectionId.HasValue)
            {
                targetCollection = await _collectionRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.CollectionId.Value)
                    ?? throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");
            }
            else
            {
                targetCollection = await _collectionRepository.GetOrCreateDefaultCollectionAsync(userId);
            }

            var existing = await _collectionRepository.GetCollectionRouteAsync(targetCollection.Id, request.RouteId);
            if (existing != null)
                return new Response<Guid>(targetCollection.Id);

            var collectionRoute = new CollectionRoute
            {
                CollectionId = targetCollection.Id,
                RouteId = request.RouteId,
                SavedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await _collectionRepository.AddCollectionRouteAsync(collectionRoute);
            return new Response<Guid>(targetCollection.Id);
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Collections.Commands.UnsaveRoute
{
    public class UnsaveRouteCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
    }

    public class UnsaveRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UnsaveRouteCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly ICollectionRepositoryAsync _collectionRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;

        public UnsaveRouteCommandHandler(ICollectionRepositoryAsync collectionRepository, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser)
        {
            _collectionRepository = collectionRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(UnsaveRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            var defaultCollection = await _collectionRepository.GetDefaultCollectionAsync(userId);
            if (defaultCollection == null)
                throw new ApiException("No saved routes collection found.");

            var collectionRoute = await _collectionRepository.GetCollectionRouteAsync(defaultCollection.Id, request.RouteId);
            if (collectionRoute == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route is not saved.");

            await _collectionRepository.RemoveCollectionRouteAsync(collectionRoute);
            return request.RouteId;
        }
    }

            var collection = await _collectionRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.Id);
            if (collection == null)
                throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");

            if (request.UserId.HasValue && collection.UserId != request.UserId.Value)
                throw new ApiException("Collection not found.");

            collection.Name = request.Name;
            collection.IsPublic = request.IsPublic;
            collection.Description = request.Description ?? string.Empty;
            collection.ThumbnailUrl = request.ThumbnailUrl ?? string.Empty;

            await _collectionRepository.UpdateAsync(collection);
            return collection.Id;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Collections/Queries/GetCollections/GetCollectionsQuery.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Collections.Queries.GetCollections
{
    public class GetCollectionsQuery : IRequest<PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>>
    {
        public Guid? UserId { get; set; }
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int PageSize { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetCollectionsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetCollectionsQuery, PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly ICollectionRepositoryAsync _collectionRepository;

        public GetCollectionsQueryHandler(ICollectionRepositoryAsync collectionRepository)
        {
            _collectionRepository = collectionRepository;
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>> Handle(GetCollectionsQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            IReadOnlyList<Collection> collections;
            int totalRecords;

            if (request.UserId.HasValue)
            {
                collections = await _collectionRepository.GetCollectionsByUserIdAsync(
                    request.UserId.Value, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
                totalRecords = await _collectionRepository.GetCountByUserIdAsync(request.UserId.Value);
            }
            else
            {
                collections = await _collectionRepository.GetAllCollectionsPagedAsync(
                    request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
                totalRecords = await _collectionRepository.GetCountAsync();
            }

            var viewModels = collections.Select(c => new CollectionViewModel
            {
                Id = c.Id,
                UserId = c.UserId,
                Name = c.Name,
                IsDefault = c.IsDefault,
                IsPublic = c.IsPublic,
                Description = c.Description,
                ThumbnailUrl = c.ThumbnailUrl,
                RouteCount = c.CollectionRoutes?.Count ?? 0,
                CreatedAt = c.CreatedAt
            }).ToList();

            var response = new PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>(viewModels, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
            response.TotalRecords = totalRecords;
            response.TotalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)totalRecords / request.PageSize);
            return response;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/RouteRatings/Commands/RateRoute/RateRouteCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.RouteRatings.Commands.RateRoute
{
    public class RateRouteCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        public short Stars { get; set; }
    }

    public class RateRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RateRouteCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRatingRepositoryAsync _ratingRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepositoryAsync<Route> _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public RateRouteCommandHandler(
            IRouteRatingRepositoryAsync ratingRepository,
            IGenericRepositoryAsync<Route> routeRepository,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _ratingRepository = ratingRepository;
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(RateRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            if (request.Stars < 1 || request.Stars > 5)
                throw new ApiException("Stars must be between 1 and 5.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RouteId);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var existing = await _ratingRepository.GetByUserAndRouteAsync(userId, request.RouteId);

            if (existing != null)
            {
                route.RatingSum = route.RatingSum - existing.Stars + request.Stars;
                existing.Stars = request.Stars;
                await _ratingRepository.UpdateAsync(existing);
                await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
                await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
                return existing.Id;
            }

            var rating = new RouteRating
            {
                UserId = userId,
                RouteId = request.RouteId,
                Stars = request.Stars,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            route.RatingSum += request.Stars;
            route.RatingCount++;

            await _ratingRepository.AddAsync(rating);
            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return rating.Id;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Routes/Commands/CreateRoute/CreateRouteCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.CreateRoute
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Data object representing a specific stop within the new Route.
    /// Used inside the CreateRouteCommand.
    /// </summary>
    public class CreateRouteSpotRequest
    {
        public Guid? SpotId { get; set; }
        
        // Map fields for creating a point on the fly
        public double? Latitude { get; set; }
        public double? Longitude { get; set; }
        public string SpotName { get; set; }
        public string GooglePlaceId { get; set; }

        public string CustomTitle { get; set; }
        public string CustomDescription { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Command to create a brand new Route (Journey).
    /// </summary>
    public class CreateRouteCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public string Title { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string ThumbnailUrl { get; set; }
        public List<Guid> TagIds { get; set; }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// The ordered list of stops. The first item in the list is the starting point (SpotOrder = 1).
        /// </summary>
        public List<CreateRouteSpotRequest> Spots { get; set; }
    }

    public class CreateRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateRouteCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly ISpotRepositoryAsync _spotRepository;
        private readonly IMapRoutingService _mapRoutingService;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public CreateRouteCommandHandler(
            IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, 
            ISpotRepositoryAsync spotRepository,
            IMapRoutingService mapRoutingService,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _mapRoutingService = mapRoutingService;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(CreateRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("You must be logged in to create a route.");

            // MVP Business Rule: A route must contain at least 2 spots.
            if (request.Spots == null || request.Spots.Count < 2)
            {
                throw new ApiException("A route must contain at least 2 spots to be valid.");
            }

            var authorId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);

            // Initialize the Route entity
            var newRoute = new Route
            {
                AuthorUserId = authorId,
                Title = request.Title,
                Description = request.Description,
                ThumbnailUrl = request.ThumbnailUrl,
                RouteType = RouteTypeEnum.Walking,
                IsPublic = true,
                RouteTags = new List<RouteTag>(),
                RouteSpots = new List<RouteSpot>()
            };

            // Map Tags
            if (request.TagIds != null && request.TagIds.Any())
            {
                foreach (var tagId in request.TagIds)
                {
                    newRoute.RouteTags.Add(new RouteTag { TagId = tagId });
                }
            }

            // Map Spots and Enforce Order (1-based index)
            var waypoints = new List<NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point>();

            for (int i = 0; i < request.Spots.Count; i++)
            {
                var spotItem = request.Spots[i];
                Guid finalSpotId = Guid.Empty;

                if (spotItem.SpotId.HasValue)
                {
                    finalSpotId = spotItem.SpotId.Value;
                    var existingSpot = await _spotRepository.GetByIdAsync(finalSpotId);
                    if (existingSpot != null)
                        waypoints.Add(existingSpot.Location);
                }
                else if (spotItem.Latitude.HasValue && spotItem.Longitude.HasValue)
                {
                    // Create new Spot on the fly
                    var point = new NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point(spotItem.Longitude.Value, spotItem.Latitude.Value) { SRID = 4326 };
                    var freshSpot = new Spot
                    {
                        Name = spotItem.SpotName ?? "New Map Location",
                        Location = point,
                        GooglePlaceId = spotItem.GooglePlaceId,
                        IsActive = true
                    };
                    await _spotRepository.AddAsync(freshSpot);
                    finalSpotId = freshSpot.Id;
                    waypoints.Add(point);
                }

                if (finalSpotId != Guid.Empty)
                {
                    newRoute.RouteSpots.Add(new RouteSpot
                    {
                        SpotId = finalSpotId,
                        SpotOrder = i + 1, // Order is purely based on the list position
                        CustomTitle = spotItem.CustomTitle,
                        CustomDescription = spotItem.CustomDescription
                    });
                }
            }

            // Map Workflow: Fetch Polyline, Distance, Duration, Center
            var geometryResult = await _mapRoutingService.GetRouteGeometryAsync(waypoints, cancellationToken);
            newRoute.EncodedPolyline = geometryResult.EncodedPolyline;
            newRoute.TotalDistanceMeters = geometryResult.DistanceMeters;
            newRoute.EstimatedDurationSeconds = geometryResult.DurationSeconds;
            newRoute.CenterLocation = geometryResult.CenterPoint;

            // This command saves the Route, RouteTags, and RouteSpots in ONE transaction automatically via EF Core
            await _routeRepository.AddAsync(newRoute);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.SpotsPrefix, cancellationToken);

            return new Response<Guid>(newRoute.Id, message: "Route successfully created.");
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Routes/Commands/DeleteRoute/DeleteRouteCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.DeleteRoute
{
    public class DeleteRouteCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
    }

    public class DeleteRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteRouteCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public DeleteRouteCommandHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(DeleteRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetRouteWithTrackingAsync(request.Id);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only delete your own routes.");

            route.IsDeleted = true;
            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(route.Id, message: "Route deleted.");
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.ForkRoute
{
    public class ForkRouteCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid OriginalRouteId { get; set; }
    }

    public class ForkRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ForkRouteCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public ForkRouteCommandHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(ForkRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var original = await _routeRepository.GetRouteWithSpotsAsync(request.OriginalRouteId);
            if (original == null)
                throw new ApiException("Original route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);

            var forked = new Route
            {
                AuthorUserId = userId,
                OriginalRouteId = original.Id,
                Title = original.Title,
                Description = original.Description,
                ThumbnailUrl = original.ThumbnailUrl,
                RouteType = original.RouteType,
                ContentType = RouteContentTypeEnum.Community,
                IsPublic = false,
                RouteTags = original.RouteTags?.Select(rt => new RouteTag { TagId = rt.TagId }).ToList() ?? new List<RouteTag>(),
                RouteSpots = original.RouteSpots?.OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder).Select((rs, i) => new RouteSpot
                {
                    SpotId = rs.SpotId,
                    SpotOrder = i + 1,
                    CustomTitle = rs.CustomTitle,
                    CustomDescription = rs.CustomDescription,
                    CustomPhotoUrl = rs.CustomPhotoUrl
                }).ToList() ?? new List<RouteSpot>()
            };

            await _routeRepository.AddAsync(forked);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(forked.Id, message: "Route forked as draft.");
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.UnpublishRoute
{
    public class UnpublishRouteCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
    }

    public class UnpublishRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UnpublishRouteCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public UnpublishRouteCommandHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(UnpublishRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetRouteWithTrackingAsync(request.Id);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only unpublish your own routes.");

            route.IsPublic = false;
            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(route.Id, message: "Route unpublished (draft).");
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Routes/Commands/UpdateRoute/UpdateRouteCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.UpdateRoute
{
    public class UpdateRouteCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Title { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string ThumbnailUrl { get; set; }
        public List<Guid> TagIds { get; set; }
    }

    public class UpdateRouteCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateRouteCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public UpdateRouteCommandHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(UpdateRouteCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetRouteWithTrackingAsync(request.Id);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only update your own routes.");

            if (request.Title != null) route.Title = request.Title;
            if (request.Description != null) route.Description = request.Description;
            if (request.ThumbnailUrl != null) route.ThumbnailUrl = request.ThumbnailUrl;

            // Update Tags
            if (request.TagIds != null)
            {
                route.RouteTags.Clear();
                foreach (var tagId in request.TagIds)
                {
                    route.RouteTags.Add(new RouteTag { TagId = tagId });
                }
            }
            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(route.Id, message: "Route updated.");
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Queries.GetAdminRoutes
{
    public class GetAdminRoutesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetAdminRoutesQuery, PagedResponse<AdminRouteViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;

        public GetAdminRoutesQueryHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<AdminRouteViewModel>> Handle(GetAdminRoutesQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var routes = await _routeRepository.GetPagedRoutesAsync(
                request.PageNumber, request.PageSize, request.SearchValue);

            var totalRecords = await _routeRepository.GetTotalRoutesCountAsync(request.SearchValue);

            var data = routes.Select(x => new AdminRouteViewModel
            {
                Id = x.Id,
                Title = x.Title,
                AuthorUserName = x.AuthorUser != null ? x.AuthorUser.UserName : "System",
                ContentType = x.ContentType,
                IsPublic = x.IsPublic,
                CreatedAt = x.CreatedAt,
                StopCount = x.RouteSpots != null ? x.RouteSpots.Count : 0,
                AverageRating = x.RatingCount > 0 ? (double)x.RatingSum / x.RatingCount : 0
            }).ToList();

            return new PagedResponse<AdminRouteViewModel>(data, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize)
            {
                TotalRecords = totalRecords
            };
        }
    }
}

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Queries.GetNearbyRoutes
{
    public class GetNearbyRoutesQuery : IRequest<Response<IEnumerable<RouteListNearbyViewModel>>>
    {
        public double Latitude { get; set; }
        public double Longitude { get; set; }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// Search radius in meters. Default is 5000 (5km).
        /// </summary>
        public double RadiusInMeters { get; set; } = 5000;
        
        public int PageNumber { get; set; } = 1;
        public int PageSize { get; set; } = 10;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// ViewModel for list representations of Routes.
    /// </summary>
    public class RouteListNearbyViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Title { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string ThumbnailUrl { get; set; }
        public Guid AuthorUserId { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// The computed average rating (0.0 to 5.0) of the route.
        /// Optimized by avoiding expensive grouping operations and returning pre-aggregated data.
        /// </summary>
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetNearbyRoutesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetNearbyRoutesQuery, Response<IEnumerable<RouteListNearbyViewModel>>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetNearbyRoutesQueryHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<IEnumerable<RouteListNearbyViewModel>>> Handle(GetNearbyRoutesQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var validFilter = new Ant.Application.Filters.RequestParameter(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
            var cacheKey = AppCacheKeys.NearbyRoutes(request.Latitude, request.Longitude, request.RadiusInMeters, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize);

            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                cacheKey,
                async _ =>
                {
                    var routes = await _routeRepository.GetNearbyRoutesAsync(
                        request.Latitude,
                        request.Longitude,
                        request.RadiusInMeters,
                        validFilter.PageNumber,
                        validFilter.PageSize);

                    var viewModelList = routes.Select(r => new RouteListNearbyViewModel
                    {
                        Id = r.Id,
                        Title = r.Title,
                        Description = r.Description,
                        ThumbnailUrl = r.ThumbnailUrl,
                        AuthorUserId = r.AuthorUserId,
                        CreatedAt = r.CreatedAt,
                        AverageRating = r.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(r.RatingSum / (double)r.RatingCount, 1)
                    }).ToList();

                    return new Response<IEnumerable<RouteListNearbyViewModel>>(viewModelList, message: $"Found {viewModelList.Count} nearby route(s).");
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
                cancellationToken);
        }

using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Queries.GetPagedRoutes

    {
        public int PageNumber { get; set; } = 1;
        public int PageSize { get; set; } = 20;
        public string Search { get; set; }
        public Guid? TagId { get; set; }
        public List<Guid> TagIds { get; set; }
        public string Sort { get; set; }
        public double? NearLat { get; set; }
        public double? NearLng { get; set; }

        public string Visibility { get; set; }

    public class RouteListViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Title { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string ThumbnailUrl { get; set; }
        public Guid AuthorUserId { get; set; }
        public string ContentType { get; set; }
        public bool IsPublic { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
        public double TotalDistanceMeters { get; set; }
        public int EstimatedDurationSeconds { get; set; }
        public double CenterLatitude { get; set; }
        public double CenterLongitude { get; set; }
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetPagedRoutesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetPagedRoutesQuery, PagedResponse<RouteListViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetPagedRoutesQueryHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<RouteListViewModel>> Handle(GetPagedRoutesQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var validFilter = new Ant.Application.Filters.RequestParameter(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);

            RouteContentTypeEnum? contentType = request.Type?.ToLower() switch
            {
                "official" => RouteContentTypeEnum.Official,
                "community" => RouteContentTypeEnum.Community,
                "sponsored" => RouteContentTypeEnum.Sponsored,
                _ => null
            };

            var cacheKey = AppCacheKeys.RouteList(
                validFilter.PageNumber,
                validFilter.PageSize,
                request.Search,
                request.TagId,
                request.TagIds,
                request.Sort,
                request.NearLat,
                request.NearLng,
                request.RadiusKm,
                request.AuthorId,
                request.Visibility,
                request.Type);

            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                cacheKey,
                async _ =>
                {
                    var routes = await _routeRepository.GetPagedRoutesAsync(
                        request.PageNumber, request.PageSize,
                        request.Search, request.TagId, request.TagIds, request.Sort,
                        request.NearLat, request.NearLng, request.RadiusKm,
                        request.AuthorId, request.Visibility, contentType);

                    var totalRecords = await _routeRepository.GetTotalRoutesCountAsync(
                        request.Search, request.TagId, request.TagIds,
                        request.NearLat, request.NearLng, request.RadiusKm,
                        request.AuthorId, request.Visibility, contentType);

                    var viewModelList = routes.Select(r => new RouteListViewModel
                    {
                        Id = r.Id,
                        Title = r.Title,
                        Description = r.Description,
                        ThumbnailUrl = r.ThumbnailUrl,
                        AuthorUserId = r.AuthorUserId,
                        ContentType = r.ContentType.ToString(),
                        IsPublic = r.IsPublic,
                        CreatedAt = r.CreatedAt,
                        TotalDistanceMeters = r.TotalDistanceMeters,
                        EstimatedDurationSeconds = r.EstimatedDurationSeconds,
                        CenterLatitude = r.CenterLocation != null ? r.CenterLocation.Y : 0,
                        CenterLongitude = r.CenterLocation != null ? r.CenterLocation.X : 0,
                        AverageRating = r.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(r.RatingSum / (double)r.RatingCount, 1)
                    }).ToList();

                    return new PagedResponse<RouteListViewModel>(viewModelList, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize)
                    {
                        TotalRecords = totalRecords
                    };
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2),
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }

using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Queries.GetRouteById
{
    public class GetRouteByIdQuery : IRequest<Response<GetRouteByIdViewModel>>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The final shape of the Route data returned to the Mobile App / Web Frontend.
    /// </summary>
    public class GetRouteByIdViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Title { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string ThumbnailUrl { get; set; }
        public Guid AuthorUserId { get; set; }
        public Ant.Core.Enums.RouteContentTypeEnum ContentType { get; set; }
        public bool IsPublic { get; set; }

        public string EncodedPolyline { get; set; }
        public double TotalDistanceMeters { get; set; }
        public int EstimatedDurationSeconds { get; set; }
        public double CenterLatitude { get; set; }
        public double CenterLongitude { get; set; }
        
        
        /// <summary>        /// The sequential list of stops (Places) on this journey.
        /// </summary>
        public List<RouteSpotDto> Stops { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The computed average rating (0.0 to 5.0) of the route.
        /// Optimized by avoiding expensive grouping operations and returning pre-aggregated data.
        /// </summary>
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
    }

    public class RouteSpotDto
    {
        public Guid SpotId { get; set; }
        public int Order { get; set; }
        
        // Combine real Spot data with optional Route-specific overrides
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string SpotName { get; set; }
        public string CustomTitle { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string PhotoUrl { get; set; }
        
        public double Latitude { get; set; }
        public double Longitude { get; set; }
        public string GooglePlaceId { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetRouteByIdQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetRouteByIdQuery, Response<GetRouteByIdViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetRouteByIdQueryHandler(IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<GetRouteByIdViewModel>> Handle(GetRouteByIdQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                AppCacheKeys.RouteDetail(request.Id),
                async _ =>
                {
                    var route = await _routeRepository.GetRouteWithSpotsAsync(request.Id);

                    if (route == null) throw new ApiException($"Route NOT FOUND.");

                    var viewModel = new GetRouteByIdViewModel
                    {
                        Id = route.Id,
                        Title = route.Title,
                        Description = route.Description,
                        ThumbnailUrl = route.ThumbnailUrl,
                        AuthorUserId = route.AuthorUserId,
                        ContentType = route.ContentType,
                        IsPublic = route.IsPublic,
                        EncodedPolyline = route.EncodedPolyline,
                        TotalDistanceMeters = route.TotalDistanceMeters,
                        EstimatedDurationSeconds = route.EstimatedDurationSeconds,
                        CenterLatitude = route.CenterLocation?.Y ?? 0,
                        CenterLongitude = route.CenterLocation?.X ?? 0,
                        AverageRating = route.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(route.RatingSum / (double)route.RatingCount, 1),
                        Stops = route.RouteSpots.OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder).Select(rs => new RouteSpotDto
                        {
                            SpotId = rs.Spot.Id,
                            Order = rs.SpotOrder,
                            Name = string.IsNullOrEmpty(rs.CustomTitle) ? rs.Spot.Name : rs.CustomTitle,
                            SpotName = rs.Spot.Name,
                            CustomTitle = rs.CustomTitle,
                            Description = string.IsNullOrEmpty(rs.CustomDescription) ? rs.Spot.Description : rs.CustomDescription,
                            PhotoUrl = string.IsNullOrEmpty(rs.CustomPhotoUrl) ? rs.Spot.PhotoUrl : rs.CustomPhotoUrl,
                            Latitude = rs.Spot.Location.Y,
                            Longitude = rs.Spot.Location.X,
                            GooglePlaceId = rs.Spot.GooglePlaceId
                        }).ToList()
                    };

                    return new Response<GetRouteByIdViewModel>(viewModel);
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }

using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.RouteStops.Commands.AddRouteStop
{
    public class AddRouteStopCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        public Guid SpotId { get; set; }
        public string CustomTitle { get; set; }
        public string CustomDescription { get; set; }
        public int? Order { get; set; }
    }

    public class AddRouteStopCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AddRouteStopCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync _routeSpotRepository;
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IMapRoutingService _mapRoutingService;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public AddRouteStopCommandHandler(
            IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync routeSpotRepository,
            IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository,
            IMapRoutingService mapRoutingService,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeSpotRepository = routeSpotRepository;
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _mapRoutingService = mapRoutingService;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(AddRouteStopCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RouteId);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only add stops to your own routes.");

            var order = request.Order ?? (await _routeSpotRepository.GetMaxOrderForRouteAsync(request.RouteId) + 1);

            var routeSpot = new RouteSpot
            {
                RouteId = request.RouteId,
                SpotId = request.SpotId,
                SpotOrder = order,
                CustomTitle = request.CustomTitle,
                CustomDescription = request.CustomDescription
            };

            await _routeSpotRepository.AddAsync(routeSpot);
            await RecomputeRouteGeometryAsync(request.RouteId, cancellationToken);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(routeSpot.Id, message: "Stop added to route.");
        }

        private async Task RecomputeRouteGeometryAsync(Guid routeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(routeId);
            if (route == null) return;

            var stops = await _routeSpotRepository.GetStopsForRouteAsync(routeId);
            var waypoints = stops
                .Where(rs => rs.Spot?.Location != null)
                .OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder)
                .Select(rs => rs.Spot.Location)
                .ToList();

            if (waypoints.Count < 2)
            {
                route.EncodedPolyline = null;
                route.TotalDistanceMeters = 0;
                route.EstimatedDurationSeconds = 0;
                route.CenterLocation = waypoints.Count == 1 ? waypoints[0] : null;
            }
            else
            {
                var geometry = await _mapRoutingService.GetRouteGeometryAsync(waypoints, cancellationToken);
                route.EncodedPolyline = geometry.EncodedPolyline;
                route.TotalDistanceMeters = geometry.DistanceMeters;
                route.EstimatedDurationSeconds = geometry.DurationSeconds;
                route.CenterLocation = geometry.CenterPoint;
            }

            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/RouteStops/Commands/RemoveRouteStop/RemoveRouteStopCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.RouteStops.Commands.RemoveRouteStop
{
    public class RemoveRouteStopCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        public Guid RouteStopId { get; set; }
    }

    public class RemoveRouteStopCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RemoveRouteStopCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync _routeSpotRepository;
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IMapRoutingService _mapRoutingService;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public RemoveRouteStopCommandHandler(
            IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync routeSpotRepository,
            IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository,
            IMapRoutingService mapRoutingService,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeSpotRepository = routeSpotRepository;
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _mapRoutingService = mapRoutingService;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(RemoveRouteStopCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RouteId);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only remove stops from your own routes.");

            var stop = await _routeSpotRepository.GetStopWithTrackingAsync(request.RouteStopId);
            if (stop == null || stop.RouteId != request.RouteId)
                throw new ApiException("Stop not found in this route.");

            await _routeSpotRepository.DeleteAsync(stop);
            await NormalizeStopOrderAsync(request.RouteId);
            await RecomputeRouteGeometryAsync(request.RouteId, cancellationToken);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(request.RouteStopId, message: "Stop removed from route.");
        }

        private async Task NormalizeStopOrderAsync(Guid routeId)
        {
            var orderedIds = (await _routeSpotRepository.GetStopsForRouteAsync(routeId))
                .OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder)
                .Select(rs => rs.Id)
                .ToList();

            if (orderedIds.Count > 0)
            {
                await _routeSpotRepository.ReorderStopsAsync(routeId, orderedIds);
            }
        }

        private async Task RecomputeRouteGeometryAsync(Guid routeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(routeId);
            if (route == null) return;

            var stops = await _routeSpotRepository.GetStopsForRouteAsync(routeId);
            var waypoints = stops
                .Where(rs => rs.Spot?.Location != null)
                .OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder)
                .Select(rs => rs.Spot.Location)
                .ToList();

            if (waypoints.Count < 2)
            {
                route.EncodedPolyline = null;
                route.TotalDistanceMeters = 0;
                route.EstimatedDurationSeconds = 0;
                route.CenterLocation = waypoints.Count == 1 ? waypoints[0] : null;
            }
            else
            {
                var geometry = await _mapRoutingService.GetRouteGeometryAsync(waypoints, cancellationToken);
                route.EncodedPolyline = geometry.EncodedPolyline;
                route.TotalDistanceMeters = geometry.DistanceMeters;
                route.EstimatedDurationSeconds = geometry.DurationSeconds;
                route.CenterLocation = geometry.CenterPoint;
            }

            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
        }
    }
}
