FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/RouteStops/Commands/ReorderRouteStops/ReorderRouteStopsCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.RouteStops.Commands.ReorderRouteStops
{
    public class ReorderRouteStopsCommand : IRequest<Response<string>>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        public List<Guid> OrderedStopIds { get; set; }
    }

    public class ReorderRouteStopsCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ReorderRouteStopsCommand, Response<string>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync _routeSpotRepository;
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IMapRoutingService _mapRoutingService;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public ReorderRouteStopsCommandHandler(
            IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync routeSpotRepository,
            IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository,
            IMapRoutingService mapRoutingService,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeSpotRepository = routeSpotRepository;
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _mapRoutingService = mapRoutingService;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<string>> Handle(ReorderRouteStopsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RouteId);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only reorder stops on your own routes.");

            if (request.OrderedStopIds == null || request.OrderedStopIds.Count == 0)
                throw new ApiException("Ordered stop IDs are required.");

            await _routeSpotRepository.ReorderStopsAsync(request.RouteId, request.OrderedStopIds);
            await RecomputeRouteGeometryAsync(request.RouteId, cancellationToken);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<string>("ok", message: "Stops reordered.");
        }

        private async Task RecomputeRouteGeometryAsync(Guid routeId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(routeId);
            if (route == null) return;

            var stops = await _routeSpotRepository.GetStopsForRouteAsync(routeId);
            var waypoints = stops
                .Where(rs => rs.Spot?.Location != null)
                .OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder)
                .Select(rs => rs.Spot.Location)
                .ToList();

            if (waypoints.Count < 2)
            {
                route.EncodedPolyline = null;
                route.TotalDistanceMeters = 0;
                route.EstimatedDurationSeconds = 0;
                route.CenterLocation = waypoints.Count == 1 ? waypoints[0] : null;
            }
            else
            {
                var geometry = await _mapRoutingService.GetRouteGeometryAsync(waypoints, cancellationToken);
                route.EncodedPolyline = geometry.EncodedPolyline;
                route.TotalDistanceMeters = geometry.DistanceMeters;
                route.EstimatedDurationSeconds = geometry.DurationSeconds;
                route.CenterLocation = geometry.CenterPoint;
            }

            await _routeRepository.UpdateAsync(route);
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.RouteStops.Commands.UpdateRouteStop
{
    public class UpdateRouteStopCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid RouteId { get; set; }
        public Guid RouteStopId { get; set; }
        public string CustomTitle { get; set; }
        public string CustomDescription { get; set; }
        public string CustomPhotoUrl { get; set; }
    }

    public class UpdateRouteStopCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateRouteStopCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync _routeSpotRepository;
        private readonly IRouteRepositoryAsync _routeRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public UpdateRouteStopCommandHandler(
            IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync routeSpotRepository,
            IRouteRepositoryAsync routeRepository,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _routeSpotRepository = routeSpotRepository;
            _routeRepository = routeRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(UpdateRouteStopCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            var route = await _routeRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.RouteId);
            if (route == null)
                throw new ApiException("Route not found.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);
            if (route.AuthorUserId != userId)
                throw new ApiException("You can only update stops on your own routes.");

            var stop = await _routeSpotRepository.GetStopWithTrackingAsync(request.RouteStopId);
            if (stop == null || stop.RouteId != request.RouteId)
                throw new ApiException("Stop not found in this route.");

            if (request.CustomTitle != null) stop.CustomTitle = request.CustomTitle;
            if (request.CustomDescription != null) stop.CustomDescription = request.CustomDescription;
            if (request.CustomPhotoUrl != null) stop.CustomPhotoUrl = request.CustomPhotoUrl;

            await _routeSpotRepository.UpdateAsync(stop);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return new Response<Guid>(stop.Id, message: "Stop updated.");
        }
    }

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/SpotRatings/Commands/RateSpot/RateSpotCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.SpotRatings.Commands.RateSpot
{
    public class RateSpotCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public Guid SpotId { get; set; }
        public short Stars { get; set; }
    }

    public class RateSpotCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RateSpotCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly ISpotRatingRepositoryAsync _ratingRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepositoryAsync<Spot> _spotRepository;
        private readonly IAuthenticatedUserService _authenticatedUser;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public RateSpotCommandHandler(
            ISpotRatingRepositoryAsync ratingRepository,
            IGenericRepositoryAsync<Spot> spotRepository,
            IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser,
            IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _ratingRepository = ratingRepository;
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _authenticatedUser = authenticatedUser;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(RateSpotCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_authenticatedUser.UserId))
                throw new ApiException("Authentication required.");

            if (request.Stars < 1 || request.Stars > 5)
                throw new ApiException("Stars must be between 1 and 5.");

            var userId = Guid.Parse(_authenticatedUser.UserId);

            var spot = await _spotRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.SpotId);
            if (spot == null)
                throw new ApiException("Spot not found.");

            var existing = await _ratingRepository.GetByUserAndSpotAsync(userId, request.SpotId);

            if (existing != null)
            {
                spot.RatingSum = spot.RatingSum - existing.Stars + request.Stars;
                existing.Stars = request.Stars;
                await _ratingRepository.UpdateAsync(existing);
                await _spotRepository.UpdateAsync(spot);
                await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.SpotsPrefix, cancellationToken);
                return existing.Id;
            }

            var rating = new SpotRating
            {
                UserId = userId,
                SpotId = request.SpotId,
                Stars = request.Stars,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            spot.RatingSum += request.Stars;
            spot.RatingCount++;

            await _ratingRepository.AddAsync(rating);
            await _spotRepository.UpdateAsync(spot);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.SpotsPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return rating.Id;
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Commands.DeleteSpot
{
    public class DeleteSpotCommand : IRequest<Response<Guid>>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public Guid? EnforcedOwnerUserId { get; set; }

        public DeleteSpotCommand()
        {
        }

        public DeleteSpotCommand(Guid id)
        {
            Id = id;
        }
    }

    public class DeleteSpotCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteSpotCommand, Response<Guid>>
    {
        private readonly ISpotRepositoryAsync _spotRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public DeleteSpotCommandHandler(ISpotRepositoryAsync spotRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<Guid>> Handle(DeleteSpotCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var spot = await _spotRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.Id);
            
            if (spot == null) throw new ApiException($"Spot Not Found.");

            if (request.EnforcedOwnerUserId.HasValue && spot.OwnerUserId != request.EnforcedOwnerUserId.Value)
            {
                throw new ApiException($"Unauthorized Spot Access.");
            }

            await _spotRepository.DeleteAsync(spot);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.SpotsPrefix, cancellationToken);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.RoutesPrefix, cancellationToken);

            return new Response<Guid>(spot.Id, "Spot has been successfully deleted.");
        }
    }
}

        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string PhotoUrl { get; set; }
        public double Latitude { get; set; }
        public double Longitude { get; set; }
        public int RouteCount { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetAdminSpotsQuery : IRequest<PagedResponse<AdminSpotViewModel>>
    {
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int PageSize { get; set; }
        public string SearchTerm { get; set; }

                PageNumber = request.PageNumber <= 0 ? 1 : request.PageNumber,

            };

                IsActive = s.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = s.CreatedAt
            }).ToList();

            return new PagedResponse<AdminSpotViewModel>(mappedData, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize) 
            { 
                TotalRecords = totalRecords 
            };
        }
    }

using Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Queries.GetSpots;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Queries.GetSavedSpots
{
    public class GetSavedSpotsQuery : IRequest<Response<List<SpotListViewModel>>>
    {
        public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetSavedSpotsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetSavedSpotsQuery, Response<List<SpotListViewModel>>>
    {
        private readonly ISpotFavoriteRepositoryAsync _spotFavoriteRepository;

        public GetSavedSpotsQueryHandler(ISpotFavoriteRepositoryAsync spotFavoriteRepository)
        {
            _spotFavoriteRepository = spotFavoriteRepository;
        }

        public async Task<Response<List<SpotListViewModel>>> Handle(GetSavedSpotsQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var spots = await _spotFavoriteRepository.GetUserFavoritesAsync(request.UserId);

            var viewModelList = spots.Select(s => new SpotListViewModel
            {
                Id = s.Id,
                Name = s.Name,
                Description = s.Description,
                PhotoUrl = s.PhotoUrl,
                Latitude = s.Location?.Y ?? 0,
                Longitude = s.Location?.X ?? 0,
                AverageRating = s.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(s.RatingSum / (double)s.RatingCount, 1)
            }).ToList();

            return new Response<List<SpotListViewModel>>(viewModelList);
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Spots/Queries/GetSpotById/GetSpotByIdQuery.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Queries.GetSpotById
{
    public class GetSpotByIdQuery : IRequest<Response<SpotDetailViewModel>>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
    }

    public class SpotDetailViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string PhotoUrl { get; set; }
        public double Latitude { get; set; }
        public double Longitude { get; set; }
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
        public long RatingCount { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetSpotByIdQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetSpotByIdQuery, Response<SpotDetailViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly ISpotRepositoryAsync _spotRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetSpotByIdQueryHandler(ISpotRepositoryAsync spotRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Response<SpotDetailViewModel>> Handle(GetSpotByIdQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                AppCacheKeys.SpotDetail(request.Id),
                async _ =>
                {
                    var spot = await _spotRepository.GetSpotWithDetailsAsync(request.Id);
                    if (spot == null)
                        throw new ApiException("Spot not found.");

                    var viewModel = new SpotDetailViewModel
                    {
                        Id = spot.Id,
                        Name = spot.Name,
                        Description = spot.Description,
                        PhotoUrl = spot.PhotoUrl,
                        Latitude = spot.Location?.Y ?? 0,
                        Longitude = spot.Location?.X ?? 0,
                        AverageRating = spot.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(spot.RatingSum / (double)spot.RatingCount, 1),
                        RatingCount = spot.RatingCount,
                        CreatedAt = spot.CreatedAt
                    };

                    return new Response<SpotDetailViewModel>(viewModel);
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Spots/Queries/GetSpotRoutes/GetSpotRoutesQuery.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Queries.GetSpotRoutes
{
    public class GetSpotRoutesQuery : IRequest<PagedResponse<SpotRouteViewModel>>
    {
        public Guid SpotId { get; set; }
        public int PageNumber { get; set; } = 1;
        public int PageSize { get; set; } = 10;
    }

    public class SpotRouteViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Title { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string ThumbnailUrl { get; set; }
        public Guid AuthorUserId { get; set; }
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetSpotRoutesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetSpotRoutesQuery, PagedResponse<SpotRouteViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly ISpotRepositoryAsync _spotRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetSpotRoutesQueryHandler(ISpotRepositoryAsync spotRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<SpotRouteViewModel>> Handle(GetSpotRoutesQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var validFilter = new Ant.Application.Filters.RequestParameter(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
            var cacheKey = AppCacheKeys.SpotRoutes(request.SpotId, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize);

            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                cacheKey,
                async _ =>
                {
                    var routes = await _spotRepository.GetRoutesForSpotAsync(request.SpotId, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize);
                    var total = await _spotRepository.GetRoutesForSpotCountAsync(request.SpotId);

                    var viewModel = routes.Select(r => new SpotRouteViewModel
                    {
                        Id = r.Id,
                        Title = r.Title,
                        Description = r.Description,
                        ThumbnailUrl = r.ThumbnailUrl,
                        AuthorUserId = r.AuthorUserId,
                        AverageRating = r.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(r.RatingSum / (double)r.RatingCount, 1)
                    }).ToList();

                    return new PagedResponse<SpotRouteViewModel>(viewModel, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize)
                    {
                        TotalRecords = total
                    };
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2),
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}

================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Queries.GetSpots
{
    public class GetSpotsQuery : IRequest<PagedResponse<SpotListViewModel>>
    {
        public int PageNumber { get; set; } = 1;
        public int PageSize { get; set; } = 20;
        public string Search { get; set; }
    }

    public class SpotListViewModel
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
        public string PhotoUrl { get; set; }
        public double Latitude { get; set; }
        public double Longitude { get; set; }
        public double AverageRating { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetSpotsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetSpotsQuery, PagedResponse<SpotListViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly ISpotRepositoryAsync _spotRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetSpotsQueryHandler(ISpotRepositoryAsync spotRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _spotRepository = spotRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<SpotListViewModel>> Handle(GetSpotsQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var validFilter = new Ant.Application.Filters.RequestParameter(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
            var cacheKey = AppCacheKeys.SpotList(validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize, request.Search);

            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                cacheKey,
                async _ =>
                {
                    var spots = await _spotRepository.GetPagedSpotsAsync(validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize, request.Search);
                    var total = await _spotRepository.GetTotalSpotsCountAsync(request.Search);

                    var viewModel = spots.Select(s => new SpotListViewModel
                    {
                        Id = s.Id,
                        Name = s.Name,
                        Description = s.Description,
                        PhotoUrl = s.PhotoUrl,
                        Latitude = s.Location?.Y ?? 0,
                        Longitude = s.Location?.X ?? 0,
                        AverageRating = s.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round(s.RatingSum / (double)s.RatingCount, 1)
                    }).ToList();

                    return new PagedResponse<SpotListViewModel>(viewModel, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize)
                    {
                        TotalRecords = total
                    };
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2),
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Tags/Commands/CreateTag/CreateTagCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Tags.Commands.CreateTag
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Command to create a new Tag in the database.
    /// When a user sends a POST request with a tag name, this command handles the logic.
    /// </summary>
    public class CreateTagCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string Description { get; set; }
    }

    public class CreateTagCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateTagCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly ITagRepositoryAsync _tagRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public CreateTagCommandHandler(ITagRepositoryAsync tagRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _tagRepository = tagRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateTagCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var newTag = new Tag
            {
                Name = request.Name,
                Description = request.Description,
                IsActive = true
            };

            await _tagRepository.AddAsync(newTag);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.TagsPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return newTag.Id;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Tags/Commands/DeleteTagById/DeleteTagByIdCommand.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Tags.Commands.DeleteTagById
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Command to delete a Tag by its unique ID.
    /// If the tag does not exist, it throws a friendly error message.
    /// </summary>
    public class DeleteTagByIdCommand : IRequest<Guid>
    {
        public Guid Id { get; set; }
    }

    public class DeleteTagByIdCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteTagByIdCommand, Guid>
    {
        private readonly ITagRepositoryAsync _tagRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public DeleteTagByIdCommandHandler(ITagRepositoryAsync tagRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _tagRepository = tagRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<Guid> Handle(DeleteTagByIdCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var tag = await _tagRepository.GetByIdAsync(command.Id);
            if (tag == null) throw new ApiException($"Tag Not Found.");
            await _tagRepository.DeleteAsync(tag);
            await _cache.RemoveByPrefixAsync(AppCacheKeys.TagsPrefix, cancellationToken);
            return tag.Id;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Features/Tags/Queries/GetAllTags/GetAllTagsQuery.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Common.Caching;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using MediatR;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Application.Features.Tags.Queries.GetAllTags
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Query to fetch all tags from the database with pagination.
    /// Used by the GET /api/v1/Tag endpoint.
    /// </summary>
    public class GetAllTagsQuery : IRequest<PagedResponse<GetAllTagsViewModel>>
    {
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int PageSize { get; set; }
    }

    public class GetAllTagsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetAllTagsQuery, PagedResponse<GetAllTagsViewModel>>
    {
        private readonly ITagRepositoryAsync _tagRepository;
        private readonly IAppCacheService _cache;

        public GetAllTagsQueryHandler(ITagRepositoryAsync tagRepository, IAppCacheService cache)
        {
            _tagRepository = tagRepository;
            _cache = cache;
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<GetAllTagsViewModel>> Handle(GetAllTagsQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var validFilter = new GetAllTagsParameter
            {
                PageNumber = request.PageNumber,
                PageSize = request.PageSize
            };

            return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
                AppCacheKeys.TagList(validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize),
                async _ =>
                {
                    var result = await _tagRepository.GetPagedReponseAsync(validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize);
                    var viewModels = result.Select(MapToViewModel).ToList();
                    return new PagedResponse<GetAllTagsViewModel>(viewModels, validFilter.PageNumber, validFilter.PageSize);
                },
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
                cancellationToken);
        }

        private static GetAllTagsViewModel MapToViewModel(Tag tag)
        {
            return new GetAllTagsViewModel
            {
                Id = tag.Id,
                Name = tag.Name,
                Description = tag.Description,
                IsActive = tag.IsActive
            };
        }
    }
}

namespace Ant.Application.Interfaces
{
    public interface IGenericRepositoryAsync<T> where T : class
    {
        Task<T> GetByIdAsync(Guid id);
        Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAllAsync();
        Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetPagedReponseAsync(int pageNumber, int pageSize);
        Task<T> AddAsync(T entity);
        Task UpdateAsync(T entity);
        Task DeleteAsync(T entity);
        Task<int> GetCountAsync();
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Parameters/RequestParameter.cs

namespace Ant.Application.Filters
{
    public class RequestParameter
    {
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int PageSize { get; set; }
        public RequestParameter()
        {
            this.PageNumber = 1;
            this.PageSize = 10;
        }
        public RequestParameter(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
        {
            this.PageNumber = pageNumber < 1 ? 1 : pageNumber;
            this.PageSize = pageSize > 100 ? 100 : pageSize;
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Ant.Application.Wrappers
{
    public class PagedResponse<T> 
    {
        public int PageNumber { get; set; }
        public int PageSize { get; set; }
        public int TotalRecords { get; set; }
        public int TotalPages { get; set; }
        public List<T> Data { get; set; }

        public PagedResponse(List<T> data, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
        {
            this.PageNumber = pageNumber;
            this.PageSize = pageSize;
            this.Data = data;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Application/Wrappers/Response.cs
================================================
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Ant.Application.Wrappers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// This is a "Standard Package" for our API responses.
    /// Instead of just sending raw data, we wrap it in this class so the mobile app
    /// always knows if the request was successful, what the message is, and if there are errors.
    /// </summary>
    public class Response<T>
    {
        public Response()
        {
        }

        // Use this when everything goes well.
        public Response(T data, string message = null)
        {
            Succeeded = true;
            Message = message;
            Data = data;
        }

        // Use this when there is an error (e.g., "Tag not found").
        public Response(string message)
        {
            Succeeded = false;
            Message = message;
        }

        // Did the request work?
        public bool Succeeded { get; set; }

        // A friendly message for the user (e.g., "Tag deleted successfully").
        public string Message { get; set; }

        // If something went wrong, we list the specific errors here.
        public List<string> Errors { get; set; }

        // The actual data we are sending back (e.g., a list of categories).
        public T Data { get; set; }
    }
}

        public string CustomDescription { get; set; }
        public string CustomPhotoUrl { get; set; }
        
        /// <summary>

    }

using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using Ant.Application.Settings;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Caching;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Models;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Repositories;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Repository;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure
{
    public static class ServiceRegistration
    {
        public static void AddPersistenceInfrastructure(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            if (configuration.GetValue<bool>("UseInMemoryDatabase"))
            {
                services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
                    options.UseInMemoryDatabase("ApplicationDb"));
            }
            else
            {
                services.AddDbContext<ApplicationDbContext>(options =>
               options.UseNpgsql(
                   configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"),
                   b => b.MigrationsAssembly(typeof(ApplicationDbContext).Assembly.FullName)
                         .UseNetTopologySuite()
                         .EnableRetryOnFailure(5, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), null)
                         .CommandTimeout(60)));
            }



            services.AddMemoryCache();
            services.AddSingleton<IAppCacheService, AppMemoryCacheService>();

            services.AddIdentity<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole<Guid>>().AddEntityFrameworkStores<ApplicationDbContext>().AddDefaultTokenProviders();
            #region Services
            services.AddTransient<IAuthService, AuthService>();
            services.AddTransient<IIdentityService, IdentityService>();
            
            // Use OSRM for map routing
            services.AddHttpClient<IMapRoutingService, OsrmMapRoutingService>(client =>
            {
                var osrmBaseUrl = configuration["Routing:OsrmBaseUrl"] ?? "http://router.project-osrm.org/";
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(osrmBaseUrl);
                client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);
            })
            .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new SocketsHttpHandler
            {
                PooledConnectionLifetime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
                PooledConnectionIdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2),
                MaxConnectionsPerServer = 20,
                AutomaticDecompression = DecompressionMethods.GZip | DecompressionMethods.Deflate | DecompressionMethods.Brotli
            })
            .SetHandlerLifetime(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10));
            #endregion
            services.Configure<JWTSettings>(configuration.GetSection("JWTSettings"));
            services.AddAuthentication(options =>
            {
                options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
                options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            })
                .AddJwtBearer(o =>
                {
                    o.RequireHttpsMetadata = false;
                    o.SaveToken = false;
                    o.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
                    {
                        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                        ValidateIssuer = true,
                        ValidateAudience = true,
                        ValidateLifetime = true,
                        ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero,
                        ValidIssuer = configuration["JWTSettings:Issuer"],
                        ValidAudience = configuration["JWTSettings:Audience"],
                        IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(configuration["JWTSettings:Key"])),
                        RoleClaimType = ClaimTypes.Role
                    };
                    o.Events = new JwtBearerEvents()
                    {
                        OnAuthenticationFailed = c =>
                        {
                            c.NoResult();
                            c.Response.StatusCode = 401;
                            c.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
                            return c.Response.WriteAsync("Authentication failed.");
                        },
                        OnChallenge = context =>
                        {
                            context.HandleResponse();
                            context.Response.StatusCode = 401;
                            context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
                            var result = "You are not Authorized";
                            return context.Response.WriteAsync(result);
                        },
                        OnForbidden = context =>
                        {
                            context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                            context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
                            var result = "You are not authorized to access this resource";
                            return context.Response.WriteAsync(result);
                        },
                    };
                });




            services.Configure<MailSettings>(configuration.GetSection("MailSettings"));
            services.AddTransient<IDateTimeService, DateTimeService>();
            services.AddTransient<IEmailService, EmailService>();


            #region Repositories
            services.AddTransient(typeof(IGenericRepositoryAsync<>), typeof(GenericRepositoryAsync<>));

            services.AddTransient<ITagRepositoryAsync, TagRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<ISpotRepositoryAsync, SpotRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<IRouteRepositoryAsync, RouteRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<ICollectionRepositoryAsync, CollectionRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<IRouteRatingRepositoryAsync, RouteRatingRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<ISpotRatingRepositoryAsync, SpotRatingRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync, RouteSpotRepositoryAsync>();
            services.AddTransient<ISpotFavoriteRepositoryAsync, SpotFavoriteRepositoryAsync>();
            #endregion
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Caching/AppMemoryCacheService.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Caching
{
    public class AppMemoryCacheService : IAppCacheService
    {
        private readonly IMemoryCache _memoryCache;
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, byte> _keys = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, SemaphoreSlim> _locks = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        public AppMemoryCacheService(IMemoryCache memoryCache)
        {
            _memoryCache = memoryCache;
        }

        public async Task<T> GetOrCreateAsync<T>(string key, Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> factory, TimeSpan ttl, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (_memoryCache.TryGetValue(key, out T cachedValue))
            {
                return cachedValue;
            }

            var cacheLock = _locks.GetOrAdd(key, _ => new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1));
            await cacheLock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);

            try
            {
                if (_memoryCache.TryGetValue(key, out cachedValue))
                {
                    return cachedValue;
                }

                var value = await factory(cancellationToken);
                var options = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions
                {
                    AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = ttl
                };

                options.RegisterPostEvictionCallback(static (evictedKey, _, _, state) =>
                {
                    if (evictedKey is not string cacheKey || state is not ConcurrentDictionary<string, byte> keys)
                    {
                        return;
                    }

                    keys.TryRemove(cacheKey, out _);
                }, _keys);

                _memoryCache.Set(key, value, options);
                _keys[key] = 0;

                return value;
            }
            finally
            {
                cacheLock.Release();
                if (cacheLock.CurrentCount == 1)
                {
                    _locks.TryRemove(key, out _);
                }
            }
        }

        public Task RemoveAsync(string key, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            _memoryCache.Remove(key);
            _keys.TryRemove(key, out _);
            _locks.TryRemove(key, out _);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public Task RemoveByPrefixAsync(string prefix, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var keysToRemove = _keys.Keys
                .Where(key => key.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .ToList();

            foreach (var key in keysToRemove)
            {
                _memoryCache.Remove(key);
                _keys.TryRemove(key, out _);
                _locks.TryRemove(key, out _);
            }

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Contexts/ApplicationDbContext.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.ChangeTracking;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts
{
    /// <summary>
    /// This is the "Heart" of our database connection.
    /// It maps our C# classes (Entities) to the actual tables in PostgreSQL (Supabase).
    /// If you add a new table to the database, you must register it here.
    /// </summary>
    public class ApplicationDbContext : IdentityDbContext<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole<Guid>, Guid>
    {
        private readonly IDateTimeService _dateTime;
        public ApplicationDbContext(DbContextOptions<ApplicationDbContext> options, IDateTimeService dateTime, IAuthenticatedUserService authenticatedUser) : base(options)
        {
            ChangeTracker.QueryTrackingBehavior = QueryTrackingBehavior.NoTracking;
            _dateTime = dateTime;
        }

        // Below are the tables currently in our database:
        public DbSet<Tag> Tags { get; set; }             // Tag (Label) table
        public DbSet<RouteTag> RouteTags { get; set; }   // Bridge: Route <-> Tag (many-to-many)
        public DbSet<Spot> Spots { get; set; }          // Spot (Place) table
        public DbSet<Route> Routes { get; set; }        // Route table
        public DbSet<RouteSpot> RouteSpots { get; set; } // Junction table for Routes and Spots
        public DbSet<Collection> Collections { get; set; }
        public DbSet<CollectionRoute> CollectionRoutes { get; set; }
        public DbSet<RouteRating> RouteRatings { get; set; }
        public DbSet<SpotRating> SpotRatings { get; set; }
        public DbSet<SpotFavorite> SpotFavorites { get; set; }
        public DbSet<User> DomainUsers { get; set; }

        public override Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = new CancellationToken())
        {
            SetTimestamps(ChangeTracker.Entries<Route>());
            SetTimestamps(ChangeTracker.Entries<Collection>());
            SetTimestamps(ChangeTracker.Entries<Spot>());

            return base.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        private void SetTimestamps<TEntity>(IEnumerable<EntityEntry<TEntity>> entries) where TEntity : class
        {
            foreach (var entry in entries)
            {
                switch (entry.State)
                {
                    case EntityState.Added:
                        entry.Property("CreatedAt").CurrentValue = _dateTime.NowUtc;
                        entry.Property("UpdatedAt").CurrentValue = _dateTime.NowUtc;
                        break;
                    case EntityState.Modified:
                        entry.Property("UpdatedAt").CurrentValue = _dateTime.NowUtc;
                        break;
                }
            }
        }
        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
        {

            builder.Entity<ApplicationUser>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable(name: "User");
                entity.OwnsMany(u => u.RefreshTokens);
                entity.HasOne(u => u.User)
                    .WithOne()
                    .HasForeignKey<User>(u => u.Id)
                    .HasPrincipalKey<ApplicationUser>(u => u.Id)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            });

            builder.Entity<User>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("Users");
                entity.HasIndex(u => u.UserName).IsUnique();
            });

            builder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");
            builder.HasPostgresExtension("pg_trgm");

            builder.Entity<Route>(entity =>
            {
                entity.HasIndex(r => r.CenterLocation).HasMethod("GIST");
                entity.HasIndex(r => new { r.IsDeleted, r.IsPublic, r.CreatedAt });
                entity.HasIndex(r => new { r.AuthorUserId, r.CreatedAt });
                entity.HasIndex(r => r.Title).HasMethod("GIN").HasOperators("gin_trgm_ops");
                entity.HasIndex(r => r.Description).HasMethod("GIN").HasOperators("gin_trgm_ops");
            });

            // Many-to-many: Route <-> Tag (via RouteTag bridge table)
            builder.Entity<RouteTag>()
                .HasKey(rt => new { rt.RouteId, rt.TagId });

            builder.Entity<RouteSpot>(entity =>
            {
                entity.HasKey(rs => rs.Id);
                entity.HasIndex(rs => new { rs.RouteId, rs.SpotOrder }).IsUnique();
            });

            builder.Entity<Spot>(entity =>
            {
                entity.HasOne(s => s.OwnerUser)
                    .WithMany(u => u.OwnedSpots)
                    .HasForeignKey(s => s.OwnerUserId)
                    .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);
                entity.HasIndex(s => s.Location).HasMethod("GIST");
                entity.HasIndex(s => new { s.IsActive, s.CreatedAt });
                entity.HasIndex(s => new { s.OwnerUserId, s.CreatedAt });
                entity.HasIndex(s => s.Name).HasMethod("GIN").HasOperators("gin_trgm_ops");
                entity.HasIndex(s => s.Description).HasMethod("GIN").HasOperators("gin_trgm_ops");
            });

            builder.Entity<CollectionRoute>()
                .HasKey(cr => new { cr.CollectionId, cr.RouteId });

            builder.Entity<Route>()
                .HasOne(r => r.AuthorUser)
                .WithMany(u => u.AuthoredRoutes)
                .HasForeignKey(r => r.AuthorUserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            builder.Entity<Collection>()
                .HasOne(c => c.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.Collections)
                .HasForeignKey(c => c.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            builder.Entity<RouteRating>()
                .HasOne(rr => rr.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.RouteRatings)
                .HasForeignKey(rr => rr.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            builder.Entity<SpotRating>()
                .HasOne(sr => sr.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.SpotRatings)
                .HasForeignKey(sr => sr.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            builder.Entity<SpotFavorite>()
                .HasKey(sf => new { sf.UserId, sf.SpotId });

            builder.Entity<SpotFavorite>()
                .HasOne(sf => sf.User)
                .WithMany(u => u.FavoriteSpots)
                .HasForeignKey(sf => sf.UserId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            builder.Entity<SpotFavorite>()
                .HasOne(sf => sf.Spot)
                .WithMany(s => s.FavoritedBy)
                .HasForeignKey(sf => sf.SpotId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            builder.Entity<IdentityRole<Guid>>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable(name: "Role");
            });
            builder.Entity<IdentityUserRole<Guid>>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("UserRoles");
            });

            builder.Entity<IdentityUserClaim<Guid>>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("UserClaims");
            });

            builder.Entity<IdentityUserLogin<Guid>>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("UserLogins");
            });

            builder.Entity<IdentityRoleClaim<Guid>>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("RoleClaims");

            });

            builder.Entity<IdentityUserToken<Guid>>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("UserTokens");
            });

            //All Decimals will have 18,6 Range
            foreach (var property in builder.Model.GetEntityTypes()
            .SelectMany(t => t.GetProperties())
            .Where(p => p.ClrType == typeof(decimal) || p.ClrType == typeof(decimal?)))
            {
                property.SetColumnType("decimal(18,6)");
            }
            base.OnModelCreating(builder);
        }
    }

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System;
using System.Text;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Helpers
{
    public class AuthenticationHelper
    {
        public static void ConfigureService(IServiceCollection service, string Issuer, string Audience, string Key)
        {
            service.AddAuthentication(options =>
            {
                options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
                options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            })

                .AddJwtBearer(o =>
                {
                    o.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
                    {
                        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                        ValidateIssuer = true,
                        ValidateAudience = true,
                        ValidateLifetime = true,
                        ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero,

                        ValidIssuer = Issuer,
                        ValidAudience = Audience,
                        IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Key))
                    };
                });
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Helpers/IpHelper.cs
================================================
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Helpers
{
    public class IpHelper
    {
        public static string GetIpAddress()
        {
            var host = Dns.GetHostEntry(Dns.GetHostName());
            foreach (var ip in host.AddressList)
            {
                if (ip.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
                {
                    return ip.ToString();
                }
            }
            return string.Empty;
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.DTOs.Account;
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Models
{
    // for authentication 
    public class ApplicationUser : IdentityUser<Guid>
    {
        public UserTypeEnum UserType { get; set; }
        public virtual User User { get; set; }
        public List<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens { get; set; }

        public bool OwnsToken(string token)
        {
            return this.RefreshTokens?.Find(x => x.Token == token) != null;
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Repositories/CollectionRepositoryAsync.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Repository;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    public class CollectionRepositoryAsync : GenericRepositoryAsync<Collection>, ICollectionRepositoryAsync
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context;

        public CollectionRepositoryAsync(ApplicationDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
        {
            _context = dbContext;
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Collection>> GetCollectionsByUserIdAsync(Guid userId, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
        {
            return await _context.Collections
                .Where(c => c.UserId == userId)
                .Include(c => c.CollectionRoutes)
                .OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt)
                .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .AsNoTracking()
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<int> GetCountByUserIdAsync(Guid userId)
        {
            return await _context.Collections
                .CountAsync(c => c.UserId == userId);
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Collection>> GetAllCollectionsPagedAsync(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
        {
            return await _context.Collections
                .Include(c => c.CollectionRoutes)
                .OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt)
                .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .AsNoTracking()
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<Collection> GetCollectionWithRoutesAsync(Guid id)
        {
            return await _context.Collections
                .Include(c => c.CollectionRoutes)
                    .ThenInclude(cr => cr.Route)
                .AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == id);
        }

        public async Task<Collection> GetDefaultCollectionAsync(Guid userId)
        {
            return await _context.Collections
                .AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.UserId == userId && c.IsDefault);
        }

        public async Task<Collection> GetOrCreateDefaultCollectionAsync(Guid userId)
        {
            var existing = await _context.Collections
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.UserId == userId && c.IsDefault);

            if (existing != null)
                return existing;

            var defaultCollection = new Collection
            {
                UserId = userId,
                Name = "Saved Routes",
                IsDefault = true,
                IsPublic = false,
                Description = string.Empty,
                ThumbnailUrl = string.Empty
            };

            await _context.Collections.AddAsync(defaultCollection);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            return defaultCollection;
        }

        public async Task<CollectionRoute> GetCollectionRouteAsync(Guid collectionId, Guid routeId)
        {
            return await _context.CollectionRoutes
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cr => cr.CollectionId == collectionId && cr.RouteId == routeId);
        }

        public async Task AddCollectionRouteAsync(CollectionRoute collectionRoute)
        {
            await _context.CollectionRoutes.AddAsync(collectionRoute);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        public async Task RemoveCollectionRouteAsync(CollectionRoute collectionRoute)
        {
            var tracked = _context.CollectionRoutes.Local
                .FirstOrDefault(cr => cr.CollectionId == collectionRoute.CollectionId && cr.RouteId == collectionRoute.RouteId);

            _context.CollectionRoutes.Remove(tracked ?? collectionRoute);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Repositories/GenericRepositoryAsync.cs
================================================
using System;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Repository
{
    /// <summary>
    /// This is the "Generic Helper" for database work.
    /// Instead of writing "Save to Database" code for every single table, we wrote it once here.
    /// It can handle Categories, Routes, Spots, or anything else we add later.
    /// </summary>
    public class GenericRepositoryAsync<T> : IGenericRepositoryAsync<T> where T : class
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _dbContext;

        // We inject the Database Context (the connection) here.
        public GenericRepositoryAsync(ApplicationDbContext dbContext)
        {
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }

        public virtual async Task<T> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
        {
            return await _dbContext.Set<T>().FindAsync(id);
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetPagedReponseAsync(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
        {
            return await _dbContext
                .Set<T>()
                .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .AsNoTracking()
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<T> AddAsync(T entity)
        {
            await _dbContext.Set<T>().AddAsync(entity);
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
            return entity;
        }

        public async Task UpdateAsync(T entity)
        {
            _dbContext.Entry(entity).State = EntityState.Modified;
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        public async Task DeleteAsync(T entity)
        {
            _dbContext.Set<T>().Remove(entity);
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAllAsync()
        {
            return await _dbContext
                 .Set<T>()
                 .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<int> GetCountAsync()
        {
            return await _dbContext.Set<T>().CountAsync();
        }
    }
}

================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Repositories/RouteRepositoryAsync.cs
================================================
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Repository;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    public class RouteRepositoryAsync : GenericRepositoryAsync<Route>, IRouteRepositoryAsync
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _dbContext;

        public RouteRepositoryAsync(ApplicationDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
        {
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }

        public async Task<Route> GetRouteWithSpotsAsync(Guid routeId)
        {
            return await _dbContext.Routes
                .AsNoTracking()
                .AsSplitQuery()
                .Include(r => r.RouteSpots)
                    .ThenInclude(rs => rs.Spot)
                .Include(r => r.RouteTags)
                    .ThenInclude(rt => rt.Tag)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Id == routeId);
        }

        public async Task<Route> GetRouteWithTrackingAsync(Guid routeId)
        {
            return await _dbContext.Routes
                .AsTracking()
                .Include(r => r.RouteSpots)
                .Include(r => r.RouteTags)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Id == routeId);
        }

        private IQueryable<Route> BuildFilteredQuery(
            string searchTerm, Guid? tagId, List<Guid> tagIds,
            double? nearLat, double? nearLng, double? radiusKm,
            Guid? authorId, string visibility, RouteContentTypeEnum? contentType)
        {
            var query = _dbContext.Routes.AsNoTracking().Where(r => !r.IsDeleted);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(visibility))
            {
                query = visibility.ToLower() switch
                {
                    "public" => query.Where(r => r.IsPublic),
                    "draft" => query.Where(r => !r.IsPublic),
                    _ => query.Where(r => r.IsPublic)
                };
            }
            else
            {
                query = query.Where(r => r.IsPublic);
            }

            if (authorId.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(r => r.AuthorUserId == authorId.Value);

            if (contentType.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(r => r.ContentType == contentType.Value);

            if (tagId.HasValue)
                query = query.Where(r => r.RouteTags.Any(rt => rt.TagId == tagId.Value));

            if (tagIds != null && tagIds.Count > 0)
                query = query.Where(r => r.RouteTags.Any(rt => tagIds.Contains(rt.TagId)));

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
            {
                var pattern = $"%{searchTerm.Trim()}%";
                query = query.Where(r => EF.Functions.ILike(r.Title, pattern)
                                      || EF.Functions.ILike(r.Description, pattern));
            }

            if (nearLat.HasValue && nearLng.HasValue && radiusKm.HasValue)
            {
                var radiusMeters = radiusKm.Value * 1000;
                var point = new Point(nearLng.Value, nearLat.Value) { SRID = 4326 };
                query = query.Where(r => r.RouteSpots.Any(rs => rs.Spot.Location.Distance(point) <= radiusMeters));
            }

            return query;
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Route>> GetPagedRoutesAsync(
            int pageNumber, int pageSize,
            string searchTerm, Guid? tagId, List<Guid> tagIds,
            string sort,
            double? nearLat, double? nearLng, double? radiusKm,
            Guid? authorId, string visibility, RouteContentTypeEnum? contentType)
        {
            var query = BuildFilteredQuery(searchTerm, tagId, tagIds, nearLat, nearLng, radiusKm, authorId, visibility, contentType);

            query = sort?.ToLower() switch
            {
                "rating" => query.OrderByDescending(r => r.RatingCount == 0 ? 0 : (r.RatingSum * 1.0) / r.RatingCount),
                "oldest" => query.OrderBy(r => r.CreatedAt),
                _ => query.OrderByDescending(r => r.CreatedAt)
            };

            return await query
                .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<int> GetTotalRoutesCountAsync(
            string searchTerm, Guid? tagId, List<Guid> tagIds,
            double? nearLat, double? nearLng, double? radiusKm,
            Guid? authorId, string visibility, RouteContentTypeEnum? contentType)
        {
            return await BuildFilteredQuery(searchTerm, tagId, tagIds, nearLat, nearLng, radiusKm, authorId, visibility, contentType).CountAsync();
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Route>> GetNearbyRoutesAsync(double latitude, double longitude, double radiusInMeters, int pageNumber, int pageSize)
        {
            var targetLocation = new Point(longitude, latitude) { SRID = 4326 };

            return await _dbContext.Routes.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(r => r.IsPublic && !r.IsDeleted && r.RouteSpots.Any(rs => rs.Spot.Location.Distance(targetLocation) <= radiusInMeters))
                .OrderBy(r => r.RouteSpots.Min(rs => rs.Spot.Location.Distance(targetLocation)))
                .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToListAsync();
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces.Repositories;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Repository;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    public class RouteSpotRepositoryAsync : GenericRepositoryAsync<RouteSpot>, IRouteSpotRepositoryAsync
    {
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _dbContext;

        public RouteSpotRepositoryAsync(ApplicationDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
        {
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<RouteSpot>> GetStopsForRouteAsync(Guid routeId)
        {
            return await _dbContext.RouteSpots
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(rs => rs.Spot)
                .Where(rs => rs.RouteId == routeId)
                .OrderBy(rs => rs.SpotOrder)
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<RouteSpot> GetStopWithTrackingAsync(Guid routeStopId)
        {
            return await _dbContext.RouteSpots
                .AsTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(rs => rs.Id == routeStopId);
        }

        public async Task<int> GetMaxOrderForRouteAsync(Guid routeId)
        {
            var hasStops = await _dbContext.RouteSpots.AnyAsync(rs => rs.RouteId == routeId);
            if (!hasStops) return 0;
            return await _dbContext.RouteSpots
                .Where(rs => rs.RouteId == routeId)
                .MaxAsync(rs => rs.SpotOrder);
        }

        public async Task ReorderStopsAsync(Guid routeId, List<Guid> orderedStopIds)
        {
            var stops = await _dbContext.RouteSpots
                .AsTracking()
                .Where(rs => rs.RouteId == routeId)
                .ToListAsync();

            for (int i = 0; i < orderedStopIds.Count; i++)
            {
                var stop = stops.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Id == orderedStopIds[i]);
                if (stop != null)
                    stop.SpotOrder = i + 1;
            }

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
    }
}

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
            {

                query = query.Where(s => EF.Functions.ILike(s.Name, pattern) || EF.Functions.ILike(s.Description, pattern));
            }

                .OrderByDescending(s => s.CreatedAt)
                .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .ToListAsync();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
            {
                var pattern = $"%{searchTerm.Trim()}%";
                query = query.Where(s => EF.Functions.ILike(s.Name, pattern) || EF.Functions.ILike(s.Description, pattern));
            }

            return await query.CountAsync();
        }
