================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Services/AuthService.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.DTOs.Account;
using Ant.Application.DTOs.Email;
using Ant.Core.Entities;
using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Settings;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Helpers;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class AuthService : IAuthService
    {
        private readonly UserManager<ApplicationUser> _userManager;
        private readonly RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>> _roleManager;
        private readonly SignInManager<ApplicationUser> _signInManager;
        private readonly IEmailService _emailService;
        private readonly JWTSettings _jwtSettings;
        private readonly IDateTimeService _dateTimeService;
        private readonly ApplicationDbContext _dbContext;

        public AuthService(UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager,
            RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>> roleManager,
            IOptions<JWTSettings> jwtSettings,
            IDateTimeService dateTimeService,
            SignInManager<ApplicationUser> signInManager,
            IEmailService emailService,
            ApplicationDbContext dbContext)
        {
            _userManager = userManager;
            _roleManager = roleManager;
            _jwtSettings = jwtSettings.Value;
            _dateTimeService = dateTimeService;
            _signInManager = signInManager;
            _emailService = emailService;
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }

        public async Task<AuthenticationResponse> AuthenticateAsync(AuthenticationRequest request, string ipAddress)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(request.Email);
            if (user == null)
                throw new ApiException($"No Accounts Registered with {request.Email}.");

            var result = await _signInManager.PasswordSignInAsync(user.UserName, request.Password, false, lockoutOnFailure: false);
            if (!result.Succeeded)
                throw new ApiException($"Invalid Credentials for '{request.Email}'.");

            if (!user.EmailConfirmed)
                throw new ApiException($"Account Not Confirmed for '{request.Email}'.");

            JwtSecurityToken jwtSecurityToken = await GenerateJWToken(user);

            var response = new AuthenticationResponse
            {
                Id = user.Id.ToString(),
                JWToken = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(jwtSecurityToken),
                Email = user.Email,
                UserName = user.UserName,
                IsVerified = user.EmailConfirmed
            };

            var rolesList = await _userManager.GetRolesAsync(user).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var activeRoles = rolesList.ToList();
            if (user.UserName?.ToLower() == "antadmin" && !activeRoles.Contains("Admin")) activeRoles.Add("Admin");
            response.Roles = activeRoles;

            var refreshToken = GenerateRefreshToken(ipAddress);
            response.RefreshToken = refreshToken.Token;

            var trackedUser = await _userManager.Users
                .AsTracking()
                .Include(u => u.RefreshTokens)
                .SingleAsync(u => u.Id == user.Id);
            trackedUser.RefreshTokens ??= new List<RefreshToken>();
            trackedUser.RefreshTokens.Add(refreshToken);
            await _userManager.UpdateAsync(trackedUser);

            return response;
        }

        public async Task<AuthenticationResponse> RefreshTokenAsync(string token, string ipAddress)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.Users
                .AsTracking()
                .Include(u => u.RefreshTokens)
                .SingleOrDefaultAsync(u => u.RefreshTokens.Any(t => t.Token == token));

            if (user == null) throw new ApiException("Invalid token.");

            var refreshToken = user.RefreshTokens.Single(x => x.Token == token);
            if (!refreshToken.IsActive) throw new ApiException("Invalid token.");

            var newRefreshToken = GenerateRefreshToken(ipAddress);
            refreshToken.Revoked = DateTime.UtcNow;
            refreshToken.RevokedByIp = ipAddress;
            refreshToken.ReplacedByToken = newRefreshToken.Token;
            user.RefreshTokens.Add(newRefreshToken);
            await _userManager.UpdateAsync(user);

            var jwtSecurityToken = await GenerateJWToken(user);
            var rolesList = await _userManager.GetRolesAsync(user);
            var activeRoles = rolesList.ToList();
            if (user.UserName?.ToLower() == "antadmin" && !activeRoles.Contains("Admin")) activeRoles.Add("Admin");

            return new AuthenticationResponse
            {
                Id = user.Id.ToString(),
                JWToken = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(jwtSecurityToken),
                Email = user.Email,
                UserName = user.UserName,
                IsVerified = user.EmailConfirmed,
                RefreshToken = newRefreshToken.Token,
                Roles = activeRoles
            };
        }

        public async Task<string> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request, string origin)
        {
            var userWithSameUserName = await _userManager.FindByNameAsync(request.UserName);
            if (userWithSameUserName != null)
                throw new ApiException($"Username '{request.UserName}' is already taken.");

            var userId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                Id = userId,
                Email = request.Email,
                UserName = request.UserName,
                UserType = request.UserType,
                EmailConfirmed = false
            };

            var domainUser = new User
            {
                Id = userId,
                UserName = request.UserName
            };

            var userWithSameEmail = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(request.Email);
            if (userWithSameEmail == null)
            {
                var result = await _userManager.CreateAsync(user, request.Password);
                if (result.Succeeded)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        _dbContext.DomainUsers.Add(domainUser);
                        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        await _userManager.DeleteAsync(user);
                        throw;
                    }

                    var roleNames = new List<string> { RoleNames.BasicUser };

                    if (request.UserType == UserTypeEnum.BusinessUser)
                        roleNames.Add(RoleNames.BusinessUser);
                    else if (request.UserType == UserTypeEnum.Admin)
                        roleNames.Add(RoleNames.Admin);

                    foreach (var roleName in roleNames.Distinct())
                        await _userManager.AddToRoleAsync(user, roleName);

                    var verificationUri = await SendVerificationEmail(user, origin);
                    return $"Account created successfully. Please confirm your email: {verificationUri}";
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new ApiException(string.Join(", ", result.Errors.Select(e => e.Description)));
                }
            }
            else
            {
                throw new ApiException($"Email {request.Email} is already registered.");
            }
        }

        public async Task<string> ConfirmEmailAsync(string userId, string code)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.FindByIdAsync(userId);
            if (user == null) throw new ApiException("User not found.");

            code = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(WebEncoders.Base64UrlDecode(code));

            var result = await _userManager.ConfirmEmailAsync(user, code);
            if (result.Succeeded)
                return $"Account Confirmed for {user.Email}. You can now log in.";
            else
                throw new ApiException($"An error occurred while confirming {user.Email}.");
        }

        public async Task ForgotPassword(ForgotPasswordRequest model, string origin)
        {
            var account = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(model.Email);
            if (account == null) return;

            var code = await _userManager.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(account);
            var emailRequest = new EmailRequest()
            {
                Body = $"Your password reset token is: {code}",
                To = model.Email,
                Subject = "Reset Password",
            };

            try { await _emailService.SendAsync(emailRequest); } catch { }
        }

        public async Task<string> ResetPassword(ResetPasswordRequest model)
        {
            var account = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(model.Email);
            if (account == null) throw new ApiException($"No Accounts Registered with {model.Email}.");

            var result = await _userManager.ResetPasswordAsync(account, model.Token, model.Password);
            if (result.Succeeded)
                return "Password Reset Successful.";
            else
                throw new ApiException("Error occurred while resetting the password.");
        }

        private async Task<JwtSecurityToken> GenerateJWToken(ApplicationUser user)
        {
            var userClaims = await _userManager.GetClaimsAsync(user);
            var roles = await _userManager.GetRolesAsync(user);
            var roleList = roles.ToList();
            if (user.UserName?.ToLower() == "antadmin" && !roleList.Contains("Admin")) roleList.Add("Admin");
            var roleClaims = roleList.Select(role => new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, role)).ToList();

            string ipAddress = IpHelper.GetIpAddress();

            var claims = new[]
            {
                new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.UserName),
                new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
                new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
                new Claim("uid", user.Id.ToString()),
                new Claim("ip", ipAddress)
            }
            .Union(userClaims)
            .Union(roleClaims);

            var symmetricSecurityKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_jwtSettings.Key));
            var signingCredentials = new SigningCredentials(symmetricSecurityKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

            var jwtSecurityToken = new JwtSecurityToken(
                issuer: _jwtSettings.Issuer,
                audience: _jwtSettings.Audience,
                claims: claims,
                expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(_jwtSettings.DurationInMinutes),
                signingCredentials: signingCredentials);

            return jwtSecurityToken;
        }

        private string RandomTokenString()
        {
            var randomBytes = new byte[40];
            RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(randomBytes);
            return BitConverter.ToString(randomBytes).Replace("-", "");
        }

        private async Task<string> SendVerificationEmail(ApplicationUser user, string origin)
        {
            var code = await _userManager.GenerateEmailConfirmationTokenAsync(user);
            code = WebEncoders.Base64UrlEncode(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(code));

            var route = "api/auth/confirm-email/";
            var endpointUri = new Uri(string.Concat($"{origin}/", route));

            var verificationUri = QueryHelpers.AddQueryString(endpointUri.ToString(), "userId", user.Id.ToString());
            verificationUri = QueryHelpers.AddQueryString(verificationUri, "code", code);

            return verificationUri;
        }

        private RefreshToken GenerateRefreshToken(string ipAddress)
        {
            return new RefreshToken
            {
                Token = RandomTokenString(),
                Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(7),
                Created = DateTime.UtcNow,
                CreatedByIp = ipAddress
            };
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Services/DummyMapRoutingService.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.DTOs;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class DummyMapRoutingService : IMapRoutingService
    {
        public Task<RouteGeometryResult> GetRouteGeometryAsync(List<Point> waypoints, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (waypoints == null || waypoints.Count < 2)
            {
                throw new ApiException("At least two waypoints are required to compute a route.");
            }

            // Calculate direct haversine distance as fallback
            double totalDistanceKm = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < waypoints.Count - 1; i++)
            {
                totalDistanceKm += CalculateHaversineDistance(waypoints[i], waypoints[i + 1]);
            }

            int distanceMeters = (int)Math.Round(totalDistanceKm * 1000);
            
            // Assume strict walking speed of ~5.0 km/h for the dummy duration
            int durationSeconds = (int)Math.Round(totalDistanceKm / 5.0 * 3600);

            // Bounding box center calculation
            double minLat = waypoints.Min(w => w.Y);
            double maxLat = waypoints.Max(w => w.Y);
            double minLng = waypoints.Min(w => w.X);
            double maxLng = waypoints.Max(w => w.X);
            var centerPoint = new Point((minLng + maxLng) / 2.0, (minLat + maxLat) / 2.0) { SRID = 4326 };

            var result = new RouteGeometryResult
            {
                DistanceMeters = distanceMeters,
                DurationSeconds = durationSeconds,
                EncodedPolyline = EncodePolyline(waypoints),
                CenterPoint = centerPoint
            };

            return Task.FromResult(result);
        }

        private double CalculateHaversineDistance(Point p1, Point p2)
        {
            double R = 6371.0; // Earth's radius in km
            double dLat = ToRadians(p2.Y - p1.Y);
            double dLon = ToRadians(p2.X - p1.X);
            double a = Math.Sin(dLat / 2) * Math.Sin(dLat / 2) +
                       Math.Cos(ToRadians(p1.Y)) * Math.Cos(ToRadians(p2.Y)) *
                       Math.Sin(dLon / 2) * Math.Sin(dLon / 2);
            double c = 2 * Math.Asin(Math.Min(1, Math.Sqrt(a)));
            return R * c;
        }

        private double ToRadians(double angle)
        {
            return angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generates a perfectly valid Google Maps encoded polyline straight from the points.
        /// This ensures the frontend will STILL be able to draw dashed straight lines directly between the points!
        /// </summary>
        private string EncodePolyline(List<Point> points)
        {
            var str = new StringBuilder();

            Action<int> encodeDiff = diff =>
            {
                int shifted = diff << 1;
                if (diff < 0)
                    shifted = ~shifted;

                int rem = shifted;
                while (rem >= 0x20)
                {
                    str.Append((char)((0x20 | (rem & 0x1f)) + 63));
                    rem >>= 5;
                }
                str.Append((char)(rem + 63));
            };

            int lastLat = 0;
            int lastLng = 0;
            foreach (var point in points)
            {
                int lat = (int)Math.Round(point.Y * 1e5);
                int lng = (int)Math.Round(point.X * 1e5);
                
                encodeDiff(lat - lastLat);
                encodeDiff(lng - lastLng);
                
                lastLat = lat;
                lastLng = lng;
            }
            return str.ToString();
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.DTOs.Email;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Application.Settings;
using MailKit.Net.Smtp;
using MailKit.Security;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MimeKit;
using System.Threading.Tasks;


namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class EmailService : IEmailService
    {
        public MailSettings _mailSettings { get; }
        public ILogger<EmailService> _logger { get; }

        public EmailService(IOptions<MailSettings> mailSettings, ILogger<EmailService> logger)
        {
            _mailSettings = mailSettings.Value;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task SendAsync(EmailRequest request)
        {
            try
            {
                // create message
                var email = new MimeMessage();
                email.Sender = MailboxAddress.Parse(request.From ?? _mailSettings.EmailFrom);
                email.To.Add(MailboxAddress.Parse(request.To));
                email.Subject = request.Subject;
                var builder = new BodyBuilder();
                builder.HtmlBody = request.Body;
                email.Body = builder.ToMessageBody();
                using var smtp = new SmtpClient();
                smtp.Connect(_mailSettings.SmtpHost, _mailSettings.SmtpPort, SecureSocketOptions.StartTls);
                smtp.Authenticate(_mailSettings.SmtpUser, _mailSettings.SmtpPass);
                await smtp.SendAsync(email);
                smtp.Disconnect(true);
                
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message, ex);
                throw new ApiException(ex.Message);
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Services/GoogleRoutesService.cs

using Ant.Application.DTOs;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Models.GoogleRoutes;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class GoogleRoutesService : IMapRoutingService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

        public GoogleRoutesService(HttpClient httpClient, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            _httpClient = httpClient;
            _configuration = configuration;
        }

        public async Task<RouteGeometryResult> GetRouteGeometryAsync(List<Point> waypoints, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (waypoints == null || waypoints.Count < 2)
            {
                throw new ApiException("At least two waypoints are required to compute a route.");
            }

            // Check max distance between consecutive waypoints
            double maxDistanceKm = _configuration.GetValue<double?>("RouteSettings:MaxRouteDistanceKm") ?? 50.0; // default 50km
            for (int i = 0; i < waypoints.Count - 1; i++)
            {
                double dist = CalculateHaversineDistance(waypoints[i], waypoints[i+1]);
                if (dist > maxDistanceKm)
                {
                    throw new ApiException($"Distance between spots ({Math.Round(dist, 1)}km) exceeds the maximum allowed contiguous distance of {maxDistanceKm}km.");
                }
            }

            var requestModel = new GoogleRoutesRequest
            {
                Origin = MapToWaypoint(waypoints.First()),
                Destination = MapToWaypoint(waypoints.Last()),
                Intermediates = waypoints.Count > 2 
                    ? waypoints.Skip(1).Take(waypoints.Count - 2).Select(MapToWaypoint).ToList() 
                    : null,
                
                // TODO: Future feature - ideally can be determined via distance natively 
                // e.g. short -> WALK, long -> DRIVE/PUBLIC_TRANSPORT. For MVP, hardcoded to WALK.
                TravelMode = "WALK"
            };

            string apiKey = _configuration["Google:ApiKey"];
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(apiKey))
                throw new ApiException("Server configuration error: Google API Key is missing.");

            var requestContent = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(requestModel, new JsonSerializerOptions { DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull }), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

            var requestMessage = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "https://routes.googleapis.com/directions/v2:computeRoutes")
            {
                Content = requestContent
            };
            requestMessage.Headers.Add("X-Goog-Api-Key", apiKey);
            requestMessage.Headers.Add("X-Goog-FieldMask", "routes.distanceMeters,routes.duration,routes.polyline.encodedPolyline");

            var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(requestMessage, cancellationToken);
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                throw new ApiException($"Failed to connect to map services. Status: {response.StatusCode}");
            }

            var responseString = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
            var responseModel = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<GoogleRoutesResponse>(responseString);

            if (responseModel?.Routes == null || !responseModel.Routes.Any())
            {
                // Implement Option B: Fail aggressively 
                throw new ApiException("No route could be mapped between the specified locations.");
            }

            var routeData = responseModel.Routes.First();
            
            // Parse duration which comes as e.g. "439s" from Google
            int durationSeconds = 0;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(routeData.Duration) && routeData.Duration.EndsWith("s"))
            {
                int.TryParse(routeData.Duration.TrimEnd('s'), out durationSeconds);
            }

            // Calculate center point via simple bounding box average
            double minLat = waypoints.Min(w => w.Y);
            double maxLat = waypoints.Max(w => w.Y);
            double minLng = waypoints.Min(w => w.X);
            double maxLng = waypoints.Max(w => w.X);
            var centerPoint = new Point((minLng + maxLng) / 2.0, (minLat + maxLat) / 2.0) { SRID = 4326 };

            return new RouteGeometryResult
            {
                DistanceMeters = routeData.DistanceMeters,
                DurationSeconds = durationSeconds,
                EncodedPolyline = routeData.Polyline?.EncodedPolyline ?? "",
                CenterPoint = centerPoint
            };
        }

        private Models.GoogleRoutes.Waypoint MapToWaypoint(Point p)
        {
            return new Models.GoogleRoutes.Waypoint
            {
                Location = new Models.GoogleRoutes.Location
                {
                    LatLng = new Models.GoogleRoutes.LatLng
                    {
                        Latitude = p.Y,
                        Longitude = p.X
                    }
                }
            };
        }

        private double CalculateHaversineDistance(Point p1, Point p2)
        {
            double R = 6371.0; // Earth's radius in km
            double dLat = ToRadians(p2.Y - p1.Y);
            double dLon = ToRadians(p2.X - p1.X);
            double a = Math.Sin(dLat / 2) * Math.Sin(dLat / 2) +
                       Math.Cos(ToRadians(p1.Y)) * Math.Cos(ToRadians(p2.Y)) *
                       Math.Sin(dLon / 2) * Math.Sin(dLon / 2);
            double c = 2 * Math.Asin(Math.Min(1, Math.Sqrt(a)));
            return R * c;
        }

        private double ToRadians(double angle)
        {
            return angle * (Math.PI / 180.0);
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Core.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class IdentityService : IIdentityService
    {
        private readonly UserManager<ApplicationUser> _userManager;
        private readonly Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts.ApplicationDbContext _dbContext;

        public IdentityService(UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager, Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts.ApplicationDbContext dbContext)
        {
            _userManager = userManager;
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }

        public async Task<UserIdentityDto> GetUserIdentityAsync(Guid userId)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.FindByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user == null)
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(nameof(ApplicationUser), userId);

            var roles = await _userManager.GetRolesAsync(user);

            return new UserIdentityDto
            {
                Id = user.Id,
                UserName = user.UserName,
                Email = user.Email,
                IsVerified = user.EmailConfirmed,
                IsActive = user.LockoutEnd == null || user.LockoutEnd <= DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
                Roles = roles.ToList()
            };
        }

        public async Task<IEnumerable<UserIdentityDto>> GetAllUsersAsync()
        {
            var users = await _dbContext.Users.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
            var roleNamesById = await _dbContext.Roles.AsNoTracking()
                .ToDictionaryAsync(role => role.Id, role => role.Name);
            var roleNamesByUserId = await _dbContext.UserRoles.AsNoTracking()
                .GroupBy(userRole => userRole.UserId)
                .ToDictionaryAsync(
                    group => group.Key,
                    group => group
                        .Select(userRole => roleNamesById.GetValueOrDefault(userRole.RoleId))
                        .Where(roleName => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(roleName))
                        .ToList());

            return users.Select(user => new UserIdentityDto
            {
                Id = user.Id,
                UserName = user.UserName,
                Email = user.Email,
                IsVerified = user.EmailConfirmed,
                IsActive = user.LockoutEnd == null || user.LockoutEnd <= DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
                Roles = roleNamesByUserId.GetValueOrDefault(user.Id) ?? new List<string>()
            }).ToList();
        }

        public async Task ChangePasswordAsync(Guid userId, string currentPassword, string newPassword)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.FindByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user == null)
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(nameof(ApplicationUser), userId);

            var result = await _userManager.ChangePasswordAsync(user, currentPassword, newPassword);
            if (!result.Succeeded)
                throw new ApiException(string.Join(", ", result.Errors.Select(e => e.Description)));
        }

        public async Task UpdateUserRolesAsync(Guid userId, List<string> roles)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.FindByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user == null)
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(nameof(ApplicationUser), userId);

            var currentRoles = await _userManager.GetRolesAsync(user);
            
            // Remove existing roles
            var removeResult = await _userManager.RemoveFromRolesAsync(user, currentRoles);
            if (!removeResult.Succeeded)
                throw new ApiException("Failed to remove existing roles.");

            // Add new roles
            var addResult = await _userManager.AddToRolesAsync(user, roles);
            if (!addResult.Succeeded)
                throw new ApiException("Failed to add new roles.");
        }

        public async Task UpdateUserStatusAsync(Guid userId, bool isActive)
        {
            var user = await _userManager.FindByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user == null)
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(nameof(ApplicationUser), userId);

            // In Identity, 'Lockout' is often used for banning/deactivating
            await _userManager.SetLockoutEnabledAsync(user, !isActive);
            if (!isActive)
            {
                await _userManager.SetLockoutEndDateAsync(user, DateTimeOffset.MaxValue);
            }
            else
            {
                await _userManager.SetLockoutEndDateAsync(user, null);
            }
        }

        public async Task<int> GetCountAsync(bool? isActive = null)
        {
            var query = _userManager.Users;
            if (isActive.HasValue)
            {
                var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                if (isActive.Value)
                {
                    query = query.Where(u => u.LockoutEnd == null || u.LockoutEnd <= now);
                }
                else
                {
                    query = query.Where(u => u.LockoutEnd != null && u.LockoutEnd > now);
                }
            }
            return await query.CountAsync();
        }
    }
}

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.Infrastructure/Services/OsrmMapRoutingService.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.DTOs;
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class OsrmMapRoutingService : IMapRoutingService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;

        public OsrmMapRoutingService(HttpClient httpClient)
        {
            _httpClient = httpClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClient));
        }

        public async Task<RouteGeometryResult> GetRouteGeometryAsync(List<Point> waypoints, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (waypoints == null || waypoints.Count < 2)
            {
                throw new ApiException("At least two waypoints are required to compute a route.");
            }

            // OSRM coordinates format: {longitude},{latitude};{longitude},{latitude}
            var coordinates = string.Join(";", waypoints.Select(w => 
                $"{w.X.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)},{w.Y.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}"));

            var requestUrl = $"route/v1/driving/{coordinates}?overview=full&geometries=polyline";

            try
            {
                var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(requestUrl, cancellationToken);
                
                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    throw new ApiException($"OSRM routing failed with status code: {response.StatusCode}");
                }

                var jsonString = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
                
                using var jsonDocument = JsonDocument.Parse(jsonString);
                var root = jsonDocument.RootElement;

                if (root.GetProperty("code").GetString() != "Ok")
                {
                    throw new ApiException($"OSRM routing failed with code: {root.GetProperty("code").GetString()}");
                }

                var routes = root.GetProperty("routes");
                if (routes.GetArrayLength() == 0)
                {
                    throw new ApiException("OSRM routing returned no routes.");
                }

                var route = routes[0];
                var distanceMeters = (int)Math.Round(route.GetProperty("distance").GetDouble());
                var durationSeconds = (int)Math.Round(route.GetProperty("duration").GetDouble());
                var encodedPolyline = route.GetProperty("geometry").GetString();

                // Bounding box center calculation
                double minLat = waypoints.Min(w => w.Y);
                double maxLat = waypoints.Max(w => w.Y);
                double minLng = waypoints.Min(w => w.X);
                double maxLng = waypoints.Max(w => w.X);
                var centerPoint = new Point((minLng + maxLng) / 2.0, (minLat + maxLat) / 2.0) { SRID = 4326 };

                return new RouteGeometryResult
                {
                    DistanceMeters = distanceMeters,
                    DurationSeconds = durationSeconds,
                    EncodedPolyline = encodedPolyline,
                    CenterPoint = centerPoint
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not ApiException)
            {
                throw new ApiException($"An error occurred while fetching route from OSRM: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Ant.Application;
using Ant.Core.Enums;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Ant.Infrastructure;
using Ant.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Ant.WebApi.Caching;
using Ant.WebApi.Extensions;
using Ant.WebApi.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Serilog;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddApplicationLayer();
builder.Services.AddPersistenceInfrastructure(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddSwaggerExtension();
builder.Services.AddControllers()
    .AddJsonOptions(options =>
    {
        options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = System.Text.Json.JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase;
        options.JsonSerializerOptions.DictionaryKeyPolicy = System.Text.Json.JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase;
    });
builder.Services.AddApiVersioningExtension();
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();
builder.Services.AddOutputCache(options =>
{
    options.AddBasePolicy(policy => policy.NoCache());
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.RoutesList, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        .SetVaryByQuery("search", "tagId", "tagIds", "sort", "nearLat", "nearLng", "radiusKm", "authorId", "visibility", "type", "page", "pageSize")
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Routes));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.RouteDetail, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2))
        .SetVaryByRouteValue("routeId")
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Routes));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.SpotsList, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        .SetVaryByQuery("search", "page", "pageSize")
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Spots));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.SpotDetail, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2))
        .SetVaryByRouteValue("spotId")
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Spots));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.SpotRoutes, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        .SetVaryByRouteValue("spotId")
        .SetVaryByQuery("page", "pageSize")
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Spots)
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Routes));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.TagsList, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10))
        .SetVaryByQuery("pageNumber", "pageSize")
        .Tag(OutputCacheTags.Tags));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.UserCollections, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        .SetVaryByQuery("pageNumber", "pageSize")
        .VaryByUserClaims("uid"));
    options.AddPolicy(OutputCachePolicies.UserCollectionDetail, policy => policy
        .Expire(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2))
        .SetVaryByRouteValue("id")
        .VaryByUserClaims("uid"));
});
builder.Services.AddScoped<IAuthenticatedUserService, AuthenticatedUserService>();
builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();

//Build the application
var app = builder.Build();

================================================
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.OutputCaching;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Caching
{
    public static class OutputCachePolicies
    {
        public const string RoutesList = nameof(RoutesList);
        public const string RouteDetail = nameof(RouteDetail);
        public const string SpotsList = nameof(SpotsList);
        public const string SpotDetail = nameof(SpotDetail);
        public const string SpotRoutes = nameof(SpotRoutes);
        public const string TagsList = nameof(TagsList);
        public const string UserCollections = nameof(UserCollections);
        public const string UserCollectionDetail = nameof(UserCollectionDetail);
    }

    public static class OutputCacheTags
    {
        public const string Routes = "routes";
        public const string Spots = "spots";
        public const string Tags = "tags";

        public static ValueTask EvictRoutesAsync(IOutputCacheStore store, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => store.EvictByTagAsync(Routes, cancellationToken);

        public static ValueTask EvictSpotsAsync(IOutputCacheStore store, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => store.EvictByTagAsync(Spots, cancellationToken);

        public static ValueTask EvictTagsAsync(IOutputCacheStore store, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            => store.EvictByTagAsync(Tags, cancellationToken);

        public static async Task EvictRoutesAndSpotsAsync(IOutputCacheStore store, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await EvictRoutesAsync(store, cancellationToken);
            await EvictSpotsAsync(store, cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Features.Account.Commands.ChangePassword;
using Ant.Application.Features.Account.Commands.UpdateProfile;
using Ant.Application.Features.Account.Queries.GetCurrentUser;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers
{
    [Route("api/account")]
    [ApiVersion("1.0")]
    [Authorize]
    public class AccountController : BaseApiController
    {
        [HttpGet("me")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<CurrentUserViewModel>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Me()
        {
            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(new GetCurrentUserQuery()));
        }

        [HttpPut("profile")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateProfile(UpdateProfileCommand command)
        {

================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.WebApi/Controllers/AuthController.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.DTOs.Account;
using Ant.Application.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers
{
    [Route("api/auth")]
    [ApiController]
    public class AuthController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IAuthService _authService;

        public AuthController(IAuthService authService)
        {
            _authService = authService;
        }

        [HttpPost("login")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Login(AuthenticationRequest request)
        {
            var response = await _authService.AuthenticateAsync(request, GetIpAddress());
            SetRefreshTokenCookie(response.RefreshToken);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        [HttpPost("register")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Register(RegisterRequest request)
        {
            var origin = Request.Headers["origin"].FirstOrDefault() ?? "http://localhost:3000";
            var result = await _authService.RegisterAsync(request, origin);
            return Ok(new { message = result });
        }

        [HttpPost("refresh")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> RefreshToken([FromBody] RefreshTokenRequest request = null)
        {
            var refreshToken = Request.Cookies["refreshToken"];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(refreshToken))
                refreshToken = request?.RefreshToken;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(refreshToken))
                return BadRequest("Refresh token not found.");

            var response = await _authService.RefreshTokenAsync(refreshToken, GetIpAddress());
            SetRefreshTokenCookie(response.RefreshToken);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        [HttpPost("logout")]
        public IActionResult Logout()
        {
            Response.Cookies.Delete("refreshToken");
            return Ok(new { message = "Logged out successfully." });
        }

        [HttpGet("confirm-email")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ConfirmEmail([FromQuery] string userId, [FromQuery] string code)
        {
            return Ok(await _authService.ConfirmEmailAsync(userId, code));
        }

        [HttpPost("forgot-password")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ForgotPassword(ForgotPasswordRequest model)
        {
            var origin = Request.Headers["origin"].FirstOrDefault() ?? "http://localhost:3000";
            await _authService.ForgotPassword(model, origin);
            return Ok("If an account with that email exists, a reset link has been sent.");
        }

        [HttpPost("reset-password")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ResetPassword(ResetPasswordRequest model)
        {
            return Ok(await _authService.ResetPassword(model));
        }

        private string GetIpAddress()
        {
            if (Request.Headers.ContainsKey("X-Forwarded-For"))
                return Request.Headers["X-Forwarded-For"];
            return HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress.MapToIPv4().ToString();
        }

        private void SetRefreshTokenCookie(string token)
        {
            Response.Cookies.Append("refreshToken", token, new CookieOptions
            {
                HttpOnly = true,
                Expires = System.DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(7),
                SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict,
                Secure = Request.IsHttps
            });
        }
    }
}

using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;


namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/v{version:apiVersion}/[controller]")]
    public abstract class BaseApiController : ControllerBase
    {
        private IMediator _mediator;
        protected IMediator Mediator => _mediator ??= HttpContext.RequestServices.GetService<IMediator>();
    }
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Diagnostics;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers
{
    public class MetaController : BaseApiController
    {
        [HttpGet("/info")]
        public ActionResult<string> Info()
        {
            var assembly = typeof(Program).Assembly;

            var lastUpdate = System.IO.File.GetLastWriteTime(assembly.Location);
            var version = FileVersionInfo.GetVersionInfo(assembly.Location).ProductVersion;

            return Ok($"Version: {version}, Last Updated: {lastUpdate}");
        }
    }
}

using Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.CreateRoute;

using Ant.Application.Features.RouteRatings.Queries.GetRouteRatings;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using Ant.WebApi.Caching;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.OutputCaching;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers
{
    [Route("api/routes")]
    [ApiVersion("1.0")]
    public class RoutesController : BaseApiController
    {
        // GET /api/routes?search=&categoryId=&tagIds=&sort=rating&page=1&pageSize=20
        // GET /api/routes?nearLat=&nearLng=&radiusKm=
        // GET /api/routes?authorId=&visibility=public&type=official|community|sponsored
        [HttpGet]
        [OutputCache(PolicyName = OutputCachePolicies.RoutesList)]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(PagedResponse<RouteListViewModel>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(
            [FromQuery] string search = null,
            [FromQuery] Guid? tagId = null,
            [FromQuery] string tagIds = null,
            [FromQuery] string sort = null,
            [FromQuery] double? nearLat = null,
            [FromQuery] double? nearLng = null,
            [FromQuery] double? radiusKm = null,
            [FromQuery] Guid? authorId = null,
            [FromQuery] string visibility = null,
            [FromQuery] string type = null,
            [FromQuery] int page = 1,
            [FromQuery] int pageSize = 20)
        {
            var tagIdList = string.IsNullOrEmpty(tagIds)
                ? null
                : tagIds.Split(',').Select(t => Guid.TryParse(t.Trim(), out var g) ? g : (Guid?)null).Where(g => g.HasValue).Select(g => g.Value).ToList();

            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(new GetPagedRoutesQuery
            {
                Search = search,
                TagId = tagId,
                TagIds = tagIdList,
                Sort = sort,
                NearLat = nearLat,
                NearLng = nearLng,
                RadiusKm = radiusKm,
                AuthorId = authorId,
                Visibility = visibility,
                Type = type,
                PageNumber = page,
                PageSize = pageSize
            }));
        }

        // GET /api/routes/{routeId}
        [HttpGet("{routeId}")]
        [OutputCache(PolicyName = OutputCachePolicies.RouteDetail)]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<GetRouteByIdViewModel>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid routeId)
        {
            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(new GetRouteByIdQuery { Id = routeId }));
        }

        // POST /api/routes
        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, [FromBody] CreateRouteCommand command)
        {
            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAndSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        // PATCH /api/routes/{routeId}
        [HttpPatch("{routeId}")]
        [Authorize]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Update(Guid routeId, [FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, [FromBody] UpdateRouteCommand command)
        {
            command.Id = routeId;
            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        // DELETE /api/routes/{routeId}
        [HttpDelete("{routeId}")]
        [Authorize]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid routeId, [FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore)

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.OutputCaching;
using Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Queries.GetAdminRoutes;
using Ant.Application.Features.Routes.Commands.PromoteRoute;
using Ant.WebApi.Caching;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers.Admin
{
    [ApiVersion("1.0")]
    [Route("api/admin/routes")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public class AdminRoutesController : BaseApiController
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Get all routes for management (Admin only)
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Get([FromQuery] GetAdminRoutesQuery filter)
        {
            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(filter));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Promote a route (Official/Sponsored)
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPut("{id}/promote")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Promote(Guid id, [FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, [FromBody] PromoteRouteCommand command)
        {
            if (id != command.Id)
                return BadRequest();

            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }
    }
}

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers.Admin
{
    [ApiVersion("1.0")]
    [Route("api/admin/spots")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
    public class AdminSpotsController : BaseApiController
    {
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Get([FromQuery] GetAdminSpotsQuery filter)
        {
            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(filter));
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Post([FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, CreateSpotCommand command)
        {
            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        [HttpPut("{id}")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Put(System.Guid id, [FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, UpdateSpotCommand command)
        {
            if (id != command.Id)

                return BadRequest();
            }

            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAndSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);

        {
            var response = await Mediator.Send(new DeleteSpotCommand(id));
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAndSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }
    }

using Ant.Application.Features.Spots.Queries.GetBusinessSpots;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Controllers.Business
{
    [Route("api/business/spots")]
    [ApiVersion("1.0")]
    [Authorize(Roles = "BusinessUser")]
    public class BusinessSpotsController : BaseApiController
    {
        // POST /api/business/spots
        [HttpPost]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, CreateSpotCommand command)
        {
            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        // GET /api/business/spots
        [HttpGet]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(PagedResponse<BusinessSpotViewModel>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll([FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 10)
        {
            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(new GetBusinessSpotsQuery
            {
                OwnerUserId = GetUserId(),
                PageNumber = page,
                PageSize = pageSize
            }));
        }

        // GET /api/business/spots/{spotId}
        [HttpGet("{spotId}")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<SpotDetailViewModel>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid spotId)
        {
            return Ok(await Mediator.Send(new GetSpotByIdQuery { Id = spotId }));
        }

        // PATCH /api/business/spots/{spotId}
        [HttpPatch("{spotId}")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Update(Guid spotId, [FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore, UpdateSpotCommand command)
        {
            command.Id = spotId;
            command.EnforcedOwnerUserId = GetUserId();
            var response = await Mediator.Send(command);
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAndSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        // DELETE /api/business/spots/{spotId}
        [HttpDelete("{spotId}")]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK, Type = typeof(Response<Guid>))]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid spotId, [FromServices] IOutputCacheStore outputCacheStore)
        {
            var response = await Mediator.Send(new DeleteSpotCommand
            {
                Id = spotId,
                EnforcedOwnerUserId = GetUserId()
            });
            await OutputCacheTags.EvictRoutesAndSpotsAsync(outputCacheStore, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return Ok(response);
        }

        private Guid GetUserId() => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirstValue("uid"));
    }

FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.WebApi/Extensions/ServiceExtensions.cs
================================================
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Extensions
{
    public static class ServiceExtensions
    {
        public static void AddSwaggerExtension(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
            {
                var xmlFile = "Ant.WebApi.xml";
                var xmlPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, xmlFile);
                c.IncludeXmlComments(xmlPath);

                c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
                {
                    Version = "v1",
                    Title = "AntAPP API",
                    Description = "Route Planning & Social Platform API",
                    Contact = new OpenApiContact
                    {
                        Name = "AntAPP Team",
                        Email = "team@antapp.local",
                        Url = new Uri("https://antapp.local"),
                    }
                });
                c.CustomSchemaIds(GetSchemaId);
                c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
                {
                    Name = "Authorization",
                    In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                    Type = SecuritySchemeType.ApiKey,
                    Scheme = "Bearer",
                    BearerFormat = "JWT",
                    Description = "Input your Bearer token in this format - Bearer {your token here} to access this API",
                });
                c.AddSecurityRequirement(new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
                {
                    {
                        new OpenApiSecurityScheme
                        {
                            Reference = new OpenApiReference
                            {
                                Type = ReferenceType.SecurityScheme,
                                Id = "Bearer",
                            },
                            Scheme = "Bearer",
                            Name = "Bearer",
                            In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                        }, new List<string>()
                    },
                });
            });
        }

        private static string GetSchemaId(Type type)
        {
            if (!type.IsGenericType)
            {
                return NormalizeSchemaName(type.FullName ?? type.Name);
            }

            var genericTypeName = type.GetGenericTypeDefinition().Name.Split('`')[0];
            var genericArguments = string.Join("And", type.GetGenericArguments().Select(GetSchemaId));

            return NormalizeSchemaName($"{genericArguments}_{genericTypeName}");
        }

        private static string NormalizeSchemaName(string name)
        {
            return new string(name.Select(character => char.IsLetterOrDigit(character) ? character : '_').ToArray());
        }

        public static void AddApiVersioningExtension(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddApiVersioning(config =>
            {
                // Specify the default API Version as 1.0
                config.DefaultApiVersion = new ApiVersion(1, 0);
                // If the client hasn't specified the API version in the request, use the default API version number 
                config.AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified = true;
                // Advertise the API versions supported for the particular endpoint
                config.ReportApiVersions = true;
            });
        }
    }
}



================================================
FILE: backend/Ant/Ant.WebApi/Middlewares/ErrorHandlerMiddleware.cs
================================================
using Ant.Application.Exceptions;
using Ant.Application.Wrappers;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Ant.WebApi.Middlewares
{
    public class ErrorHandlerMiddleware
    {
        private readonly RequestDelegate _next;

        public ErrorHandlerMiddleware(RequestDelegate next)
        {
            _next = next;
        }

        public async Task Invoke(HttpContext context)
        {
            try
            {
                await _next(context);
            }
            catch (Exception error)
            {
                var response = context.Response;
                response.ContentType = "application/json";
                var errorResponse = new ErrorResponse();


                switch (error)
                {
                    case ApiException e:
                        // custom application error
                        response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;
                        errorResponse.Message = e.Message;
                        break;
                    case ValidationException e:
                        // custom application error
                        response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;
                        errorResponse.Message ="Some validation errors occured.";
                        errorResponse.Errors = e.Errors;
                        break;
                    case KeyNotFoundException e:
                        // not found error
                        response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.NotFound;
                        break;
                    default:
                        // unhandled error
                        response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError;
                        break;
                }
                var result = JsonSerializer.Serialize(errorResponse, new JsonSerializerOptions 
                { 
                    PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase 
                });

                await response.WriteAsync(result);
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: docs/COLLECTIONS_API.md
================================================
# Collections API

Route collections allow users to organize saved routes into groups (e.g. "Weekend Trips", "Istanbul Walks"). Every user gets an auto-created **default collection** called "Saved Routes" for quick save/unsave via the mobile shortcut endpoints.

---

## Authentication


| Scope                      | Requirement                           |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| User API (`/api/me/…`)     | Bearer token (any authenticated user) |
| Admin API (`/api/admin/…`) | Bearer token with **Admin** role      |


User endpoints extract the user ID from the JWT `uid` claim — it is never passed as a parameter.

---

## Response Models

### CollectionViewModel (list item)

```json
{
  "id": "guid",
  "userId": "guid",
  "name": "string",
  "isDefault": false,
  "isPublic": true,
  "description": "string",
  "thumbnailUrl": "string",
  "routeCount": 3,
  "created": "2026-03-16T12:00:00Z"
}
```

### CollectionDetailViewModel (single collection)

```json
{
  "id": "guid",
  "userId": "guid",
  "name": "string",
  "isDefault": false,
  "isPublic": true,
  "description": "string",
  "thumbnailUrl": "string",
  "created": "2026-03-16T12:00:00Z",
  "routes": [
    {
      "routeId": "guid",
      "title": "Sunset Walk",
      "thumbnailUrl": "string",
      "savedAt": "2026-03-16T12:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## User API

All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

### List my collections

```
GET /api/me/collections?pageNumber=1&pageSize=10
```

**Response:** `PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>`

---

### Create a collection

```
POST /api/me/collections
```

**Body:**

```json
{
  "name": "Weekend Trips",
  "isPublic": true,
  "description": "Relaxing weekend routes",
  "thumbnailUrl": "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"
}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the new collection ID.

---

### Get collection detail

```
GET /api/me/collections/{id}
```

Returns the collection with its route list. Only returns collections owned by the authenticated user.

**Response:** `CollectionDetailViewModel`

---

### Update a collection

```
PUT /api/me/collections/{id}
```

**Body:**

```json
{
  "name": "Updated Name",
  "isPublic": false,
  "description": "New description",
  "thumbnailUrl": "https://example.com/new-thumb.jpg"
}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the updated collection ID.

---

### Delete a collection

```
DELETE /api/me/collections/{id}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the deleted collection ID.

---

### Add a route to a collection

```
POST /api/me/collections/{id}/routes
```

**Body:**

```json
{
  "routeId": "guid"
}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the added route ID.

**Errors:** `400` if the route is already in the collection.

---

### Remove a route from a collection

```
DELETE /api/me/collections/{id}/routes/{routeId}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the removed route ID.

---

### Save a route (mobile shortcut)

Adds a route to the user's default "Saved Routes" collection. Creates the default collection automatically on first use.

```
POST /api/me/saved-routes
```

**Body:**

```json
{
  "routeId": "guid"
}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the default collection ID.

**Errors:** `400` if the route is already saved.

---

### Unsave a route (mobile shortcut)

Removes a route from the user's default "Saved Routes" collection.

```
DELETE /api/me/saved-routes/{routeId}
```

**Response:** `Guid` — the removed route ID.

**Errors:** `400` if the route is not saved or no default collection exists.

---

## Admin API

All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with **Admin** role.

Admin endpoints skip ownership checks — any collection can be viewed, edited, or deleted.

### List all collections

```
GET /api/admin/collections?pageNumber=1&pageSize=10
```

Returns collections from all users, ordered by creation date (newest first).

**Response:** `PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>`

---

### Get collection detail

```
GET /api/admin/collections/{id}
```

**Response:** `CollectionDetailViewModel`

---

### Update a collection

```
PUT /api/admin/collections/{id}
```

**Body:**

```json
{
  "name": "Admin Override Name",
  "isPublic": false,
  "description": "Edited by admin",
  "thumbnailUrl": "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"
}
```

**Response:** `Guid`

---

### Delete a collection

```
DELETE /api/admin/collections/{id}
```

**Response:** `Guid`

---

### Add a route to a collection

```
POST /api/admin/collections/{id}/routes
```

**Body:**

```json
{
  "routeId": "guid"
}
```

**Response:** `Guid`

---

### Remove a route from a collection

```
DELETE /api/admin/collections/{id}/routes/{routeId}
```

**Response:** `Guid`

---

### List a specific user's collections

```
GET /api/admin/users/{userId}/collections?pageNumber=1&pageSize=10
```

**Response:** `PagedResponse<CollectionViewModel>`

---

## Error Responses

All errors are returned as `ApiException` with a descriptive message:


| Scenario                       | Message                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| Collection not found           | `"Collection not found."`                |
| Ownership mismatch (user API)  | `"Collection not found."`                |
| Route already in collection    | `"Route is already in this collection."` |
| Route not in collection        | `"Route is not in this collection."`     |
| Route already saved (shortcut) | `"Route is already saved."`              |
| Route not saved (shortcut)     | `"Route is not saved."`                  |
| No default collection (unsave) | `"No saved routes collection found."`    |
| Not authenticated              | `"Authentication required."`             |


> **Note:** Ownership mismatches intentionally return "Collection not found" to avoid leaking the existence of other users' collections.

# Design System Specification: Editorial Mediterranean Engineering

## 1. Overview & Creative North Star
**Creative North Star: The Coastal Architect**
This design system avoids the generic SaaS look and instead builds a high-end, editorial product language shaped by **Mediterranean light, coastal depth, and engineering precision**. The interface should feel calm, premium, and structured — like a route carefully designed around sea, sun, and movement.

We reject the flat white web. Instead, we use **Layered Sophistication**: tonal depth, soft atmosphere, large-radius surfaces, and color fields that feel environmental rather than decorative.

The goal is to create a UI that feels **built**, not merely drawn — authoritative in structure, warm in tone, and unmistakably tied to Antalya / Akdeniz energy.

---

## 2. Color Theory & Tonal Geometry

### Canonical Brand Palette
- **Primary:** `#005696` — deep Mediterranean blue, the core trust color
- **Secondary:** `#FF8C00` — sun orange, the energetic accent
- **Tertiary:** `#00CEC9` — coastal teal, freshness and motion
- **Neutral:** `#F8F9FA` — soft cloud background, the main canvas

### Recommended Distribution
Use color with restraint:
- **60% Neutral / Surface**
- **20% Primary Blue**
- **12% Secondary Orange**
- **8% Tertiary Teal**

For auth, onboarding, and editorial surfaces, orange can become slightly more visible to introduce warmth — but only as an atmosphere layer, not as noise.

### The "No-Line" Rule
**Explicit Instruction:** Avoid using 1px solid borders for sectioning.
Boundaries must be defined through:
- tonal surface shifts
- spacing
- soft elevation
- layered color fields

Instead of a border, place a `surface_container_lowest` (`#FFFFFF`) card on a `surface` / `surface_container_low` base.
The transition between sections should feel like a change in material, not a line drawn by a tool.

### Surface Hierarchy & Nesting
Treat the UI as a series of physical layers:
1. **Base:** `surface` (`#F8F9FA`) — page canvas
2. **Sectioning:** `surface_container_low` (`#EEF3F6`) — large structural zones
3. **Content Hubs:** `surface_container_lowest` (`#FFFFFF`) — cards, forms, panels
4. **Prominence:** `surface_container_high` (`#E3EBF1`) — inset elements, emphasized surfaces

### The "Glass & Gradient" Rule
To give the product soul without becoming loud:
- **Primary actions:** subtle blue-led gradients, e.g. `#005696 → #0A3C63` or blue with a faint teal lift
- **Warm atmosphere layers:** orange should appear as a glow, bleed, or highlight field rather than a flat block everywhere
- **Floating navigation / overlays:** translucent white surfaces with backdrop softness so blue, orange, and teal tones can breathe underneath
- **Auth / marketing backgrounds:** layer orange + blue + teal on top of `#F8F9FA` to evoke sea and sunset without sacrificing clarity

---

## 3. Typography: The Editorial Voice
We use a dual-font strategy to balance warmth and technical precision.

- **Display & Headlines (Manrope):** the architectural voice; use large sizes with tight tracking for confident headlines
- **Body & Labels (Inter):** the functional voice; maximum readability for product content, forms, and data
- **Hierarchy Rule:** lead with contrast — strong headline, quieter supporting body copy, restrained labels

Typography should always support the layout’s rhythm; boldness should come from scale and spacing before weight alone.

---

## 4. Elevation & Depth: Tonal Layering
Traditional heavy shadows make the interface feel dirty. Prefer **ambient layering**.

- **Primary depth principle:** a white card on a soft neutral field already creates lift
- **Shadows:** use only when an element truly floats above others
- **Shadow color:** always tint from `on_surface`, never use pure black
- **Ghost Border fallback:** if accessibility requires an edge, use a very low-opacity tinted outline rather than a hard border

Recommended floating shadow:
- `box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(25, 28, 29, 0.04), 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(25, 28, 29, 0.08);`

---

## 5. Component Logic

### Buttons (The Energy Core)
- **Primary:** deep Mediterranean blue (`#005696`) with white text; may use a subtle blue-depth gradient on premium surfaces
- **Secondary:** sun orange (`#FF8C00`) for highlighted alternative actions, special promotions, or warm emphasis
- **Tertiary:** teal (`#00CEC9`) for lighter supporting actions and focused interactive states

Buttons should feel rounded, calm, and premium — never aggressive.

### Cards & Lists (The Engineering Grid)
- **Forbid Dividers:** no `<hr>`, no border-bottom sectioning
- Separate items with spacing and tonal contrast
- Use large radii: `12px–24px`
- Prefer white or near-white surfaces on soft neutral backgrounds

### Input Fields (The Precision Tools)
- **Track / field surface:** soft lifted neutral, never bright flat white unless inside a white card
- **Focus State:** use a teal aura derived from `#00CEC9`, not a hard electric border
- **Error State:** keep warning backgrounds softened and premium, never harsh or alarmist

### Signature Component: The "Data Sheet"
For structured route / place / engineering information:
- header labels in blue or muted secondary text
- values in stronger surface text
- no lines, only gutter spacing

---

## 6. Do’s and Don’ts

### Do:
- Use intentional asymmetry
- Let color behave like atmosphere, not paint buckets
- Use blue as the trust anchor
- Use orange as warmth and energy
- Use teal as freshness, focus, and motion
- Keep surfaces breathable and calm

### Don’t:
- Don’t use generic purple SaaS gradients
- Don’t default to fully white empty backgrounds
- Don’t draw hard borders between major sections
- Don’t cover every card with shadows
- Don’t let accent colors overpower readability

---

## 7. Spacing & Rhythm
The system runs on a 4px baseline, but layouts should prefer **wide breathability**.

- **Internal card padding:** `spacing.6` (`1.5rem`)
- **Major section gap:** `spacing.16` (`4rem`)
- **Auth / hero compositions:** allow larger atmosphere fields and more negative space so the background can feel environmental rather than flat

## 1. Mimari Özet

```
packages/ui/          ← @antapp/ui  — tasarım sisteminin tek kaynağı
packages/app/         ← @antapp/app — platform-agnostic paylaşımlı ekranlar
web/                  ← Next.js 16  — @antapp/ui'yi tüketir
mobile/               ← Expo 55     — @antapp/ui'yi tüketir
```

**Altın Kural:** Bütün UI, `@antapp/ui`'den import edilir. `react-native`'den `StyleSheet`, `View`, `Text`, `Pressable` gibi primitive'ler direkt import edilmez; onların yerine Tamagui primitive'leri ve `@antapp/ui` komponentleri kullanılır.

---

## 2. Dosya Yapısı

```
packages/ui/src/
├── tokens.ts                  ← createTokens() — renk, boşluk, boyut, radius, z-index
├── themes.ts                  ← light/dark + sub-theme'ler
├── fonts.ts                   ← Web font stack (react-native import YOK)
├── fonts.native.ts            ← Native font stack (Metro otomatik seçer)
├── tamagui.config.ts          ← Ana config (defaultConfig extend)
├── tamagui-config.d.ts        ← TamaguiCustomConfig tip augmentation
├── index.ts                   ← Tüm export'lar buradan
└── components/
    ├── button.tsx
    ├── input.tsx
    ├── text.tsx
    ├── card.tsx
    ├── badge.tsx
    ├── layout.tsx             ← VStack, HStack, Center, Container, Divider
    └── form/
        ├── form-field.tsx
        ├── checkbox.tsx
        ├── select.tsx
        └── switch.tsx
```

**Önemli:** `fonts.ts` ve `fonts.native.ts` aynı API'yi export eder. Next.js `fonts.ts`'i, Metro (React Native) `fonts.native.ts`'i kullanır. `fonts.native.ts`'e `Platform` import'u eklenebilir; `fonts.ts`'e eklenemez (Turbopack'ı bozar).

---

## 3. Token Sistemi

**Dosya:** `packages/ui/src/tokens.ts`

Token'lar `createTokens()` ile tanımlanır ve `$` prefix'iyle komponentlerde kullanılır.

### Renk Paleti

### Kanonik Marka Paleti

- **Primary:** `#005696` — ana marka / güven / derin Akdeniz mavisi
- **Secondary:** `#FF8C00` — sıcak vurgu / güneş turuncusu
- **Tertiary:** `#00CEC9` — ferahlık / hareket / kıyı turkuazı
- **Neutral:** `#F8F9FA` — ana yüzey / arkaplan

### Mevcut Token Grupları

| Grup | Tonlar | Açıklama |
|---|---|---|
| `ant` | 50–950 | Legacy sıcak accent ailesi — turuncu/güneş vurgu yüzeyleri |
| `gray` | 50–950 | Nötr gri / yüzey geçişleri |
| `success` | 50–500 | Yeşil |
| `warning` | 50–500 | Sıcak uyarı / amber |
| `error` | 50–500 | Kırmızı |
| `info` | 50–500 | Mavi ailesi — primary yönüne en yakın mevcut token grubu |
| `white`, `black`, `transparent` | — | Sabit değerler |

> Not: Kod tabanında bazı token isimleri legacy olarak korunuyor (`ant`, `info` vb.). Yeni auth / editorial yüzeylerde ve yeni görsel çalışmalarda hedef palet her zaman **Primary `#005696` / Secondary `#FF8C00` / Tertiary `#00CEC9` / Neutral `#F8F9FA`** olmalı.

Kullanım:
```tsx
// Direkt token referansı (tema dışı renk)
<YStack backgroundColor="$info500" />
<Text color="$error500" />
```

### Space Tokens (4px grid)

```
$0=0  $0.5=2  $1=4  $1.5=6  $2=8  $2.5=10  $3=12  $3.5=14
$4=16  $5=20  $6=24  $7=28  $8=32  $9=36  $10=40
$11=44  $12=48  $14=56  $16=64  $20=80
```

Kullanım: `gap="$3"`, `paddingHorizontal="$4"`, `marginTop="$2"`

### Size Tokens (komponent yükseklikleri)

```
$1=24  $2=28  $3=32  $4=40  $5=44  $6=48  $7=52
$8=56  $9=60  $10=64  $11=72  $12=80
```

Kullanım: Button'lar `size="sm|md|lg"` şeklinde kullanır; bu token'lara karşılık gelir.

### Radius Tokens

```
$0=0  $1=4  $2=8  $3=12  $4=16  $5=24  $true=8  $full=9999
```

### Z-Index Tokens

```
$0–$10 = 0–100 (×10)
$modal=1000  $overlay=1100  $tooltip=1200  $dropdown=1300
```

## 4. Tema Sistemi

**Dosya:** `packages/ui/src/themes.ts`

### Tema Hiyerarşisi

```
light  →  light_surface     (kart/modal arkaplanı)
       →  light_overlay     (backdrop)
       →  light_user        (user paneli accent)
       →  light_business    (business paneli accent — mavi)
       →  light_admin       (admin paneli accent — mor)
       →  light_Button_active
       →  light_Input_focus

dark   →  dark_surface
       →  dark_overlay
       →  dark_user
       →  dark_business
       →  dark_admin
       →  dark_Button_active
       →  dark_Input_focus
```

Tamagui'nin `{base}_{sub}` convention'ı kullanılır. `<Theme name="user">` uygulandığında, mevcut root tema `light` ise `light_user`, `dark` ise `dark_user` otomatik seçilir.

> Tasarım yönü notu: Yeni görsel işlerde semantic tema kullanımı korunurken renk karakteri **Primary `#005696` / Secondary `#FF8C00` / Tertiary `#00CEC9` / Neutral `#F8F9FA`** etrafında kurulmalı.

### Semantic Tema Keys

Komponentlerde **hardcoded hex renk kullanılmaz**. Her zaman tema değişkenleri kullanılır:

| Key | Açıklama |
|---|---|
| `$background` | Sayfa/ekran arkaplanı |
| `$backgroundStrong` | En güçlü arkaplan (beyaz/siyah) |
| `$backgroundHover` | Hover durumu arkaplanı |
| `$backgroundPress` | Basılı durum arkaplanı |
| `$color` | Ana metin rengi |
| `$mutedForeground` | İkincil/soluk metin |
| `$borderColor` | Kenarlık rengi |
| `$primary` | Marka/aksiyon rengi |
| `$primaryHover` | Hover durumu |
| `$primaryPress` | Basılı durum |
| `$destructive` | Hata/silme rengi |
| `$muted` | Soluk arkaplan |
| `$card` | Kart arkaplanı |
| `$popover` | Popover arkaplanı |

### Tema Değerini Okuma (runtime)

```tsx
import { useTheme } from 'tamagui'

function MyComponent() {
  const theme = useTheme()
  // .get() — web'de CSS var yerine gerçek değeri döner
  const primaryColor = theme.primary?.get() ?? '#EA580C'
}
```

### Font Aileleri

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `$heading` | Başlıklar | system-ui | System | sans-serif |

### Font Boyut Skalası

```
$1=11  $2=12  $3=13  $4=14  $5=16  $6=18  $7=20
$8=24  $9=28  $10=32  $11=36  $12=40
```

Komponetlerde direkt `fontSize="$5"` veya `Text variant="body"` şeklinde kullanılır.

Kullanım:

## 7. Medya Sorguları

```tsx
// Breakpoint'ler
xs  → maxWidth: 479
sm  → maxWidth: 639
md  → maxWidth: 767
lg  → maxWidth: 1023
xl  → maxWidth: 1279
xxl → maxWidth: 1535

gtXs → minWidth: 480
gtSm → minWidth: 640
gtMd → minWidth: 768
gtLg → minWidth: 1024
```

Kullanım (styled içinde):
```tsx
const MyView = styled(YStack, {
  padding: '$4',
  $sm: { padding: '$2' },
  $xs: { padding: '$1' },
})
```

Kullanım (hook ile):
```tsx
import { useMedia } from 'tamagui'

function MyComponent() {
  const media = useMedia()
  return <Text>{media.sm ? 'Mobil' : 'Masaüstü'}</Text>
}
```
