## 8. Komponent Kütüphanesi

Tüm komponentler `import { ... } from '@antapp/ui'` ile alınır.

### Button

```tsx
<Button
  variant="solid"      // solid | outline | ghost | link
  size="md"            // sm | md | lg
  loading={false}
  disabled={false}
  icon={<Icon />}      // sol ikon
  iconAfter={<Icon />} // sağ ikon
  onPress={handlePress}
>
  Kaydet
</Button>
```

### Input + Field

`Field` label/hint/error wrapper'ı, `Input` ise input alanıdır. Her zaman birlikte kullanılır.

```tsx
<Field label="Email" hint="Kayıtlı email adresiniz" error={errorMessage}>
  <Input
    value={email}
    onChangeText={setEmail}
    variant="outline"    // outline | filled | underline
    size="md"            // sm | md | lg
    autoCapitalize="none"
    keyboardType="email-address"
    placeholder="email@example.com"
  />
</Field>
```

`error` prop'u `Field`'a verildiğinde `Input`'a otomatik olarak `error={true}` iletilir (kırmızı border).

### Text

```tsx
<Text
  variant="body"      // heading1 | heading2 | heading3 | heading4
                      // body | bodyLarge | caption | label | code
  weight="regular"    // regular | medium | semibold | bold
  align="left"        // left | center | right
  muted               // $mutedForeground rengi
  truncate            // tek satır, üç nokta
>
  İçerik
</Text>
```

### Card

Compound komponent — `Card.Header`, `Card.Content`, `Card.Footer` alt komponentleri vardır.

```tsx
<Card
  variant="outline"   // elevated | outline | filled
  size="md"           // sm | md | lg
  pressable           // tıklanabilir efekt
>
  <Card.Header>
    <Text variant="heading4">Başlık</Text>
    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">...</Button>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Content>
    <Text>İçerik</Text>
  </Card.Content>
  <Card.Footer>
    <Button variant="outline" size="sm">İptal</Button>
    <Button size="sm">Kaydet</Button>
  </Card.Footer>
</Card>
```

### Badge

```tsx
<Badge
  variant="default"   // default | success | warning | error | info
  size="md"           // sm | md
>
  Aktif
</Badge>
```

### Layout Primitifleri

```tsx
// Dikey yığın
<VStack gap="$3">...</VStack>

// Yatay yığın (items otomatik center)
<HStack gap="$2">...</HStack>

// Tam ekran ortalayıcı
<Center>...</Center>

// Sayfa genişlik sınırlayıcı (maxWidth: 960)
<Container>...</Container>

// Ayırıcı çizgi
<Divider orientation="horizontal" />  // horizontal | vertical
```

### Form Komponentleri

```tsx
// Wrapper (label + hint + error — Input/Checkbox/Switch için)
<FormField label="İsim" hint="Adınızı girin" error={error} required>
  <Input ... />
</FormField>

// Checkbox
<Checkbox
  label="Şartları kabul ediyorum"
  checked={checked}
  onCheckedChange={setChecked}
/>

// Switch
<Switch
  label="Bildirimleri aç"
  checked={enabled}
  onCheckedChange={setEnabled}
/>

// Select (Tamagui's built-in Select)
<AntSelect value={val} onValueChange={setVal}>
  <AntSelect.Trigger />
  <AntSelect.Content>
    <AntSelect.Item value="a" index={0}>Seçenek A</AntSelect.Item>
    <AntSelect.Item value="b" index={1}>Seçenek B</AntSelect.Item>
  </AntSelect.Content>
</AntSelect>
```

### Tamagui Primitive'leri (doğrudan kullanım)

`@antapp/ui`'den `export * from 'tamagui'` yapıldığı için tüm Tamagui primitive'leri de erişilebilir:

```tsx
import { YStack, XStack, ZStack, Sheet, Dialog, ScrollView } from '@antapp/ui'
// veya doğrudan tamagui'den de alınabilir — ikisi de kabul edilir
```

---

## 9. Yeni Komponent Ekleme

### Adımlar

**1. Dosyayı oluştur:**

```
packages/ui/src/components/avatar.tsx
```

**2. `styled()` ile yaz — hardcoded renk yok, her zaman semantic token:**

```tsx
import { styled, GetProps, XStack, Text as TamaguiText } from 'tamagui'

const AvatarFrame = styled(XStack, {
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  borderRadius: '$full',
  backgroundColor: '$muted',
  overflow: 'hidden',

  variants: {
    size: {
      sm: { width: 32, height: 32 },
      md: { width: 40, height: 40 },
      lg: { width: 56, height: 56 },
    },
  } as const,

  defaultVariants: {
    size: 'md',
  },
})

export type AvatarProps = Omit<GetProps<typeof AvatarFrame>, 'size'> & {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  initials?: string
}

export function Avatar({ size = 'md', initials, ...rest }: AvatarProps) {
  return (
    <AvatarFrame size={size} {...rest}>
      {initials && (
        <TamaguiText fontSize="$3" fontWeight="600" color="$mutedForeground">
          {initials}
        </TamaguiText>
      )}
    </AvatarFrame>
  )
}
```

**3. `index.ts`'e export ekle:**

```ts
// packages/ui/src/index.ts
export { Avatar } from './components/avatar'
export type { AvatarProps } from './components/avatar'
```

**4. Kullan:**

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@antapp/ui'
<Avatar size="lg" initials="EA" />
```

### Kurallar

- `react-native`'den `ActivityIndicator`, `StyleSheet`, `View`, `Text` gibi şeyler **import edilmez**. Tamagui `Spinner`, `YStack`, `Text as TamaguiText` kullanılır.
- `react-native`'den `Platform` import'u **sadece `fonts.native.ts`'e** yazılabilir, başka yere değil.
- Variant isimleri tutarlı olsun: `size` → `sm | md | lg`, `variant` → anlamlı isimler.
- `defaultVariants` her zaman tanımlanmalı.

---

## 10. Mevcut Komponenti Değiştirme

### Yeni Variant Eklemek

Örnek: `Button`'a `danger` variant'ı eklemek.

```ts
// packages/ui/src/components/button.tsx

// ButtonFrame variants içine ekle:
variant: {
  // ... mevcut variant'lar ...
  danger: {
    backgroundColor: '$destructive',
    borderColor: '$destructive',
    pressStyle: { backgroundColor: '$destructiveHover', borderColor: '$destructiveHover' },
    hoverStyle: { backgroundColor: '$destructiveHover' },
  },
},

// ButtonLabel variants içine ekle:
variant: {
  // ... mevcut variant'lar ...
  danger: { color: '$backgroundStrong' },
},

// Type güncelle:
type ButtonVariant = 'solid' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'link' | 'danger'
```

### Boyut Eklemek

```ts
// ButtonFrame size variants:
size: {
  // ... mevcut boyutlar ...
  xl: { height: '$6', paddingHorizontal: '$6' },
},

// ButtonLabel size variants:
size: {
  // ... mevcut boyutlar ...
  xl: { fontSize: '$7' },
},

// Type güncelle:
type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'
```

### Tema Key'i Değiştirmek

Tema key'ini değiştirmek tüm komponentleri etkiler. `themes.ts`'teki `BaseTheme` tipini ve `light`/`dark` objelerini güncelle. Ardından `tamagui-config.d.ts` otomatik olarak yeni tipleri alır (import `tamaguiConfig`'den).

---

## 11. Yeni Token Ekleme

### Renk Token

```ts
// packages/ui/src/tokens.ts → color objesine ekle:
color: {
  // ... mevcut renkler ...
  brand50: '#F0FDF4',
  brand500: '#22C55E',
  brand900: '#14532D',
},
```

Kullanım: `<YStack backgroundColor="$brand500" />`

### Space / Size / Radius Token

```ts
// Aralara uygun pozisyona ekle:
space: {
  // ... mevcut değerler ...
  24: 96,
},
```

### Önemli

Token eklemek/değiştirmek `themes.ts`'i **etkilemez** (temalar kendi hex değerlerini içerir). Token'lar yalnızca `$tokenName` şeklinde direkt prop'larda kullanılır.

---

## 12. Yeni Tema/Panel Ekleme

### Yeni Panel Sub-Theme'i

Örnek: `support` paneli için yeni renk teması.

```ts
// packages/ui/src/themes.ts

const lightSupport: BaseTheme = {
  ...light,
  primary: '#00CEC9',
  primaryHover: '#00B8B3',
  primaryPress: '#009B97',
}

const darkSupport: BaseTheme = {
  ...dark,
  primary: '#00CEC9',
  primaryHover: '#5FE7E3',
  primaryPress: '#A8F5F3',
}

export const themes = {
  // ... mevcut temalar ...
  light_support: lightSupport,
  dark_support: darkSupport,
}
```

Web'de ilgili layout'a ekle:

```tsx
// web/src/app/(support)/layout.tsx
import { Theme } from 'tamagui'

export default function SupportLayout({ children }) {
  return <Theme name="support">{children}</Theme>
}
```

Tamagui, `<Theme name="support">` gördüğünde mevcut root tema `light` ise `light_support`'u, `dark` ise `dark_support`'u otomatik uygular.

---

## 13. Web — Panel Theming

Her web panelinin layout'u kendi tema sub-theme'ini uygular:

```tsx
// web/src/app/(user)/layout.tsx
import { Theme } from 'tamagui'

export default function UserLayout({ children }) {
  return <Theme name="user">{children}</Theme>
}
```

```tsx
// web/src/app/(business)/layout.tsx
export default function BusinessLayout({ children }) {
  return <Theme name="business">{children}</Theme>
}
```

```tsx
// web/src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx
export default function AdminLayout({ children }) {
  return <Theme name="admin">{children}</Theme>
}
```

Root provider `defaultTheme="light"` kullanır. Dark mode toggle `NextThemeProvider` tarafından yönetilir ve `light` ↔ `dark` arası geçiş yapar. Panel sub-theme'leri bu geçişi otomatik takip eder.

---

## 14. Mobile Kullanımı

### TamaguiProvider

`mobile/src/app/_layout.tsx` — `defaultTheme` `useColorScheme`'den gelir:

```tsx
<TamaguiProvider config={tamaguiConfig} defaultTheme={colorScheme ?? 'light'}>
```

### Import Kuralı

```tsx
// ✅ Doğru
import { Button, Text, VStack, Card } from '@antapp/ui'
import { YStack, XStack } from '@antapp/ui'

// ❌ Yanlış
import { View, Text, StyleSheet } from 'react-native'
import { Button } from 'tamagui'  // tamagui'den direkt alınmaz, @antapp/ui'den alınır
```

### `fonts.native.ts` Güncelleme

Native'e özel font eklenecekse (örn. Expo Font ile yüklenen özel font):

```ts
// packages/ui/src/fonts.native.ts
import * as Font from 'expo-font'

const sansFamily = 'Inter'  // expo-font ile yüklenen font adı
```

Font'u `_layout.tsx`'te yükle, ardından `fonts.native.ts`'te referans ver.

---

## 15. Shared Screens (`packages/app`)

Platform-agnostic ekranlar `packages/app/src/screens/` altına yazılır.

### Mevcut

```
packages/app/src/screens/auth/login-screen.tsx  →  AuthLoginScreen
```

`AuthLoginScreen` props ile API'yi alır (platform-specific auth logic dışarıda kalır):

```tsx
<AuthLoginScreen
  onLogin={async (email, password) => {
    // web: server action çağır
    // mobile: AuthContext.login çağır
    return null // veya error string
  }}
/>
```

### Yeni Shared Screen Ekleme

```
packages/app/src/screens/profile/profile-screen.tsx
```

```tsx
// packages/app/src/index.ts
export { ProfileScreen } from './screens/profile/profile-screen'
```

Shared screen'ler:
- Yalnızca `@antapp/ui` ve `tamagui`'den import yapar
- Platform-specific API (cookies, secure-store, server actions) kullanmaz
- Navigasyon için `solito/link` veya prop callback kullanır

---

## 16. Kurallar — Yapılacaklar / Yapılmayacaklar

### ✅ Yapılacaklar

```tsx
// Semantic token kullan
<YStack backgroundColor="$background" />
<Text color="$mutedForeground" />

// @antapp/ui'den import et
import { Button, Card, Text } from '@antapp/ui'

// Shared wrapper component'lerde accessibility prop'larını
// web için aria-*'ya map ederek geçir

// styled() ile komponent yaz
const MyBox = styled(YStack, {
  backgroundColor: '$card',
  borderRadius: '$3',
  padding: '$4',
})

// Variant'larla esnek komponent yaz
variants: {
  size: { sm: {...}, md: {...}, lg: {...} },
} as const

// useTheme ile runtime değer oku
const theme = useTheme()
const color = theme.primary?.get() ?? '#EA580C'
```

### ❌ Yapılmayacaklar

```tsx
// Hardcoded renk — asla
<YStack backgroundColor="#005696" />
<Text color="#111827" />

// react-native primitive'leri — asla (fonts.native.ts hariç)
import { View, Text, StyleSheet, Pressable } from 'react-native'

// Shared wrapper'larda accessibilityLabel/accessibilityRole'u
// doğrudan XStack/YStack'e yayma — web'de DOM warning üretir
;<XStack accessibilityLabel="Open menu" accessibilityRole="button" />

// Platform import — sadece fonts.native.ts'te
import { Platform } from 'react-native'  // ❌ başka dosyada
// ✅ sadece packages/ui/src/fonts.native.ts'te

// StyleSheet — asla
const styles = StyleSheet.create({ ... })

// Inline style object — asla Tamagui komponentlerinde
<YStack style={{ backgroundColor: '#fff' }} />

// tamagui'den direkt komponent (override edilmişleri için)
import { Button, Text, Card } from 'tamagui'  // ❌
import { Button, Text, Card } from '@antapp/ui'  // ✅
```

---

## Hızlı Başvuru

### Sık Kullanılan Pattern'lar

```tsx
// Sayfa wrapper
<YStack f={1} bg="$background" px="$4" py="$6">

// Liste öğesi
<HStack gap="$3" px="$4" py="$3" bg="$backgroundStrong" br="$3">

// Form alanı
<VStack gap="$4">
  <Field label="Ad" error={errors.name}>
    <Input value={name} onChangeText={setName} />
  </Field>
  <Button onPress={submit} loading={pending}>Gönder</Button>
</VStack>

// Kart grid
<YStack gap="$3">
  <Card variant="elevated" pressable onPress={handlePress}>
    <Card.Content>
      <Text variant="heading4">Başlık</Text>
      <Text muted>Açıklama</Text>
    </Card.Content>
  </Card>
</YStack>

// Durum badge'i
<HStack gap="$2">
  <Badge variant="success">Aktif</Badge>
  <Badge variant="warning">Beklemede</Badge>
  <Badge variant="error">İptal</Badge>
</HStack>
```

### Config Dosyaları

| Değişiklik | Dosya |
|---|---|
| Renk ekle/değiştir | `packages/ui/src/tokens.ts` |
| Tema semantic key güncelle | `packages/ui/src/themes.ts` |
| Yeni panel teması | `packages/ui/src/themes.ts` |
| Medya query ekle | `packages/ui/src/tamagui.config.ts` |
| Shorthand ekle | `packages/ui/src/tamagui.config.ts` |
| Web font değiştir | `packages/ui/src/fonts.ts` |
| Native font değiştir | `packages/ui/src/fonts.native.ts` |
| Yeni komponent | `packages/ui/src/components/*.tsx` + `index.ts` |

# AntAPP Mobile User

Expo Router tabanli mobil user istemcisi.

cd mobile/user

import '@tamagui/native/setup-zeego';
import { DarkTheme, DefaultTheme, ThemeProvider } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import React from 'react';
import { useColorScheme } from 'react-native';
import { TamaguiProvider } from 'tamagui';
import { tamaguiConfig } from '@antapp/ui';

import { AnimatedSplashOverlay } from '@/components/icons/animated-icon';
import { BottomTabBar } from '@/components/layout/app-tabs';
import { AppBootstrapSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '@/features/auth/context';
import { AuthScreen } from '@/features/auth/auth-screen';

function AppContent() {
  const { status } = useAuth();

  if (status === 'loading') {
    return <AppBootstrapSkeleton />;
  }

  if (status === 'anonymous') {
    return <AuthScreen />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <AnimatedSplashOverlay />
      <Stack screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }} />
      <BottomTabBar />
    </>
  );
}

export default function RootLayout() {
  const colorScheme = useColorScheme();
  return (
    <TamaguiProvider config={tamaguiConfig} defaultTheme={colorScheme ?? 'light'}>
      <ThemeProvider value={colorScheme === 'dark' ? DarkTheme : DefaultTheme}>
        <AuthProvider>
          <AppContent />
        </AuthProvider>
      </ThemeProvider>
    </TamaguiProvider>
  );
}

FILE: mobile/src/app/create.tsx
================================================
import React, { useState, useTransition, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import {
  YStack, XStack, Text, Input, Button, ScrollView, Badge,
} from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { createRoute } from '@/features/routes/api'
import { getSpots } from '@/features/spots/api'
import type { SpotListItem } from '@/features/api/types'
import { TextInput, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, View, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native'

type StopEntry = {
  id: string
  spotId: string
  spotName: string
  customTitle: string
}

function generateTempId() {
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
}

function emptyStop(): StopEntry {
  return { id: generateTempId(), spotId: '', spotName: '', customTitle: '' }
}

function SpotSearchInput({
  onSelect,
  excludeIds,
}: {
  onSelect: (spot: SpotListItem) => void
  excludeIds: string[]
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [results, setResults] = useState<SpotListItem[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)

    if (!query.trim()) {
      setResults([])
      setOpen(false)
      return
    }

    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
      setLoading(true)
      try {
        const res = await getSpots({ search: query.trim(), pageSize: 5 })
        setResults(res.data.filter((s) => !excludeIds.includes(s.id)))
        setOpen(true)
      } catch {
        setResults([])
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }, 300)
  }, [query, excludeIds.join(',')])

  const handleSelect = (spot: SpotListItem) => {
    setQuery('')
    setResults([])
    setOpen(false)
    onSelect(spot)
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$1">
      <XStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$3"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
        paddingHorizontal="$3"
        alignItems="center"
        gap="$2"
      >
        <Feather name="search" size={16} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
        <TextInput
          value={query}
          onChangeText={setQuery}
          placeholder="Search spots by name..."
          placeholderTextColor="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)"
          style={{ flex: 1, paddingVertical: 12, fontSize: 14, color: 'inherit' }}
        />
        {loading ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" /> : null}
      </XStack>

      {open && results.length > 0 ? (
        <YStack
          backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
          borderRadius="$3"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor="$borderColor"
          overflow="hidden"
        >
          {results.map((spot, idx) => (
            <XStack
              key={spot.id}
              paddingHorizontal="$3"
              paddingVertical="$3"
              gap="$3"
              alignItems="center"
              cursor="pointer"
              onPress={() => handleSelect(spot)}
              borderTopWidth={idx > 0 ? 1 : 0}
              borderTopColor="$borderColor"
              pressStyle={{ backgroundColor: '$muted' }}
            >
              <Feather name="map-pin" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
              <YStack flex={1}>
                <Text variant="label">{spot.name}</Text>
                {spot.description ? (
                  <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={1}>{spot.description}</Text>
                ) : null}
              </YStack>
              <Text variant="caption" color="$primary">Add</Text>
            </XStack>
          ))}
        </YStack>
      ) : open && results.length === 0 && !loading ? (
        <YStack
          backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
          borderRadius="$3"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor="$borderColor"
          padding="$3"
          alignItems="center"
        >
          <Text variant="caption" muted>No spots found</Text>
        </YStack>
      ) : null}
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function CreateScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [stops, setStops] = useState<StopEntry[]>([emptyStop(), emptyStop()])
  const [addingStopIndex, setAddingStopIndex] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const excludeIds = stops.map((s) => s.spotId).filter(Boolean)

  const handleSelectSpot = (index: number, spot: SpotListItem) => {
    setStops((prev) =>
      prev.map((s, i) =>
        i === index
          ? { ...s, spotId: spot.id, spotName: spot.name, customTitle: spot.name }
          : s
      )
    )
    setAddingStopIndex(null)
  }

  const handleClearStop = (index: number) => {
    setStops((prev) =>
      prev.map((s, i) =>
        i === index ? { ...s, spotId: '', spotName: '', customTitle: '' } : s
      )
    )
  }

  const handleAddStop = () => {
    setStops((prev) => [...prev, emptyStop()])
  }

  const handleRemoveStop = (id: string) => {
    setStops((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== id))
  }

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setError(null)

    if (!title.trim()) {
      setError('Route title is required.')
      return
    }

    const validStops = stops.filter((s) => s.spotId.trim())
    if (validStops.length < 2) {
      setError('A route must have at least 2 spots.')
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const routeId = await createRoute({
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description.trim() || undefined,
          spots: validStops.map((s) => ({
            spotId: s.spotId,
            customTitle: s.customTitle.trim() || undefined,
          })),
        })
        router.replace(`/routes/${routeId}`)
      } catch (e) {
        setError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to create route.')
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled">
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={120} gap="$5">
          <YStack gap="$1">
            <Text variant="heading2">Create Route</Text>
            <Text variant="body" muted>Build your adventure</Text>
          </YStack>

          {/* Route Info */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <Text variant="heading4">Route Information</Text>

            <YStack gap="$1.5">
              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Title *</Text>
              <Input
                value={title}
                onChangeText={setTitle}
                placeholder="e.g. Classic Kaleici History Tour"
                variant="outline"
              />
            </YStack>

            <YStack gap="$1.5">
              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Description</Text>
              <Input
                value={description}
                onChangeText={setDescription}
                placeholder="Describe your route..."
                variant="outline"
                multiline
                numberOfLines={3}
                height={80}
                textAlignVertical="top"
              />
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Route Stops */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
              <YStack>
                <Text variant="heading4">Route Stops</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Search and add at least 2 spots</Text>
              </YStack>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onPress={handleAddStop} icon={<Feather name="plus" size={14} />}>
                Add Stop
              </Button>
            </XStack>

            <YStack gap="$4">
              {stops.map((stop, idx) => (
                <XStack key={stop.id} gap="$3" alignItems="flex-start">
                  {/* Step number */}
                  <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1" paddingTop="$1">
                    <XStack
                      width={32}
                      height={32}
                      borderRadius="$full"
                      backgroundColor={stop.spotId ? '$primary' : '$muted'}
                      alignItems="center"
                      justifyContent="center"
                    >
                      <Text variant="label" color={stop.spotId ? '#FFFFFF' : '$mutedForeground'} fontSize="$3">
                        {idx + 1}
                      </Text>
                    </XStack>
                    {idx < stops.length - 1 ? (
                      <YStack width={2} height={20} backgroundColor="$borderColor" />
                    ) : null}
                  </YStack>

                  {/* Stop content */}
                  <YStack flex={1} gap="$2">
                    {stop.spotId ? (
                      <XStack
                        backgroundColor="$primary50"
                        padding="$3"
                        borderRadius="$3"
                        alignItems="center"
                        justifyContent="space-between"
                        borderWidth={1}
                        borderColor="$primary200"
                      >
                        <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center" flex={1}>
                          <Feather name="map-pin" size={14} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                          <Text variant="label" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1} flex={1}>{stop.customTitle || stop.spotName}</Text>
                        </XStack>
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onPress={() => handleClearStop(idx)}>
                          Change
                        </Button>
                      </XStack>
                    ) : addingStopIndex === idx ? (
                      <SpotSearchInput
                        onSelect={(spot) => handleSelectSpot(idx, spot)}
                        excludeIds={excludeIds}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <XStack
                        backgroundColor="$muted"
                        padding="$3"
                        borderRadius="$3"
                        borderWidth={1}
                        borderStyle="dashed"
                        borderColor="$borderColor"
                        alignItems="center"
                        gap="$2"
                        cursor="pointer"
                        onPress={() => setAddingStopIndex(idx)}
                      >
                        <Feather name="search" size={14} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                        <Text variant="caption" muted>Tap to search for a spot</Text>
                      </XStack>
                    )}
                  </YStack>

                  {stops.length > 2 ? (
                    <XStack paddingTop="$1" cursor="pointer" onPress={() => handleRemoveStop(stop.id)} padding="$2">
                      <Feather name="trash-2" size={16} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />
                    </XStack>
                  ) : null}
                </XStack>
              ))}
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          {error ? (
            <YStack backgroundColor="$error50" borderRadius="$3" padding="$3" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$error200">
              <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">{error}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Sticky bottom actions */}
      <YStack
        position="absolute"
        bottom={0}
        left={0}
        right={0}
        paddingHorizontal="$4"
        paddingTop="$3"
        paddingBottom={insets.bottom + 12}
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderTopWidth={1}
        borderTopColor="$borderColor"
      >
        <Button
          variant="solid"
          size="lg"
          loading={isPending}
          disabled={isPending || !title.trim()}
          onPress={handleSubmit}
        >
          Create Route
        </Button>
      </YStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, SearchInput, FilterChip, RouteCard, ScrollView } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { getRoutes, getTags } from '@/features/routes/api'
import type { RouteContentType, RouteListItem, Tag } from '@/features/api/types'
import { routeToCardData } from '@/features/routes/presenters'
import { ExploreScreenSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

const ROUTE_TYPES: { label: string; value: RouteContentType | '' }[] = [
  { label: 'All', value: '' },
  { label: 'Official', value: 'Official' },
  { label: 'Community', value: 'Community' },
]

export default function ExploreScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ q?: string; sort?: string; type?: string }>()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(params.q ?? '')
  const [activeTagId, setActiveTagId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const initialRouteType =
    params.type === 'official'
      ? 'Official'
      : params.type === 'community'
        ? 'Community'
        : params.type === 'sponsored'
          ? 'Sponsored'
          : ''

  const [routeType, setRouteType] = useState<RouteContentType | ''>(initialRouteType)
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>([])
  const [results, setResults] = useState<RouteListItem[]>([])
  const [totalResults, setTotalResults] = useState(0)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    getTags(100).then(setTags).catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  const fetchResults = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const result = await getRoutes({
        search: search.trim() || undefined,
        tagIds: activeTagId ? [activeTagId] : undefined,
        type: routeType ? routeType.toLowerCase() as 'official' | 'community' | 'sponsored' : undefined,
        sort: params.sort,
        pageSize: 20,
      })
      setResults(result.data)
      setTotalResults(result.totalRecords)
    } catch {
      setResults([])
      setTotalResults(0)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [activeTagId, params.sort, routeType, search])

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(fetchResults, 250)
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout)
  }, [fetchResults])

  const activeTags = useMemo(() => tags.filter((tag) => tag.isActive), [tags])

  if (loading && results.length === 0) {
    return <ExploreScreenSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={100} gap="$4">
          <YStack gap="$3">
            <Text variant="heading2">Explore Routes</Text>
            <SearchInput
              value={search}
              onChangeText={setSearch}
              placeholder="Search routes..."
              size="md"
            />
          </YStack>

          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
            <XStack gap="$2">
              {ROUTE_TYPES.map((type) => (
                <FilterChip
                  key={type.value || 'all'}
                  active={routeType === type.value}
                  onPress={() => setRouteType(type.value)}
                >
                  {type.label}
                </FilterChip>
              ))}
            </XStack>
          </ScrollView>

          {activeTags.length > 0 ? (
            <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
              <XStack gap="$2">
                <FilterChip active={!activeTagId} onPress={() => setActiveTagId(null)}>
                  All Tags
                </FilterChip>
                {activeTags.map((tag) => (
                  <FilterChip
                    key={tag.id}
                    active={activeTagId === tag.id}
                    onPress={() => setActiveTagId(activeTagId === tag.id ? null : tag.id)}
                  >
                    {tag.name}
                  </FilterChip>
                ))}
              </XStack>
            </ScrollView>
          ) : null}

          <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
            <Text variant="heading4">Results</Text>
            <Text variant="body" muted>
              {loading ? 'Searching...' : `${totalResults} routes found`}
            </Text>
          </XStack>

          {results.length > 0 ? (
            <YStack gap="$4">
              {results.map((route) => (
                <RouteCard
                  key={route.id}
                  data={routeToCardData(route)}
                  onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
                />
              ))}
            </YStack>
          ) : !loading ? (
            <YStack
              alignItems="center"
              justifyContent="center"
              backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
              borderRadius="$4"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor="$borderColor"
              padding="$6"
              gap="$3"
            >
              <Feather name="map" size={36} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
              <Text variant="heading4" muted>No routes found</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted align="center">
                Try adjusting the search term or filters.
              </Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { Share } from 'react-native'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Avatar, StatBox, Button, RouteCard, ScrollView, Badge } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { useAuth } from '@/features/auth/context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { CurrentUser, RouteListItem } from '@/features/api/types'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/features/account/api'
import { getRoutes, publishRoute, unpublishRoute } from '@/features/routes/api'
import { routeToCardData } from '@/features/routes/presenters'
import { ProfileScreenSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

function RouteActionCard({
  route,
  onPress,
}: {
  route: RouteListItem
  onPress: () => void
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(route.isPublic)
  const [isToggling, startToggle] = useTransition()

  const handleTogglePublish = () => {
    startToggle(async () => {
      try {
        if (isPublic) {
          await unpublishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(false)
        } else {
          await publishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(true)
        }
      } catch {}
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack position="relative">
      <RouteCard
        data={routeToCardData(route)}
        onPress={onPress}
      />
      {/* Overlay action bar — matches web exactly */}
      <XStack
        position="absolute"
        bottom={0}
        left={0}
        right={0}
        backgroundColor="rgba(0,0,0,0.65)"
        borderBottomLeftRadius={12}
        borderBottomRightRadius={12}
        paddingHorizontal="$3"
        paddingVertical="$2"
        gap="$2"
        justifyContent="flex-end"
        alignItems="center"
      >
        {/* Status indicator */}
        <XStack flex={1} alignItems="center" gap="$1.5">
          <Feather
            name={isPublic ? 'globe' : 'lock'}
            size={13}
            color={isPublic ? '#4ade80' : '#d1d5db'}
          />
          <Text
            variant="caption"
            color={isPublic ? '#4ade80' : '#d1d5db'}
            fontSize={11}
          >
            {isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}
          </Text>
        </XStack>

        {/* Toggle publish */}
        <XStack
          cursor="pointer"
          paddingHorizontal="$2"
          paddingVertical="$1"
          borderRadius="$2"
          backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)"
          pressStyle={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' }}
          opacity={isToggling ? 0.5 : 1}
          onPress={handleTogglePublish}
        >
          <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF" fontSize={11}>
            {isPublic ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
          </Text>
        </XStack>

        {/* Edit */}
        <XStack
          cursor="pointer"
          padding="$1.5"
          borderRadius="$2"
          backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)"
          pressStyle={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' }}
          onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}/edit`)}
        >
          <Feather name="edit-2" size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />
        </XStack>
      </XStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function ProfileScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const { user, logout } = useAuth()
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<CurrentUser | null>(null)
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<RouteListItem[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return

    let mounted = true

    Promise.allSettled([
      getCurrentUser(),
      getRoutes({ authorId: user.id, pageSize: 20 }),
    ]).then((results) => {
      if (!mounted) return

      const [profileResult, routesResult] = results
      setProfile(profileResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? profileResult.value : null)
      setRoutes(routesResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? routesResult.value.data : [])
      setLoading(false)
    })

    return () => { mounted = false }
  }, [user?.id])

  const publicCount = useMemo(() => routes.filter((r) => r.isPublic).length, [routes])
  const privateCount = routes.length - publicCount
  const displayName = profile?.userName ?? user?.userName ?? 'User'
  const initials = displayName.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()

  const handleShare = () => {
    Share.share({
      title: displayName,
      message: `Check out ${displayName}'s profile on AntAPP`,
    }).catch(() => {})
  }

  if (loading) {
    return <ProfileScreenSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={100} gap="$5">
          {/* Top bar */}
          <XStack justifyContent="flex-end" gap="$2">
            <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={handleShare} padding="$2" borderRadius="$full">
              <Feather name="share-2" size={20} color="currentColor" />
            </XStack>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onPress={() => router.push('/settings')}
              icon={<Feather name="settings" size={14} />}
            >
              Edit Profile
            </Button>
          </XStack>

          {/* Avatar & info */}
          <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
            <Avatar size="xl" initials={initials} src={profile?.profilePhotoUrl ?? undefined} />
            <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
              <Text variant="heading2">{displayName}</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted>{profile?.email ?? user?.email}</Text>
            </YStack>

            {!profile?.isVerified ? (
              <XStack backgroundColor="$warning50" paddingHorizontal="$3" paddingVertical="$1.5" borderRadius="$full">
                <Text variant="caption" color="$warning500">Email not verified</Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : null}

            {profile?.roles?.length ? (
              <XStack gap="$1.5" flexWrap="wrap" justifyContent="center">
                {profile.roles.map((role) => (
                  <Badge key={role} variant="info" size="sm">{role}</Badge>
                ))}
              </XStack>
            ) : null}
          </YStack>

          {/* Stats */}
          <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
            <StatBox value={routes.length} label="Routes" flex={1} />
            {publicCount > 0 ? <StatBox value={publicCount} label="Public" flex={1} /> : null}
            {privateCount > 0 ? <StatBox value={privateCount} label="Private" flex={1} /> : null}
          </XStack>

          {/* Routes */}
          <YStack gap="$3">
            <Text variant="heading3">My Routes</Text>

            {routes.length > 0 ? (
              <YStack gap="$4">
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <RouteActionCard
                    key={route.id}
                    route={route}
                    onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
                  />
                ))}

                {/* Create placeholder card */}
                <YStack
                  borderRadius="$4"
                  borderWidth={2}
                  borderStyle="dashed"
                  borderColor="$borderColor"
                  alignItems="center"
                  justifyContent="center"
                  height={100}
                  cursor="pointer"
                  gap="$2"
                  onPress={() => router.push('/create')}
                  pressStyle={{ borderColor: '$primary', backgroundColor: '$ant50' }}
                >
                  <Feather name="plus-circle" size={24} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                  <Text variant="label" color="$primary">Create Route</Text>
                </YStack>
              </YStack>
            ) : !loading ? (
              <YStack
                alignItems="center"
                justifyContent="center"
                height={200}
                gap="$3"
                borderRadius="$4"
                borderWidth={2}
                borderStyle="dashed"
                borderColor="$borderColor"
                cursor="pointer"
                onPress={() => router.push('/create')}
                pressStyle={{ borderColor: '$primary', backgroundColor: '$ant50' }}
              >
                <Feather name="plus-circle" size={32} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
                  <Text variant="label" color="$primary">Create Route</Text>
                  <Text variant="body" muted>Share your latest adventure</Text>
                </YStack>
              </YStack>
            ) : (
              <Text variant="body" muted>Loading your routes...</Text>
            )}
          </YStack>

          {/* Logout */}
          <Button variant="ghost" size="md" onPress={logout}>
            <Text variant="label" color="$error500">Logout</Text>
          </Button>
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Badge, ScrollView, Switch } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { Collection } from '@/features/api/types'
import {
  createCollection,
  deleteCollection,
  getCollections,
} from '@/features/collections/api'

type FeedbackState = {
  ok: boolean
  message: string
} | null

export default function SavedScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const [collections, setCollections] = useState<Collection[]>([])
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [showCreateForm, setShowCreateForm] = useState(false)
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(false)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const loadCollections = async () => {
    try {
      const result = await getCollections(1, 50)
      setCollections(result.data)
    } catch (error) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to load collections.' })
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCollections().catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  const handleCreateCollection = () => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Collection name is required.' })
      return
    }

    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await createCollection({
          name: name.trim(),
          description: description.trim() || undefined,
          isPublic,
        })
        setName('')
        setDescription('')
        setIsPublic(false)
        setShowCreateForm(false)
        await loadCollections()
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Collection created successfully.' })
      } catch (error) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to create collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDeleteCollection = (collectionId: string) => {
    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteCollection(collectionId)
        await loadCollections()
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Collection deleted successfully.' })
      } catch (error) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to delete collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={100} gap="$4">
          <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3">
            <YStack gap="$1">
              <Text variant="heading2">My Collections</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted>Save and organize your favorite routes</Text>
            </YStack>
            <Button variant="solid" size="sm" onPress={() => setShowCreateForm((value) => !value)}>
              {showCreateForm ? 'Close' : 'New'}
            </Button>
          </XStack>

          {feedback ? (
            <YStack
              padding="$3"
              borderRadius="$3"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor={feedback.ok ? '$success200' : '$error200'}
              backgroundColor={feedback.ok ? '$success50' : '$error50'}
            >
              <Text variant="body" color={feedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>{feedback.message}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {showCreateForm ? (
            <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
              <Text variant="heading4">Create collection</Text>
              <YStack gap="$3">
                <YStack gap="$1.5">
                  <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Name *</Text>
                  <Input value={name} onChangeText={setName} placeholder="Weekend favorites" variant="outline" />
                </YStack>
                <YStack gap="$1.5">
                  <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Description</Text>
                  <Input
                    value={description}
                    onChangeText={setDescription}
                    placeholder="A short description"
                    variant="outline"
                    multiline
                    numberOfLines={3}
                  />
                </YStack>
                <Switch
                  label="Public collection"
                  checked={isPublic}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => setIsPublic(Boolean(checked))}
                />
              </YStack>
              <Button variant="solid" onPress={handleCreateCollection} loading={isPending} disabled={isPending}>
                Create Collection
              </Button>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {collections.length > 0 ? (
            <YStack gap="$4">
              {collections.map((collection) => (
                <YStack
                  key={collection.id}
                  backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                  borderRadius="$4"
                  borderWidth={1}
                  borderColor="$borderColor"
                  padding="$4"
                  gap="$3"
                >
                  <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3">
                    <YStack flex={1} gap="$1">
                      <Text variant="heading4">{collection.name}</Text>
                      {collection.description ? <Text variant="caption" muted>{collection.description}</Text> : null}
                    </YStack>
                    <XStack gap="$2">
                      {collection.isDefault ? <Badge variant="info" size="sm">Default</Badge> : null}
                      <Badge variant={collection.isPublic ? 'success' : 'warning'} size="sm">
                        {collection.isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}
                      </Badge>
                    </XStack>
                  </XStack>

                  <Text variant="caption" muted>{collection.routeCount} routes</Text>

                  <XStack gap="$3">
                    <Button variant="outline" flex={1} onPress={() => router.push(`/saved/${collection.id}`)}>
                      Open
                    </Button>
                    {!collection.isDefault ? (
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        onPress={() => handleDeleteCollection(collection.id)}
                        loading={isPending}
                        disabled={isPending}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </Button>
                    ) : null}
                  </XStack>
                </YStack>
              ))}
            </YStack>
          ) : (
            <YStack alignItems="center" justifyContent="center" paddingVertical="$10" gap="$4">
              <XStack
                width={72}
                height={72}
                borderRadius="$full"
                backgroundColor="$ant50"
                alignItems="center"
                justifyContent="center"
              >
                <Feather name="bookmark" size={32} color="var(--color-primary, #005696)" />
              </XStack>
              <Text variant="heading4" muted>No collections yet</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted align="center" maxWidth={280}>
                Save routes you love and create collections to keep them organized.
              </Text>
            </YStack>
          )}
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Avatar, Divider, ScrollView } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { useAuth } from '@/features/auth/context'
import { updateProfile, changePassword } from '@/features/account/api'

type FeedbackState = { ok: boolean; message: string } | null

export default function SettingsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const { user } = useAuth()

  const [userName, setUserName] = useState(user?.userName ?? '')
  const [profileFeedback, setProfileFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isUpdatingProfile, startProfileUpdate] = useTransition()

  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('')
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [passwordFeedback, setPasswordFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isChangingPw, startPwChange] = useTransition()

  const handleProfileSave = () => {
    setProfileFeedback(null)
    startProfileUpdate(async () => {
      try {
        await updateProfile({ userName: userName.trim() })
        setProfileFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Profile updated successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setProfileFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update profile.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handlePasswordChange = () => {
    setPasswordFeedback(null)
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setPasswordFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Passwords do not match.' })
      return
    }
    startPwChange(async () => {
      try {
        await changePassword({ currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword })
        setPasswordFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Password changed successfully.' })
        setCurrentPassword('')
        setNewPassword('')
        setConfirmPassword('')
      } catch (e) {
        setPasswordFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to change password.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const initials = user?.userName?.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() ?? 'U'

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={100} gap="$5">
          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
            <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={() => router.back()} padding="$2" borderRadius="$full">
              <Feather name="arrow-left" size={20} color="currentColor" />
            </XStack>
            <YStack flex={1}>
              <Text variant="heading2">Settings</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted>Manage your account and preferences</Text>
            </YStack>
          </XStack>

          {/* Profile Section */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
              <Feather name="user" size={20} color="var(--color-primary)" />
              <Text variant="heading4">Profile Information</Text>
            </XStack>

            <Divider />

            <XStack gap="$4" alignItems="center">
              <Avatar size="lg" initials={initials} />
              <YStack gap="$0.5">
                <Text variant="body" weight="semibold">{user?.userName ?? '—'}</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>{user?.email ?? '—'}</Text>
              </YStack>
            </XStack>

            <YStack gap="$1.5">
              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Username</Text>
              <Input
                value={userName}
                onChangeText={setUserName}
                variant="outline"
                size="md"
                placeholder="Your username"
                autoCapitalize="none"
              />
            </YStack>

            {profileFeedback ? (
              <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
                <Feather
                  name={profileFeedback.ok ? 'check-circle' : 'alert-circle'}
                  size={16}
                  color={profileFeedback.ok ? 'var(--color-success500, #22C55E)' : 'var(--color-error500, #DC2626)'}
                />
                <Text variant="caption" color={profileFeedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>
                  {profileFeedback.message}
                </Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : null}

            <Button
              variant="solid"
              size="md"
              alignSelf="flex-start"
              loading={isUpdatingProfile}
              disabled={isUpdatingProfile || !userName.trim() || userName === user?.userName}
              onPress={handleProfileSave}
            >
              Save Changes
            </Button>
          </YStack>

          {/* Password Section */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
              <Feather name="lock" size={20} color="var(--color-primary)" />
              <Text variant="heading4">Change Password</Text>
            </XStack>

            <Divider />

            <YStack gap="$3">
              <YStack gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Current Password</Text>
                <Input
                  value={currentPassword}
                  onChangeText={setCurrentPassword}
                  secureTextEntry
                  variant="outline"
                  size="md"
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                />
              </YStack>

              <YStack gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">New Password</Text>
                <Input
                  value={newPassword}
                  onChangeText={setNewPassword}
                  secureTextEntry
                  variant="outline"
                  size="md"
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                />
              </YStack>

              <YStack gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Confirm New Password</Text>
                <Input
                  value={confirmPassword}
                  onChangeText={setConfirmPassword}
                  secureTextEntry
                  variant="outline"
                  size="md"
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                />
              </YStack>
            </YStack>

            {passwordFeedback ? (
              <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
                <Feather
                  name={passwordFeedback.ok ? 'check-circle' : 'alert-circle'}
                  size={16}
                  color={passwordFeedback.ok ? 'var(--color-success500, #22C55E)' : 'var(--color-error500, #DC2626)'}
                />
                <Text variant="caption" color={passwordFeedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>
                  {passwordFeedback.message}
                </Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : null}

            <Button
              variant="solid"
              size="md"
              alignSelf="flex-start"
              loading={isChangingPw}
              disabled={isChangingPw || !currentPassword || !newPassword || newPassword !== confirmPassword}
              onPress={handlePasswordChange}
            >
              Change Password
            </Button>
          </YStack>

          {/* Account Info */}
          {user ? (
            <YStack backgroundColor="$muted" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$2">
              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Account Details</Text>
              <XStack gap="$4" flexWrap="wrap">
                <YStack gap="$0.5">
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>Roles</Text>
                  <Text variant="body">{user.roles.join(', ')}</Text>
                </YStack>
                <YStack gap="$0.5">
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>Email</Text>
                  <Text variant="body">{user.email}</Text>
                </YStack>
              </XStack>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>
    </YStack>
  )
}

FILE: mobile/src/app/spots.tsx
================================================
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { FlatList, ActivityIndicator, TextInput } from 'react-native'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, RatingDisplay, Badge } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { getSpots, getSavedSpots, toggleSpotFavorite } from '@/features/spots/api'
import type { SpotListItem } from '@/features/api/types'
import { SpotsScreenSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

const PAGE_SIZE = 20

type ViewMode = 'all' | 'saved'

function SpotCard({
  spot,
  isFavorite,
  onPress,
  onToggleFavorite,
  isToggling,
}: {
  spot: SpotListItem
  isFavorite: boolean
  onPress: () => void
  onToggleFavorite: () => void
  isToggling: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <XStack
      backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
      borderRadius="$4"
      borderWidth={1}
      borderColor="$borderColor"
      padding="$4"
      gap="$3"
      cursor="pointer"
      onPress={onPress}
      pressStyle={{ opacity: 0.85 }}
    >
      <YStack
        width={52}
        height={52}
        borderRadius="$3"
        backgroundColor={spot.photoUrl ? '$muted' : '$primary50'}
        alignItems="center"
        justifyContent="center"
        flexShrink={0}
        overflow="hidden"
      >
        <Feather name="map-pin" size={22} color="var(--color-primary)" />
      </YStack>

      <YStack flex={1} gap="$1.5">
        <Text variant="heading4" numberOfLines={1}>{spot.name}</Text>
        {spot.description ? (
          <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={2}>{spot.description}</Text>
        ) : null}
        <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="center">
          <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lat {spot.latitude.toFixed(3)}</Badge>
          <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lng {spot.longitude.toFixed(3)}</Badge>
          {spot.averageRating > 0 ? (
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
              <RatingDisplay value={spot.averageRating} />
              <Text variant="caption" muted>{spot.averageRating.toFixed(1)}</Text>
            </XStack>
          ) : null}
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      <XStack
        padding="$2"
        cursor="pointer"
        onPress={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation?.()
          if (!isToggling) onToggleFavorite()
        }}
        opacity={isToggling ? 0.5 : 1}
        alignSelf="center"
      >
        <Feather
          name="heart"
          size={20}
          color={isFavorite ? '#EF4444' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)'}
        />
      </XStack>
    </XStack>
  )
}

export default function SpotsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>('all')
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [activeSearch, setActiveSearch] = useState('')
  const [spots, setSpots] = useState<SpotListItem[]>([])
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0)
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false)
  const [savedIds, setSavedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const [togglingId, setTogglingId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const loadSavedIds = async () => {
    try {
      const saved = await getSavedSpots()
      setSavedIds(new Set(saved.map((s) => s.id)))
    } catch {}
  }

  const loadSpots = useCallback(async (searchQuery: string, pageNum: number, mode: ViewMode) => {
    if (pageNum === 1) {
      setLoading(true)
      setSpots([])
    } else {
      setLoadingMore(true)
    }
    setError(null)

    try {
      if (mode === 'saved') {
        const result = await getSavedSpots()
        setSpots(result)
        setTotal(result.length)
        setTotalPages(1)
        setPage(1)
      } else {
        const result = await getSpots({
          search: searchQuery || undefined,
          page: pageNum,
          pageSize: PAGE_SIZE,
        })
        setSpots((prev) => pageNum === 1 ? result.data : [...prev, ...result.data])
        setTotal(result.totalRecords)
        setTotalPages(result.totalPages)
        setPage(pageNum)
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to load spots.')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
      setLoadingMore(false)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSavedIds()
    loadSpots('', 1, 'all')
  }, [])

  const handleSearchChange = (text: string) => {
    setSearch(text)
    if (viewMode === 'saved') return
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current)
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setActiveSearch(text)
      loadSpots(text, 1, 'all')
    }, 350)
  }

  const handleViewModeChange = (mode: ViewMode) => {
    setViewMode(mode)
    loadSpots(activeSearch, 1, mode)
  }

  const handleLoadMore = () => {
    if (loadingMore || page >= totalPages || viewMode === 'saved') return
    loadSpots(activeSearch, page + 1, viewMode)
  }

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (spotId: string) => {
    setTogglingId(spotId)
    try {
      const nowFavorite = await toggleSpotFavorite(spotId)
      setSavedIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev)
        if (nowFavorite) {
          next.add(spotId)
        } else {
          next.delete(spotId)
          if (viewMode === 'saved') {
            setSpots((current) => {
              const refreshed = current.filter((s) => s.id !== spotId)
              setTotal(refreshed.length)
              return refreshed
            })
          }
        }
        return next
      })
    } catch {}
    setTogglingId(null)
  }

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: SpotListItem }) => (
    <SpotCard
      spot={item}
      isFavorite={savedIds.has(item.id)}
      isToggling={togglingId === item.id}
      onPress={() => router.push(`/spots/${item.id}`)}
      onToggleFavorite={() => handleToggleFavorite(item.id)}
    />
  )

  const ListHeader = (
    <YStack gap="$4" paddingBottom="$2">
      {/* Page header */}
      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$4"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
        padding="$4"
        gap="$3"
      >
        <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
          <Feather name="compass" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
          <Text variant="caption" color="$primary">SPOTS DIRECTORY</Text>
        </XStack>
        <Text variant="heading2">Discover destinations</Text>
        <Text variant="body" muted>
          Browse places, inspect ratings, and find routes that include them.
        </Text>

        {/* Search + toggle row */}
        <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center" flexWrap="wrap">
          <XStack
            flex={1}
            backgroundColor="$muted"
            borderRadius="$3"
            borderWidth={1}
            borderColor="$borderColor"
            paddingHorizontal="$3"
            alignItems="center"
            gap="$2"
            opacity={viewMode === 'saved' ? 0.5 : 1}
          >
            <Feather name="search" size={14} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
            <TextInput
              value={search}
              onChangeText={handleSearchChange}
              placeholder="Search spots..."
              placeholderTextColor="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)"
              style={{ flex: 1, paddingVertical: 10, fontSize: 14, color: 'inherit' }}
              editable={viewMode === 'all'}
            />
            {search && viewMode === 'all' ? (
              <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={() => handleSearchChange('')} padding="$1">
                <Feather name="x" size={12} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
              </XStack>
            ) : null}
          </XStack>

          {/* All / Saved toggle */}
          <XStack backgroundColor="$muted" borderRadius="$3" padding="$0.5" gap="$0.5">
            <Button
              variant={viewMode === 'all' ? 'solid' : 'ghost'}
              size="sm"
              onPress={() => handleViewModeChange('all')}
            >
              All
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={viewMode === 'saved' ? 'solid' : 'ghost'}
              size="sm"
              onPress={() => handleViewModeChange('saved')}
              icon={<Feather name="heart" size={12} color={viewMode === 'saved' ? '#FFFFFF' : 'var(--color-primary)'} />}
            >
              Saved
            </Button>
          </XStack>

          <Badge variant="info" size="md">
            {loading ? '...' : `${total}`}
          </Badge>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      {spots.length > 0 ? (
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
          <Text variant="heading3">{viewMode === 'saved' ? 'Saved Spots' : 'All Spots'}</Text>
          <Text variant="caption" muted>{spots.length} visible</Text>
        </XStack>
      ) : null}
    </YStack>
  )

  const ListEmpty = loading ? null : (
    <YStack
      padding="$6"
      backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
      borderRadius="$4"
      borderWidth={1}
      borderColor="$borderColor"
      alignItems="center"
      gap="$3"
    >
      <Feather name="map-pin" size={36} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
      <Text variant="heading4" muted>
        {viewMode === 'saved'
          ? 'No saved spots yet'
          : activeSearch
          ? `No spots found for "${activeSearch}"`
          : 'No spots yet'}
      </Text>
      <Text variant="body" muted align="center">
        {viewMode === 'saved'
          ? 'Tap the heart on any spot to save it here.'
          : 'Try a different search term.'}
      </Text>
    </YStack>
  )

  const ListFooter = loadingMore ? (
    <YStack padding="$4" alignItems="center">
      <ActivityIndicator />
    </YStack>
  ) : null

  if (loading && spots.length === 0) {
    return <SpotsScreenSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <FlatList
        data={spots}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={renderItem}
        ListHeaderComponent={ListHeader}
        ListEmptyComponent={ListEmpty}
        ListFooterComponent={ListFooter}
        onEndReached={handleLoadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.3}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={{
          paddingHorizontal: 16,
          paddingTop: insets.top + 12,
          paddingBottom: 100,
          gap: 12,
        }}
      />

      {error ? (
        <YStack
          position="absolute"
          bottom={insets.bottom + 16}
          left="$4"
          right="$4"
          backgroundColor="$error50"
          borderRadius="$3"
          padding="$3"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor="$error200"
        >
          <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">{error}</Text>
        </YStack>
      ) : null}
    </YStack>
  )
}
