import React, { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { Share } from 'react-native'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, StatBox, RatingDisplay, ScrollView, Badge } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { RouteDetail } from '@/features/api/types'
import { getRouteById, rateRoute, forkRoute } from '@/features/routes/api'
import { useAuth } from '@/features/auth/context'
import { SaveToCollectionModal } from '@/components/modals/save-to-collection-modal'
import { RouteMap } from '@/components/map/route-map'
import { RouteDetailSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

function RouteRatingWidget({
  routeId,
  onRated,
}: {
  routeId: string
  onRated: (score: number) => void
}) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(0)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const active = hovered || selected

  const handleRate = (score: number) => {
    if (submitted) return

    setSelected(score)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await rateRoute(routeId, score)
        setSubmitted(true)
        onRated(score)
      } catch {
        setSelected(0)
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$3">
      <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Rate this route</Text>
      <XStack gap="$1.5" alignItems="center">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
          <XStack
            key={score}
            padding="$1"
            borderRadius="$2"
            cursor={submitted || isPending ? 'default' : 'pointer'}
            onPress={() => handleRate(score)}
            // @ts-ignore web-only
            onMouseEnter={() => !submitted && !isPending && setHovered(score)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(0)}
          >
            <Feather
              name="star"
              size={24}
              color={score <= active ? '#FF8C00' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)'}
            />
          </XStack>
        ))}
        {isPending ? <Text variant="caption" muted>Saving...</Text> : null}
      </XStack>
      {submitted ? (
        <Text variant="caption" color="$success500">Thanks for rating this route.</Text>
      ) : null}
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function RouteDetailScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>()
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const { user } = useAuth()

  const [route, setRoute] = useState<RouteDetail | null>(null)
  const [displayRating, setDisplayRating] = useState(0)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [collectionModalVisible, setCollectionModalVisible] = useState(false)
  const [isForking, startFork] = useTransition()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return

    let mounted = true
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    getRouteById(id)
      .then((r) => {
        if (!mounted) return
        setRoute(r)
        setDisplayRating(r.averageRating)
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!mounted) return
        setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load route.')
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!mounted) return
        setLoading(false)
      })

    return () => { mounted = false }
  }, [id])

  const isOwner = !!user && !!route && route.authorUserId === user.id

  const handleFork = () => {
    if (!route) return
    startFork(async () => {
      try {
        const newId = await forkRoute(route.id)
        router.push(`/routes/${newId}/edit`)
      } catch (e) {
        setError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to fork route.')
      }
    })
  }

  const handleShare = () => {
    if (!route) return
    Share.share({
      title: route.title,
      message: `Check out this route: ${route.title}`,
    }).catch(() => {})
  }

  if (loading) {
    return <RouteDetailSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  if (!route) {
    return (
      <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background" alignItems="center" justifyContent="center" padding="$5" gap="$3">
        <Text variant="heading4">Route not available</Text>
        <Text variant="body" muted align="center">{error ?? 'We could not load this route.'}</Text>
        <Button variant="outline" onPress={() => router.back()}>Go Back</Button>
      </YStack>
    )
  }

  const distanceKm = route.totalDistanceMeters > 0
    ? (route.totalDistanceMeters / 1000).toFixed(1) + ' km'
    : '—'

  const durationMin = route.estimatedDurationSeconds > 0
    ? Math.round(route.estimatedDurationSeconds / 60) + ' min'
    : '—'

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingBottom={140}>
          {/* Header */}
          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$ant900"
            paddingHorizontal="$4"
            paddingTop={insets.top + 12}
            paddingBottom="$5"
            gap="$3"
          >
            <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2" cursor="pointer" onPress={() => router.back()}>
                <Feather name="arrow-left" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
                <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">Back</Text>
              </XStack>
              <XStack gap="$2">
                <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={handleShare} padding="$2">
                  <Feather name="share-2" size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
                </XStack>
                {isOwner ? (
                  <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}/edit`)} padding="$2">
                    <Feather name="edit-2" size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
                  </XStack>
                ) : null}
              </XStack>
            </XStack>

            <Text variant="heading2" color="#FFFFFF">{route.title}</Text>

            <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
              <Badge variant={route.isPublic ? 'success' : 'default'} size="sm">
                {route.isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}
              </Badge>
              <Badge variant="info" size="sm">{route.contentType}</Badge>
            </XStack>

            {displayRating > 0 ? (
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                <RatingDisplay value={displayRating} />
                <Text variant="caption" color="$ant200">{displayRating.toFixed(1)} avg rating</Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : null}
          </YStack>

          {/* Stats */}
          <XStack gap="$2" padding="$4" flexWrap="wrap">
            <StatBox value={`${route.stops.length}`} label="Stops" flex={1} />
            <StatBox value={distanceKm} label="Distance" flex={1} />
            <StatBox value={durationMin} label="Duration" flex={1} />
          </XStack>

          {/* Description */}
          {route.description ? (
            <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingBottom="$4" gap="$2">
              <Text variant="heading3">About this route</Text>
              <Text variant="body" color="$mutedForeground">{route.description}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {/* Interactive Map */}
          <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingBottom="$4" gap="$2">
            <Text variant="heading3">Interactive Route Map</Text>
            <YStack height={240} borderRadius="$4" overflow="hidden" backgroundColor="$muted">
              <RouteMap route={route} />
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Stops */}
          <YStack marginHorizontal="$4" marginBottom="$4" gap="$3">
            <Text variant="heading3">Route Stops ({route.stops.length})</Text>
            <YStack gap="$3">
              {route.stops.map((stop, index) => (
                <XStack key={`${stop.spotId}-${index}`} gap="$3" alignItems="flex-start">
                  <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
                    <XStack
                      width={32}
                      height={32}
                      borderRadius="$full"
                      backgroundColor="$primary"
                      alignItems="center"
                      justifyContent="center"
                    >
                      <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">{index + 1}</Text>
                    </XStack>
                    {index < route.stops.length - 1 ? (
                      <YStack width={2} height={32} backgroundColor="$borderColor" />
                    ) : null}
                  </YStack>
                  <YStack
                    flex={1}
                    gap="$1.5"
                    padding="$3"
                    borderRadius="$4"
                    backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                    borderWidth={1}
                    borderColor="$borderColor"
                  >
                    <Text variant="heading4">{stop.name}</Text>
                    {stop.description ? <Text variant="caption" muted>{stop.description}</Text> : null}
                    <Text variant="caption" muted>
                      {stop.latitude.toFixed(4)}, {stop.longitude.toFixed(4)}
                    </Text>
                  </YStack>
                </XStack>
              ))}
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Rating widget */}
          {!isOwner ? (
            <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" gap="$4" marginBottom="$4">
              <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
                <Text variant="heading4">Community feedback</Text>
                <RouteRatingWidget
                  routeId={route.id}
                  onRated={(score) => {
                    setDisplayRating((prev) => {
                      if (prev === 0) return score
                      return parseFloat(((prev + score) / 2).toFixed(1))
                    })
                  }}
                />
              </YStack>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {/* Fork section */}
          {!isOwner ? (
            <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" marginBottom="$4">
              <YStack
                backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                borderRadius="$4"
                padding="$4"
                borderWidth={1}
                borderColor="$borderColor"
                gap="$2"
              >
                <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                  <Feather name="git-branch" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                  <Text variant="heading4">Fork this route</Text>
                </XStack>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Create your own copy and customize it freely.</Text>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="md"
                  alignSelf="flex-start"
                  loading={isForking}
                  disabled={isForking}
                  onPress={handleFork}
                  icon={<Feather name="git-branch" size={14} />}
                >
                  Fork Route
                </Button>
              </YStack>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {error ? (
            <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4">
              <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">{error}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Bottom action bar */}
      <YStack
        position="absolute"
        bottom={0}
        left={0}
        right={0}
        paddingHorizontal="$4"
        paddingTop="$3"
        paddingBottom={insets.bottom + 12}
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderTopWidth={1}
        borderTopColor="$borderColor"
        gap="$2"
      >
        <XStack gap="$2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"

            flex={1}

            icon={<Feather name="bookmark" size={16} />}
          >
            Save
          </Button>
          {isOwner ? (
            <Button
              variant="outline"

import React, { useState, useTransition, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { Alert } from 'react-native'
import {
  YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Divider, Badge, ScrollView,
} from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { RouteDetail, RouteStopItem } from '@/features/api/types'
import {
  getRouteById,
  getRouteStops,
  updateRoute,
  publishRoute,
  unpublishRoute,
  deleteRoute,
  addRouteStop,
  updateRouteStop,
  deleteRouteStop,
  reorderRouteStops,
} from '@/features/routes/api'
import { FormPageSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

type FeedbackState = { ok: boolean; message: string } | null

function reorderArray<T>(items: T[], fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): T[] {
  const next = [...items]
  const [moved] = next.splice(fromIndex, 1)
  next.splice(toIndex, 0, moved)
  return next
}

export default function RouteEditScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>()
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()

  const [route, setRoute] = useState<RouteDetail | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isSaving, startSave] = useTransition()

  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(false)
  const [isTogglingPublish, startToggle] = useTransition()

  const [isDeleting, startDelete] = useTransition()

  const [stops, setStops] = useState<RouteStopItem[]>([])
  const [savedStops, setSavedStops] = useState<RouteStopItem[]>([])
  const [newStopSpotId, setNewStopSpotId] = useState('')
  const [newStopCustomTitle, setNewStopCustomTitle] = useState('')
  const [stopFeedback, setStopFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isManagingStops, startManageStops] = useTransition()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return

    let mounted = true
    setLoading(true)

    Promise.allSettled([getRouteById(id), getRouteStops(id)]).then(([routeRes, stopsRes]) => {
      if (!mounted) return

      if (routeRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
        const r = routeRes.value
        setRoute(r)
        setTitle(r.title)
        setDescription(r.description ?? '')
        setIsPublic(r.isPublic)
      }

      if (stopsRes.status === 'fulfilled') {
        setStops(stopsRes.value)
        setSavedStops(stopsRes.value)
      }

      setLoading(false)
    })

    return () => { mounted = false }
  }, [id])

  const refreshStops = async (successMsg?: string) => {
    if (!id) return
    const nextStops = await getRouteStops(id)
    setStops(nextStops)
    setSavedStops(nextStops)
    if (successMsg) setStopFeedback({ ok: true, message: successMsg })
  }

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!route) return
    setFeedback(null)
    if (!title.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Title is required.' })
      return
    }
    startSave(async () => {
      try {
        await updateRoute(route.id, {
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description.trim() || undefined,
        })
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Route updated successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleTogglePublish = () => {
    if (!route) return
    startToggle(async () => {
      try {
        if (isPublic) {
          await unpublishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(false)
        } else {
          await publishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(true)
        }
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to change visibility.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDelete = () => {
    if (!route) return
    Alert.alert(
      'Delete Route',
      'Are you sure? This action cannot be undone.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Delete',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: () => {
            startDelete(async () => {
              try {
                await deleteRoute(route.id)
                router.replace('/profile')
              } catch (e) {
                setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to delete route.' })
              }
            })
          },
        },
      ]
    )
  }

  const handleStopFieldChange = (stopId: string, field: 'customTitle' | 'customDescription', value: string) => {
    setStops((prev) => prev.map((s) => s.id === stopId ? { ...s, [field]: value } : s))
  }

  const handleResetStop = (stopId: string) => {
    const original = savedStops.find((s) => s.id === stopId)
    if (!original) return
    setStops((prev) => prev.map((s) => s.id === stopId ? original : s))
  }

  const isStopDirty = (stop: RouteStopItem) => {
    const original = savedStops.find((s) => s.id === stop.id)
    if (!original) return false
    return (original.customTitle ?? '') !== (stop.customTitle ?? '')
      || (original.customDescription ?? '') !== (stop.customDescription ?? '')
  }

  const handleSaveStop = (stop: RouteStopItem) => {
    if (!route) return
    setStopFeedback(null)
    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await updateRouteStop(route.id, stop.id, {
          customTitle: (stop.customTitle ?? '').trim(),
          customDescription: (stop.customDescription ?? '').trim(),
        })
        await refreshStops('Stop updated.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update stop.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleAddStop = () => {
    if (!route) return
    setStopFeedback(null)
    if (!newStopSpotId.trim()) {
      setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Spot ID is required.' })
      return
    }
    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await addRouteStop(route.id, {
          spotId: newStopSpotId.trim(),
          customTitle: newStopCustomTitle.trim() || undefined,
        })
        setNewStopSpotId('')
        setNewStopCustomTitle('')
        await refreshStops('Stop added.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to add stop.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDeleteStop = (stopId: string) => {
    if (!route) return
    Alert.alert('Remove Stop', 'Remove this stop from the route?', [
      { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Remove',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: () => {
          setStopFeedback(null)
          startManageStops(async () => {
            try {
              await deleteRouteStop(route.id, stopId)
              await refreshStops('Stop removed.')
            } catch (e) {
              setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to remove stop.' })
            }
          })
        },
      },
    ])
  }

  const handleMoveStop = (fromIndex: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    if (!route) return
    const toIndex = direction === 'up' ? fromIndex - 1 : fromIndex + 1
    if (toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= stops.length) return

    const nextStops = reorderArray(stops, fromIndex, toIndex)
    setStops(nextStops)
    setStopFeedback(null)

    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await reorderRouteStops(route.id, nextStops.map((s) => s.id))
        await refreshStops('Order updated.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStops(savedStops)
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to reorder.' })
      }
    })
  }

  if (loading) {
    return <FormPageSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  if (!route) {
    return (
      <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background" alignItems="center" justifyContent="center" padding="$5" gap="$3">
        <Text variant="heading4">Route not found</Text>
        <Button variant="outline" onPress={() => router.back()}>Go Back</Button>
      </YStack>
    )
  }

  const isDirty = title !== route.title || description !== (route.description ?? '')

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={100} gap="$5">
          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
            <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={() => router.back()} padding="$2" borderRadius="$full">
              <Feather name="arrow-left" size={20} color="currentColor" />
            </XStack>
            <YStack flex={1}>
              <Text variant="heading2">Edit Route</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted numberOfLines={1}>{route.title}</Text>
            </YStack>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}>
              View
            </Button>
          </XStack>

          {/* Route Info */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <Text variant="heading4">Route Information</Text>

            <YStack gap="$1.5">
              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Title *</Text>
              <Input value={title} onChangeText={setTitle} variant="outline" placeholder="Route title" />
            </YStack>

            <YStack gap="$1.5">
              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Description</Text>
              <Input
                value={description}
                onChangeText={setDescription}
                variant="outline"
                placeholder="Describe your route..."
                multiline
                numberOfLines={4}
                height={90}
                textAlignVertical="top"
              />
            </YStack>

            {feedback ? (
              <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
                <Feather
                  name={feedback.ok ? 'check-circle' : 'alert-circle'}
                  size={16}
                  color={feedback.ok ? 'var(--color-success500, #22C55E)' : 'var(--color-error500, #DC2626)'}
                />
                <Text variant="caption" color={feedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>{feedback.message}</Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : null}

            <XStack gap="$2">
              <Button variant="solid" size="md" loading={isSaving} disabled={isSaving || !isDirty || !title.trim()} onPress={handleSave}>
                Save Changes
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="md"
                disabled={isSaving}
                onPress={() => { setTitle(route.title); setDescription(route.description ?? ''); setFeedback(null) }}
              >
                Discard
              </Button>
            </XStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Stops */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
              <YStack gap="$0.5">
                <Text variant="heading4">Route Stops</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Add, reorder, or remove stops</Text>
              </YStack>
              <Badge variant="info" size="md">{stops.length}</Badge>
            </XStack>

            {/* Add Stop Form */}
            <YStack gap="$3" padding="$3" borderRadius="$4" backgroundColor="$muted" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                <Feather name="plus" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                <Text variant="heading4">Add Stop</Text>
              </XStack>

              <YStack gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Spot ID *</Text>
                <Input
                  value={newStopSpotId}
                  onChangeText={setNewStopSpotId}
                  variant="outline"
                  placeholder="Paste Spot UUID"
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                />
              </YStack>

              <YStack gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Title (optional)</Text>
                <Input
                  value={newStopCustomTitle}
                  onChangeText={setNewStopCustomTitle}
                  variant="outline"
                  placeholder="Override spot name"
                />
              </YStack>

              <XStack justifyContent="flex-end">
                <Button variant="solid" size="sm" loading={isManagingStops} disabled={isManagingStops} onPress={handleAddStop}>
                  Add Stop
                </Button>
              </XStack>
            </YStack>

            {stopFeedback ? (
              <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
                <Feather
                  name={stopFeedback.ok ? 'check-circle' : 'alert-circle'}
                  size={16}
                  color={stopFeedback.ok ? 'var(--color-success500, #22C55E)' : 'var(--color-error500, #DC2626)'}
                />
                <Text variant="caption" color={stopFeedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>{stopFeedback.message}</Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : null}

            {stops.length === 0 ? (
              <YStack padding="$5" borderRadius="$4" borderWidth={1} borderStyle="dashed" borderColor="$borderColor" alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                <Feather name="map-pin" size={28} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                <Text variant="heading4">No stops yet</Text>
                <Text variant="body" muted align="center">Add at least one spot above.</Text>
              </YStack>
            ) : (
              <YStack gap="$4">
                {stops.map((stop, index) => {
                  const displayName = (stop.customTitle ?? '').trim() || stop.name
                  const dirty = isStopDirty(stop)

                  return (
                    <XStack key={stop.id} gap="$3" alignItems="flex-start">
                      <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1" paddingTop="$2">
                        <XStack width={34} height={34} borderRadius="$full" backgroundColor="$primary" alignItems="center" justifyContent="center">
                          <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">{index + 1}</Text>
                        </XStack>
                        {index < stops.length - 1 ? (
                          <YStack width={2} height={40} backgroundColor="$borderColor" />
                        ) : null}
                      </YStack>

                      <YStack flex={1} gap="$3" padding="$3" borderRadius="$4" backgroundColor="$background" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
                        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$2">
                          <YStack gap="$0.5" flex={1}>
                            <Text variant="heading4">{displayName}</Text>
                            <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={1}>Lat {stop.latitude.toFixed(4)} · Lng {stop.longitude.toFixed(4)}</Text>
                          </YStack>
                          <XStack gap="$1">
                            <XStack
                              padding="$2"
                              borderRadius="$2"
                              borderWidth={1}
                              borderColor="$borderColor"
                              cursor="pointer"
                              disabled={index === 0 || isManagingStops}
                              opacity={index === 0 ? 0.4 : 1}
                              onPress={() => handleMoveStop(index, 'up')}
                            >
                              <Feather name="chevron-up" size={14} color="currentColor" />
                            </XStack>
                            <XStack
                              padding="$2"
                              borderRadius="$2"
                              borderWidth={1}
                              borderColor="$borderColor"
                              cursor="pointer"
                              disabled={index === stops.length - 1 || isManagingStops}
                              opacity={index === stops.length - 1 ? 0.4 : 1}
                              onPress={() => handleMoveStop(index, 'down')}
                            >
                              <Feather name="chevron-down" size={14} color="currentColor" />
                            </XStack>
                          </XStack>
                        </XStack>

                        <YStack gap="$1.5">
                          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Title</Text>
                          <Input
                            value={stop.customTitle ?? ''}
                            onChangeText={(v) => handleStopFieldChange(stop.id, 'customTitle', v)}
                            variant="outline"
                            placeholder={stop.name}
                          />
                        </YStack>

                        <YStack gap="$1.5">
                          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Description</Text>
                          <Input
                            value={stop.customDescription ?? ''}
                            onChangeText={(v) => handleStopFieldChange(stop.id, 'customDescription', v)}
                            variant="outline"
                            placeholder={stop.description ?? 'Optional override'}
                            multiline
                            numberOfLines={2}
                            height={60}
                            textAlignVertical="top"
                          />
                        </YStack>

                        {dirty ? (
                          <XStack gap="$1" flexWrap="wrap">
                            <Badge variant="warning" size="sm">Unsaved</Badge>
                          </XStack>
                        ) : null}

                        <Divider />

                        <XStack gap="$2" justifyContent="flex-end" flexWrap="wrap">
                          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={!dirty || isManagingStops} onPress={() => handleResetStop(stop.id)}>
                            Reset
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="solid" size="sm" loading={isManagingStops} disabled={!dirty || isManagingStops} onPress={() => handleSaveStop(stop)}>
                            Save Stop
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={isManagingStops} onPress={() => handleDeleteStop(stop.id)}>
                            <Text variant="label" color="$error500">Delete</Text>
                          </Button>
                        </XStack>
                      </YStack>
                    </XStack>
                  )
                })}
              </YStack>
            )}
          </YStack>

          {/* Visibility */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <Text variant="heading4">Visibility</Text>
            <XStack
              backgroundColor={isPublic ? '$success50' : '$muted'}
              borderRadius="$3"
              padding="$4"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor={isPublic ? '$success200' : '$borderColor'}
              gap="$3"
              alignItems="center"
            >
              <Feather name={isPublic ? 'globe' : 'lock'} size={20} color={isPublic ? 'var(--color-success500, #22C55E)' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)'} />
              <YStack flex={1} gap="$0.5">
                <Text variant="label" weight="semibold">{isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>
                  {isPublic ? 'Visible to everyone.' : 'Only you can see this.'}
                </Text>
              </YStack>
              <Button variant={isPublic ? 'outline' : 'solid'} size="sm" loading={isTogglingPublish} disabled={isTogglingPublish} onPress={handleTogglePublish}>
                {isPublic ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
              </Button>
            </XStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Danger Zone */}
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$error200">
            <Text variant="heading4" color="$error500">Danger Zone</Text>
            <Divider />
            <XStack gap="$4" alignItems="center" flexWrap="wrap">
              <YStack flex={1} gap="$0.5">
                <Text variant="label">Delete Route</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Permanently delete this route. Cannot be undone.</Text>
              </YStack>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" loading={isDeleting} disabled={isDeleting} onPress={handleDelete}>
                <Text variant="label" color="$error500">Delete</Text>
              </Button>
            </XStack>
          </YStack>
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, ScrollView, Switch } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import type { CollectionDetail } from '@/features/api/types'
import {
  deleteCollection,
  getCollectionById,
  removeRouteFromCollection,
  updateCollection,
} from '@/features/collections/api'
import { FormPageSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

type FeedbackState = {
  ok: boolean
  message: string
} | null

export default function SavedCollectionDetailScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>()
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()
  const [collection, setCollection] = useState<CollectionDetail | null>(null)
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [thumbnailUrl, setThumbnailUrl] = useState('')
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(false)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const loadCollection = async () => {
    if (!id) return

    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const detail = await getCollectionById(id)
      setCollection(detail)
      setName(detail.name)
      setDescription(detail.description ?? '')
      setThumbnailUrl(detail.thumbnailUrl ?? '')
      setIsPublic(detail.isPublic)
      setFeedback(null)
    } catch (error) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to load collection.' })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCollection().catch(() => {})
  }, [id])

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!collection) return
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Collection name is required.' })
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateCollection(collection.id, {
          name: name.trim(),
          description: description.trim() || undefined,
          thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl.trim() || undefined,
          isPublic,
        })
        await loadCollection()
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Collection updated successfully.' })
      } catch (error) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDelete = () => {
    if (!collection || collection.isDefault) return

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteCollection(collection.id)
        router.replace('/saved')
      } catch (error) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to delete collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleRemoveRoute = (routeId: string) => {
    if (!collection) return

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await removeRouteFromCollection(collection.id, routeId)
        await loadCollection()
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Route removed from collection.' })
      } catch (error) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to remove route.' })
      }
    })
  }

  if (loading && !collection) {
    return <FormPageSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingTop={insets.top + 12} paddingBottom={100} gap="$4">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" alignSelf="flex-start" onPress={() => router.back()}>
            Back
          </Button>

          <YStack gap="$1">
            <Text variant="heading2">{collection?.name ?? 'Collection'}</Text>
            <Text variant="body" muted>Manage collection details and route entries</Text>
          </YStack>

          {feedback ? (
            <YStack
              padding="$3"
              borderRadius="$3"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor={feedback.ok ? '$success200' : '$error200'}
              backgroundColor={feedback.ok ? '$success50' : '$error50'}
            >
              <Text variant="body" color={feedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>{feedback.message}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {collection ? (
            <>
              <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
                <Text variant="heading4">Collection Settings</Text>
                <YStack gap="$3">
                  <YStack gap="$1.5">
                    <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Name *</Text>
                    <Input value={name} onChangeText={setName} variant="outline" />
                  </YStack>
                  <YStack gap="$1.5">
                    <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Description</Text>
                    <Input
                      value={description}
                      onChangeText={setDescription}
                      variant="outline"
                      multiline
                      numberOfLines={3}
                    />
                  </YStack>
                  <YStack gap="$1.5">
                    <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Thumbnail URL</Text>
                    <Input value={thumbnailUrl} onChangeText={setThumbnailUrl} variant="outline" autoCapitalize="none" />
                  </YStack>
                  <Switch label="Public collection" checked={isPublic} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setIsPublic(Boolean(checked))} />
                </YStack>
                <XStack gap="$3">
                  <Button variant="solid" flex={1} onPress={handleSave} loading={isPending} disabled={isPending}>
                    Save Changes
                  </Button>
                  {!collection.isDefault ? (
                    <Button variant="outline" onPress={handleDelete} loading={isPending} disabled={isPending}>
                      Delete
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                </XStack>
              </YStack>

              <YStack gap="$3">
                <Text variant="heading3">Routes ({collection.routes.length})</Text>
                {collection.routes.length > 0 ? (
                  <YStack gap="$3">
                    {collection.routes.map((route) => (
                      <YStack
                        key={route.routeId}
                        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                        borderRadius="$4"
                        borderWidth={1}
                        borderColor="$borderColor"
                        padding="$4"
                        gap="$3"
                      >
                        <YStack gap="$1">
                          <Text variant="heading4">{route.title ?? 'Untitled route'}</Text>
                          <Text variant="caption" muted>{new Date(route.savedAt).toLocaleString()}</Text>
                        </YStack>
                        <XStack gap="$3">
                          <Button variant="outline" flex={1} onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.routeId}`)}>
                            Open Route
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="outline" onPress={() => handleRemoveRoute(route.routeId)} loading={isPending} disabled={isPending}>
                            Remove
                          </Button>
                        </XStack>
                      </YStack>
                    ))}
                  </YStack>
                ) : (
                  <YStack
                    alignItems="center"
                    justifyContent="center"
                    padding="$6"
                    gap="$3"
                    backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                    borderRadius="$4"
                    borderWidth={1}
                    borderColor="$borderColor"
                  >
                    <Feather name="folder" size={32} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                    <Text variant="heading4" muted>No routes yet</Text>
                    <Text variant="body" muted align="center">
                      Saved routes added to this collection will appear here.
                    </Text>
                  </YStack>
                )}
              </YStack>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, StatBox, RatingDisplay, RouteCard, ScrollView, Badge } from '@antapp/ui'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import { getSpotById, getSpotRoutes, rateSpot, toggleSpotFavorite } from '@/features/spots/api'
import type { SpotDetail, SpotRouteItem } from '@/features/api/types'
import { SpotDetailSkeleton } from '@/components/loading/page-skeletons'

function SpotRatingWidget({
  spotId,
  onRated,
}: {
  spotId: string
  onRated: (score: number) => void
}) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(0)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const active = hovered || selected

  const handleRate = (score: number) => {
    if (submitted) return
    setSelected(score)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await rateSpot(spotId, score)
        setSubmitted(true)
        onRated(score)
      } catch {
        setSelected(0)
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$3">
      <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Rate this spot</Text>
      <XStack gap="$1.5" alignItems="center">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
          <XStack
            key={score}
            padding="$1"
            borderRadius="$2"
            cursor={submitted || isPending ? 'default' : 'pointer'}
            onPress={() => handleRate(score)}
            // @ts-ignore web-only
            onMouseEnter={() => !submitted && !isPending && setHovered(score)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(0)}
          >
            <Feather
              name="star"
              size={24}
              color={score <= active ? '#FF8C00' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)'}
            />
          </XStack>
        ))}
        {isPending ? <Text variant="caption" muted>Saving...</Text> : null}
      </XStack>
      {submitted ? (
        <Text variant="caption" color="$success500">Thanks for rating this spot.</Text>
      ) : null}
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function SpotDetailScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>()
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()

  const [spot, setSpot] = useState<SpotDetail | null>(null)
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<SpotRouteItem[]>([])
  const [displayRating, setDisplayRating] = useState(0)
  const [isFavorite, setIsFavorite] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isTogglingFavorite, startToggle] = useTransition()
  const [routesLoading, setRoutesLoading] = useState(false)
  const [routePage, setRoutePage] = useState(1)
  const [routeTotalPages, setRouteTotalPages] = useState(1)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return

    let mounted = true
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    getSpotById(id)
      .then((s) => {
        if (!mounted) return
        setSpot(s)
        setDisplayRating(s.averageRating)
        loadRoutes(id, 1)
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!mounted) return
        setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load spot.')
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!mounted) return
        setLoading(false)
      })

    return () => { mounted = false }
  }, [id])

  const loadRoutes = async (spotId: string, page: number) => {
    setRoutesLoading(true)
    try {
      const result = await getSpotRoutes(spotId, page, 10)
      setRoutes((prev) => page === 1 ? result.data : [...prev, ...result.data])
      setRoutePage(page)
      setRouteTotalPages(result.totalPages)
    } catch {}
    setRoutesLoading(false)
  }

  const handleToggleFavorite = () => {
    if (!spot) return
    startToggle(async () => {
      try {
        const nowFavorite = await toggleSpotFavorite(spot.id)
        setIsFavorite(nowFavorite)
      } catch {}
    })
  }

  if (loading) {
    return <SpotDetailSkeleton topInset={insets.top} />
  }

  if (!spot) {
    return (
      <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background" alignItems="center" justifyContent="center" padding="$5" gap="$3">
        <Text variant="heading4">Spot not found</Text>
        <Text variant="body" muted align="center">{error ?? 'Could not load this spot.'}</Text>
        <Button variant="outline" onPress={() => router.back()}>Go Back</Button>
      </YStack>
    )
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
      <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <YStack paddingBottom={100}>
          {/* Header */}
          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$ant900"
            paddingHorizontal="$4"
            paddingTop={insets.top + 12}
            paddingBottom="$5"
            gap="$3"
          >
            <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2" cursor="pointer" onPress={() => router.back()}>
                <Feather name="arrow-left" size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
                <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">Back</Text>
              </XStack>
              <XStack
                cursor="pointer"
                onPress={handleToggleFavorite}
                padding="$2"
                opacity={isTogglingFavorite ? 0.5 : 1}
              >
                <Feather
                  name="heart"
                  size={20}
                  color={isFavorite ? '#EF4444' : '#FFFFFF'}
                />
              </XStack>
            </XStack>

            <Text variant="heading2" color="#FFFFFF">{spot.name}</Text>

            {displayRating > 0 ? (
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                <RatingDisplay value={displayRating} />
                <Text variant="caption" color="$ant200">
                  {displayRating.toFixed(1)} · {spot.ratingCount} ratings
                </Text>
              </XStack>
            ) : (
              <Text variant="caption" color="$ant400">No ratings yet</Text>
            )}
          </YStack>

          {/* Stats */}
          <XStack gap="$2" padding="$4" flexWrap="wrap">
            <StatBox value={spot.ratingCount} label="Ratings" flex={1} />
            <StatBox value={displayRating > 0 ? displayRating.toFixed(1) : '—'} label="Avg Score" flex={1} />
            <StatBox value={routes.length} label="Routes" flex={1} />
          </XStack>

          {/* Description */}
          {spot.description ? (
            <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingBottom="$4" gap="$2">
              <Text variant="heading3">About this spot</Text>
              <Text variant="body" color="$mutedForeground">{spot.description}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}

          {/* Location */}
          <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingBottom="$4">
            <YStack
              backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
              borderRadius="$4"
              padding="$4"
              gap="$3"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor="$borderColor"
            >
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                <Feather name="map-pin" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                <Text variant="heading4">Location</Text>
              </XStack>
              <YStack
                backgroundColor="$muted"
                borderRadius="$3"
                padding="$4"
                alignItems="center"
                justifyContent="center"
                height={120}
                gap="$2"
              >
                <Feather name="map" size={28} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Map — Coming Soon</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>
                  {spot.latitude.toFixed(5)}, {spot.longitude.toFixed(5)}
                </Text>
              </YStack>
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Rating widget */}
          <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingBottom="$4">
            <YStack
              backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
              borderRadius="$4"
              padding="$4"
              gap="$4"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor="$borderColor"
            >
              <Text variant="heading4">Your Rating</Text>
              <SpotRatingWidget
                spotId={spot.id}
                onRated={(score) => {
                  setDisplayRating((prev) => {
                    if (prev === 0) return score
                    return parseFloat(((prev + score) / 2).toFixed(1))
                  })
                }}
              />
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          {/* Routes using this spot */}
          <YStack paddingHorizontal="$4" paddingBottom="$4" gap="$3">
            <Text variant="heading3">Routes featuring this spot</Text>
            {routes.length === 0 && !routesLoading ? (
              <YStack
                padding="$5"
                borderRadius="$4"
                borderWidth={1}
                borderStyle="dashed"
                borderColor="$borderColor"
                alignItems="center"
                gap="$2"
              >
                <Feather name="map" size={28} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                <Text variant="body" muted>No routes include this spot yet.</Text>
              </YStack>
            ) : (
              <YStack gap="$3">
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <XStack
                    key={route.id}
                    backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                    borderRadius="$4"
                    padding="$4"
                    borderWidth={1}
                    borderColor="$borderColor"
                    gap="$3"
                    alignItems="center"
                    cursor="pointer"
                    onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
                    pressStyle={{ opacity: 0.85 }}
                  >
                    <YStack
                      width={40}
                      height={40}
                      borderRadius="$3"
                      backgroundColor="$primary50"
                      alignItems="center"
                      justifyContent="center"
                      flexShrink={0}
                    >
                      <Feather name="navigation" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                    </YStack>
                    <YStack flex={1} gap="$1">
                      <Text variant="heading4" numberOfLines={1}>{route.title}</Text>
                      {route.description ? (
                        <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={1}>{route.description}</Text>
                      ) : null}
                      {route.averageRating > 0 ? (
                        <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
                          <RatingDisplay value={route.averageRating} />
                          <Text variant="caption" muted>{route.averageRating.toFixed(1)}</Text>
                        </XStack>
                      ) : null}
                    </YStack>
                    <Feather name="chevron-right" size={16} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                  </XStack>
                ))}
              </YStack>
            )}

            {routePage < routeTotalPages ? (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="md"
                loading={routesLoading}
                disabled={routesLoading}
                onPress={() => loadRoutes(spot.id, routePage + 1)}
              >
                Load More Routes
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </YStack>
        </YStack>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Bottom action bar */}
      <YStack
        position="absolute"
        bottom={0}
        left={0}
        right={0}
        paddingHorizontal="$4"
        paddingTop="$3"
        paddingBottom={insets.bottom + 12}
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderTopWidth={1}
        borderTopColor="$borderColor"
      >
        <Button
          variant={isFavorite ? 'outline' : 'solid'}
          size="lg"
          loading={isTogglingFavorite}
          disabled={isTogglingFavorite}
          onPress={handleToggleFavorite}
          icon={<Feather name="heart" size={18} color={isFavorite ? 'var(--color-primary)' : '#FFFFFF'} />}
        >
          {isFavorite ? 'Remove from Favorites' : 'Add to Favorites'}
        </Button>
      </YStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

FILE: mobile/src/components/common/external-link.tsx
================================================
import { Href, Link } from 'expo-router';
import { openBrowserAsync, WebBrowserPresentationStyle } from 'expo-web-browser';
import { type ComponentProps } from 'react';

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Link>, 'href'> & { href: Href & string };

export function ExternalLink({ href, ...rest }: Props) {
  return (
    <Link
      target="_blank"
      {...rest}
      href={href}
      onPress={async (event) => {
        if (process.env.EXPO_OS !== 'web') {
          // Prevent the default behavior of linking to the default browser on native.
          event.preventDefault();
          // Open the link in an in-app browser.
          await openBrowserAsync(href, {
            presentationStyle: WebBrowserPresentationStyle.AUTOMATIC,
          });
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}

FILE: mobile/src/components/icons/animated-icon.tsx

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dimensions, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { Easing, Keyframe } from 'react-native-reanimated';
import { scheduleOnRN } from 'react-native-worklets';

const INITIAL_SCALE_FACTOR = Dimensions.get('screen').height / 90;
const DURATION = 600;

export function AnimatedSplashOverlay() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true);

  if (!visible) return null;

  const splashKeyframe = new Keyframe({
    0: {
      transform: [{ scale: INITIAL_SCALE_FACTOR }],
      opacity: 1,
    },
    20: {
      opacity: 1,
    },
    70: {
      opacity: 0,
      easing: Easing.elastic(0.7),
    },
    100: {
      opacity: 0,
      transform: [{ scale: 1 }],
      easing: Easing.elastic(0.7),
    },
  });

  return (
    <Animated.View
      entering={splashKeyframe.duration(DURATION).withCallback((finished) => {
        'worklet';
        if (finished) {
          scheduleOnRN(setVisible, false);
        }
      })}
      style={styles.backgroundSolidColor}
    />
  );
}

const keyframe = new Keyframe({
  0: {
    transform: [{ scale: INITIAL_SCALE_FACTOR }],
  },
  100: {
    transform: [{ scale: 1 }],
    easing: Easing.elastic(0.7),
  },
});

const logoKeyframe = new Keyframe({
  0: {
    transform: [{ scale: 1.3 }],
    opacity: 0,
  },
  40: {
    transform: [{ scale: 1.3 }],
    opacity: 0,
    easing: Easing.elastic(0.7),
  },
  100: {
    opacity: 1,
    transform: [{ scale: 1 }],
    easing: Easing.elastic(0.7),
  },
});

const glowKeyframe = new Keyframe({
  0: {
    transform: [{ rotateZ: '0deg' }],
  },
  100: {
    transform: [{ rotateZ: '7200deg' }],
  },
});

export function AnimatedIcon() {
  return (
    <View style={styles.iconContainer}>
      <Animated.View entering={glowKeyframe.duration(60 * 1000 * 4)} style={styles.glow}>
        <Image style={styles.glow} source={require('@/assets/images/logo-glow.png')} />
      </Animated.View>

      <Animated.View entering={keyframe.duration(DURATION)} style={styles.background} />
      <Animated.View style={styles.imageContainer} entering={logoKeyframe.duration(DURATION)}>
        <Image style={styles.image} source={require('@/assets/images/expo-logo.png')} />
      </Animated.View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  imageContainer: {
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  glow: {
    width: 201,
    height: 201,
    position: 'absolute',
  },
  iconContainer: {
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
    width: 128,
    height: 128,
    zIndex: 100,
  },
  image: {
    position: 'absolute',
    width: 76,
    height: 71,
  },
  background: {
    borderRadius: 40,
    experimental_backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(180deg, #3C9FFE, #0274DF)`,
    width: 128,
    height: 128,
    position: 'absolute',
  },
  backgroundSolidColor: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    backgroundColor: '#208AEF',
    zIndex: 1000,
  },
});

FILE: mobile/src/components/layout/app-tabs.tsx
================================================
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'expo-router'
import React from 'react'
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context'
import { XStack, YStack, Text, styled } from 'tamagui'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'

type TabItem = {
  route: string
  label: string
  icon: React.ComponentProps<typeof Feather>['name']
}

const TABS: TabItem[] = [
  { route: '/',        label: 'Home',    icon: 'home' },
  { route: '/explore', label: 'Explore', icon: 'compass' },
  { route: '/spots',   label: 'Spots',   icon: 'map-pin' },
  { route: '/create',  label: 'Create',  icon: 'plus-circle' },
  { route: '/profile', label: 'Profile', icon: 'user' },
]

const TAB_ROUTES = new Set(TABS.map((t) => t.route))

const TabBarContainer = styled(XStack, {
  position: 'absolute',
  bottom: 0,
  left: 0,
  right: 0,
  backgroundColor: '$background',
  borderTopWidth: 1,
  borderTopColor: '$borderColor',
  justifyContent: 'space-around',
  alignItems: 'center',
})

const TabItemFrame = styled(YStack, {
  flex: 1,
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  gap: '$1',
  paddingTop: '$2',
  pressStyle: { opacity: 0.6 },
  cursor: 'pointer',
})

export function BottomTabBar() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const router = useRouter()
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets()

  const isTabRoute = pathname === '/' || TAB_ROUTES.has(pathname)
  if (!isTabRoute) return null

  return (
    <TabBarContainer paddingBottom={insets.bottom || 12}>
      {TABS.map((tab) => {
        const active = pathname === tab.route
        const color = active ? '#FF8C00' : '#999'

        return (
          <TabItemFrame
            key={tab.route}
            onPress={() => {
              if (!active) router.push(tab.route as Parameters<typeof router.push>[0])
            }}
          >
            <Feather name={tab.icon} size={22} color={color} />
            <Text
              fontSize={10}
              fontWeight={active ? '600' : '400'}
              color={active ? '#FF8C00' : '$mutedForeground'}
            >
              {tab.label}
            </Text>
          </TabItemFrame>
        )
      })}
    </TabBarContainer>
  )
}

FILE: mobile/src/components/map/route-map.tsx
================================================
import React, { useMemo } from 'react'
import { WebView } from 'react-native-webview'
import type { RouteDetail } from '@/features/api/types'

function decodePolyline(encoded: string): Array<[number, number]> {
  const points: Array<[number, number]> = []
  let index = 0
  let lat = 0
  let lng = 0

  while (index < encoded.length) {
    let result = 0
    let shift = 0
    let byte = 0
    do {
      byte = encoded.charCodeAt(index++) - 63
      result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift
      shift += 5
    } while (byte >= 0x20)
    lat += (result & 1) !== 0 ? ~(result >> 1) : result >> 1

    result = 0
    shift = 0
    do {
      byte = encoded.charCodeAt(index++) - 63
      result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift
      shift += 5
    } while (byte >= 0x20)
    lng += (result & 1) !== 0 ? ~(result >> 1) : result >> 1

    points.push([lng / 1e5, lat / 1e5])
  }

  return points
}

function buildMapHTML(options: {
  center: [number, number]
  zoom: number
  polyline: Array<[number, number]>
  stops: Array<{ lng: number; lat: number; order: number }>
}): string {
  const data = JSON.stringify(options)

  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css" />
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.js"></script>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body, #map { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    .maplibregl-ctrl-bottom-left,
    .maplibregl-ctrl-bottom-right,
    .maplibregl-ctrl-top-left { display: none; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="map"></div>
  <script>
    var options = ${data};
    var map = new maplibregl.Map({
      container: 'map',
      style: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty',
      center: options.center,
      zoom: options.zoom,
      attributionControl: false
    });

    map.on('load', function() {
      if (options.polyline.length > 1) {
        map.addSource('route-line', {
          type: 'geojson',
          data: { type: 'Feature', geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: options.polyline }, properties: {} }
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'route-line-layer',
          type: 'line',
          source: 'route-line',
          layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' },
          paint: { 'line-color': '#FF8C00', 'line-width': 4, 'line-dasharray': [1.5, 1.5] }
        });
      }

      if (options.stops.length > 0) {
        map.addSource('route-stops', {
          type: 'geojson',
          data: {
            type: 'FeatureCollection',
            features: options.stops.map(function(s) {
              return { type: 'Feature', geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [s.lng, s.lat] }, properties: { order: s.order } };
            })
          }
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'route-stops-circle',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'route-stops',
          paint: { 'circle-radius': 8, 'circle-color': '#FF8C00', 'circle-stroke-color': '#FFFFFF', 'circle-stroke-width': 2 }
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'route-stops-label',
          type: 'symbol',
          source: 'route-stops',
          minzoom: 11,
          layout: { 'text-field': ['to-string', ['get', 'order']], 'text-size': 11, 'text-font': ['Open Sans Semibold'], 'text-allow-overlap': false },
          paint: { 'text-color': '#FFFFFF' }
        });
      }

      var fitCoords = options.polyline.length > 1 ? options.polyline : options.stops.map(function(s) { return [s.lng, s.lat]; });
      if (fitCoords.length > 1) {
        var lons = fitCoords.map(function(c) { return c[0]; });
        var lats = fitCoords.map(function(c) { return c[1]; });
        map.fitBounds(
          [[Math.min.apply(null, lons), Math.min.apply(null, lats)], [Math.max.apply(null, lons), Math.max.apply(null, lats)]],
          { padding: 40, maxZoom: 14, duration: 0 }
        );
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>`
}

export function RouteMap({ route }: { route: RouteDetail }) {
  const html = useMemo(() => {
    const polyline = route.encodedPolyline
      ? (() => { try { return decodePolyline(route.encodedPolyline) } catch { return [] } })()
      : []

    const stops = route.stops
      .filter((s) => Number.isFinite(s.latitude) && Number.isFinite(s.longitude))
      .map((s, i) => ({ lng: s.longitude, lat: s.latitude, order: i + 1 }))

    const hasCenter =
      Number.isFinite(route.centerLatitude) && Number.isFinite(route.centerLongitude)

    return buildMapHTML({
      center: hasCenter ? [route.centerLongitude, route.centerLatitude] : [30.7133, 36.8969],
      zoom: hasCenter ? 11 : 10,
      polyline,
      stops,
    })
  }, [route])

  return (
    <WebView
      source={{ html }}
      style={{ flex: 1 }}
      scrollEnabled={false}
      javaScriptEnabled
      originWhitelist={['*']}
    />
  )
}

FILE: mobile/src/components/modals/save-to-collection-modal.tsx
================================================
import React, { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Modal, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, ScrollView } from '@antapp/ui'
import { Feather } from '@expo/vector-icons'
import {
  getCollections,
  addRouteToCollection,
  removeRouteFromCollection,
  createCollection,
  getCollectionById,
} from '@/features/collections/api'
import type { Collection } from '@/features/api/types'

type Props = {
  visible: boolean
  routeId: string
  onClose: () => void
}

export function SaveToCollectionModal({ visible, routeId, onClose }: Props) {
  const [collections, setCollections] = useState<Collection[]>([])
  const [savedInIds, setSavedInIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
  const [isCreating, startCreate] = useTransition()
  const [isToggling, startToggle] = useTransition()

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setFeedback(null)
    try {
      const result = await getCollections(1, 50)
      setCollections(result.data)

      const inIds = new Set<string>()
      await Promise.allSettled(
        result.data.map(async (col) => {
          try {
            const detail = await getCollectionById(col.id)
            if (detail.routes.some((r) => r.routeId === routeId)) {
              inIds.add(col.id)
            }
          } catch {}
        })
      )
      setSavedInIds(inIds)
    } catch {
      setFeedback('Failed to load collections.')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible) {
      load()
    }
  }, [visible])

  const handleToggle = (collection: Collection) => {
    startToggle(async () => {
      setFeedback(null)
      try {
        if (savedInIds.has(collection.id)) {
          await removeRouteFromCollection(collection.id, routeId)
          setSavedInIds((prev) => {
            const next = new Set(prev)
            next.delete(collection.id)
            return next
          })
        } else {
          await addRouteToCollection(collection.id, routeId)
          setSavedInIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(collection.id))
        }
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback((e as Error).message ?? 'Action failed.')
      }
    })
  }

  const handleCreate = () => {
    if (!newName.trim()) return
    startCreate(async () => {
      setFeedback(null)
      try {
        await createCollection({ name: newName.trim() })
        setNewName('')
        await load()
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to create collection.')
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <Modal visible={visible} animationType="slide" presentationStyle="pageSheet" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <YStack flex={1} backgroundColor="$background">
        <XStack
          paddingHorizontal="$4"
          paddingTop="$5"
          paddingBottom="$3"
          borderBottomWidth={1}
          borderBottomColor="$borderColor"
          justifyContent="space-between"
          alignItems="center"
        >
          <YStack>
            <Text variant="heading3">Save to Collection</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>Choose where to save this route</Text>
          </YStack>
          <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={onClose} padding="$2">
            <Feather name="x" size={22} color="currentColor" />
          </XStack>
        </XStack>

        {loading ? (
          <YStack flex={1} alignItems="center" justifyContent="center">
            <ActivityIndicator />
          </YStack>
        ) : (
          <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            <YStack padding="$4" gap="$4">
              {feedback ? (
                <YStack backgroundColor="$error50" borderRadius="$3" padding="$3" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$error200">
                  <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">{feedback}</Text>
                </YStack>
              ) : null}

              {/* Create new collection */}
              <YStack gap="$3" padding="$4" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
                <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                  <Feather name="plus-circle" size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                  <Text variant="heading4">New Collection</Text>
                </XStack>
                <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
                  <Input
                    flex={1}
                    value={newName}
                    onChangeText={setNewName}
                    variant="outline"
                    placeholder="Collection name"
                  />
                  <Button
                    variant="solid"
                    size="md"
                    loading={isCreating}
                    disabled={isCreating || !newName.trim()}
                    onPress={handleCreate}
                  >
                    Create
                  </Button>
                </XStack>
              </YStack>

              {/* Collection list */}
              <YStack gap="$2">
                {collections.length === 0 ? (
                  <YStack padding="$5" alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                    <Feather name="folder" size={32} color="var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)" />
                    <Text variant="body" muted>No collections yet</Text>
                  </YStack>
                ) : (
                  collections.map((col) => {
                    const saved = savedInIds.has(col.id)
                    return (
                      <XStack
                        key={col.id}
                        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                        borderRadius="$4"
                        padding="$4"
                        borderWidth={1}
                        borderColor={saved ? '$primary200' : '$borderColor'}
                        alignItems="center"
                        gap="$3"
                      >
                        <XStack
                          width={36}
                          height={36}
                          borderRadius="$3"
                          backgroundColor={saved ? '$primary50' : '$muted'}
                          alignItems="center"
                          justifyContent="center"
                        >
                          <Feather
                            name={col.isDefault ? 'bookmark' : 'folder'}
                            size={16}
                            color={saved ? 'var(--color-primary)' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground, #999)'}
                          />
                        </XStack>
                        <YStack flex={1} gap="$0.5">
                          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                            <Text variant="label" weight="semibold">{col.name}</Text>
                            {col.isDefault ? (
                              <XStack
                                backgroundColor="$primary50"
                                paddingHorizontal="$1.5"
                                paddingVertical="$0.5"
                                borderRadius="$full"
                              >
                                <Text variant="caption" color="$primary" fontSize={10}>Default</Text>
                              </XStack>
                            ) : null}
                          </XStack>
                          <Text variant="caption" muted>{col.routeCount} routes</Text>
                        </YStack>
                        <Button
                          variant={saved ? 'outline' : 'solid'}
                          size="sm"
                          loading={isToggling}
                          disabled={isToggling}
                          onPress={() => handleToggle(col)}
                        >
                          {saved ? 'Remove' : 'Add'}
                        </Button>
                      </XStack>
                    )
                  })
                )}
              </YStack>

              <Button variant="outline" size="md" onPress={onClose}>
                Done
              </Button>
            </YStack>
          </ScrollView>
        )}
      </YStack>
    </Modal>
  )
}

import { Platform, StyleSheet, Text, type TextProps } from 'react-native';

import { Fonts, ThemeColor } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useTheme } from '@/hooks/use-theme';

export type ThemedTextProps = TextProps & {
  type?: 'default' | 'title' | 'small' | 'smallBold' | 'subtitle' | 'link' | 'linkPrimary' | 'code';
  themeColor?: ThemeColor;
};

export function ThemedText({ style, type = 'default', themeColor, ...rest }: ThemedTextProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();

  return (
    <Text
      style={[
        { color: theme[themeColor ?? 'text'] },
        type === 'default' && styles.default,
        type === 'title' && styles.title,
        type === 'small' && styles.small,
        type === 'smallBold' && styles.smallBold,
        type === 'subtitle' && styles.subtitle,
        type === 'link' && styles.link,
        type === 'linkPrimary' && styles.linkPrimary,
        type === 'code' && styles.code,
        style,
      ]}
      {...rest}
    />
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  small: {
    fontSize: 14,
    lineHeight: 20,
    fontWeight: 500,
  },
  smallBold: {
    fontSize: 14,
    lineHeight: 20,
    fontWeight: 700,
  },
  default: {
    fontSize: 16,
    lineHeight: 24,
    fontWeight: 500,
  },
  title: {
    fontSize: 48,
    fontWeight: 600,
    lineHeight: 52,
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontSize: 32,
    lineHeight: 44,
    fontWeight: 600,
  },
  link: {
    lineHeight: 30,
    fontSize: 14,
  },
  linkPrimary: {
    lineHeight: 30,
    fontSize: 14,
    color: '#3c87f7',
  },
  code: {
    fontFamily: Fonts.mono,
    fontWeight: Platform.select({ android: 700 }) ?? 500,
    fontSize: 12,
  },
});

import { View, type ViewProps } from 'react-native';

import { ThemeColor } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useTheme } from '@/hooks/use-theme';

export type ThemedViewProps = ViewProps & {
  lightColor?: string;
  darkColor?: string;
  type?: ThemeColor;
};

export function ThemedView({ style, lightColor, darkColor, type, ...otherProps }: ThemedViewProps) {
  const theme = useTheme();

  return <View style={[{ backgroundColor: theme[type ?? 'background'] }, style]} {...otherProps} />;
}

import { SymbolView } from 'expo-symbols';
import { PropsWithChildren, useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import Animated, { FadeIn } from 'react-native-reanimated';

import { ThemedText } from '@/components/theme/themed-text';
import { ThemedView } from '@/components/theme/themed-view';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useTheme } from '@/hooks/use-theme';

export function Collapsible({ children, title }: PropsWithChildren & { title: string }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const theme = useTheme();

  return (
    <ThemedView>
      <Pressable
        style={({ pressed }) => [styles.heading, pressed && styles.pressedHeading]}
        onPress={() => setIsOpen((value) => !value)}>
        <ThemedView type="backgroundElement" style={styles.button}>
          <SymbolView
            name={{ ios: 'chevron.right', android: 'chevron_right', web: 'chevron_right' }}
            size={14}
            weight="bold"
            tintColor={theme.text}
            style={{ transform: [{ rotate: isOpen ? '-90deg' : '90deg' }] }}
          />
        </ThemedView>

        <ThemedText type="small">{title}</ThemedText>
      </Pressable>
      {isOpen && (
        <Animated.View entering={FadeIn.duration(200)}>
          <ThemedView type="backgroundElement" style={styles.content}>
            {children}
          </ThemedView>
        </Animated.View>
      )}
    </ThemedView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  heading: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.two,
  },
  pressedHeading: {
    opacity: 0.7,
  },
  button: {
    width: Spacing.four,
    height: Spacing.four,
    borderRadius: 12,
    justifyContent: 'center',
    alignItems: 'center',
  },
  content: {
    marginTop: Spacing.three,
    borderRadius: Spacing.three,
    marginLeft: Spacing.four,
    padding: Spacing.four,
  },
});

FILE: mobile/src/constants/theme.ts
