import { clearAuthSession, loadAuthSession, persistAuthSession } from '@/features/auth/storage'
import { refreshWithToken } from '@/features/auth/api'
import type { AuthResponse } from '@/features/auth/types'
import type { ApiResponse, PagedApiResponse } from './types'

const API_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL

if (!API_URL) {
  throw new Error('EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL environment variable is not set')
}

function readMessage(data: unknown): string | null {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return null

  const directMessage = (data as { message?: unknown }).message
  if (typeof directMessage === 'string' && directMessage.length > 0) {
    return directMessage
  }

  const errors = (data as { errors?: unknown }).errors
  if (Array.isArray(errors) && typeof errors[0] === 'string') {
    return errors[0]
  }

  return null
}

function toSession(data: AuthResponse) {
  return {
    accessToken: data.jwToken,
    refreshToken: data.refreshToken,
    user: {
      id: data.id,
      userName: data.userName,
      email: data.email,
      roles: data.roles,
    },
  }
}

async function parseApiError(res: Response): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const data = await res.json()
    return readMessage(data) ?? `API error: ${res.status}`
  } catch {
    const text = (await res.text()).trim()
    return text || `API error: ${res.status}`
  }
}

async function authorizedFetch(path: string, options?: RequestInit, hasRetried = false): Promise<Response> {
  const session = await loadAuthSession()
  const headers = new Headers(options?.headers)

  if (!headers.has('Content-Type')) {
    headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  }

  if (session?.accessToken) {
    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${session.accessToken}`)
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    headers,
  })

  if (response.status !== 401 || hasRetried || !session?.refreshToken) {
    return response
  }

  try {
    const refreshed = await refreshWithToken(session.refreshToken)
    const nextSession = toSession(refreshed)
    await persistAuthSession(nextSession)

    const retryHeaders = new Headers(options?.headers)
    if (!retryHeaders.has('Content-Type')) {
      retryHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    }
    retryHeaders.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${nextSession.accessToken}`)

    return fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
      ...options,
      headers: retryHeaders,
    })
  } catch {
    await clearAuthSession()
    return response
  }
}

export async function apiFetch<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await authorizedFetch(path, options)

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(await parseApiError(response))
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<T>
}

export async function apiFetchData<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const wrapped = await apiFetch<ApiResponse<T>>(path, options)
  return wrapped.data
}

export async function apiFetchPaged<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<PagedApiResponse<T>> {
  return apiFetch<PagedApiResponse<T>>(path, options)
}

import type { AuthResponse } from './types'

const API_URL = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL

if (!API_URL) {
  throw new Error('EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL environment variable is not set')
}

function readMessage(data: unknown): string | null {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return null
  const message = (data as { message?: unknown }).message
  if (typeof message === 'string' && message.length > 0) return message
  return null
}

async function parseApiError(res: Response): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const data = await res.json()
    return readMessage(data) ?? `API error: ${res.status}`
  } catch {
    const text = (await res.text()).trim()
    return text || `API error: ${res.status}`
  }
}

async function post<T>(
  path: string,
  body: unknown,
  headers?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...headers,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(await parseApiError(res))
  }

  return (await res.json()) as T
}

async function postText(
  path: string,
  body: unknown,
  headers?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<string> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...headers,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(await parseApiError(res))
  }

  const raw = (await res.text()).trim()
  if (!raw) return 'Request completed successfully.'

  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(raw)
    if (typeof data === 'string' && data.length > 0) return data
  } catch {}

  return raw
}

export function authenticate(email: string, password: string) {
  return post<AuthResponse>('/auth/login', { email, password })
}

export function refreshWithToken(refreshToken: string) {
  return post<AuthResponse>(
    '/auth/refresh',
    { refreshToken },
    { Cookie: `refreshToken=${refreshToken}` }
  )
}

export function registerAccount(
  userName: string,
  email: string,
  password: string,
  confirmPassword: string,
  userType: number = 0
) {
  return postText('/auth/register', {
    userType,
    email,
    userName,
    password,
    confirmPassword,
  })
}

export async function confirmEmail(userId: string, code: string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/auth/confirm-email?userId=${encodeURIComponent(userId)}&code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`,
    { method: 'GET' }
  )

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(await parseApiError(res))
  }
}

export async function resetPassword(data: {
  email: string
  token: string
  password: string
  confirmPassword: string
}): Promise<void> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/reset-password`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  })

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(await parseApiError(res))
  }
}

export async function forgotPasswordRequest(email: string): Promise<string> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/forgot-password`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
  })

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(await parseApiError(res))
  }

  return 'If an account with that email exists, a reset link has been sent.'
}

FILE: mobile/src/features/auth/auth-screen.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { Image } from 'expo-image'
import {
  AuthForgotPasswordScreen,
  AuthLoginScreen,
  AuthRegisterScreen,
} from '@antapp/app'
import { forgotPasswordRequest } from './api'
import { useAuth } from './context'

const mascotSource = require('@/assets/images/ant-mascot.png')
const MascotImage = () => (
  <Image source={mascotSource} style={{ width: 130, height: 130 }} contentFit="contain" />
)

type AuthMode = 'login' | 'register' | 'forgot'

export function AuthScreen() {
  const { login, register } = useAuth()
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<AuthMode>('login')
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [loginEmail, setLoginEmail] = useState('')
  const [loginPassword, setLoginPassword] = useState('')

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('')
  const [registerEmail, setRegisterEmail] = useState('')
  const [registerPassword, setRegisterPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [userType, setUserType] = useState<'personal' | 'business'>('personal')

  const openLogin = () => {
    setMode('login')
    setError(null)
  }

  const openRegister = () => {
    setMode('register')
    setError(null)
    setSuccessMessage(null)
  }

  const openForgotPassword = () => {
    setMode('forgot')
    setError(null)
    setSuccessMessage(null)
  }

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    if (pending) return

    setPending(true)
    setError(null)
    setSuccessMessage(null)

    const result = await login(loginEmail, loginPassword)
    if (result) setError(result)

    setPending(false)
  }

  const handleRegister = async () => {
    if (pending) return

    setPending(true)
    setError(null)

    const result = await register(
      fullName,
      registerEmail,
      registerPassword,
      confirmPassword,
      userType
    )

    if (result.ok) {
      setMode('login')
      setSuccessMessage(
        'Account created successfully. Check the confirmation instructions, then sign in.'
      )
      setLoginEmail(registerEmail.trim())
      setLoginPassword('')
      setFullName('')
      setRegisterEmail('')
      setRegisterPassword('')
      setConfirmPassword('')
    } else {
      setError(result.message)
    }

    setPending(false)
  }

  const handleForgotPassword = async () => {
    if (pending) return

    setPending(true)
    setError(null)
    setSuccessMessage(null)

    try {
      const message = await forgotPasswordRequest(loginEmail)
      setSuccessMessage(message)
    } catch (forgotError) {
      setError(forgotError instanceof Error ? forgotError.message : 'Request failed')
    }

    setPending(false)
  }

  if (mode === 'register') {
    return (
      <AuthRegisterScreen
        fullName={fullName}
        email={registerEmail}
        password={registerPassword}
        confirmPassword={confirmPassword}
        userType={userType}
        onFullNameChange={(value) => {
          setFullName(value)
          setError(null)
        }}
        onEmailChange={(value) => {
          setRegisterEmail(value)
          setError(null)
        }}
        onPasswordChange={(value) => {
          setRegisterPassword(value)
          setError(null)
        }}
        onConfirmPasswordChange={(value) => {
          setConfirmPassword(value)
          setError(null)
        }}
        onUserTypeChange={setUserType}
        onSubmit={handleRegister}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onNavigateToLogin={openLogin}
        mascot={<MascotImage />}
      />
    )
  }

  if (mode === 'forgot') {
    return (
      <AuthForgotPasswordScreen
        email={loginEmail}
        onEmailChange={(value) => {
          setLoginEmail(value)
          setError(null)
          setSuccessMessage(null)
        }}
        onSubmit={handleForgotPassword}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        successMessage={successMessage}
        onNavigateToLogin={openLogin}
        mascot={<MascotImage />}
      />
    )
  }

  return (
    <AuthLoginScreen
      email={loginEmail}
      password={loginPassword}
      onEmailChange={(value) => {
        setLoginEmail(value)
        setError(null)
        setSuccessMessage(null)
      }}
      onPasswordChange={(value) => {
        setLoginPassword(value)
        setError(null)
        setSuccessMessage(null)
      }}
      onSubmit={handleLogin}
      pending={pending}
      error={error}
      successMessage={successMessage}
      onNavigateToRegister={openRegister}
      onNavigateToForgotPassword={openForgotPassword}
      mascot={<MascotImage />}
    />
  )
}

import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react'
import { authenticate, refreshWithToken, registerAccount } from './api'
import {
  clearAuthSession,
  loadAuthSession,
  persistAuthSession,
} from './storage'
import type { AuthMutationResult, AuthResponse, AuthSession, AuthUser } from './types'

type AuthStatus = 'loading' | 'authenticated' | 'anonymous'

type AuthContextValue = {
  status: AuthStatus
  user: AuthUser | null
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<string | null>
  register: (
    fullName: string,
    email: string,
    password: string,
    confirmPassword: string,
    userType?: 'personal' | 'business'
  ) => Promise<AuthMutationResult>
  logout: () => Promise<void>
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | undefined>(undefined)

function normalizeRoles(roles: string[]): string[] {
  return Array.from(new Set(roles.map((r) => r.trim()).filter(Boolean)))
}

function toSession(data: AuthResponse): AuthSession {
  return {
    accessToken: data.jwToken,
    refreshToken: data.refreshToken,
    user: {
      id: data.id,
      userName: data.userName,
      email: data.email,
      roles: normalizeRoles(data.roles),
    },
  }
}

function canUseMobileClient(roles: string[]): boolean {
  return normalizeRoles(roles).includes('BasicUser')
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<AuthStatus>('loading')
  const [session, setSession] = useState<AuthSession | null>(null)

  const applySession = useCallback((nextSession: AuthSession) => {
    setSession(nextSession)
    setStatus('authenticated')
  }, [])

  const clearSession = useCallback(async () => {
    setSession(null)
    setStatus('anonymous')
    await clearAuthSession()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const restore = async () => {
      const stored = await loadAuthSession()
      if (!stored) {
        setStatus('anonymous')
        return
      }

      if (stored.refreshToken) {
        try {
          const refreshed = await refreshWithToken(stored.refreshToken)
          const nextSession = toSession(refreshed)
          applySession(nextSession)
          await persistAuthSession(nextSession)
          return
        } catch {}
      }

      if (stored.accessToken && stored.user) {
        applySession(stored)
        return
      }

      await clearSession()
    }

    restore().catch(async () => {
      await clearSession()
    })
  }, [applySession, clearSession])

  const login = useCallback(
    async (email: string, password: string): Promise<string | null> => {
      try {
        const data = await authenticate(email.trim(), password)
        if (!canUseMobileClient(data.roles)) {
          return 'Mobile client sadece user rolü olan hesaplar içindir.'
        }

        const nextSession = toSession(data)
        applySession(nextSession)
        await persistAuthSession(nextSession)
        return null
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof Error) return error.message
        return 'Login failed'
      }
    },
    [applySession]
  )

  const register = useCallback(
    async (
      fullName: string,
      email: string,
      password: string,
      confirmPassword: string,
      userType: 'personal' | 'business' = 'personal'
    ): Promise<AuthMutationResult> => {
      try {
        const message = await registerAccount(
          fullName.trim(),
          email.trim(),
          password,
          confirmPassword,
          userType === 'business' ? 1 : 0
        )

        return {
          ok: true,
          message,
        }
      } catch (error) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          message:
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Registration failed',
        }
      }
    },
    []
  )

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    await clearSession()
  }, [clearSession])

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({
      status,
      user: session?.user ?? null,
      login,
      register,
      logout,
    }),
    [status, session, login, register, logout]
  )

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider')
  }
  return context
}

import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store'
import { Platform } from 'react-native'
import type { AuthSession } from './types'

const SESSION_KEY = 'antapp.mobile.auth.session'

async function getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return null
    return localStorage.getItem(key)
  }
  return SecureStore.getItemAsync(key)
}

async function setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return
    localStorage.setItem(key, value)
    return
  }
  await SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value)
}

async function deleteItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return
    localStorage.removeItem(key)
    return
  }
  await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key)
}

export async function loadAuthSession(): Promise<AuthSession | null> {
  const raw = await getItem(SESSION_KEY)
  if (!raw) return null

  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as AuthSession
  } catch {
    await deleteItem(SESSION_KEY)
    return null
  }
}

export function persistAuthSession(session: AuthSession): Promise<void> {
  return setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(session))
}

export function clearAuthSession(): Promise<void> {
  return deleteItem(SESSION_KEY)
}

import { apiFetchData, apiFetchPaged } from '@/features/api/client'
import type { PagedApiResponse, RouteDetail, RouteListItem, RouteStopItem, Tag } from '@/features/api/types'

export type GetRoutesParams = {
  search?: string
  tagIds?: string[]
  sort?: 'rating' | 'newest' | string
  type?: 'official' | 'community' | 'sponsored'
  visibility?: 'public' | 'private'
  authorId?: string
  page?: number
  pageSize?: number
}

export async function getRoutes(params: GetRoutesParams = {}): Promise<PagedApiResponse<RouteListItem>> {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams()

  if (params.search) qs.set('search', params.search)
  if (params.tagIds?.length) qs.set('tagIds', params.tagIds.join(','))
  if (params.sort) qs.set('sort', params.sort)
  if (params.type) qs.set('type', params.type)
  if (params.visibility) qs.set('visibility', params.visibility)
  if (params.authorId) qs.set('authorId', params.authorId)
  if (params.page) qs.set('page', String(params.page))
  if (params.pageSize) qs.set('pageSize', String(params.pageSize))

  const query = qs.toString()
  return apiFetchPaged<RouteListItem>(`/routes${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`)
}

export async function getRouteById(id: string): Promise<RouteDetail> {
  return apiFetchData<RouteDetail>(`/routes/${id}`)
}

export async function getTags(pageSize = 100): Promise<Tag[]> {
  const result = await apiFetchPaged<Tag>(`/tags?pageSize=${pageSize}`)
  return result.data
}

  })

import type { RouteCardData } from '@antapp/ui'

export function routeToCardData(route: RouteListItem): RouteCardData {
  return {
    id: route.id,
    title: route.title,
    description: route.description ?? undefined,
    image: route.thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    rating: route.averageRating > 0 ? route.averageRating : undefined,
    contentType: route.contentType,
    isOfficial: route.contentType === 'Official',

FILE: mobile/src/hooks/use-color-scheme.web.ts
================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useColorScheme as useRNColorScheme } from 'react-native';

/**
 * To support static rendering, this value needs to be re-calculated on the client side for web
 */
export function useColorScheme() {
  const [hasHydrated, setHasHydrated] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setHasHydrated(true);
  }, []);

  const colorScheme = useRNColorScheme();

  if (hasHydrated) {
    return colorScheme;
  }

  return 'light';
}



================================================
FILE: mobile/src/hooks/use-theme.ts
================================================
/**
 * Learn more about light and dark modes:
 * https://docs.expo.dev/guides/color-schemes/
 */

import { Colors } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useColorScheme } from '@/hooks/use-color-scheme';

export function useTheme() {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const theme = scheme === 'unspecified' ? 'light' : scheme;

  return Colors[theme];
}

const AUTH_PALETTE = {

  neutralSoft: '#EEF3F6',
} as const

type AuthShellProps = {
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  panelTitle: string
  panelDescription: string
  panelPosition?: 'left' | 'right'
  footer?: React.ReactNode
  mascot?: React.ReactNode
  children: React.ReactNode
}

type AuthFieldProps = {
  label: string
  error?: string
  children: React.ReactNode
}

type AuthNoticeProps = {
  tone: 'error' | 'success'
  children: React.ReactNode
}

export function AuthShell({
  title,
  subtitle,
  panelTitle,
  panelDescription,
  panelPosition = 'right',
  footer,
  mascot,
  children,
}: AuthShellProps) {
  const [showDecorativeLayers, setShowDecorativeLayers] = React.useState(!isWeb)
  const shellClassName = isWeb ? 'auth-shell' : undefined
  const frameClassName = isWeb
    ? `auth-shell__frame ${panelPosition === 'left' ? 'auth-shell__frame--panel-left' : ''}`.trim()
    : undefined
  const formClassName = isWeb ? 'auth-shell__form' : undefined
  const panelClassName = isWeb ? 'auth-shell__panel' : undefined
  const footerClassName = isWeb ? 'auth-shell__footer' : undefined

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isWeb) return
    setShowDecorativeLayers(true)
  }, [])

  return (
    <Theme name="light_user">
      <YStack
        className={shellClassName}
        flex={1}
        position="relative"
        overflow="hidden"
        backgroundColor={AUTH_PALETTE.neutral}
        justifyContent="center"
        paddingHorizontal="$4"
        paddingVertical="$6"
        minHeight={isWeb ? '100vh' : undefined}
      >
        {showDecorativeLayers ? <AuthBackdrop /> : null}

        <XStack
          className={frameClassName}
          width="100%"
          maxWidth={560}
          alignSelf="center"
          alignItems="stretch"
          justifyContent="center"
          gap="$5"
          zIndex={1}
        >
          <YStack
            className={formClassName}
            flex={1}
            width="100%"
            maxWidth={560}
            alignSelf="center"
            justifyContent="center"
            gap="$5"
          >
            <VStack alignItems="center" gap="$2" paddingHorizontal="$2">
              <Text variant="heading2" align="center" color="$primary">
                AntAPP
              </Text>
              <VStack alignItems="center" gap="$2" maxWidth={440}>
                <Text variant="heading2" align="center">
                  {title}
                </Text>
                <Text variant="bodyLarge" align="center" muted>
                  {subtitle}
                </Text>
              </VStack>
            </VStack>

            <YStack position="relative" width="100%">
              {mascot ? (
                <YStack
                  position="absolute"
                  top={-80}
                  left={20}
                  zIndex={10}
                  alignItems="center"
                >
                  {mascot}
                </YStack>
              ) : null}
              <Card
                variant="elevated"
                size="md"
                width="100%"
                borderRadius="$5"
                backgroundColor={AUTH_PALETTE.neutralStrong}
                {...(mascot ? { paddingTop: '$5', marginTop: '$9' } : {})}
              >
                <VStack gap="$4">{children}</VStack>
              </Card>
            </YStack>

            {footer ? (
              <XStack
                className={footerClassName}
                width="100%"
                justifyContent="center"
                paddingHorizontal="$2"
              >
                {footer}
              </XStack>
            ) : null}
          </YStack>

          {showDecorativeLayers ? (
            <AuthVisualPanel
              className={panelClassName}
              title={panelTitle}
              description={panelDescription}
            />
          ) : null}
        </XStack>
      </YStack>
    </Theme>
  )
}

export function AuthField({ label, error, children }: AuthFieldProps) {
  return (
    <VStack gap="$2">
      <Text variant="label">{label}</Text>
      {children}
      {error ? (
        <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">
          {error}
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </VStack>
  )
}

export function AuthNotice({ tone, children }: AuthNoticeProps) {
  const backgroundColor = tone === 'success' ? '$success50' : '$error50'
  const borderColor = tone === 'success' ? '$success200' : '$error200'
  const textColor = tone === 'success' ? '$success500' : '$error500'

  return (
    <YStack
      padding="$3"
      borderRadius="$3"
      borderWidth={1}
      backgroundColor={backgroundColor}
      borderColor={borderColor}
    >
      <Text variant="body" color={textColor}>
        {children}
      </Text>
    </YStack>
  )
}

FILE: packages/app/src/screens/auth/confirm-email-screen.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@antapp/ui'
import { AuthNotice, AuthShell } from './auth-shell'

export type AuthConfirmEmailScreenProps = {
  userId?: string
  code?: string
  onConfirm: (userId: string, code: string) => Promise<void>
  onNavigateToApp: () => void
  mascot?: React.ReactNode
}

type Status = 'loading' | 'success' | 'error'

export function AuthConfirmEmailScreen({
  userId,
  code,
  onConfirm,
  onNavigateToApp,
  mascot,
}: AuthConfirmEmailScreenProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('loading')
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId || !code) {
      setStatus('error')
      setMessage('Invalid or expired confirmation link.')
      return
    }

    onConfirm(userId, code)
      .then(() => {
        setStatus('success')
        setMessage('Your email has been confirmed. You can now use the app.')
      })
      .catch((e: Error) => {
        setStatus('error')
        setMessage(e.message || 'Confirmation failed. The link may have expired.')
      })
  }, [userId, code])

  const isSuccess = status === 'success'
  const isError = status === 'error'

  return (
    <AuthShell
      title={
        status === 'loading' ? 'Confirming your email…' :
        isSuccess ? 'Email Confirmed!' :
        'Confirmation Failed'
      }
      subtitle={
        status === 'loading'
          ? 'Please wait while we verify your email address.'
          : message
      }
      panelTitle={isSuccess ? 'You are all set!' : 'Verify your account'}
      panelDescription={
        isSuccess
          ? 'Your email is confirmed. Explore routes and build your adventure.'
          : 'A confirmed email keeps your account secure and allows you to recover access.'
      }
      mascot={mascot}
    >
      {isSuccess ? (
        <Button onPress={onNavigateToApp} size="lg" borderRadius="$4">
          Start Exploring
        </Button>
      ) : isError ? (
        <>
          <AuthNotice tone="error">{message}</AuthNotice>
          <Button onPress={onNavigateToApp} variant="outline" size="lg" borderRadius="$4">
            Go to App
          </Button>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </AuthShell>
  )
}

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Button, Input, XStack, isWeb } from '@antapp/ui'
import { AuthField, AuthFooterLink, AuthNotice, AuthShell } from './auth-shell'

export type AuthLoginScreenProps = {
  email: string
  password: string
  onEmailChange: (value: string) => void
  onPasswordChange: (value: string) => void
  onSubmit: () => void
  pending?: boolean
  error?: string | null
  successMessage?: string | null
  onNavigateToRegister?: () => void
  onNavigateToForgotPassword?: () => void
  mascot?: React.ReactNode
}

export function AuthLoginScreen({
  email,
  password,
  onEmailChange,
  onPasswordChange,
  onSubmit,
  pending = false,
  error,
  successMessage,
  onNavigateToRegister,
  onNavigateToForgotPassword,
  mascot,
}: AuthLoginScreenProps) {
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const passwordInputRef = useRef<any>(null)

  const togglePasswordVisibility = () => {
    setShowPassword((current) => !current)

    if (isWeb) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        passwordInputRef.current?.focus?.()
      })
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell
      title="Welcome Back"
      subtitle="Discover amazing routes in Antalya"
      panelTitle="Start your journey"
      panelDescription="Plan better routes, return to saved stops faster, and keep your Antalya trips organized."
      panelPosition="right"
      mascot={mascot}
      footer={
        onNavigateToRegister ? (
          <AuthFooterLink
            prefix="Don't have an account?"
            actionLabel="Sign Up"
            onPress={onNavigateToRegister}
          />
        ) : undefined
      }
    >
      {successMessage ? <AuthNotice tone="success">{successMessage}</AuthNotice> : null}
      {error ? <AuthNotice tone="error">{error}</AuthNotice> : null}

      <AuthField label="Email">
        <Input
          value={email}
          onChangeText={onEmailChange}
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="email"
          keyboardType="email-address"
          placeholder="Enter your email"
          variant="filled"
          size="lg"
          disabled={pending}
        />
      </AuthField>

      <AuthField label="Password">
        <XStack position="relative" alignItems="center">
          <Input
            ref={passwordInputRef}
            flex={1}
            value={password}
            onChangeText={onPasswordChange}
            secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
            {...(isWeb ? { type: showPassword ? 'text' : 'password' } : {})}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
            spellCheck={false}
            autoComplete="current-password"
            placeholder="Enter your password"
            variant="filled"
            size="lg"
            paddingRight="$14"
            disabled={pending}
            onSubmitEditing={onSubmit}
          />
          <Button
            variant="link"
            size="sm"
            position="absolute"
            right="$3"
            top="$2.5"
            zIndex={2}
            onMouseDown={isWeb ? (event) => event.preventDefault() : undefined}
            onPress={togglePasswordVisibility}
            disabled={pending}
            accessibilityLabel={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
          >
            {showPassword ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}
          </Button>
        </XStack>
      </AuthField>

      {onNavigateToForgotPassword ? (
        <XStack justifyContent="flex-end">
          <Button variant="link" size="sm" onPress={onNavigateToForgotPassword} disabled={pending}>
            Forgot password?
          </Button>
        </XStack>
      ) : null}

      <Button onPress={onSubmit} loading={pending} disabled={pending} size="lg" borderRadius="$4">
        Sign In
      </Button>
    </AuthShell>
  )
}

              backgroundColor={isActive ? '$primary' : 'transparent'}

              opacity={disabled ? 0.5 : 1}

FILE: packages/app/src/screens/auth/reset-password-screen.tsx
================================================
import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { Button, Input } from '@antapp/ui'
import { AuthField, AuthFooterLink, AuthNotice, AuthShell } from './auth-shell'

export type AuthResetPasswordScreenProps = {
  email?: string
  token?: string
  onSubmit: (data: { email: string; token: string; password: string; confirmPassword: string }) => Promise<void>
  onNavigateToLogin?: () => void
  onNavigateToForgotPassword?: () => void
  mascot?: React.ReactNode
}

export function AuthResetPasswordScreen({
  email = '',
  token = '',
  onSubmit,
  onNavigateToLogin,
  onNavigateToForgotPassword,
  mascot,
}: AuthResetPasswordScreenProps) {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const invalidLink = !email || !token

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setError(null)

    if (!password || password.length < 6) {
      setError('Password must be at least 6 characters.')
      return
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError('Passwords do not match.')
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await onSubmit({ email, token, password, confirmPassword })
        setSuccess(true)
      } catch (e) {
        setError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to reset password.')
      }
    })
  }

  if (success) {
    return (
      <AuthShell
        title="Password Reset!"
        subtitle="Your password has been updated successfully. You can now sign in with your new password."
        panelTitle="Back on track"
        panelDescription="Your account is secured. Pick up where you left off."
        mascot={mascot}
        footer={
          onNavigateToLogin ? (
            <AuthFooterLink
              prefix="Ready to continue?"
              actionLabel="Sign In"
              onPress={onNavigateToLogin}
            />
          ) : undefined
        }
      >
        {onNavigateToLogin ? (
          <Button onPress={onNavigateToLogin} size="lg" borderRadius="$4">
            Go to Sign In
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </AuthShell>
    )
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell
      title="Reset Password"
      subtitle="Enter your new password below."
      panelTitle="Secure your trail"
      panelDescription="Choose a strong password to keep your routes, collections, and profile safe."
      mascot={mascot}
      footer={
        onNavigateToForgotPassword ? (
          <AuthFooterLink
            prefix="Link expired?"
            actionLabel="Request a new one"
            onPress={onNavigateToForgotPassword}
          />
        ) : undefined
      }
    >
      {invalidLink ? (
        <AuthNotice tone="error">
          Invalid or expired reset link. Please request a new password reset.
        </AuthNotice>
      ) : null}

      {error ? <AuthNotice tone="error">{error}</AuthNotice> : null}

      <AuthField label="New Password">
        <Input
          value={password}
          onChangeText={setPassword}
          secureTextEntry
          placeholder="••••••••"
          variant="filled"
          size="lg"
          disabled={isPending || invalidLink}
          onSubmitEditing={handleSubmit}
        />
      </AuthField>

      <AuthField label="Confirm Password">
        <Input
          value={confirmPassword}
          onChangeText={setConfirmPassword}
          secureTextEntry
          placeholder="••••••••"
          variant="filled"
          size="lg"
          disabled={isPending || invalidLink}
          onSubmitEditing={handleSubmit}
        />
      </AuthField>

      <Button
        onPress={handleSubmit}
        loading={isPending}
        disabled={isPending || invalidLink || !password || !confirmPassword}
        size="lg"
        borderRadius="$4"
      >
        Set New Password
      </Button>
    </AuthShell>
  )
}

FILE: packages/ui/src/components/accessibility-props.ts
================================================
import { isWeb } from 'tamagui'

type CrossPlatformAccessibilityProps = {
  role?: string
  accessibilityRole?: string
  accessibilityLabel?: string
  accessibilityHint?: string
  accessibilityLabelledBy?: string
  accessibilityLiveRegion?: 'none' | 'polite' | 'assertive'
  importantForAccessibility?: string
  accessibilityElementsHidden?: boolean
  testID?: string
  nativeID?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
  'aria-labelledby'?: string
  'aria-live'?: 'off' | 'polite' | 'assertive'
  'aria-hidden'?: boolean
  'data-testid'?: string
}

export function splitAccessibilityProps<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  props: T,
  options?: { defaultRole?: string },
) {
  const {
    role,
    accessibilityRole,
    accessibilityLabel,
    accessibilityHint,
    accessibilityLabelledBy,
    accessibilityLiveRegion,
    importantForAccessibility,
    accessibilityElementsHidden,
    testID,
    nativeID,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy,
    'aria-live': ariaLive,
    'aria-hidden': ariaHidden,
    'data-testid': dataTestId,
    ...rest
  } = props as T & CrossPlatformAccessibilityProps

  if (isWeb) {
    const webRole = role ?? accessibilityRole ?? options?.defaultRole
    const webAriaHidden =
      ariaHidden ??
      accessibilityElementsHidden ??
      (importantForAccessibility === 'no-hide-descendants' ? true : undefined)
    const webAriaLive =
      ariaLive ?? (accessibilityLiveRegion === 'none' ? 'off' : accessibilityLiveRegion)

    return {
      rest,
      accessibilityProps: {
        ...(webRole ? { role: webRole } : {}),
        ...(ariaLabel ?? accessibilityLabel ? { 'aria-label': ariaLabel ?? accessibilityLabel } : {}),
        ...(ariaLabelledBy ?? accessibilityLabelledBy
          ? { 'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy ?? accessibilityLabelledBy }
          : {}),
        ...(webAriaLive ? { 'aria-live': webAriaLive } : {}),
        ...(webAriaHidden !== undefined ? { 'aria-hidden': webAriaHidden } : {}),
        ...(nativeID ? { id: nativeID } : {}),
        ...(dataTestId ?? testID ? { 'data-testid': dataTestId ?? testID } : {}),
      } as Record<string, unknown>,
    }
  }

  return {
    rest,
    accessibilityProps: {
      ...(role ? { role } : {}),
      ...(accessibilityRole ?? options?.defaultRole
        ? { accessibilityRole: accessibilityRole ?? options?.defaultRole }
        : {}),
      ...(accessibilityLabel ? { accessibilityLabel } : {}),
      ...(accessibilityHint ? { accessibilityHint } : {}),
      ...(accessibilityLabelledBy ? { accessibilityLabelledBy } : {}),
      ...(accessibilityLiveRegion ? { accessibilityLiveRegion } : {}),
      ...(importantForAccessibility ? { importantForAccessibility } : {}),
      ...(accessibilityElementsHidden !== undefined
        ? { accessibilityElementsHidden }
        : {}),
      ...(nativeID ? { nativeID } : {}),
      ...(testID ? { testID } : {}),
    } as Record<string, unknown>,
  }
}

FILE: packages/ui/src/components/avatar.tsx
================================================
import React from 'react'
import { styled, GetProps, XStack, Text as TamaguiText, Image } from 'tamagui'
import { splitAccessibilityProps } from './accessibility-props'

const AvatarFrame = styled(XStack, {
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  borderRadius: '$full',
  backgroundColor: '$muted',
  overflow: 'hidden',

  variants: {
    size: {
      sm: { width: 32, height: 32 },
      md: { width: 40, height: 40 },
      lg: { width: 56, height: 56 },
      xl: { width: 80, height: 80 },
    },
  } as const,

  defaultVariants: {
    size: 'md',
  },
})

const initialsSize = { sm: '$2' as const, md: '$3' as const, lg: '$5' as const, xl: '$7' as const }

type AvatarSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'

export type AvatarProps = Omit<GetProps<typeof AvatarFrame>, 'size'> & {
  size?: AvatarSize
  initials?: string
  src?: string
}

export function Avatar({ size = 'md', initials, src, ...rest }: AvatarProps) {
  const { rest: avatarRest, accessibilityProps } = splitAccessibilityProps(rest)

  return (
    <AvatarFrame size={size} {...accessibilityProps} {...avatarRest}>
      {src ? (
        <Image source={{ uri: src }} width="100%" height="100%" objectFit="cover" />
      ) : initials ? (
        <TamaguiText fontSize={initialsSize[size]} fontWeight="600" color="$mutedForeground">
          {initials}
        </TamaguiText>
      ) : null}
    </AvatarFrame>
  )
}

    },
  } as const,

  defaultVariants: {
    size: 'md',
    variant: 'default',
  },

type BadgeVariant = 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info'
type BadgeSize = 'sm' | 'md'

export type BadgeProps = Omit<GetProps<typeof BadgeFrame>, 'variant'> & {
  variant?: BadgeVariant
  size?: BadgeSize
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

export function Badge({ children, variant = 'default', size = 'md', ...rest }: BadgeProps) {
  const { rest: badgeRest, accessibilityProps } = splitAccessibilityProps(rest)

  return (
    <BadgeFrame variant={variant} size={size} {...accessibilityProps} {...badgeRest}>
      <BadgeLabel variant={variant} size={size}>
        {children}
      </BadgeLabel>
    </BadgeFrame>
  )
}

import React from 'react'
import { styled, GetProps, XStack, Text as TamaguiText, Spinner, useTheme } from 'tamagui'
import { splitAccessibilityProps } from './accessibility-props'

const ButtonFrame = styled(XStack, {
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  gap: '$2',
  borderWidth: 1,
  borderRadius: '$3',
  cursor: 'pointer',

  variants: {
    size: {
      sm: { height: '$3', paddingHorizontal: '$3' },
      md: { height: '$4', paddingHorizontal: '$4' },
      lg: { height: '$5', paddingHorizontal: '$5' },
    },
    variant: {
      solid: {
        backgroundColor: '$primary',
        borderColor: '$primary',
        pressStyle: { backgroundColor: '$primaryPress', borderColor: '$primaryPress' },
        hoverStyle: { backgroundColor: '$primaryHover', borderColor: '$primaryHover' },
      },
      outline: {
        backgroundColor: 'transparent',
        borderColor: '$borderColor',
        pressStyle: { backgroundColor: '$backgroundPress' },
        hoverStyle: { backgroundColor: '$backgroundHover', borderColor: '$borderColorHover' },
      },
      ghost: {
        backgroundColor: 'transparent',
        borderColor: 'transparent',
        pressStyle: { backgroundColor: '$backgroundPress' },
        hoverStyle: { backgroundColor: '$backgroundHover' },
      },
      link: {
        backgroundColor: 'transparent',
        borderColor: 'transparent',
        paddingHorizontal: 0,
        paddingVertical: 0,
        height: 'auto',
        pressStyle: { opacity: 0.7 },
        hoverStyle: { opacity: 0.85 },
      },
    },
    disabled: {
      true: {
        opacity: 0.5,
        pointerEvents: 'none',
        cursor: 'not-allowed',
      },
    },
    loading: {
      true: {
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      },
    },
  } as const,

  defaultVariants: {
    size: 'md',
    variant: 'solid',
  },
})

const ButtonLabel = styled(TamaguiText, {
  fontFamily: '$body',
  fontWeight: '600',
  userSelect: 'none',

  variants: {
    variant: {
      solid: { color: '$backgroundStrong' },
      outline: { color: '$primary' },
      ghost: { color: '$primary' },
      link: { color: '$primary' },
    },
    size: {
      sm: { fontSize: '$4' },
      md: { fontSize: '$5' },
      lg: { fontSize: '$6' },
    },
  } as const,

  defaultVariants: {
    variant: 'solid',
    size: 'md',
  },
})

type ButtonVariant = 'solid' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'link'
type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'

export type ButtonProps = Omit<GetProps<typeof ButtonFrame>, 'variant'> & {
  variant?: ButtonVariant
  size?: ButtonSize
  loading?: boolean
  color?: any
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  iconAfter?: React.ReactNode
  children?: React.ReactNode
}

export function Button({
  children,
  icon,
  iconAfter,
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  variant = 'solid',
  size = 'md',
  color,
  accessibilityLabel,
  accessibilityRole,
  role,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  ...rest
}: ButtonProps) {
  const theme = useTheme()
  const spinnerColor =
    variant === 'solid'
      ? (theme.backgroundStrong?.get() ?? '#FFFFFF')
      : (theme.primary?.get() ?? '#EA580C')

  const isDisabled = disabled || loading
  const { rest: buttonRest, accessibilityProps } = splitAccessibilityProps(
    {
      ...rest,
      role,
      accessibilityRole,
      accessibilityLabel,
      'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    },
    { defaultRole: 'button' },
  )

  return (
    <ButtonFrame
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      disabled={isDisabled}
      loading={loading}
      {...accessibilityProps}
      {...buttonRest}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <Spinner size="small" color={spinnerColor} />
      ) : (
        icon
      )}
      {children != null && (
        <ButtonLabel variant={variant} size={size} color={color}>
          {children}
        </ButtonLabel>
      )}
      {!loading && iconAfter}
    </ButtonFrame>
  )
}

  variants: {

      sm: { height: 4 },

  },
})

  height: '100%',
  backgroundColor: '$primary',
  borderRadius: '$full',
})

type ProgressBarSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'

export type ProgressBarProps = Omit<GetProps<typeof BarTrack>, 'size'> & {
  value: number
  max?: number
  size?: ProgressBarSize
  color?: string
}

export function ProgressBar({ value, max = 100, size = 'md', color, ...rest }: ProgressBarProps) {
  const percentage = Math.min(Math.max((value / max) * 100, 0), 100)
  const { rest: trackRest, accessibilityProps } = splitAccessibilityProps(rest)

  return (
    <BarTrack size={size} {...accessibilityProps} {...trackRest}>
      <BarFill
        width={`${percentage}%`}
        {...(color ? { backgroundColor: color } : {})}
      />
    </BarTrack>
  )
}

import React from 'react'
import { GetProps, XStack, YStack, Text as TamaguiText } from 'tamagui'
import { splitAccessibilityProps } from './accessibility-props'

export type RatingDisplayProps = GetProps<typeof XStack> & {
  value: number
  maxStars?: number
  showValue?: boolean
  starSize?: number
}

function StarShape({ filled, size = 10 }: { filled: boolean; size?: number }) {
  return (
    <YStack
      width={size}
      height={size}
      borderRadius={2}
      backgroundColor={filled ? '$ant500' : '$muted'}
      transform={[{ rotate: '45deg' }]}
    />
  )
}

export function RatingDisplay({ value, maxStars = 5, showValue = true, starSize = 10, ...rest }: RatingDisplayProps) {
  const { rest: ratingRest, accessibilityProps } = splitAccessibilityProps(rest)

  return (
    <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1.5" {...accessibilityProps} {...ratingRest}>
      <XStack gap="$1" alignItems="center">
        {Array.from({ length: maxStars }, (_, i) => (
          <StarShape key={i} filled={i < Math.round(value)} size={starSize} />
        ))}
      </XStack>
      {showValue && (
        <TamaguiText fontSize="$4" fontWeight="600" color="$color">
          {value.toFixed(1)}
        </TamaguiText>
      )}
    </XStack>
  )
}

export type RouteCardData = {
  id: string
  title: string
  location?: string
  image?: string
  rating?: number
  distance?: string
  duration?: string
  /** @deprecated - backend has no difficulty field, use contentType */
  difficulty?: 'easy' | 'moderate' | 'hard'
  contentType?: 'Community' | 'Official' | 'Sponsored'
  tag?: string
  description?: string
  stopsCount?: number
  isFavorited?: boolean
  /** @deprecated - use contentType === 'Official' */
  isOfficial?: boolean

  data: RouteCardData

        {data.rating != null && (
          <XStack
            position="absolute"
            top={10}

            <TamaguiText fontSize="$3" fontWeight="600" color="$color">{data.rating.toFixed(1)}</TamaguiText>
          </XStack>
        )}
      </CardImage>

      <YStack padding="$3" gap="$1.5" flex={1}>
        {data.tag && (
          <TamaguiText fontSize="$2" fontWeight="600" color="$primary" textTransform="uppercase">
            {data.tag}

        )}
        <TamaguiText fontFamily="$heading" fontSize="$5" fontWeight="600" color="$color" numberOfLines={2}>

          </XStack>
        )}
        <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3" marginTop="$1">
          {data.distance && (
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1.5">
              <SmallDot />
              <TamaguiText fontSize="$3" color="$mutedForeground">{data.distance}</TamaguiText>
            </XStack>
          )}
          {data.duration && (
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1.5">
              <SmallDot />
              <TamaguiText fontSize="$3" color="$mutedForeground">{data.duration}</TamaguiText>
            </XStack>
          )}
          {data.stopsCount != null && (
            <TamaguiText fontSize="$3" color="$mutedForeground">
              {data.stopsCount} Stops
            </TamaguiText>
          )}
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

  borderWidth: 0,
  color: '$color',
  placeholderTextColor: '$placeholderColor',
  outlineWidth: 0,
  focusStyle: { outlineWidth: 0 },
})

type SearchInputSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'

export type SearchInputProps = Omit<GetProps<typeof SearchInputField>, 'size'> & {
  size?: SearchInputSize
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  iconAfter?: React.ReactNode
}

function DefaultSearchIcon() {
  return (
    <XStack width={18} height={18} alignItems="center" justifyContent="center">
      <YStack
        width={12}
        height={12}
        borderRadius="$full"
        borderWidth={2}
        borderColor="$mutedForeground"
      />
      <YStack
        position="absolute"
        bottom={0}
        right={0}
        width={6}
        height={2}
        backgroundColor="$mutedForeground"
        borderRadius={1}
        transform={[{ rotate: '45deg' }]}
      />
    </XStack>
  )
}

export function SearchInput({ size = 'md', icon, iconAfter, ...rest }: SearchInputProps) {
  const { rest: inputRest, accessibilityProps } = splitAccessibilityProps(rest)

  return (
    <SearchFrame size={size}>
      {icon ?? <DefaultSearchIcon />}
      <SearchInputField {...accessibilityProps} {...inputRest} />
      {iconAfter}
    </SearchFrame>
  )
}

FILE: web/src/proxy.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import {
  ACCESS_MAX_AGE,
  ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE,
  API_URL,
  REFRESH_MAX_AGE,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE,
} from '@/features/auth/constants'
import { decodeJwtPayload, getTokenRoles, isJwtExpired } from '@/features/auth/jwt'
import { canAccessPath, getLandingPathByRoles } from '@/features/auth/roles'

const PUBLIC_PATHS = ['/login', '/register', '/forgot-password', '/reset-password', '/confirm-email']


type RefreshResponse = {
  jwToken: string
  refreshToken: string
}

function cookieOpts(maxAge: number) {
  return {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'strict' as const,
    maxAge,
    path: '/',
  }
}

function applyAuthCookies(response: NextResponse, tokens: RefreshResponse) {
  response.cookies.set(
    ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE,
    tokens.jwToken,
    cookieOpts(ACCESS_MAX_AGE)
  )
  response.cookies.set(
    REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE,
    tokens.refreshToken,
    cookieOpts(REFRESH_MAX_AGE)
  )
}

function clearAuthCookies(response: NextResponse) {
  response.cookies.delete(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE)
  response.cookies.delete(REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE)
}

async function refreshFromBackend(
  refreshToken: string
): Promise<RefreshResponse | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/refresh`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Cookie: `${REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE}=${refreshToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken }),
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
    if (!res.ok) return null

    const data = (await res.json()) as Partial<RefreshResponse>
    if (!data.jwToken || !data.refreshToken) return null
    return { jwToken: data.jwToken, refreshToken: data.refreshToken }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function withAuthUpdates(
  response: NextResponse,
  nextTokens: RefreshResponse | null,
  shouldClearCookies: boolean
) {
  if (nextTokens) {
    applyAuthCookies(response, nextTokens)
  } else if (shouldClearCookies) {
    clearAuthCookies(response)
  }
  return response
}

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl
  const isPublic = pathname === '/' || PUBLIC_PATHS.some((p) => pathname.startsWith(p))
  let accessToken = request.cookies.get(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE)?.value ?? null
  const refreshToken = request.cookies.get(REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE)?.value ?? null

  let refreshedTokens: RefreshResponse | null = null
  let shouldClearCookies = false

  let payload = decodeJwtPayload(accessToken)
  if (!payload || isJwtExpired(payload)) {
    accessToken = null
    payload = null
    if (refreshToken) {
      const refreshed = await refreshFromBackend(refreshToken)
      if (refreshed) {
        refreshedTokens = refreshed
        accessToken = refreshed.jwToken
        payload = decodeJwtPayload(accessToken)
      } else {
        shouldClearCookies = true
      }
    } else {
      shouldClearCookies = true
    }
  }

  if (!payload || isJwtExpired(payload)) {
    if (isPublic) {
      return withAuthUpdates(NextResponse.next(), refreshedTokens, shouldClearCookies)
    }
    return withAuthUpdates(
      NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url)),
      refreshedTokens,
      true
    )
  }

  const roles = getTokenRoles(payload)
  const username = payload?.['sub'] as string | undefined
  const landingPath = getLandingPathByRoles(roles, username)

  if (isPublic) {
    // "/" is landing page, accessible to everyone
    // But authenticated users on "/" should stay there
    // Auth pages (/login, /register, etc.) redirect authenticated users to dashboard
    if (pathname !== '/') {
      return withAuthUpdates(
        NextResponse.redirect(new URL(landingPath, request.url)),
        refreshedTokens,
        shouldClearCookies
      )
    }
    // "/" - everyone can access (public landing page)
    return withAuthUpdates(NextResponse.next(), refreshedTokens, shouldClearCookies)
  }

  if (!canAccessPath(pathname, roles, username)) {
    return withAuthUpdates(
      NextResponse.redirect(new URL(landingPath, request.url)),
      refreshedTokens,
      shouldClearCookies
    )
  }

  return withAuthUpdates(NextResponse.next(), refreshedTokens, shouldClearCookies)
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.png$|.*\\.svg$|.*\\.ico$|.*\\.jpg$|.*\\.jpeg$|.*\\.webp$|.*\\.gif$).*)'],
}

export const revalidate = 300

export default async function LandingPage() {

    getRoutes({ sort: 'rating', type: 'official', pageSize: 3 }),

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Card } from '@antapp/ui'
import { LogOut, Grid3x3, Tag, Users, TrendingUp, MapPin } from 'lucide-react'
import { logout } from '@/features/auth/actions'
import { getAdminStats, type AdminStats } from '@/features/admin/dashboard-actions'
import { useEffect } from 'react'

type AdminSection = 'overview' | 'tags' | 'routes' | 'users' | 'spots'

export default function AdminDashboard({
  userName,
  email,
  roles,
}: {
  userName: string
  email: string
  roles: string[]
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<AdminSection>('overview')
  const [isLoggingOut, setIsLoggingOut] = useState(false)
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<AdminStats | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSection === 'overview') {
      getAdminStats().then(setStats)
    }
  }, [activeSection])

  useEffect(() => {
    // Prefetch routes for instant navigation
    router.prefetch('/admin/tags')
    router.prefetch('/admin/routes')
    router.prefetch('/admin/users')
    router.prefetch('/admin/spots')
  }, [router])

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    setIsLoggingOut(true)
    await logout()
  }

  const sections: Array<{
    id: AdminSection
    label: string
    icon: React.ReactNode
    description: string
  }> = [
      {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <Grid3x3 size={22} />,
        description: 'Dashboard & analytics',
      },
      {
        id: 'tags',
        label: 'Tags',
        icon: <Tag size={22} />,
        description: 'Manage route tags',
      },
      {
        id: 'routes',
        label: 'Routes',
        icon: <TrendingUp size={22} />,
        description: 'Moderate & promote routes',
      },
      {
        id: 'users',
        label: 'Users',
        icon: <Users size={22} />,
        description: 'Manage user accounts',
      },
      {
        id: 'spots',
        label: 'Spots',
        icon: <MapPin size={22} />,
        description: 'Manage places of interest',
      },
    ]

  const handleSelectSection = (sectionId: AdminSection) => {
    setActiveSection(sectionId)
    if (sectionId === 'tags') {
      router.push('/admin/tags')
    } else if (sectionId === 'routes') {
      router.push('/admin/routes')
    } else if (sectionId === 'users') {
      router.push('/admin/users')
    } else if (sectionId === 'spots') {
      router.push('/admin/spots')
    }
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} gap="$6" padding="$6">
      {/* Header */}
      <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" borderBottomWidth={1} borderBottomColor="$borderColor" paddingBottom="$4">
        <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$4" flex={1}>
          <img src="/ant-logo.png" alt="AntAPP Logo" style={{ width: 40, height: 40, objectFit: 'contain' }} />
          <YStack gap="$2">
            <Text variant="heading1" color="$primary">Admin Panel</Text>
            <Text variant="body" muted>Welcome, {userName}</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>{email}</Text>
          </YStack>
        </XStack>
        <Button
          size="md"
          variant="outline"
          icon={<LogOut size={16} />}
          loading={isLoggingOut}
          disabled={isLoggingOut}
          onPress={handleLogout}
        >
          Logout
        </Button>
      </XStack>

      {/* Navigation Cards */}
      <YStack gap="$3">
        <Text variant="heading3">Management</Text>
        <XStack gap="$4" flexWrap="wrap">
          {sections.map((section) => (
            <Card
              key={section.id}
              flex={1}
              minWidth={180}
              maxWidth={220}
              padding="$4"
              gap="$3"
              alignItems="flex-start"
              cursor="pointer"
              backgroundColor={
                activeSection === section.id
                  ? '$primary'
                  : '$backgroundStrong'
              }
              borderColor={
                activeSection === section.id
                  ? '$primary'
                  : '$borderColor'
              }
              hoverStyle={{
                borderColor: '$primary',
                scale: 1.02,
              }}
              pressStyle={{ scale: 0.98 }}
              onPress={() => handleSelectSection(section.id)}
              borderRadius="$4"
              borderWidth={2}
            >
              <YStack
                width={40}
                height={40}
                borderRadius="$2"
                backgroundColor={
                  activeSection === section.id
                    ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)'
                    : '$muted'
                }
                justifyContent="center"
                alignItems="center"
              >
                {section.icon}
              </YStack>
              <YStack gap="$1">
                <Text
                  variant="heading4"
                  weight="semibold"
                  color={activeSection === section.id ? '#FFFFFF' : '$color'}
                >
                  {section.label}
                </Text>
                <Text
                  variant="caption"
                  color={
                    activeSection === section.id
                      ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)'
                      : '$mutedForeground'
                  }
                >
                  {section.description}
                </Text>
              </YStack>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      {/* Overview Content */}
      {activeSection === 'overview' && (
        <YStack gap="$6">
          <YStack gap="$4">
            <Text variant="heading3">System Overview</Text>
            <XStack gap="$4" flexWrap="wrap">
              <Card flex={1} minWidth={150} padding="$4" gap="$2" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderColor="$borderColor" borderWidth={1}>
                <Text variant="heading2" color="$primary">{stats?.totalRoutes ?? '—'}</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Total Routes</Text>
              </Card>
              <Card flex={1} minWidth={150} padding="$4" gap="$2" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderColor="$borderColor" borderWidth={1}>
                <Text variant="heading2" color="$primary">{stats?.activeUsers ?? '—'}</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Active Users</Text>
              </Card>
              <Card flex={1} minWidth={150} padding="$4" gap="$2" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderColor="$borderColor" borderWidth={1}>
                <Text variant="heading2" color="$primary">{stats?.totalTags ?? '—'}</Text>
                <Text variant="caption" muted>Total Tags</Text>
              </Card>
            </XStack>
          </YStack>

          <XStack gap="$6" flexWrap="wrap">
            {/* Latest Routes */}
            <YStack flex={1} minWidth={300} gap="$4">
              <Text variant="heading3">Latest Routes</Text>
              <YStack gap="$2">
                {stats?.recentRoutes && stats.recentRoutes.length > 0 ? (
                  stats.recentRoutes.map(route => (
                    <XStack key={route.id} padding="$3" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$3" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
                      <YStack gap="$1">
                        <Text weight="bold" fontSize={14}>{route.title}</Text>
                        <Text variant="caption" muted>{new Date(route.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</Text>
                      </YStack>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onPress={() => router.push('/admin/routes')}>View in Panel</Button>
                    </XStack>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>No recent routes found.</Text>
                )}
              </YStack>
            </YStack>

            {/* Top Spots */}
            <YStack flex={1} minWidth={300} gap="$4">
              <Text variant="heading3">Top Rated Spots</Text>
              <YStack gap="$2">
                {stats?.topSpots && stats.topSpots.length > 0 ? (
                  stats.topSpots.map(spot => (
                    <XStack key={spot.id} padding="$3" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$3" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
                      <YStack gap="$1">
                        <Text weight="bold" fontSize={14}>{spot.name}</Text>
                        <Text variant="caption" color="$warning600">★ {spot.averageRating.toFixed(1)}</Text>
                      </YStack>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onPress={() => handleSelectSection('spots')}>Manage</Button>
                    </XStack>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>No top spots found.</Text>
                )}
              </YStack>
            </YStack>
          </XStack>
        </YStack>
      )}
    </YStack>
  )
}



================================================
FILE: web/src/app/(admin)/admin/admin-panel-client.tsx
================================================
'use client'

import { useMemo, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Badge, Switch, SearchInput } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { AdminCollection, AdminCollectionDetail, Tag } from '@/types/api'
import { logout } from '@/features/auth/actions'
import {
  createAdminTag,
  deleteAdminCollection,
  deleteAdminTag,
  getAdminCollectionById,
  getAdminCollections,
  getAdminTags,
  removeRouteFromAdminCollection,
  updateAdminCollection,
} from '@/features/admin/actions'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/empty-state'
import {
  BookMarked,
  Compass,
  FolderOpen,
  LogOut,
  Search,
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  Tag as TagIcon,
  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react'

type FeedbackState = {
  ok: boolean
  message: string
} | null

type CollectionFormState = {
  name: string
  description: string
  thumbnailUrl: string
  isPublic: boolean
}

function createEmptyCollectionForm(): CollectionFormState {
  return {
    name: '',
    description: '',
    thumbnailUrl: '',
    isPublic: false,
  }
}

export default function AdminPanelClient({
  userName,
  email,
  roles,
  initialCollections,
  initialTags,
  initialCollectionDetail,
}: {
  userName: string
  email: string
  roles: string[]
  initialCollections: AdminCollection[]
  initialTags: Tag[]
  initialCollectionDetail: AdminCollectionDetail | null
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [collections, setCollections] = useState(initialCollections)
  const [tags, setTags] = useState(initialTags)
  const [selectedCollectionId, setSelectedCollectionId] = useState<string | null>(initialCollectionDetail?.id ?? null)
  const [selectedCollectionDetail, setSelectedCollectionDetail] = useState<AdminCollectionDetail | null>(initialCollectionDetail)
  const [collectionsQuery, setCollectionsQuery] = useState('')
  const [tagsQuery, setTagsQuery] = useState('')
  const [deleteConfirmCollectionId, setDeleteConfirmCollectionId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [deleteConfirmTagId, setDeleteConfirmTagId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [removeRouteConfirmId, setRemoveRouteConfirmId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [collectionForm, setCollectionForm] = useState<CollectionFormState>(() => initialCollectionDetail
    ? {
      name: initialCollectionDetail.name,
      description: initialCollectionDetail.description ?? '',
      thumbnailUrl: initialCollectionDetail.thumbnailUrl ?? '',
      isPublic: initialCollectionDetail.isPublic,
    }
    : createEmptyCollectionForm())
  const [newTagName, setNewTagName] = useState('')
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()
  const [isLoggingOut, startLogoutTransition] = useTransition()

  const refreshCollections = async (selectedId?: string | null) => {
    const result = await getAdminCollections(1, 50)
    setCollections(result.data)
    setDeleteConfirmCollectionId(null)
    setRemoveRouteConfirmId(null)

    const nextSelectedId = selectedId ?? result.data[0]?.id ?? null
    setSelectedCollectionId(nextSelectedId)

    if (nextSelectedId) {
      const detail = await getAdminCollectionById(nextSelectedId)
      setSelectedCollectionDetail(detail)
      setCollectionForm({
        name: detail.name,
        description: detail.description ?? '',
        thumbnailUrl: detail.thumbnailUrl ?? '',
        isPublic: detail.isPublic,
      })
    } else {
      setSelectedCollectionDetail(null)
      setCollectionForm(createEmptyCollectionForm())
    }
  }

  const refreshTags = async () => {
    const result = await getAdminTags(100)
    setTags(result)
    setDeleteConfirmTagId(null)
  }

  const handleSelectCollection = (collectionId: string) => {
    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const detail = await getAdminCollectionById(collectionId)
        setSelectedCollectionId(collectionId)
        setSelectedCollectionDetail(detail)
        setCollectionForm({
          name: detail.name,
          description: detail.description ?? '',
          thumbnailUrl: detail.thumbnailUrl ?? '',
          isPublic: detail.isPublic,
        })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to load collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleSaveCollection = () => {
    if (!selectedCollectionId || !selectedCollectionDetail) return

    if (!collectionForm.name.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Collection name is required.' })
      return
    }

    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateAdminCollection(selectedCollectionId, {
          name: collectionForm.name.trim(),
          description: collectionForm.description.trim() || undefined,
          thumbnailUrl: collectionForm.thumbnailUrl.trim() || undefined,
          isPublic: collectionForm.isPublic,
        })
        await refreshCollections(selectedCollectionId)
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Collection updated successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDeleteCollection = (collectionId: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this collection?')) return

    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteAdminCollection(collectionId)
        await refreshCollections(collectionId === selectedCollectionId ? null : selectedCollectionId)
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Collection deleted successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to delete collection.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleRemoveRoute = (routeId: string) => {
    if (!selectedCollectionId) return
    if (!window.confirm('Remove this route from the collection?')) return

    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await removeRouteFromAdminCollection(selectedCollectionId, routeId)
        await refreshCollections(selectedCollectionId)
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Route removed from collection.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to remove route.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleCreateTag = () => {
    if (!newTagName.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Tag name is required.' })
      return
    }

    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await createAdminTag(newTagName.trim())
        setNewTagName('')
        await refreshTags()
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Tag created successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to create tag.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDeleteTag = (tagId: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this tag?')) return

    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteAdminTag(tagId)
        await refreshTags()
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Tag deleted successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to delete tag.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleLogout = () => {
    startLogoutTransition(async () => {
      await logout()
    })
  }

  const totalRoutesInsideCollections = useMemo(
    () => collections.reduce((sum, collection) => sum + collection.routeCount, 0),
    [collections],
  )

  const visibleCollections = useMemo(() => {
    const query = collectionsQuery.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!query) return collections

    return collections.filter((collection) => {
      const haystack = [collection.name, collection.description, collection.userId, collection.id]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()

      return haystack.includes(query)
    })
  }, [collections, collectionsQuery])

  const visibleTags = useMemo(() => {
    const query = tagsQuery.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!query) return tags

    return tags.filter((tag) => tag.name.toLowerCase().includes(query))
  }, [tags, tagsQuery])

  return (
    <YStack maxWidth={1320} marginHorizontal="auto" padding="$5" gap="$5">
      <YStack
        padding="$6"
        borderRadius="$5"
        backgroundColor="$primary"
        gap="$5"
      >
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
          <YStack gap="$2" maxWidth={760}>
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
              <Shield size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
              <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">ADMIN PANEL</Text>
            </XStack>
            <Text variant="heading1" color="#FFFFFF">Moderate collections and taxonomy from one place</Text>
            <Text variant="bodyLarge" color="#FFFFFF">
              Manage user collections, inspect which routes they contain, and keep the tag vocabulary clean.
            </Text>
          </YStack>

          <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onPress={() => router.push('/')} icon={<Compass size={14} color="currentColor" />}>
              User
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onPress={() => router.push('/business')} icon={<BookMarked size={14} color="currentColor" />}>
              Business
            </Button>
            <Button variant="solid" size="sm" disabled icon={<Shield size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}>
              Admin
            </Button>
            <Button variant="solid" size="sm" onPress={handleLogout} loading={isLoggingOut} icon={<LogOut size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}>
              Sign Out
            </Button>
          </XStack>
        </XStack>

        <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
          <YStack minWidth={180} padding="$4" borderRadius="$4" backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)" gap="$1">
            <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Admin</Text>
            <Text variant="heading4" color="#FFFFFF">{userName}</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">{email}</Text>
          </YStack>
          <YStack minWidth={180} padding="$4" borderRadius="$4" backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)" gap="$1">
            <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Roles</Text>
            <Text variant="heading4" color="#FFFFFF">{roles.join(', ')}</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Moderation access active</Text>
          </YStack>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={220} backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$1.5" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Collections</Text>
          <Text variant="heading2">{collections.length}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Loaded into moderation queue</Text>
        </YStack>
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={220} backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$1.5" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Routes inside collections</Text>
          <Text variant="heading2">{totalRoutesInsideCollections}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Entries visible in the current page</Text>
        </YStack>
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={220} backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$1.5" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Tags</Text>
          <Text variant="heading2">{tags.length}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Available taxonomy items</Text>
        </YStack>
      </XStack>

      {feedback && (
        <XStack
          alignItems="center"
          gap="$2"
          padding="$3"
          borderRadius="$3"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor={feedback.ok ? '$success200' : '$error200'}
          backgroundColor={feedback.ok ? '$success50' : '$error50'}
        >
          <Text variant="body" color={feedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>{feedback.message}</Text>
        </XStack>
      )}

      <XStack gap="$5" flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="flex-start">
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={320} gap="$4">
          <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
            <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
              <YStack gap="$1">
                <Text variant="heading3">Collections</Text>
                <Text variant="body" muted>Select one to inspect and edit.</Text>
              </YStack>
              <Badge variant="info" size="md">{visibleCollections.length}</Badge>
            </XStack>

            <SearchInput
              value={collectionsQuery}
              onChangeText={setCollectionsQuery}
              placeholder="Search collections by name, user, or ID"
              icon={<Search size={16} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />}
            />

            {collections.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                Icon={FolderOpen}
                title="No collections"
                description="There are no collections to moderate yet."
              />
            ) : visibleCollections.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                Icon={Search}
                title="No matching collections"
                description="Try a different keyword or clear the search field."
              />
            ) : (
              <YStack gap="$3">
                {visibleCollections.map((collection) => {
                  const isActive = collection.id === selectedCollectionId

                  return (
                    <YStack
                      key={collection.id}
                      padding="$4"
                      borderRadius="$4"
                      borderWidth={1}
                      borderColor={isActive ? '$primary' : '$borderColor'}
                      backgroundColor={isActive ? '$ant50' : '$background'}
                      gap="$3"
                    >
                      <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3">
                        <YStack gap="$1" flex={1}>
                          <Text variant="heading4">{collection.name}</Text>
                          <Text variant="caption" muted>{collection.userId}</Text>
                        </YStack>
                        <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                          {collection.isDefault && <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Default</Badge>}
                          <Badge variant={collection.isPublic ? 'success' : 'warning'} size="sm">
                            {collection.isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}
                          </Badge>
                        </XStack>
                      </XStack>

                      <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={2}>
                        {collection.description ?? 'No description.'}
                      </Text>

                      <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" borderBottomWidth={1} borderBottomColor="$borderColor" paddingBottom="$4">
                        <Text variant="caption" muted>{collection.routeCount} routes</Text>
                        <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                          <Button
                            variant={isActive ? 'solid' : 'outline'}
                            size="sm"
                            onPress={() => handleSelectCollection(collection.id)}
                          >
                            {isActive ? 'Opened' : 'Open'}
                          </Button>
