'use client'

import { useMemo, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Badge, SearchInput } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { BusinessSpotItem } from '@/types/api'
import { logout } from '@/features/auth/actions'
import {
  getBusinessSpots,
  createBusinessSpot,
  updateBusinessSpot,
  deleteBusinessSpot,
} from '@/features/spots/actions'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/empty-state'
import {
  Building2,
  Compass,
  Copy,
  Edit3,
  LogOut,
  MapPinned,
  Plus,
  Search,
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  Trash2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react'

type FeedbackState = {
  ok: boolean
  message: string
} | null

type SpotFormState = {
  name: string
  description: string
  photoUrl: string
  latitude: string
  longitude: string
}

function createEmptyForm(): SpotFormState {
  return {
    name: '',
    description: '',
    photoUrl: '',
    latitude: '',
    longitude: '',
  }
}

function parseCoordinate(value: string) {
  const normalized = value.replace(',', '.').trim()
  if (!normalized) return null

  const parsed = Number(normalized)
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Number.NaN
}

function validateSpotForm(form: SpotFormState):
  | { error: string }
  | {
    data: {
      name: string
      description?: string
      photoUrl?: string
      latitude: number
      longitude: number
    }
  } {
  if (!form.name.trim()) {
    return { error: 'Spot name is required.' }
  }

  const latitude = parseCoordinate(form.latitude)
  const longitude = parseCoordinate(form.longitude)

  if (latitude === null || longitude === null || Number.isNaN(latitude) || Number.isNaN(longitude)) {
    return { error: 'Latitude and longitude must be valid numbers.' }
  }

  if (latitude < -90 || latitude > 90) {
    return { error: 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90.' }
  }

  if (longitude < -180 || longitude > 180) {
    return { error: 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180.' }
  }

  return {
    data: {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim() || undefined,
      photoUrl: form.photoUrl.trim() || undefined,
      latitude,
      longitude,
    },
  }
}

function formatDate(value: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('tr-TR', { dateStyle: 'medium' }).format(new Date(value))
}

export default function BusinessSpotsClient({
  userName,
  email,
  roles,
  isAdmin,
  initialSpots,
  initialTotal,
}: {
  userName: string
  email: string
  roles: string[]
  isAdmin: boolean
  initialSpots: BusinessSpotItem[]
  initialTotal: number
}) {
  const router = useRouter()

  const [spots, setSpots] = useState(initialSpots)
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(initialTotal)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')
  const [createForm, setCreateForm] = useState<SpotFormState>(createEmptyForm())
  const [editingSpotId, setEditingSpotId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [deleteConfirmSpotId, setDeleteConfirmSpotId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<SpotFormState>(createEmptyForm())
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()
  const [isLoggingOut, startLogoutTransition] = useTransition()

  const refreshSpots = async (successMessage?: string) => {
    try {
      const result = await getBusinessSpots(1, 50)
      setSpots(result.data)
      setTotal(result.totalRecords)

      if (successMessage) {
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: successMessage })
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to refresh spots.' })
    }
  }

  const handleCreate = () => {
    setFeedback(null)
    const result = validateSpotForm(createForm)

    if ('error' in result) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: result.error })
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await createBusinessSpot(result.data)
        setCreateForm(createEmptyForm())
        await refreshSpots('Spot created successfully.')
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to create spot.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleStartEdit = (spot: BusinessSpotItem) => {
    setEditingSpotId(spot.id)
    setEditForm({
      name: spot.name,
      description: spot.description ?? '',
      photoUrl: spot.photoUrl ?? '',
      latitude: String(spot.latitude),
      longitude: String(spot.longitude),
    })
    setFeedback(null)
  }

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingSpotId(null)
    setDeleteConfirmSpotId(null)
    setEditForm(createEmptyForm())
  }

  const handleSaveEdit = (spotId: string) => {
    setFeedback(null)
    const result = validateSpotForm(editForm)

    if ('error' in result) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: result.error })
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await updateBusinessSpot(spotId, result.data)
        await refreshSpots('Spot updated successfully.')
        handleCancelEdit()
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update spot.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDelete = (spotId: string) => {
    setFeedback(null)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteBusinessSpot(spotId)
        if (editingSpotId === spotId) {
          handleCancelEdit()
        }
        setDeleteConfirmSpotId(null)
        await refreshSpots('Spot deleted successfully.')
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to delete spot.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleCopyId = async (spotId: string) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(spotId)
      setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Spot ID copied. You can paste it into route stops.' })
    } catch {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Could not copy Spot ID.' })
    }
  }

  const handleLogout = () => {
    startLogoutTransition(async () => {
      await logout()
    })
  }

  const averageRating = useMemo(() => {
    if (spots.length === 0) return 0
    return spots.reduce((sum, spot) => sum + spot.averageRating, 0) / spots.length
  }, [spots])

  const activeCount = spots.filter((spot) => spot.isActive).length

  const visibleSpots = useMemo(() => {
    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!query) return spots

    return spots.filter((spot) => {
      const haystack = [spot.name, spot.description, spot.id]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()

      return haystack.includes(query)
    })
  }, [searchQuery, spots])

  return (
    <YStack maxWidth={1240} marginHorizontal="auto" padding="$5" gap="$5">
      <YStack
        padding="$6"
        borderRadius="$5"
        backgroundColor="$primary"
        gap="$5"
        overflow="hidden"
        position="relative"
      >
        <YStack gap="$4" zIndex={1}>
          <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
            <YStack gap="$2" maxWidth={760}>
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
                <Sparkles size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
                <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">BUSINESS PANEL</Text>
              </XStack>
              <Text variant="heading1" color="#FFFFFF">Manage the spots behind your routes</Text>
              <Text variant="bodyLarge" color="#FFFFFF">
                Create and maintain your business spots here, then copy their IDs into route stop planning.
              </Text>
            </YStack>

            <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onPress={() => router.push('/')}
                icon={<Compass size={14} color="currentColor" />}
              >
                User
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="solid"
                size="sm"
                disabled
                icon={<Building2 size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}
              >
                Business
              </Button>
              {isAdmin && (
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onPress={() => router.push('/admin')}
                  icon={<Shield size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                >
                  Admin
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button
                variant="solid"
                size="sm"
                onPress={handleLogout}
                loading={isLoggingOut}
                icon={<LogOut size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}
              >
                Sign Out
              </Button>
            </XStack>
          </XStack>

          <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
            <YStack
              minWidth={180}
              padding="$4"
              borderRadius="$4"
              backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"
              gap="$1"
            >
              <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Signed in as</Text>
              <Text variant="heading4" color="#FFFFFF">{userName}</Text>
              <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">{email}</Text>
            </YStack>

            <YStack
              minWidth={180}
              padding="$4"
              borderRadius="$4"
              backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.12)"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"
              gap="$1"
            >
              <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Roles</Text>
              <Text variant="heading4" color="#FFFFFF">{roles.join(', ')}</Text>
              <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Business access is active</Text>
            </YStack>
          </XStack>
        </YStack>
      </YStack>

      <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={220} backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$1.5" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Total spots</Text>
          <Text variant="heading2">{total}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Published in your business catalog</Text>
        </YStack>
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={220} backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$1.5" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Active</Text>
          <Text variant="heading2">{activeCount}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Ready to be used in routes</Text>
        </YStack>
        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={220} backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$1.5" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Average rating</Text>
          <Text variant="heading2">{averageRating > 0 ? averageRating.toFixed(1) : '—'}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Based on visible spot ratings</Text>
        </YStack>
      </XStack>

      {feedback && (

          gap="$4"

                multiline

                placeholder="https://..."
                autoCapitalize="none"

                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Latitude *</Text>
                <Input

                  onChangeText={(value) => setCreateForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, latitude: value }))}

                Copy IDs from here while editing route stops.

          <SearchInput
            value={searchQuery}
            onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
            placeholder="Search your spots by name, description, or ID"
            icon={<Search size={16} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />}
          />

                            </Badge>
                            {spot.averageRating > 0 && (

                            )}
                          </XStack>
                        </XStack>

                        {isEditing ? (

                              <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Name *</Text>

                                value={editForm.name}
                                onChangeText={(value) => setEditForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: value }))}
                                variant="outline"

                              />

                              <Input
                                value={editForm.description}

                                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Latitude *</Text>

                              <YStack flex={1} minWidth={140} gap="$1.5">

                                />
                              </YStack>
                            </XStack>

                            <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                              <Button
                                variant="solid"
                                size="sm"
                                onPress={() => handleSaveEdit(spot.id)}
                                loading={isPending}
                                disabled={isPending}
                                icon={<Edit3 size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}
                              >
                                Save Changes
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onPress={handleCancelEdit}
                                disabled={isPending}
                                icon={<X size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                              >
                                Cancel
                              </Button>
                            </XStack>
                          </YStack>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <YStack gap="$2">
                              <Text variant="body">{spot.description || 'No description yet.'}</Text>
                              <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                                <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lat {spot.latitude.toFixed(4)}</Badge>
                                <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lng {spot.longitude.toFixed(4)}</Badge>
                                <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Created {formatDate(spot.createdAt)}</Badge>
                                {spot.averageRating > 0 && (
                                  <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Rated</Badge>
                                )}
                              </XStack>
                            </YStack>

                            <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onPress={() => router.push(`/spots/${spot.id}`)}
                              >
                                Open Spot
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onPress={() => handleCopyId(spot.id)}
                                icon={<Copy size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                              >
                                Copy ID
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onPress={() => handleStartEdit(spot)}
                                icon={<Edit3 size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                              >
                                Edit
                              </Button>
                              {deleteConfirmSpotId === spot.id ? (
                                <XStack gap="$2">
                                  <Button
                                    variant="outline"
                                    size="sm"
                                    onPress={() => setDeleteConfirmSpotId(null)}
                                    disabled={isPending}
                                  >
                                    Cancel
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    variant="solid"
                                    size="sm"
                                    onPress={() => handleDelete(spot.id)}
                                    disabled={isPending}
                                    backgroundColor="$error500"
                                    hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: '$error400' }}
                                  >
                                    Confirm Delete
                                  </Button>
                                </XStack>
                              ) : (
                                <Button
                                  variant="outline"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onPress={() => setDeleteConfirmSpotId(spot.id)}
                                  disabled={isPending}
                                  icon={<Trash2 size={14} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />}
                                >
                                  <Text variant="label" color="$error500">Delete</Text>
                                </Button>
                              )}
                            </XStack>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </YStack>
                    </XStack>
                  </YStack>
                )
              })}
            </YStack>
          )}
        </YStack>
      </XStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, RouteCard, FilterChip } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteCardData } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteListItem, Tag } from '@/types/api'
import { Map } from 'lucide-react'
import { loadMapLibre, runWhenBrowserIdle } from '@/lib/maplibre'

function routeToCardData(route: RouteListItem): RouteCardData {
  return {
    id: route.id,
    title: route.title,
    description: route.description ?? undefined,
    image: route.thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    rating: route.averageRating > 0 ? route.averageRating : undefined,
    contentType: route.contentType,
    isOfficial: route.contentType === 'Official',
  }
}

export default function HomeClient({
  popularRoutes,
  recommendedRoutes,
  tags,
}: {
  popularRoutes: RouteListItem[]
  recommendedRoutes: RouteListItem[]
  tags: Tag[]
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [activeTagId, setActiveTagId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const mapContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const mapRef = useRef<unknown>(null)
  const [mapError, setMapError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [shouldLoadMap, setShouldLoadMap] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => runWhenBrowserIdle(() => setShouldLoadMap(true)), [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldLoadMap) return

    let cancelled = false

    const initMap = async () => {
      if (!mapContainerRef.current || mapRef.current) return

      try {
        const maplibre = await loadMapLibre()

        if (cancelled || !mapContainerRef.current || mapRef.current) return

        const map = new maplibre.Map({
          container: mapContainerRef.current,
          style: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty',
          center: [30.7133, 36.8969],
          zoom: 11,
        })

        map.addControl(new maplibre.NavigationControl(), 'top-right')
        mapRef.current = map
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setMapError('Map could not be loaded right now.')
        }
      }
    }

    void initMap()

    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      if (mapRef.current && typeof mapRef.current === 'object' && 'remove' in mapRef.current) {
        ;(mapRef.current as { remove: () => void }).remove()
      }
      mapRef.current = null
    }
  }, [shouldLoadMap])

  const allTag = { id: '__all__', name: 'All', isActive: true }
  const tagList = [allTag, ...tags.filter((t) => t.isActive)]

  const filterRoutes = (routes: RouteListItem[]) => {
    if (!activeTagId) return routes
    return routes // tag filtering is server-side; this is just UI state for now
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$4" flex={1} style={{ rowGap: 'clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 24px)' }}>
      {/* Hero Banner */}
      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$ant900"
        borderRadius="$4"
        padding="$6"
        minHeight={160}
        justifyContent="center"
        position="relative"
        overflow="hidden"
      >
        <XStack
          position="absolute"
          top={-40}
          right={-40}
          width={200}
          height={200}
          borderRadius="$full"
          backgroundColor="$ant800"
          opacity={0.3}
        />
        <YStack gap="$2" maxWidth={480} zIndex={1}>
          <XStack
            backgroundColor="$primary"
            paddingHorizontal="$2.5"
            paddingVertical="$1"
            borderRadius="$2"
            alignSelf="flex-start"
          >
            <Text variant="caption" weight="bold" color="#FFFFFF">EXPLORE</Text>
          </XStack>
          <Text variant="heading2" color="#FFFFFF">
            Discover Your Next Big Adventure
          </Text>
          <Text variant="body" color="$ant200">
            Join thousands of explorers sharing the best trails and hidden paths worldwide.
          </Text>
        </YStack>
      </YStack>

      {/* Tag Filters */}
      {tagList.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', paddingBottom: '2px' }}>
          <XStack gap="$2" paddingVertical="$1" style={{ width: 'max-content' }}>
            {tagList.map((tag) => (
              <FilterChip
                key={tag.id}
                active={activeTagId === (tag.id === '__all__' ? null : tag.id)}
                onPress={() => setActiveTagId(tag.id === '__all__' ? null : tag.id)}
              >
                {tag.name}
              </FilterChip>
            ))}
          </XStack>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Interactive Route Explorer */}
      <YStack gap="$3">
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
          <Text variant="heading3">Interactive Route Explorer</Text>
        </XStack>
        <YStack
          height={260}
          backgroundColor="$muted"
          borderRadius="$4"
          overflow="hidden"
        >
          <div
            ref={mapContainerRef}
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
            aria-label="Route explorer map"
          />
          {mapError ? (
            <YStack
              position="absolute"
              inset={0}
              alignItems="center"
              justifyContent="center"
              gap="$2"
              backgroundColor="$muted"
              borderWidth={2}
              borderStyle="dashed"
              borderColor="$borderColor"
            >
              <Map size={48} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
              <Text variant="body" muted>{mapError}</Text>
            </YStack>
          ) : null}
        </YStack>
      </YStack>

      {/* Popular Routes */}
      {filterRoutes(popularRoutes).length > 0 && (
        <YStack gap="$3">
          <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
            <Text variant="heading3">Popular Routes</Text>
            <Text
              variant="body"
              color="$primary"
              cursor="pointer"
              onPress={() => router.push('/search?sort=rating&type=official')}
            >
              View All
            </Text>
          </XStack>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)', gap: '16px' }}>
            {filterRoutes(popularRoutes).map((route) => (
              <RouteCard
                key={route.id}
                data={routeToCardData(route)}
                onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </YStack>
      )}

      {/* Recommended / Community */}
      {filterRoutes(recommendedRoutes).length > 0 && (
        <YStack gap="$3">
          <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
            <Text variant="heading3">Community Routes</Text>
            <Text
              variant="body"
              color="$primary"
              cursor="pointer"
              onPress={() => router.push('/search?sort=newest&type=community')}
            >
              See More
            </Text>
          </XStack>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: '16px' }}>
            {filterRoutes(recommendedRoutes).map((route) => (
              <RouteCard
                key={route.id}
                data={routeToCardData(route)}
                onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </YStack>
      )}

      {/* Empty state when no routes */}
      {popularRoutes.length === 0 && recommendedRoutes.length === 0 && (
        <YStack alignItems="center" justifyContent="center" padding="$10" gap="$3">
          <Map size={48} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
          <Text variant="heading3" muted align="center">No routes yet</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted align="center">Be the first to create a route and share your adventure!</Text>
        </YStack>
      )}
    </YStack>
  )
}

import { getRoutes, getTags } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import HomeClient from './home-client'

export default async function ExplorePage() {
  const [popularResult, recommendedResult, tags] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getRoutes({ sort: 'rating', type: 'official', pageSize: 8 }),
    getRoutes({ sort: 'newest', type: 'community', pageSize: 6 }),
    getTags(),
  ])

  const popularRoutes = popularResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? popularResult.value.data : []
  const recommendedRoutes = recommendedResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? recommendedResult.value.data : []
  const tagList = tags.status === 'fulfilled' ? tags.value : []

  return (
    <HomeClient
      popularRoutes={popularRoutes}
      recommendedRoutes={recommendedRoutes}
      tags={tagList}
    />
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Image } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { Collection } from '@/types/api'
import { Plus, Globe, Lock, X, Trash2, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import { createCollection, deleteCollection } from '@/features/collections/actions'

function collectionCoverStyle(id: string) {
  const gradients = [
    'linear-gradient(135deg, #0A4A7A 0%, #1E81B0 52%, #58B9E0 100%)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg, #7A2F0A 0%, #C35B1D 55%, #F9A44B 100%)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg, #0A6A56 0%, #0FA37F 50%, #6BE8C6 100%)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg, #3D3D68 0%, #6262A6 52%, #9E9EEB 100%)',
  ]
  const seed = id.split('').reduce((acc, char) => acc + char.charCodeAt(0), 0)
  return gradients[seed % gradients.length]
}

function stopEventPropagation(e: unknown) {
  if (e && typeof e === 'object' && 'stopPropagation' in e && typeof (e as { stopPropagation?: unknown }).stopPropagation === 'function') {
    ; (e as { stopPropagation: () => void }).stopPropagation()
  }
}

function CollectionCard({
  collection,
  onDeleteRequest,
}: {
  collection: Collection
  onDeleteRequest: (collection: Collection) => void
}) {
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <YStack
      backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
      borderRadius="$4"
      borderWidth={1}
      borderColor="$borderColor"
      overflow="hidden"
      cursor="pointer"
      onPress={() => router.push(`/collections/${collection.id}`)}
      hoverStyle={{ borderColor: '$primary', opacity: 0.95 }}
      pressStyle={{ scale: 0.985 }}
    >
      <YStack height={160} backgroundColor="$muted" alignItems="center" justifyContent="center">
        {collection.thumbnailUrl ? (
          <Image
            src={collection.thumbnailUrl}
            alt=""
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', display: 'block' }}
          />
        ) : (
          <YStack
            width="100%"
            height="100%"
            justifyContent="space-between"
            padding="$3"
            style={{ background: collectionCoverStyle(collection.id) }}
          >
            <XStack justifyContent="flex-end" alignItems="center">
              <XStack
                backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"
                borderRadius="$full"
                paddingHorizontal="$2"
                paddingVertical="$1"
              >
                <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">{collection.routeCount ?? 0} routes</Text>
              </XStack>
            </XStack>
            <XStack />
          </YStack>
        )}
      </YStack>

      <YStack padding="$4" gap="$2">
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start">
          <Text variant="heading4" flex={1} numberOfLines={1}>{collection.name}</Text>
          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1" marginLeft="$2">
            {collection.isPublic ? <Globe size={14} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" /> : <Lock size={14} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />}
          </XStack>
        </XStack>

        {collection.description ? (
          <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={2}>{collection.description}</Text>
        ) : null}

        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" marginTop="$1">
          <Text variant="caption" muted>{collection.routeCount ?? 0} routes</Text>
          {collection.isDefault ? (
            <Text variant="caption" color="$primary" weight="semibold">Saved Routes</Text>
          ) : null}
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      {!collection.isDefault ? (
        <XStack
          position="absolute"
          right="$3"
          bottom="$3"
          width={34}
          height={34}
          borderRadius="$full"
          alignItems="center"
          justifyContent="center"
          cursor="pointer"
          backgroundColor="#EA580C"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor="#C2410C"
          style={{ boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.36)' }}
          hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#C2410C' }}
          pressStyle={{ scale: 0.96 }}
          onPress={(e) => {
            stopEventPropagation(e)
            onDeleteRequest(collection)
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
        </XStack>
      ) : null}
    </YStack>
  )
}

        </YStack>

        <XStack gap="$3" justifyContent="flex-end">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="md" onPress={onClose} disabled={deleting}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="solid" size="md" onPress={onConfirm} disabled={deleting}>
            {deleting ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete Collection'}
          </Button>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

function NewCollectionModal({ onClose, onCreated }: { onClose: () => void; onCreated: () => void }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) { setError('Collection name is required.'); return }
    setLoading(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      await createCollection({ name: name.trim(), description: description.trim() || undefined })
      onCreated()
      onClose()
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to create collection.')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <YStack
      position="fixed"
      top={0}
      left={0}
      right={0}
      bottom={0}
      zIndex={200}
      backgroundColor="rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"
      alignItems="center"
      justifyContent="center"
      style={{ backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)' }}
      onPress={onClose}
    >
      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$5"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
        padding="$6"
        gap="$4"
        width={400}
        maxWidth="90vw"
        onPress={(e: unknown) => {
          if (e && typeof e === 'object' && 'stopPropagation' in e && typeof (e as { stopPropagation?: unknown }).stopPropagation === 'function') {
            ;(e as { stopPropagation: () => void }).stopPropagation()
          }
        }}
      >
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
          <Text variant="heading3">New Collection</Text>
          <XStack cursor="pointer" onPress={onClose} padding="$1">
            <X size={20} color="currentColor" />
          </XStack>
        </XStack>

        <YStack gap="$3">
          <YStack gap="$1">
            <Text variant="label">Name *</Text>
            <Input
              value={name}
              onChangeText={setName}
              placeholder="e.g. Weekend Getaways"
            />
          </YStack>
          <YStack gap="$1">
            <Text variant="label">Description</Text>
            <Input
              value={description}
              onChangeText={setDescription}
              placeholder="Optional description..."
            />
          </YStack>
          {error ? <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">{error}</Text> : null}
        </YStack>

        <XStack gap="$3" justifyContent="flex-end">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="md" onPress={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button variant="solid" size="md" onPress={handleCreate} disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create'}
          </Button>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function CollectionsClient({ collections: initialCollections }: { collections: Collection[]; total: number }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false)
  const [collections, setCollections] = useState(initialCollections)
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<Collection | null>(null)
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState('')
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    setCollections(initialCollections)
  }, [initialCollections])

  const handleCreated = () => {
    // Refresh the page to load the new collection
    router.refresh()
  }

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return
    setDeleteError('')
    setIsDeleting(true)
    try {
      await deleteCollection(deleteTarget.id)
      setCollections((prev) => prev.filter((collection) => collection.id !== deleteTarget.id))
      setDeleteTarget(null)
      router.refresh()
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      setDeleteError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to delete collection.')
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$5" flex={1}>
      {showModal && (
        <NewCollectionModal
          onClose={() => setShowModal(false)}
          onCreated={handleCreated}
        />
      )}
      {deleteTarget && (
        <DeleteCollectionModal
          target={deleteTarget}
          deleting={isDeleting}
          error={deleteError}
          onClose={() => {
            if (isDeleting) return
            setDeleteTarget(null)
            setDeleteError('')
          }}
          onConfirm={handleDelete}
        />
      )}

      <YStack gap="$2">
        <Text variant="heading2">My Collections</Text>
        <Text variant="body" muted>Save and organize your favorite routes</Text>
      </YStack>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))', gap: '16px' }}>
        {collections.map((col) => (
          <CollectionCard
            key={col.id}
            collection={col}
            onDeleteRequest={(collection) => {
              if (collection.isDefault) return
              setDeleteError('')
              setDeleteTarget(collection)
            }}
          />
        ))}

        {/* New Collection card */}
        <YStack
          borderRadius="$4"
          borderWidth={2}
          borderStyle="dashed"
          borderColor="$borderColor"
          alignItems="center"
          justifyContent="center"
          minHeight={220}
          cursor="pointer"
          gap="$3"
          onPress={() => setShowModal(true)}
          hoverStyle={{ borderColor: '$primary', backgroundColor: '$ant50' }}
          pressStyle={{ scale: 0.98 }}
        >
          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$muted"
            borderRadius="$round"
            padding="$3"
          >
            <Plus size={24} color="var(--color-primary)" />
          </YStack>
          <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
            <Text variant="label" color="$primary">New Collection</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>Organize your saved routes</Text>
          </YStack>

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'

import type { RouteCardData } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { CurrentUser, RouteListItem } from '@/types/api'
import { publishRoute, unpublishRoute } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import { Plus, Share2, Globe, Lock, Pencil } from 'lucide-react'

function routeToCardData(route: RouteListItem): RouteCardData {
  return {
    id: route.id,
    title: route.title,
    description: route.description ?? undefined,
    image: route.thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    rating: route.averageRating > 0 ? route.averageRating : undefined,
    contentType: route.contentType,
    isOfficial: route.contentType === 'Official',
  }

function RouteActionCard({
  route,
  onPress,
}: {
  route: RouteListItem
  onPress: () => void
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(route.isPublic)
  const [isToggling, startToggle] = useTransition()

  const handleTogglePublish = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    startToggle(async () => {
      try {
        if (isPublic) {
          await unpublishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(false)
        } else {
          await publishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(true)
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack flex={1} position="relative">
      <RouteCard
        data={routeToCardData(route)}
        onPress={onPress}
      />
      {/* Overlay action bar */}
      <XStack
        position="absolute"
        bottom="$0"
        left="$0"
        right="$0"
        backgroundColor="rgba(0,0,0,0.65)"
        borderBottomLeftRadius="$4"
        borderBottomRightRadius="$4"
        paddingHorizontal="$3"
        paddingVertical="$2"
        gap="$2"
        justifyContent="flex-end"
        alignItems="center"
      >
        {/* Publish status badge */}
        <XStack
          flex={1}
          alignItems="center"
          gap="$1.5"
        >
          {isPublic
            ? <Globe size={13} color="#4ade80" />
            : <Lock size={13} color="#d1d5db" />
          }
          <Text variant="caption" color={isPublic ? '#4ade80' : '#d1d5db'} fontSize="$2">
            {isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}
          </Text>
        </XStack>

        {/* Toggle publish */}
        <XStack
          cursor="pointer"
          padding="$1.5"
          borderRadius="$2"
          backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"
          hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }}
          onPress={(e: any) => handleTogglePublish(e)}
          opacity={isToggling ? 0.5 : 1}
        >
          <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF" fontSize="$2">
            {isPublic ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
          </Text>
        </XStack>

        {/* Edit */}
        <XStack
          cursor="pointer"
          padding="$1.5"
          borderRadius="$2"
          backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"
          hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }}
          onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}/edit`)}
        >
          <Pencil size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />
        </XStack>
      </XStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

import { getRouteById } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/features/account/actions'
import RouteDetailClient from './route-detail-client'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'

export default async function RouteDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
}) {
  const { id } = await params

  const [routeResult, userResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getRouteById(id),
    getCurrentUser(),
  ])

  if (routeResult.status === 'rejected') {
    const err = routeResult.reason as Error
    // Dev: throw so Next.js error overlay shows the real message
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      throw new Error(`getRouteById failed: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`)
    }
    notFound()
  }

  const route = (routeResult as PromiseFulfilledResult<typeof routeResult extends PromiseFulfilledResult<infer T> ? T : never>).value as Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getRouteById>>
  const currentUser = userResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? userResult.value : null
  const isOwner = !!(currentUser && route.authorUserId === currentUser.id)
  const isAdmin = currentUser?.userName === 'antadmin'

  return <RouteDetailClient route={route} isOwner={isOwner} isAdmin={isAdmin} />
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, StatBox, RatingDisplay } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteDetail } from '@/types/api'
import { Navigation, Bookmark, BookmarkCheck, Map, Star, GitFork, Pencil, Crown, X, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react'
import { SaveToCollectionModal } from '@/features/collections/save-to-collection-modal'
import { rateRoute, forkRoute, promoteRouteToOfficial } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import { loadMapLibre, runWhenBrowserIdle } from '@/lib/maplibre'

// ─── Star Rating Widget ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StarRatingWidget({
  routeId,
  onRated,
}: {
  routeId: string
  onRated: (score: number) => void
}) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(0)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [isSubmitting, startSubmit] = useTransition()
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)

  const handleRate = (score: number) => {
    if (submitted) return
    setSelected(score)
    startSubmit(async () => {
      try {
        await rateRoute(routeId, score)
        setSubmitted(true)
        onRated(score)
      } catch {
        setSelected(0)
      }
    })
  }

  const active = hovered || selected

  if (submitted) {
    return (
      <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2" padding="$3" backgroundColor="$success50" borderRadius="$3">
        <Star size={16} fill="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" color="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" />
        <Text variant="caption" color="$success500">Thanks! You rated this {selected}/5</Text>
      </XStack>
    )
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$2">
      <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Rate This Route</Text>
      <XStack gap="$1.5" alignItems="center">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
          <XStack
            key={star}
            cursor={isSubmitting ? 'default' : 'pointer'}
            onPress={() => handleRate(star)}
            padding="$1"
            borderRadius="$2"

            onMouseEnter={() => !isSubmitting && setHovered(star)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(0)}
          >
            <Star
              size={28}
              fill={star <= active ? '#FF8C00' : 'transparent'}
              color={star <= active ? '#FF8C00' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground)'}
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          </XStack>
        ))}
        {isSubmitting && <Text variant="caption" muted>Saving...</Text>}
      </XStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

function decodePolyline(encoded: string): Array<[number, number]> {
  const points: Array<[number, number]> = []
  let index = 0
  let lat = 0
  let lng = 0

  while (index < encoded.length) {
    let result = 0
    let shift = 0
    let byte = 0
    do {
      byte = encoded.charCodeAt(index++) - 63
      result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift
      shift += 5
    } while (byte >= 0x20)
    const deltaLat = (result & 1) !== 0 ? ~(result >> 1) : result >> 1
    lat += deltaLat

    result = 0
    shift = 0
    do {
      byte = encoded.charCodeAt(index++) - 63
      result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift
      shift += 5
    } while (byte >= 0x20)
    const deltaLng = (result & 1) !== 0 ? ~(result >> 1) : result >> 1
    lng += deltaLng

    points.push([lng / 1e5, lat / 1e5])
  }

  return points
}

// ─── Main Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getBaseSpotName(stop: RouteDetail['stops'][number]) {
  return stop.spotName?.trim() || stop.name
}

function hasTitleOverride(stop: RouteDetail['stops'][number]) {
  const customTitle = stop.customTitle?.trim()
  if (!customTitle) return false
  return customTitle !== getBaseSpotName(stop)
}

function buildSpotHref(spotId: string, routeStopName: string) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams()
  params.set('fromRouteName', routeStopName)
  return `/spots/${spotId}?${params.toString()}`
}

export default function RouteDetailClient({
  route,
  isOwner = false,
  isAdmin = false,
}: {
  route: RouteDetail
  isOwner?: boolean
  isAdmin?: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const mapContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const mapRef = useRef<unknown>(null)
  const [mapError, setMapError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [shouldLoadMap, setShouldLoadMap] = useState(false)

  const polylineCoordinates = useMemo(() => {
    if (!route.encodedPolyline) return []
    try {
      return decodePolyline(route.encodedPolyline)
    } catch {
      return []
    }
  }, [route.encodedPolyline])

  const stopPoints = useMemo(
    () => route.stops
      .filter((stop) => Number.isFinite(stop.latitude) && Number.isFinite(stop.longitude))
      .map((stop, index) => ({
        coordinates: [stop.longitude, stop.latitude] as [number, number],
        order: stop.order || index + 1,
        name: stop.name,
        spotId: stop.spotId,
      })),
    [route.stops],
  )

  const stopCoordinates = useMemo(
    () => stopPoints.map((point) => point.coordinates),
    [stopPoints],
  )

  const routeLineCoordinates = useMemo(
    () => (polylineCoordinates.length > 1 ? polylineCoordinates : stopCoordinates),
    [polylineCoordinates, stopCoordinates],
  )

  useEffect(() => runWhenBrowserIdle(() => setShouldLoadMap(true)), [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldLoadMap) return

    let cancelled = false

    const initMap = async () => {
      if (!mapContainerRef.current || mapRef.current) return

      try {
        const maplibre = await loadMapLibre()
        if (cancelled || !mapContainerRef.current || mapRef.current) return

        const hasCenter = Number.isFinite(route.centerLatitude) && Number.isFinite(route.centerLongitude)
        const map = new maplibre.Map({
          container: mapContainerRef.current,
          style: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty',
          center: hasCenter ? [route.centerLongitude, route.centerLatitude] : [30.7133, 36.8969],
          zoom: hasCenter ? 11 : 10,
        })

        map.addControl(new maplibre.NavigationControl(), 'top-right')

        map.on('load', () => {
          if (cancelled) return

          if (routeLineCoordinates.length > 1) {
            map.addSource('route-line', {
              type: 'geojson',
              data: {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: {
                  type: 'LineString',
                  coordinates: routeLineCoordinates,
                },
                properties: {},
              },
            })

            map.addLayer({
              id: 'route-line-layer',
              type: 'line',
              source: 'route-line',
              layout: {
                'line-cap': 'round',
                'line-join': 'round',
              },
              paint: {
                'line-color': '#FF8C00',
                'line-width': 4,
                'line-dasharray': [1.5, 1.5],
              },
            })
          }

          if (stopPoints.length > 0) {
            map.addSource('route-stops', {
              type: 'geojson',
              data: {
                type: 'FeatureCollection',
                features: stopPoints.map((stop) => ({
                  type: 'Feature',
                  geometry: {
                    type: 'Point',
                    coordinates: stop.coordinates,
                  },
                  properties: {
                    order: stop.order,
                  },
                })),
              },
            })

            map.addLayer({
              id: 'route-stops-layer',
              type: 'circle',
              source: 'route-stops',
              paint: {
                'circle-radius': 8,
                'circle-color': '#FF8C00',
                'circle-stroke-color': '#FFFFFF',
                'circle-stroke-width': 2,
              },
            })

            map.addLayer({
              id: 'route-stops-label-layer',
              type: 'symbol',
              source: 'route-stops',
              layout: {
                'text-field': ['to-string', ['get', 'order']],
                'text-size': 11,
                'text-font': ['Open Sans Semibold'],
                'text-allow-overlap': true,
                'text-ignore-placement': true,
              },
              paint: {
                'text-color': '#FFFFFF',
                'text-halo-color': '#C2410C',
                'text-halo-width': 1.25,
              },
            })
          }

          const fitCoordinates = routeLineCoordinates.length > 0 ? routeLineCoordinates : stopCoordinates

          if (fitCoordinates.length > 0) {
            let minLon = fitCoordinates[0][0]
            let minLat = fitCoordinates[0][1]
            let maxLon = fitCoordinates[0][0]
            let maxLat = fitCoordinates[0][1]

            for (const [lon, lat] of fitCoordinates) {
              if (lon < minLon) minLon = lon
              if (lat < minLat) minLat = lat
              if (lon > maxLon) maxLon = lon
              if (lat > maxLat) maxLat = lat
            }

            if (minLon === maxLon && minLat === maxLat) {
              map.setCenter([minLon, minLat])
              map.setZoom(14)
            } else {
              map.fitBounds(
                [
                  [minLon, minLat],
                  [maxLon, maxLat],
                ],
                { padding: 40, maxZoom: 14 }
              )
            }
          }
        })

        mapRef.current = map
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setMapError('Route map could not be loaded right now.')
        }
      }
    }

    void initMap()

    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      if (mapRef.current && typeof mapRef.current === 'object' && 'remove' in mapRef.current) {
        ; (mapRef.current as { remove: () => void }).remove()
      }
      mapRef.current = null
    }
  }, [route.centerLatitude, route.centerLongitude, routeLineCoordinates, shouldLoadMap, stopCoordinates, stopPoints])

  // Save state
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false)
  const [isSaving] = useTransition()
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showCollectionModal, setShowCollectionModal] = useState(false)

  // Fork state
  const [isForking, startFork] = useTransition()
  const [forkError, setForkError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Promote state
  const [isPromoting, startPromote] = useTransition()
  const [promoteError, setPromoteError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isPromoted, setIsPromoted] = useState(route.contentType === 'Official')

  // Rating state
  const [displayRating, setDisplayRating] = useState(route.averageRating)

  // Tour Guide Mode state
  const [isTourMode, setIsTourMode] = useState(false)
  const [currentStopIndex, setCurrentStopIndex] = useState(0)
  const currentStop = route.stops[currentStopIndex] ?? route.stops[0]

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (isSaved) return
    setShowCollectionModal(true)
  }

  const handleFork = () => {
    setForkError(null)
    startFork(async () => {
      try {
        const forkedId = await forkRoute(route.id)
        router.push(`/routes/${forkedId}`)
      } catch (e) {
        setForkError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to fork route')
      }
    })
  }

  const handlePromote = () => {
    if (isPromoted) return
    setPromoteError(null)
    startPromote(async () => {
      try {
        await promoteRouteToOfficial(route.id)
        setIsPromoted(true)
      } catch (e) {
        setPromoteError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to promote route')
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$5" flex={1}>
      {/* Hero Banner */}
      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$ant900"
        borderRadius="$4"
        padding="$6"
        minHeight={240}
        justifyContent="flex-end"
        position="relative"
        overflow="hidden"
      >
        {route.thumbnailUrl && (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img
            src={route.thumbnailUrl}
            alt=""
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              width: '100%',
              height: '100%',
              objectFit: 'cover',
              objectPosition: 'center center',
              opacity: 0.96,
            }}
          />
        )}
        <XStack
          position="absolute"
          top={0}
          left={0}
          right={0}
          bottom={0}
          style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.16) 0%, rgba(15,23,42,0.44) 100%)' }}
        />

        {/* Owner badge */}
        {isOwner && (
          <XStack
            position="absolute"
            top="$4"
            right="$4"
            backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"
            paddingHorizontal="$3"
            paddingVertical="$1.5"
            borderRadius="$2"
            gap="$1.5"
            alignItems="center"
          >
            <Pencil size={12} color="#fff" />
            <Text variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF">Your Route</Text>
          </XStack>
        )}

        <YStack zIndex={1} gap="$3">
          <YStack gap="$1">
            <Text variant="heading1" color="#FFFFFF">{route.title}</Text>
            {displayRating > 0 && (
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
                <RatingDisplay value={displayRating} />
                <Text variant="caption" color="$ant200">{displayRating.toFixed(1)} avg rating</Text>
              </XStack>
            )}
          </YStack>

          <XStack gap="$2.5" flexWrap="wrap" marginTop="$1">
            <Button variant="solid" size="md" onPress={() => {
              if (route.stops.length > 0) {
                setCurrentStopIndex(0)
                setIsTourMode(true)
              } else {
                alert("This route has no stops.")
              }
            }}>
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1.5">
                <Navigation size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
                <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">Start Navigation</Text>
              </XStack>
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="md"
              loading={isSaving}
              disabled={isSaved || isSaving}
              onPress={handleSave}

              style={{ backgroundColor: isSaved ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' : undefined }}
            >
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1.5">
                {isSaved
                  ? <BookmarkCheck size={16} color="#FFFFFF" />
                  : <Bookmark size={16} color="currentColor" />
                }
                <YStack>
                  <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1">
                    <Text variant="label" color={isSaved ? '#FFFFFF' : undefined}>
                      {isSaved ? 'In Collection' : 'Save to Collection'}
                    </Text>
                  </XStack>
                </YStack>
              </XStack>
            </Button>

            {isOwner && (
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="md"
                onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}/edit`)}

                style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' }}
              >

                  <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">Edit</Text>

              </Button>
            )}

            {isAdmin && (

                size="md"
                loading={isPromoting}
                disabled={isPromoted || isPromoting}
                onPress={handlePromote}

                style={{ backgroundColor: isPromoted ? 'rgba(76,175,80,0.2)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' }}
              >
                <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$1.5">
                  <Crown size={16} color={isPromoted ? '#4CAF50' : '#FFFFFF'} />
                  <Text variant="label" color={isPromoted ? '#4CAF50' : '#FFFFFF'}>
                    {isPromoted ? 'Official ✓' : 'Promote'}
                  </Text>
                </XStack>

          </XStack>

          {saveError && (

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 300px', gap: '32px', alignItems: 'start' }}>

                      {stop.description && (
                        <Text variant="body" muted>{stop.description}</Text>
                      )}
                      {stop.photoUrl && (
                        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                        <img
                          src={stop.photoUrl}
                          alt={stop.name}
                          loading="lazy"

                          style={{
                            width: '100%',

              <Text variant="heading4">Rate This Route</Text>
              <StarRatingWidget
                routeId={route.id}
                onRated={(score) => {
                  // Optimistically blend the new score into averageRating
                  setDisplayRating((prev) =>
                    parseFloat(((prev + score) / 2).toFixed(1))
                  )
                }}

          )}

          {/* Rating Summary */}
          {displayRating > 0 && (
            <YStack
              backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
              borderRadius="$4"
              padding="$4"
              gap="$3"
              borderWidth={1}
              borderColor="$borderColor"
            >
              <Text variant="heading4">Ratings</Text>
              <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
                <Text fontFamily="$heading" fontSize="$11" weight="bold" color="$color">
                  {displayRating.toFixed(1)}
                </Text>
                <YStack gap="$1">
                  <RatingDisplay value={displayRating} showValue={false} />

          {/* Fork Route */}

            backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"

            padding="$4"

            borderWidth={1}
            borderColor="$borderColor"

            <Button

              size="md"

      {/* Active Tour Mode Overlay */}
      {isTourMode && route.stops.length > 0 && (

          <XStack padding="$4" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" borderBottomWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong">

          <YStack flex={1} overflowY="auto" alignItems="center" padding="$6">

              {/* Progress Indicator */}

                </Text>
              </XStack>

              {/* Current Stop Card */}
              <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" overflow="hidden" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
                {currentStop?.photoUrl && (
                  <img
                    src={currentStop.photoUrl}
                    alt={currentStop.name}
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: 260, objectFit: 'cover' }}
                  />
                )}
                <YStack padding="$5" gap="$3">
                  <Text variant="heading2">{currentStop?.name}</Text>
                  {currentStop && hasTitleOverride(currentStop) && (
                    <Text variant="caption" muted>
                      Original spot: {getBaseSpotName(currentStop)}
                    </Text>
                  )}
                  {currentStop?.description && (
                    <Text variant="body" lineHeight="$7">{currentStop.description}</Text>
                  )}
                </YStack>
              </YStack>

              {/* Actions */}
              <YStack gap="$3" marginTop="$2">
                <Button
                  size="lg"
                  variant="solid"
                  icon={<Navigation size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />}
                  onPress={() => {
                    if (!currentStop) return
                    window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${currentStop.latitude},${currentStop.longitude}`, '_blank')
                  }}
                >
                  <Text color="#FFFFFF" weight="semibold">Navigate to Stop {currentStop?.order || currentStopIndex + 1} on Maps</Text>
                </Button>

                <Button
                  size="lg"
                  variant="outline"
                  icon={<CheckCircle size={18} />}
                  onPress={() => {
                    if (currentStopIndex < route.stops.length - 1) {
                      setCurrentStopIndex(currentStopIndex + 1)
                      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
                    } else {
                      alert('Congratulations! You completed the route!')
                      setIsTourMode(false)
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <Text weight="semibold">
                    {currentStopIndex < route.stops.length - 1 ? 'Mark Arrived & Continue to Next' : 'Finish Route Checklist!'}
                  </Text>
                </Button>
              </YStack>
            </YStack>
          </YStack>
        </YStack>
      )}
    </YStack>
  )
}

import { getRouteById, getRouteStops } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/features/account/actions'
import RouteEditClient from './route-edit-client'
import { notFound, redirect } from 'next/navigation'

export default async function RouteEditPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
}) {
  const { id } = await params

  const [routeResult, userResult, stopsResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getRouteById(id),
    getCurrentUser(),
    getRouteStops(id),
  ])

  if (routeResult.status === 'rejected') notFound()

  const route = routeResult.value
  const currentUser = userResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? userResult.value : null
  const initialStops = stopsResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? stopsResult.value : []

  // Only owner can edit
  if (!currentUser || route.authorUserId !== currentUser.id) {
    redirect(`/routes/${id}`)
  }

  return <RouteEditClient route={route} initialStops={initialStops} />
}
