'use client'

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Divider, Badge } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteDetail, RouteStopItem, SpotListItem } from '@/types/api'
import {
  updateRoute,
  publishRoute,
  unpublishRoute,
  deleteRoute,
  getRouteStops,
  addRouteStop,
  updateRouteStop,
  deleteRouteStop,
  reorderRouteStops,
} from '@/features/routes/actions'
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Globe,
  Lock,
  Trash2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Plus,
  ChevronUp,
  ChevronDown,
  Save,
  RotateCcw,
  MapPinned,
  Heart,
} from 'lucide-react'
import SpotSelect from '@/components/spot-select'
import { SavedSpotsPickerModal } from '@/features/spots/saved-spots-picker-modal'

type FeedbackState = { ok: boolean; message: string } | null

type NewStopForm = {
  spotId: string
  customTitle: string
  customDescription: string
}

function createEmptyStopForm(): NewStopForm {
  return {
    spotId: '',
    customTitle: '',
    customDescription: '',
  }
}

function uniqueSpotIds(items: string[]) {
  return Array.from(new Set(items.filter(Boolean)))
}

function reorderArray<T>(items: T[], fromIndex: number, toIndex: number) {
  const next = [...items]
  const [moved] = next.splice(fromIndex, 1)
  next.splice(toIndex, 0, moved)
  return next
}

export default function RouteEditClient({
  route,
  initialStops,
}: {
  route: RouteDetail
  initialStops: RouteStopItem[]
}) {
  const router = useRouter()

  const [title, setTitle] = useState(route.title)
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(route.description ?? '')
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isSaving, startSave] = useTransition()

  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(route.isPublic)
  const [isTogglingPublish, startToggle] = useTransition()

  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState(false)
  const [isDeleting, startDelete] = useTransition()

  const [stops, setStops] = useState<RouteStopItem[]>(initialStops)
  const [savedStops, setSavedStops] = useState<RouteStopItem[]>(initialStops)
  const [newStop, setNewStop] = useState<NewStopForm>(createEmptyStopForm())
  const [showSavedSpotPicker, setShowSavedSpotPicker] = useState(false)
  const [stopFeedback, setStopFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isManagingStops, startManageStops] = useTransition()

  const refreshStops = async (successMessage?: string) => {
    const nextStops = await getRouteStops(route.id)
    setStops(nextStops)
    setSavedStops(nextStops)
    if (successMessage) {
      setStopFeedback({ ok: true, message: successMessage })
    }
  }

  const handleSave = () => {
    setFeedback(null)
    if (!title.trim()) {
      setFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Title is required.' })
      return
    }
    startSave(async () => {
      try {
        await updateRoute(route.id, {
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description.trim() || undefined,
        })
        setFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Route updated successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleTogglePublish = () => {
    startToggle(async () => {
      try {
        if (isPublic) {
          await unpublishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(false)
        } else {
          await publishRoute(route.id)
          setIsPublic(true)
        }
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to change visibility.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDelete = () => {
    startDelete(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteRoute(route.id)
        router.replace('/profile')
      } catch (e) {
        setFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to delete route.' })
        setDeleteConfirm(false)
      }
    })
  }

  const handleStopFieldChange = (
    stopId: string,
    field: keyof Pick<RouteStopItem, 'customTitle' | 'customDescription'>,
    value: string,
  ) => {
    setStops((prev) => prev.map((stop) => (
      stop.id === stopId
        ? { ...stop, [field]: value }
        : stop
    )))
  }

  const handleResetStop = (stopId: string) => {
    const original = savedStops.find((stop) => stop.id === stopId)
    if (!original) return

    setStops((prev) => prev.map((stop) => (
      stop.id === stopId ? original : stop
    )))
  }

  const isStopDirty = (stop: RouteStopItem) => {
    const original = savedStops.find((item) => item.id === stop.id)
    if (!original) return false

    return (original.customTitle ?? '') !== (stop.customTitle ?? '')
      || (original.customDescription ?? '') !== (stop.customDescription ?? '')
  }

  const handleSaveStop = (stop: RouteStopItem) => {
    setStopFeedback(null)
    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await updateRouteStop(route.id, stop.id, {
          customTitle: (stop.customTitle ?? '').trim(),
          customDescription: (stop.customDescription ?? '').trim(),
        })
        await refreshStops('Stop updated successfully.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update stop.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleAddStop = () => {
    setStopFeedback(null)

    if (!newStop.spotId.trim()) {
      setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Please select a spot to add a new stop.' })
      return
    }

    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await addRouteStop(route.id, {
          spotId: newStop.spotId.trim(),
          customTitle: newStop.customTitle.trim() || undefined,
          customDescription: newStop.customDescription.trim() || undefined,
        })
        setNewStop(createEmptyStopForm())
        await refreshStops('Stop added successfully.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to add stop.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleAddFromSaved = (pickedSpots: SpotListItem[]) => {
    if (pickedSpots.length === 0) return

    setStopFeedback(null)
    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        for (const spot of pickedSpots) {
          await addRouteStop(route.id, {
            spotId: spot.id,
            customTitle: spot.name,
          })
        }
        await refreshStops(`${pickedSpots.length} stop${pickedSpots.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} added from saved spots.`)
      } catch (e) {
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to add saved spots.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDeleteStop = (stopId: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Remove this stop from the route?')) {
      return
    }

    setStopFeedback(null)
    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await deleteRouteStop(route.id, stopId)
        await refreshStops('Stop removed from route.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to remove stop.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handleMoveStop = (fromIndex: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    const toIndex = direction === 'up' ? fromIndex - 1 : fromIndex + 1
    if (toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= stops.length) {
      return
    }

    const nextStops = reorderArray(stops, fromIndex, toIndex)
    setStops(nextStops)
    setStopFeedback(null)

    startManageStops(async () => {
      try {
        await reorderRouteStops(route.id, nextStops.map((stop) => stop.id))
        await refreshStops('Stop order updated.')
      } catch (e) {
        setStops(savedStops)
        setStopFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to reorder stops.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const isDirty = title !== route.title || description !== (route.description ?? '')

  return (
    <YStack gap="$5" flex={1} maxWidth={860}>
      <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
        <XStack
          cursor="pointer"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          padding="$2"
          borderRadius="$full"
          hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: '$backgroundHover' }}
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={20} color="currentColor" />
        </XStack>
        <YStack flex={1}>
          <Text variant="heading2">Edit Route</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted numberOfLines={1}>{route.title}</Text>
        </YStack>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
        >
          View Route
        </Button>
      </XStack>

      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$4"
        padding="$5"
        gap="$4"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
      >
        <Text variant="heading4">Route Information</Text>

        <YStack gap="$1.5">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Title *</Text>
          <Input
            value={title}
            onChangeText={setTitle}
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            placeholder="Route title"
          />
        </YStack>

        <YStack gap="$1.5">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Description</Text>
          <Input
            value={description}
            onChangeText={setDescription}
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            placeholder="Describe your route..."

            multiline
            numberOfLines={4}
          />
        </YStack>

        {feedback && (
          <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
            {feedback.ok
              ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} color="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" />
              : <AlertCircle size={16} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />
            }
            <Text variant="caption" color={feedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>
              {feedback.message}
            </Text>
          </XStack>
        )}

        <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
          <Button
            variant="solid"
            size="md"
            loading={isSaving}
            disabled={isSaving || !isDirty || !title.trim()}
            onPress={handleSave}
          >
            Save Changes
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            disabled={isSaving}
            onPress={() => {
              setTitle(route.title)
              setDescription(route.description ?? '')
              setFeedback(null)
            }}
          >
            Discard
          </Button>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$4"
        padding="$5"
        gap="$4"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
      >
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
          <YStack gap="$1">
            <Text variant="heading4">Route Stops</Text>
            <Text variant="body" muted>
              Add new spots, override titles and descriptions, remove stops, or change the order.
            </Text>
          </YStack>
          <Badge variant="info" size="md">{stops.length} stops</Badge>
        </XStack>

        <YStack
          gap="$3"
          padding="$4"
          borderRadius="$4"
          backgroundColor="$muted"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor="$borderColor"
        >
          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
            <Plus size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
            <Text variant="heading4">Add Stop</Text>
          </XStack>

          <YStack gap="$3">
            <YStack gap="$1.5">
              <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Select Spot *</Text>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  icon={<Heart size={14} color="#EA580C" fill="#EA580C" />}
                  onPress={() => setShowSavedSpotPicker(true)}
                  disabled={isManagingStops}
                >
                  Add from Saved
                </Button>
              </XStack>
              {newStop.spotId ? (
                <XStack
                  backgroundColor="$primary50"
                  padding="$3"
                  borderRadius="$3"
                  borderWidth={1}
                  borderColor="$primary200"
                  justifyContent="space-between"
                  alignItems="center"
                  gap="$2"
                >
                  <YStack gap="$0.5" flex={1}>
                    <Text variant="label" color="$primary">Spot selected</Text>
                    <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={1}>
                      {newStop.customTitle || newStop.spotId}
                    </Text>
                  </YStack>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    onPress={() => setNewStop(createEmptyStopForm())}
                    disabled={isManagingStops}
                  >
                    Change
                  </Button>
                </XStack>
              ) : (
                <SpotSelect
                  onSelect={(spot) => {
                    setNewStop((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      spotId: spot.id,
                      customTitle: prev.customTitle.trim() ? prev.customTitle : spot.name,
                    }))
                    setStopFeedback(null)
                  }}
                  excludeIds={uniqueSpotIds(stops.map((s) => s.spotId))}
                />
              )}
            </YStack>

            <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
              <YStack flex={1} minWidth={240} gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Title</Text>
                <Input
                  value={newStop.customTitle}
                  onChangeText={(value) => setNewStop((prev) => ({ ...prev, customTitle: value }))}
                  variant="outline"
                  size="md"
                  placeholder="Optional name override"
                />
              </YStack>

              <YStack flex={1} minWidth={240} gap="$1.5">
                <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Description</Text>
                <Input
                  value={newStop.customDescription}
                  onChangeText={(value) => setNewStop((prev) => ({ ...prev, customDescription: value }))}
                  variant="outline"
                  size="md"
                  placeholder="Optional description override"

                  multiline
                  numberOfLines={3}
                />
              </YStack>
            </XStack>

            <XStack justifyContent="flex-end">
              <Button
                variant="solid"
                size="sm"
                loading={isManagingStops}
                disabled={isManagingStops}
                onPress={handleAddStop}
                icon={<Plus size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}
              >
                Add Stop
              </Button>
            </XStack>
          </YStack>
        </YStack>

        {stopFeedback && (
          <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
            {stopFeedback.ok
              ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} color="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" />
              : <AlertCircle size={16} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />
            }
            <Text variant="caption" color={stopFeedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>
              {stopFeedback.message}
            </Text>
          </XStack>
        )}

        {stops.length === 0 ? (
          <YStack
            padding="$6"
            borderRadius="$4"
            borderWidth={1}
            borderStyle="dashed"
            borderColor="$borderColor"
            alignItems="center"
            gap="$2"
          >
            <MapPinned size={28} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
            <Text variant="heading4">No stops yet</Text>
            <Text variant="body" muted align="center">
              Add at least one spot to turn this route into a real itinerary.
            </Text>
          </YStack>
        ) : (
          <YStack gap="$4">
            {stops.map((stop, index) => {
              const displayName = (stop.customTitle ?? '').trim() || stop.name
              const displayDescription = (stop.customDescription ?? '').trim() || stop.description
              const dirty = isStopDirty(stop)

              return (
                <XStack key={stop.id} gap="$3" alignItems="flex-start">
                  <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1" paddingTop="$2">
                    <XStack
                      width={34}
                      height={34}
                      borderRadius="$full"
                      backgroundColor="$primary"
                      alignItems="center"
                      justifyContent="center"
                    >
                      <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">{index + 1}</Text>
                    </XStack>
                    {index < stops.length - 1 && (
                      <YStack width={2} minHeight={64} backgroundColor="$borderColor" />
                    )}
                  </YStack>

                  <YStack
                    flex={1}
                    gap="$4"
                    padding="$4"
                    borderRadius="$4"
                    backgroundColor="$background"
                    borderWidth={1}
                    borderColor="$borderColor"
                  >
                    <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
                      <YStack gap="$1" flex={1} minWidth={220}>
                        <Text variant="heading4">{displayName}</Text>
                        <Text variant="caption" muted>
                          Spot ID: {stop.spotId}
                        </Text>
                      </YStack>

                      <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={index === 0 || isManagingStops}
                          onPress={() => handleMoveStop(index, 'up')}
                          icon={<ChevronUp size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                        >
                          Up
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={index === stops.length - 1 || isManagingStops}
                          onPress={() => handleMoveStop(index, 'down')}
                          icon={<ChevronDown size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                        >
                          Down
                        </Button>
                      </XStack>
                    </XStack>

                    <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
                      <YStack flex={1} minWidth={240} gap="$1.5">
                        <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Title</Text>
                        <Input
                          value={stop.customTitle ?? ''}
                          onChangeText={(value) => handleStopFieldChange(stop.id, 'customTitle', value)}
                          variant="outline"
                          size="md"
                          placeholder={stop.name}
                        />
                      </YStack>

                      <YStack flex={1} minWidth={240} gap="$1.5">
                        <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Description</Text>
                        <Input
                          value={stop.customDescription ?? ''}
                          onChangeText={(value) => handleStopFieldChange(stop.id, 'customDescription', value)}
                          variant="outline"
                          size="md"
                          placeholder={stop.description ?? 'Optional description override'}

                          multiline
                          numberOfLines={3}
                        />
                      </YStack>
                    </XStack>

                    <YStack gap="$2">
                      <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Current preview</Text>
                      <YStack
                        gap="$2"
                        padding="$3"
                        borderRadius="$3"
                        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                        borderWidth={1}
                        borderColor="$borderColor"
                      >
                        <Text variant="label">{displayName}</Text>
                        {displayDescription ? (
                          <Text variant="caption" muted>{displayDescription}</Text>
                        ) : (
                          <Text variant="caption" muted>No description</Text>
                        )}
                        <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                          <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lat {stop.latitude.toFixed(4)}</Badge>
                          <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lng {stop.longitude.toFixed(4)}</Badge>
                          {dirty && <Badge variant="warning" size="sm">Unsaved changes</Badge>}
                        </XStack>
                      </YStack>
                    </YStack>

                    <Divider />

                    <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
                      <Text variant="caption" muted>
                        Base spot: {stop.name}
                      </Text>

                      <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={!dirty || isManagingStops}
                          onPress={() => handleResetStop(stop.id)}
                          icon={<RotateCcw size={14} color="currentColor" />}
                        >
                          Reset
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="solid"
                          size="sm"
                          loading={isManagingStops}
                          disabled={!dirty || isManagingStops}
                          onPress={() => handleSaveStop(stop)}
                          icon={<Save size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />}
                        >
                          Save Stop
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          disabled={isManagingStops}
                          onPress={() => handleDeleteStop(stop.id)}
                          icon={<Trash2 size={14} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />}
                        >
                          <Text variant="label" color="$error500">Delete</Text>
                        </Button>
                      </XStack>
                    </XStack>
                  </YStack>
                </XStack>
              )
            })}
          </YStack>
        )}
      </YStack>

      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$4"
        padding="$5"
        gap="$4"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
      >
        <Text variant="heading4">Visibility</Text>
        <XStack
          backgroundColor={isPublic ? '$success50' : '$muted'}
          borderRadius="$3"
          padding="$4"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor={isPublic ? '$success200' : '$borderColor'}
          gap="$3"
          alignItems="center"
        >
          {isPublic
            ? <Globe size={20} color="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" />
            : <Lock size={20} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
          }
          <YStack flex={1} gap="$0.5">
            <Text variant="label" weight="semibold">
              {isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}
            </Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>
              {isPublic
                ? 'This route is visible to everyone on the platform.'
                : 'Only you can see this route.'
              }
            </Text>
          </YStack>
          <Button
            variant={isPublic ? 'outline' : 'solid'}
            size="sm"
            loading={isTogglingPublish}
            disabled={isTogglingPublish}
            onPress={handleTogglePublish}
          >
            {isPublic ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
          </Button>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      <YStack
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderRadius="$4"
        padding="$5"
        gap="$4"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$error200"
      >
        <Text variant="heading4" color="$error500">Danger Zone</Text>
        <Divider />
        <XStack gap="$4" alignItems="center" flexWrap="wrap">
          <YStack flex={1} gap="$0.5">
            <Text variant="label">Delete Route</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>
              Permanently delete this route. This action cannot be undone.
            </Text>
          </YStack>
          {!deleteConfirm ? (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onPress={() => setDeleteConfirm(true)}
              icon={<Trash2 size={14} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />}
            >
              <Text variant="label" color="$error500">Delete</Text>
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <XStack gap="$2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onPress={() => setDeleteConfirm(false)}
                disabled={isDeleting}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                loading={isDeleting}
                disabled={isDeleting}
                onPress={handleDelete}
                backgroundColor="$error500"
                hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: '$error400' }}
              >
                <Text variant="label" color="#FFFFFF">Confirm Delete</Text>
              </Button>
            </XStack>
          )}
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      <SavedSpotsPickerModal
        isOpen={showSavedSpotPicker}
        onClose={() => setShowSavedSpotPicker(false)}
        onAddSelected={handleAddFromSaved}
        excludeIds={uniqueSpotIds(stops.map((s) => s.spotId))}
      />
    </YStack>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input } from '@antapp/ui'
import { createRoute } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import { ArrowLeft, Plus, Trash2, MapPin, Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import SpotSelect from '@/components/spot-select'
import { SavedSpotsPickerModal } from '@/features/spots/saved-spots-picker-modal'

type StopEntry = {
  id: string
  spotId: string
  customTitle: string
  customDescription: string
}

function generateTempId() {
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)
}

export default function CreateRoutePage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [stops, setStops] = useState<StopEntry[]>([
    { id: generateTempId(), spotId: '', customTitle: '', customDescription: '' },
    { id: generateTempId(), spotId: '', customTitle: '', customDescription: '' },
  ])
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [showPicker, setShowPicker] = useState(false)

  const handleAddFromSaved = (spots: import('@/types/api').SpotListItem[]) => {
    if (spots.length === 0) return
    const newStops: StopEntry[] = spots.map((spot) => ({
      id: generateTempId(),
      spotId: spot.id,
      customTitle: spot.name,
      customDescription: '',
    }))
    setStops((prev) => {
      // Replace any empty trailing rows, then append the rest
      const nonEmpty = prev.filter((s) => s.spotId.trim())
      const tail = prev.filter((s) => !s.spotId.trim())
      const toAdd = newStops
      // Keep at least 2 rows after adding
      const merged = [...nonEmpty, ...toAdd, ...tail]
      return merged.length >= 2 ? merged : [...merged, { id: generateTempId(), spotId: '', customTitle: '', customDescription: '' }]
    })
  }

  const addStop = () => {
    setStops((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id: generateTempId(), spotId: '', customTitle: '', customDescription: '' },
    ])
  }

  const removeStop = (id: string) => {
    setStops((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== id))
  }

  const updateStop = (id: string, field: keyof Omit<StopEntry, 'id'>, value: string) => {
    setStops((prev) => prev.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, [field]: value } : s)))
  }

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setError(null)

    if (!title.trim()) {
      setError('Route title is required.')
      return
    }

    const validStops = stops.filter((s) => s.spotId.trim())
    if (validStops.length < 2) {
      setError('A route must have at least 2 spots with valid Spot IDs.')
      return
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const routeId = await createRoute({
          title: title.trim(),
          description: description.trim() || undefined,
          spots: validStops.map((s) => ({
            spotId: s.spotId.trim(),
            customTitle: s.customTitle.trim() || undefined,
            customDescription: s.customDescription.trim() || undefined,
          })),
        })
        router.push(`/routes/${routeId}`)
      } catch (e) {
        setError((e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to create route.')
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$5" flex={1} maxWidth={720}>
      {/* Header */}
      <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
        <XStack
          cursor="pointer"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          padding="$2"
          borderRadius="$full"
          hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: '$backgroundHover' }}
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={20} color="currentColor" />
        </XStack>
        <YStack flex={1}>
          <Text variant="heading2">Create Route</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Build your adventure</Text>
        </YStack>
      </XStack>

      {/* Route Info */}
      <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
        <Text variant="heading4">Route Information</Text>

        <YStack gap="$1.5">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Title *</Text>
          <Input
            value={title}
            onChangeText={setTitle}
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            placeholder="e.g. Classic Kaleici History Tour"
          />
        </YStack>

        <YStack gap="$1.5">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Description</Text>
          <Input
            value={description}
            onChangeText={setDescription}
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            placeholder="Describe your route..."
            // @ts-ignore — multiline works on web
            multiline
            numberOfLines={3}
          />
        </YStack>
      </YStack>

      {/* Route Stops */}
      <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
          <YStack>
            <Text variant="heading4">Route Stops</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>Search spots or pick from your saved favorites</Text>
          </YStack>
          <XStack gap="$2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              icon={<Heart size={14} color="#EA580C" fill="#EA580C" />}
              onPress={() => setShowPicker(true)}
            >
              Saved
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" icon={<Plus size={14} color="currentColor" />} onPress={addStop}>
              Add Stop
            </Button>
          </XStack>
        </XStack>

        <YStack gap="$4">
          {stops.map((stop, idx) => (
            <XStack key={stop.id} gap="$3" alignItems="flex-start">
              {/* Step number */}
              <YStack alignItems="center" gap="$1" paddingTop="$3">
                <XStack
                  width={32}
                  height={32}
                  borderRadius="$full"
                  backgroundColor={stop.spotId ? '$primary' : '$muted'}
                  alignItems="center"
                  justifyContent="center"
                >
                  <Text variant="label" color={stop.spotId ? '#FFFFFF' : '$mutedForeground'} fontSize="$3">
                    {idx + 1}
                  </Text>
                </XStack>
                {idx < stops.length - 1 && (
                  <YStack width={2} height={20} backgroundColor="$borderColor" />
                )}
              </YStack>

              {/* Stop fields */}
              <YStack flex={1} gap="$2">
                <YStack gap="$1">
                  <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Select Spot *</Text>
                  {stop.spotId ? (
                    <XStack
                      backgroundColor="$primary50"
                      padding="$2"
                      borderRadius="$2"
                      alignItems="center"
                      justifyContent="space-between"
                      borderWidth={1}
                      borderColor="$primary200"
                    >
                      <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
                        <MapPin size={14} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                        <Text variant="label" weight="semibold">{stop.customTitle || 'Selected Spot'}</Text>
                      </XStack>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onPress={() => updateStop(stop.id, 'spotId', '')}>Change</Button>
                    </XStack>
                  ) : (
                    <SpotSelect
                      onSelect={(spot) => {
                        updateStop(stop.id, 'spotId', spot.id)
                        updateStop(stop.id, 'customTitle', spot.name)
                      }}
                      excludeIds={stops.map(s => s.spotId).filter(Boolean)}
                    />
                  )}
                </YStack>
                <XStack gap="$2">
                  <YStack flex={1} gap="$1">
                    <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">Custom Title (optional)</Text>
                    <Input
                      value={stop.customTitle}
                      onChangeText={(v) => updateStop(stop.id, 'customTitle', v)}
                      variant="outline"
                      size="md"
                      placeholder="Override spot name..."
                    />
                  </YStack>
                </XStack>
              </YStack>

              {/* Remove */}
              {stops.length > 2 && (
                <XStack
                  paddingTop="$3"
                  cursor="pointer"
                  onPress={() => removeStop(stop.id)}
                  hoverStyle={{ opacity: 0.7 }}
                  padding="$2"
                >
                  <Trash2 size={16} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />
                </XStack>
              )}
            </XStack>
          ))}
        </YStack>
      </YStack>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <YStack
          backgroundColor="$error50"
          borderRadius="$3"
          padding="$3"
          borderWidth={1}
          borderColor="$error200"
        >
          <Text variant="caption" color="$error500">{error}</Text>
        </YStack>
      )}

      {/* Footer Actions */}
      <XStack gap="$3">
        <Button variant="outline" size="md" onPress={() => router.back()}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="solid"
          size="md"
          loading={isPending}
          disabled={isPending || !title.trim()}
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          flex={1}
        >
          Create Route
        </Button>
      </XStack>

      {/* Saved Spots Picker Modal */}
      <SavedSpotsPickerModal
        isOpen={showPicker}
        onClose={() => setShowPicker(false)}
        onAddSelected={handleAddFromSaved}
        excludeIds={stops.map((s) => s.spotId).filter(Boolean)}
      />
    </YStack>
  )
}

﻿'use client'

import { useState, useTransition, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, RouteCard, SearchInput, Divider } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteCardData } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteListItem, Tag, RouteContentType, RouteDetail } from '@/types/api'
import { getRoutes, getTags, getRouteById } from '@/features/routes/actions'
import { Map } from 'lucide-react'
import { loadMapLibre } from '@/lib/maplibre'

const ROUTE_TYPES: { label: string; value: RouteContentType | '' }[] = [
  { label: 'All Types', value: '' },
  { label: 'Official', value: 'Official' },
  { label: 'Community', value: 'Community' },
]

const DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER: [number, number] = [30.7133, 36.8969]
const DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM = 10

const PREVIEW_LINE_SOURCE = 'search-preview-line-source'
const PREVIEW_STOPS_SOURCE = 'search-preview-stops-source'
const PREVIEW_LINE_LAYER = 'search-preview-line-layer'
const PREVIEW_STOPS_LAYER = 'search-preview-stops-layer'

type PreviewMapSource = {
  setData: (data: unknown) => void
}

type PreviewMap = {
  addControl: (control: unknown, position?: string) => void
  on: (event: string, cb: () => void) => void
  once: (event: string, cb: () => void) => void
  remove: () => void
  isStyleLoaded: () => boolean
  getSource: (id: string) => PreviewMapSource | undefined
  addSource: (id: string, source: unknown) => void
  getLayer: (id: string) => unknown
  addLayer: (layer: unknown) => void
  setCenter: (center: [number, number]) => void
  setZoom: (zoom: number) => void
  fitBounds: (bounds: [[number, number], [number, number]], options?: { padding?: number; maxZoom?: number }) => void
}

function routeToCardData(route: RouteListItem): RouteCardData {
  return {
    id: route.id,
    title: route.title,
    description: route.description ?? undefined,
    image: route.thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    rating: route.averageRating > 0 ? route.averageRating : undefined,
    contentType: route.contentType,
    isOfficial: route.contentType === 'Official',
  }
}

function decodePolyline(encoded: string): Array<[number, number]> {
  const points: Array<[number, number]> = []
  let index = 0
  let lat = 0
  let lng = 0

  while (index < encoded.length) {
    let result = 0
    let shift = 0
    let byte = 0
    do {
      byte = encoded.charCodeAt(index++) - 63
      result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift
      shift += 5
    } while (byte >= 0x20)
    const deltaLat = (result & 1) !== 0 ? ~(result >> 1) : result >> 1
    lat += deltaLat

    result = 0
    shift = 0
    do {
      byte = encoded.charCodeAt(index++) - 63
      result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift
      shift += 5
    } while (byte >= 0x20)
    const deltaLng = (result & 1) !== 0 ? ~(result >> 1) : result >> 1
    lng += deltaLng

    points.push([lng / 1e5, lat / 1e5])
  }

  return points
}

export default function SearchPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [activeTagId, setActiveTagId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [routeType, setRouteType] = useState<RouteContentType | ''>('')
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<Tag[]>([])
  const [results, setResults] = useState<RouteListItem[]>([])
  const [totalResults, setTotalResults] = useState(0)
  const [previewRouteId, setPreviewRouteId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [previewRouteDetails, setPreviewRouteDetails] = useState<Record<string, RouteDetail>>({})
  const [previewLoadingId, setPreviewLoadingId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [previewMapError, setPreviewMapError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const previewMapContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const previewMapRef = useRef<PreviewMap | null>(null)
  const resultsRequestIdRef = useRef(0)
  const hoverIntentTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    getTags(100).then(setTags).catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  const fetchResults = useCallback((filters: {
    search: string
    activeTagId: string | null
    routeType: RouteContentType | ''
  }) => {
    const requestId = ++resultsRequestIdRef.current

    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await getRoutes({
          search: filters.search || undefined,
          tagIds: filters.activeTagId ? [filters.activeTagId] : undefined,
          type: filters.routeType ? filters.routeType.toLowerCase() as 'official' | 'community' | 'sponsored' : undefined,
          pageSize: 20,
        })

        if (requestId !== resultsRequestIdRef.current) return

        setResults(res.data)
        setTotalResults(res.totalRecords)
      } catch {
        if (requestId !== resultsRequestIdRef.current) return
        setResults([])
        setTotalResults(0)
      }
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchResults({ search: search.trim(), activeTagId, routeType })
    }, 250)

    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [activeTagId, fetchResults, routeType, search])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (results.length === 0) {
      setPreviewRouteId(null)
      return
    }
    if (previewRouteId && !results.some((route) => route.id === previewRouteId)) {
      setPreviewRouteId(null)
    }
  }, [results, previewRouteId])

  const ensurePreviewDetail = useCallback(async (routeId: string) => {
    if (!routeId || previewRouteDetails[routeId] || previewLoadingId === routeId) return
    setPreviewLoadingId(routeId)
    try {
      const detail = await getRouteById(routeId)
      setPreviewRouteDetails((prev) => ({ ...prev, [routeId]: detail }))
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setPreviewLoadingId((current) => (current === routeId ? null : current))
    }
  }, [previewRouteDetails, previewLoadingId])

  const previewRoute = useMemo(
    () => (previewRouteId ? results.find((route) => route.id === previewRouteId) ?? null : null),
    [previewRouteId, results],
  )

  const previewRouteDetail = previewRoute ? previewRouteDetails[previewRoute.id] : null

  useEffect(() => {
    if (previewRoute) {
      void ensurePreviewDetail(previewRoute.id)
    }
  }, [previewRoute, ensurePreviewDetail])

  const tryInitPreviewMap = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!previewMapContainerRef.current || previewMapRef.current) return

    try {
      const maplibre = await loadMapLibre()
      if (!previewMapContainerRef.current || previewMapRef.current) return

      const map = new maplibre.Map({
        container: previewMapContainerRef.current,
        style: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty',
        center: DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER,
        zoom: DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM,
      }) as unknown as PreviewMap

      map.addControl(new maplibre.NavigationControl(), 'top-right')

      map.on('load', () => {
        if (!map.getSource(PREVIEW_LINE_SOURCE)) {
          map.addSource(PREVIEW_LINE_SOURCE, {
            type: 'geojson',
            data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] },
          })
        }

        if (!map.getLayer(PREVIEW_LINE_LAYER)) {
          map.addLayer({
            id: PREVIEW_LINE_LAYER,
            type: 'line',
            source: PREVIEW_LINE_SOURCE,
            layout: { 'line-cap': 'round', 'line-join': 'round' },
            paint: { 'line-color': '#FF8C00', 'line-width': 3.5 },
          })
        }

        if (!map.getSource(PREVIEW_STOPS_SOURCE)) {
          map.addSource(PREVIEW_STOPS_SOURCE, {
            type: 'geojson',
            data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] },
          })
        }

        if (!map.getLayer(PREVIEW_STOPS_LAYER)) {
          map.addLayer({
            id: PREVIEW_STOPS_LAYER,
            type: 'circle',
            source: PREVIEW_STOPS_SOURCE,
            paint: {
              'circle-radius': 5.5,
              'circle-color': '#FF8C00',
              'circle-stroke-color': '#FFFFFF',
              'circle-stroke-width': 1.5,
            },
          })
        }
      })

      previewMapRef.current = map
      setPreviewMapError(null)
    } catch {
      setPreviewMapError('Map preview could not be loaded.')
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!previewRouteId) return
    void tryInitPreviewMap()
  }, [previewRouteId, tryInitPreviewMap])

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (hoverIntentTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(hoverIntentTimeoutRef.current)
      }
      if (previewMapRef.current) {
        previewMapRef.current.remove()
      }
      previewMapRef.current = null
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const map = previewMapRef.current
    if (!map) return

    const applyPreview = () => {
      const lineSource = map.getSource(PREVIEW_LINE_SOURCE)
      const stopsSource = map.getSource(PREVIEW_STOPS_SOURCE)
      if (!lineSource || !stopsSource) return

      if (!previewRoute) {
        lineSource.setData({
          type: 'FeatureCollection',
          features: [],
        })
        stopsSource.setData({
          type: 'FeatureCollection',
          features: [],
        })
        map.setCenter(DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER)
        map.setZoom(DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM)
        return
      }

      const stopCoordinates = (previewRouteDetail?.stops ?? [])
        .filter((stop) => Number.isFinite(stop.latitude) && Number.isFinite(stop.longitude))
        .map((stop) => [stop.longitude, stop.latitude] as [number, number])

      const polylineCoordinates = previewRouteDetail?.encodedPolyline
        ? decodePolyline(previewRouteDetail.encodedPolyline)
        : []

      const routeCoordinates = polylineCoordinates.length > 1 ? polylineCoordinates : stopCoordinates

      lineSource.setData({
        type: 'FeatureCollection',
        features: routeCoordinates.length > 1
          ? [{
              type: 'Feature',
              geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: routeCoordinates },
              properties: {},
            }]
          : [],
      })

      stopsSource.setData({
        type: 'FeatureCollection',
        features: stopCoordinates.map((coordinates, index) => ({
          type: 'Feature',
          geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates },
          properties: { order: index + 1 },
        })),
      })

      const fitCoordinates = routeCoordinates.length > 0 ? routeCoordinates : stopCoordinates

      if (fitCoordinates.length === 0) {
        if (
          previewRouteDetail
          && Number.isFinite(previewRouteDetail.centerLatitude)
          && Number.isFinite(previewRouteDetail.centerLongitude)
        ) {
          map.setCenter([previewRouteDetail.centerLongitude, previewRouteDetail.centerLatitude])
          map.setZoom(11)
        } else {
          map.setCenter(DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER)
          map.setZoom(DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM)
        }
        return
      }

      let minLon = fitCoordinates[0][0]
      let minLat = fitCoordinates[0][1]
      let maxLon = fitCoordinates[0][0]
      let maxLat = fitCoordinates[0][1]

      for (const [lon, lat] of fitCoordinates) {
        if (lon < minLon) minLon = lon
        if (lat < minLat) minLat = lat
        if (lon > maxLon) maxLon = lon
        if (lat > maxLat) maxLat = lat
      }

      if (minLon === maxLon && minLat === maxLat) {
        map.setCenter([minLon, minLat])
        map.setZoom(13)
      } else {
        map.fitBounds(
          [
            [minLon, minLat],
            [maxLon, maxLat],
          ],
          { padding: 26, maxZoom: 13 },
        )
      }
    }

    if (!map.isStyleLoaded()) {
      map.once('load', applyPreview)
      return
    }
    applyPreview()
  }, [previewRoute, previewRouteDetail])

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: '280px minmax(0, 1fr) 320px',
        gap: '20px',
        alignItems: 'stretch',
      }}
    >
      <YStack gap="$5" $md={{ display: 'none' }} style={{ alignSelf: 'start' }}>
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center">
          <Text variant="heading3">Filters</Text>
          <Text
            variant="caption"
            color="$primary"
            cursor="pointer"
            weight="semibold"
            onPress={() => {
              setActiveTagId(null)
              setRouteType('')
              setSearch('')
            }}
          >
            RESET ALL
          </Text>
        </XStack>

        <YStack gap="$2">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Search</Text>
          <SearchInput
            value={search}
            onChangeText={setSearch}
            placeholder="Search routes..."
          />
        </YStack>

        <Divider />

        {tags.length > 0 && (
          <YStack gap="$2">
            <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Tags</Text>

              </YStack>
            )}
          </YStack>
          </YStack>
        </div>
      </YStack>
    </div>
  )

'use client'

import { useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Input, Avatar, Divider } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { CurrentUser } from '@/types/api'
import { updateProfile, changePassword } from '@/features/account/actions'
import { User, Lock, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react'

type FeedbackState = { ok: boolean; message: string } | null

export default function SettingsClient({ user }: { user: CurrentUser | null }) {
  // Profile form
  const [userName, setUserName] = useState(user?.userName ?? '')
  const [profileFeedback, setProfileFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isUpdatingProfile, startProfileUpdate] = useTransition()

  // Password form
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState('')
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [passwordFeedback, setPasswordFeedback] = useState<FeedbackState>(null)
  const [isChangingPw, startPwChange] = useTransition()

  const handleProfileSave = () => {
    setProfileFeedback(null)
    startProfileUpdate(async () => {
      try {
        await updateProfile({ userName })
        setProfileFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Profile updated successfully.' })
      } catch (e) {
        setProfileFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to update profile.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const handlePasswordChange = () => {
    setPasswordFeedback(null)
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setPasswordFeedback({ ok: false, message: 'Passwords do not match.' })
      return
    }
    startPwChange(async () => {
      try {
        await changePassword({ currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword })
        setPasswordFeedback({ ok: true, message: 'Password changed successfully.' })
        setCurrentPassword('')
        setNewPassword('')
        setConfirmPassword('')
      } catch (e) {
        setPasswordFeedback({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message ?? 'Failed to change password.' })
      }
    })
  }

  const initials = user?.userName?.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() ?? 'U'

  return (
    <YStack gap="$6" flex={1} maxWidth={680}>
      <YStack gap="$1">
        <Text variant="heading2">Settings</Text>
        <Text variant="body" muted>Manage your account and preferences</Text>
      </YStack>

      {/* Profile Section */}
      <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
        <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
          <User size={20} color="var(--color-primary)" />
          <Text variant="heading4">Profile Information</Text>
        </XStack>

        <Divider />

        <XStack gap="$4" alignItems="center">
          <Avatar size="lg" initials={initials} />
          <YStack gap="$0.5">
            <Text variant="body" weight="semibold">{user?.userName ?? '—'}</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted>{user?.email ?? '—'}</Text>
            {user && !user.isVerified && (
              <XStack
                backgroundColor="$warning50"
                paddingHorizontal="$2"
                paddingVertical="$0.5"
                borderRadius="$2"
                alignSelf="flex-start"
              >
                <Text variant="caption" color="$warning500">Email not verified</Text>
              </XStack>
            )}
          </YStack>
        </XStack>

        <YStack gap="$1.5">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Username</Text>
          <Input
            value={userName}
            onChangeText={setUserName}
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            placeholder="Your username"
            autoCapitalize="none"
          />
        </YStack>

        {profileFeedback && (
          <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
            {profileFeedback.ok
              ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} color="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" />
              : <AlertCircle size={16} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />
            }
            <Text variant="caption" color={profileFeedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>
              {profileFeedback.message}
            </Text>
          </XStack>
        )}

        <Button
          variant="solid"
          size="md"
          alignSelf="flex-start"
          loading={isUpdatingProfile}
          disabled={isUpdatingProfile || !userName.trim() || userName === user?.userName}
          onPress={handleProfileSave}
        >
          Save Changes
        </Button>
      </YStack>

      {/* Password Section */}
      <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" padding="$5" gap="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
        <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
          <Lock size={20} color="var(--color-primary)" />
          <Text variant="heading4">Change Password</Text>
        </XStack>

        <Divider />

        <YStack gap="$3">
          <YStack gap="$1.5">
            <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Current Password</Text>
            <Input
              value={currentPassword}
              onChangeText={setCurrentPassword}
              secureTextEntry
              variant="outline"
              size="md"
              placeholder="••••••••"
            />
          </YStack>

          <YStack gap="$1.5">
            <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">New Password</Text>
            <Input
              value={newPassword}
              onChangeText={setNewPassword}
              secureTextEntry
              variant="outline"
              size="md"
              placeholder="••••••••"
            />
          </YStack>

          <YStack gap="$1.5">
            <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Confirm New Password</Text>
            <Input
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChangeText={setConfirmPassword}
              secureTextEntry
              variant="outline"
              size="md"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              error={!!confirmPassword && confirmPassword !== newPassword}
            />
          </YStack>
        </YStack>

        {passwordFeedback && (
          <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
            {passwordFeedback.ok
              ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} color="var(--color-success500, #22C55E)" />
              : <AlertCircle size={16} color="var(--color-error500, #DC2626)" />
            }
            <Text variant="caption" color={passwordFeedback.ok ? '$success500' : '$error500'}>
              {passwordFeedback.message}
            </Text>
          </XStack>
        )}

        <Button
          variant="solid"
          size="md"
          alignSelf="flex-start"
          loading={isChangingPw}
          disabled={isChangingPw || !currentPassword || !newPassword || newPassword !== confirmPassword}
          onPress={handlePasswordChange}
        >
          Change Password
        </Button>
      </YStack>

      {/* Account Info */}
      {user && (
        <YStack backgroundColor="$muted" borderRadius="$4" padding="$4" gap="$2">
          <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Account Details</Text>
          <XStack gap="$4" flexWrap="wrap">
            <YStack gap="$0.5">
              <Text variant="caption" muted>Roles</Text>
              <Text variant="body">{user.roles.join(', ')}</Text>
            </YStack>
            <YStack gap="$0.5">
              <Text variant="caption" muted>Email Status</Text>
              <Text variant="body" color={user.isVerified ? '$success500' : '$warning500'}>
                {user.isVerified ? 'Verified' : 'Not Verified'}
              </Text>
            </YStack>
          </XStack>
        </YStack>
      )}
    </YStack>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, SearchInput, Button, Badge, Image } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { SpotListItem } from '@/types/api'
import { Compass, MapPinned, Search, Star, Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import { getSpots, toggleSpotFavorite, getSavedSpots } from '@/features/spots/actions'
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/empty-state'

function SpotCard({
  spot,
  onPress,
  isSaved,
  onToggleSave
}: {
  spot: SpotListItem
  onPress: () => void
  isSaved: boolean
  onToggleSave: (e: any) => void
}) {
  return (
    <YStack
      backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
      borderRadius="$4"
      borderWidth={1}
      borderColor="$borderColor"
      overflow="hidden"
      cursor="pointer"
      onPress={onPress}
      hoverStyle={{ borderColor: '$primary', opacity: 0.96 }}
      pressStyle={{ scale: 0.985 }}
    >
      <YStack height={200} backgroundColor="$muted" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" position="relative">
        <YStack
          position="absolute"
          top={12}
          right={12}
          zIndex={10}
          backgroundColor={isSaved ? '#ff4757' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'}
          borderRadius="$round"
          padding="$2"
          cursor="pointer"
          onPress={onToggleSave}
          hoverStyle={{ scale: 1.1 }}
        >
          <Heart size={20} color={isSaved ? 'white' : '#2f3542'} fill={isSaved ? "white" : "transparent"} />
        </YStack>

        {spot.photoUrl ? (
          <Image src={spot.photoUrl} alt={spot.name} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', display: 'block' }} />
        ) : (
          <MapPinned size={36} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
        )}
      </YStack>

      <YStack padding="$4" gap="$3" flex={1}>
        <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$2">
          <YStack gap="$1" flex={1}>
            <Text variant="heading4">{spot.name}</Text>
            <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={2}>
              {spot.description ?? 'No description yet.'}
            </Text>
          </YStack>
          {spot.averageRating > 0 && (
            <Badge variant="info" size="sm">{spot.averageRating.toFixed(1)}</Badge>
          )}
        </XStack>

        <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
          <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lat {spot.latitude.toFixed(3)}</Badge>
          <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lng {spot.longitude.toFixed(3)}</Badge>
          {spot.averageRating > 0 && <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Rated</Badge>}
        </XStack>

        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onPress={onPress}>
          View Spot
        </Button>
      </YStack>
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function SpotsClient({
  initialSpots,
  initialTotal,
}: {
  initialSpots: SpotListItem[]
  initialTotal: number
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [spots, setSpots] = useState(initialSpots)
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(initialTotal)
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'all' | 'saved'>('all')
  const [savedSpotIds, setSavedSpotIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const fetchSpots = useCallback((search: string, mode: 'all' | 'saved') => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        if (mode === 'saved') {
          const result = await getSavedSpots()
          setSpots(result)
          setTotal(result.length)
        } else {
          const result = await getSpots({
            search: search.trim() || undefined,
            page: 1,
            pageSize: 24,
          })
          setSpots(result.data)
          setTotal(result.totalRecords)
        }
      } catch {
        setSpots([])
        setTotal(0)
      }
    })
  }, [])

  const fetchSavedSpotIds = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const saved = await getSavedSpots()
      setSavedSpotIds(new Set(saved.map((s) => s.id)))
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSavedSpotIds()
  }, [fetchSavedSpotIds])

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
      fetchSpots(query, viewMode)
    }, 250)

    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeout)
  }, [fetchSpots, query, viewMode])

  const handleToggleSave = async (e: any, spotId: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    try {
      const isNowSaved = await toggleSpotFavorite(spotId)

      setSavedSpotIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev)
        if (isNowSaved) {
          next.add(spotId)
        } else {
          next.delete(spotId)

          // If we are in saved mode, remove the card immediately
          if (viewMode === 'saved') {
            setSpots((current) => {
              const refreshed = current.filter(s => s.id !== spotId)
              setTotal(refreshed.length)
              return refreshed
            })
          }
        }
        return next
      })
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$5" flex={1}>
      <YStack
        borderRadius="$4"
        backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
        borderWidth={1}
        borderColor="$borderColor"
        padding="$5"
        gap="$4"
      >
        <YStack gap="$2" maxWidth={760}>
          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
            <Compass size={18} color="var(--color-primary)" />
            <Text variant="caption" color="$primary">SPOTS DIRECTORY</Text>
          </XStack>
          <Text variant="heading2">Discover destinations before you build a route</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>
            Browse places added to the platform, inspect their ratings, and jump into the routes that already include them.
          </Text>
        </YStack>

        <XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap" alignItems="center">
          <YStack flex={1} minWidth={280}>
            <SearchInput
              value={query}
              onChangeText={setQuery}
              placeholder="Search spots by name or description..."
              icon={<Search size={18} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />}
              disabled={viewMode === 'saved'}
            />
          </YStack>

          <XStack gap="$2" backgroundColor="$muted" borderRadius="$4" padding="$1">
            <Button
              variant={viewMode === 'all' ? 'solid' : 'ghost'}
              size="sm"
              onPress={() => setViewMode('all')}
            >
              All Spots
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={viewMode === 'saved' ? 'solid' : 'ghost'}
              size="sm"
              onPress={() => setViewMode('saved')}
            >
              Saved Spots
            </Button>
          </XStack>

          <Badge variant="info" size="md">{isPending ? 'Loading...' : `${total} spots`}</Badge>
        </XStack>
      </YStack>

      {spots.length === 0 && !isPending ? (
        <YStack backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" borderRadius="$4" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
          <EmptyState
            Icon={MapPinned}
            title="No spots found"
            description="Try a different search term or come back later as the directory grows."
          />
        </YStack>
      ) : (
        <YStack gap="$4">
          <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" flexWrap="wrap" gap="$3">
            <YStack gap="$1">
              <Text variant="heading3">All spots</Text>
              <Text variant="body" muted>
                {isPending ? 'Refreshing results...' : `${spots.length} visible cards`}
              </Text>
            </YStack>
            <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center">
              <Star size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
              <Text variant="caption" muted>Open a spot to see routes and rating details</Text>
            </XStack>
          </XStack>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(3, 1fr)', gap: '16px' }}>
            {spots.map((spot) => (
              <SpotCard
                key={spot.id}
                spot={spot}
                isSaved={savedSpotIds.has(spot.id)}
                onToggleSave={(e) => handleToggleSave(e, spot.id)}
                onPress={() => router.push(`/spots/${spot.id}`)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </YStack>
      )}
    </YStack>
  )
}

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { getSpotById, getSpotRoutes } from '@/features/spots/actions'
import SpotDetailClient from './spot-detail-client'

export default async function SpotDetailPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
  searchParams: Promise<{ fromRouteName?: string }>
}) {
  const { id } = await params
  const { fromRouteName } = await searchParams

  const [spotResult, routesResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getSpotById(id),
    getSpotRoutes(id, 1, 12),
  ])

  if (spotResult.status === 'rejected') {
    notFound()
  }

  return (
    <SpotDetailClient
      spot={spotResult.value}
      routeLabel={fromRouteName}
      initialRoutes={routesResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? routesResult.value.data : []}
    />
  )
}
