'use client'

import { useState, useTransition, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button, Badge, RouteCard, RatingDisplay } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { RouteCardData } from '@antapp/ui'
import type { SpotDetail, SpotRouteItem } from '@/types/api'
import { rateSpot, toggleSpotFavorite, getSavedSpots } from '@/features/spots/actions'
import { ArrowLeft, MapPinned, Route as RouteIcon, Star, Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import { loadMapLibre, runWhenBrowserIdle } from '@/lib/maplibre'

type SpotPreviewMap = {
  addControl: (control: unknown, position?: string) => void
  remove: () => void
}

function routeToCardData(route: SpotRouteItem): RouteCardData {
  return {
    id: route.id,
    title: route.title,
    description: route.description ?? undefined,
    image: route.thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    rating: route.averageRating > 0 ? route.averageRating : undefined,
  }
}

function SpotRatingWidget({
  spotId,
  onRated,
}: {
  spotId: string
  onRated: (score: number) => void
}) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(0)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  const active = hovered || selected

  const handleRate = (score: number) => {
    if (submitted) return

    setSelected(score)
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        await rateSpot(spotId, score)
        setSubmitted(true)
        onRated(score)
      } catch {
        setSelected(0)
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$3">
      <Text variant="label" color="$mutedForeground">Rate this spot</Text>
      <XStack gap="$1.5" alignItems="center">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((score) => (
          <XStack
            key={score}
            padding="$1"
            borderRadius="$2"
            cursor={submitted || isPending ? 'default' : 'pointer'}
            onPress={() => handleRate(score)}

            onMouseEnter={() => !submitted && !isPending && setHovered(score)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(0)}
          >
            <Star
              size={26}
              fill={score <= active ? '#FF8C00' : 'transparent'}
              color={score <= active ? '#FF8C00' : 'var(--color-mutedForeground)'}
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          </XStack>
        ))}
        {isPending && <Text variant="caption" muted>Saving...</Text>}
      </XStack>
      {submitted && (
        <XStack backgroundColor="$success50" borderRadius="$3" padding="$3">
          <Text variant="caption" color="$success500">Thanks! You rated this spot {selected}/5.</Text>
        </XStack>
      )}
    </YStack>
  )
}

export default function SpotDetailClient({
  spot,
  routeLabel,
  initialRoutes,
}: {
  spot: SpotDetail
  routeLabel?: string
  initialRoutes: SpotRouteItem[]
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [displayRating, setDisplayRating] = useState(spot.averageRating)
  const [displayRatingCount, setDisplayRatingCount] = useState(spot.ratingCount)
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false)
  const [isSaving, startSavingTransition] = useTransition()
  const [spotMapError, setSpotMapError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const spotMapContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const spotMapRef = useRef<SpotPreviewMap | null>(null)
  const hasValidCoordinates = Number.isFinite(spot.latitude) && Number.isFinite(spot.longitude)
  const [shouldLoadMap, setShouldLoadMap] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    getSavedSpots().then(spots => {
      setIsSaved(spots.some(s => s.id === spot.id))
    }).catch(() => { })
  }, [spot.id])

  useEffect(() => runWhenBrowserIdle(() => setShouldLoadMap(true)), [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldLoadMap || !hasValidCoordinates || !spotMapContainerRef.current || spotMapRef.current) return

    let cancelled = false

    const initSpotMap = async () => {
      try {
        const maplibre = await loadMapLibre()
        if (cancelled || !spotMapContainerRef.current || spotMapRef.current) return

        const map = new maplibre.Map({
          container: spotMapContainerRef.current,
          style: 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty',
          center: [spot.longitude, spot.latitude],
          zoom: 14,
        })

        map.addControl(new maplibre.NavigationControl(), 'top-right')

        const markerEl = document.createElement('div')
        markerEl.style.width = '16px'
        markerEl.style.height = '16px'
        markerEl.style.borderRadius = '50%'
        markerEl.style.backgroundColor = '#FF8C00'
        markerEl.style.border = '2px solid #FFFFFF'
        markerEl.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'

        new maplibre.Marker({ element: markerEl })
          .setLngLat([spot.longitude, spot.latitude])
          .setPopup(new maplibre.Popup({ closeButton: false, closeOnClick: false }).setText(spot.name))
          .addTo(map)
          .togglePopup()

        spotMapRef.current = map as unknown as SpotPreviewMap
        setSpotMapError(null)
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setSpotMapError('Location map could not be loaded.')
        }
      }
    }

    void initSpotMap()

    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      if (spotMapRef.current) {
        spotMapRef.current.remove()
      }
      spotMapRef.current = null
    }
  }, [hasValidCoordinates, shouldLoadMap, spot.latitude, spot.longitude, spot.name])

  const handleToggleSave = () => {
    startSavingTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await toggleSpotFavorite(spot.id)
        setIsSaved(saved)
      } catch {
        // Ignored
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <YStack gap="$5" flex={1}>
      <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$3">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onPress={() => router.back()} icon={<ArrowLeft size={16} color="currentColor" />}>
          Back
        </Button>
        <YStack flex={1}>
          <Text variant="heading2">{spot.name}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" muted>Spot details and related routes</Text>
          {routeLabel && routeLabel.trim() && routeLabel.trim() !== spot.name && (
            <Text variant="caption" color="$mutedForeground">
              This stop was labeled as &quot;{routeLabel}&quot; inside the route.
            </Text>
          )}
        </YStack>
      </XStack>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 300px', gap: '32px', alignItems: 'start' }}>
        <YStack gap="$5">
          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
            borderRadius="$4"
            borderWidth={1}
            borderColor="$borderColor"
            overflow="hidden"
          >
            <YStack height={320} backgroundColor="$muted" alignItems="center" justifyContent="center">
              {spot.photoUrl ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img
                  src={spot.photoUrl}
                  alt={spot.name}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    height: '100%',
                    objectFit: 'cover',
                    objectPosition: 'center center',
                    display: 'block',
                  }}
                />
              ) : (
                <MapPinned size={56} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
              )}
            </YStack>

            <YStack padding="$5" gap="$4">
              <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="flex-start" gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap">
                <YStack gap="$2" flex={1}>
                  <Text variant="heading2">{spot.name}</Text>
                  <Text variant="body" muted>
                    {spot.description ?? 'No description has been added for this spot yet.'}
                  </Text>
                </YStack>

                <YStack gap="$2" alignItems="flex-end">
                  {displayRating > 0 ? (
                    <RatingDisplay value={displayRating} />
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant="default" size="md">No ratings yet</Badge>
                  )}
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>
                    {displayRatingCount} ratings · Added {new Intl.DateTimeFormat('tr-TR', { dateStyle: 'medium' }).format(new Date(spot.createdAt))}
                  </Text>
                </YStack>
              </XStack>

              <XStack gap="$2" flexWrap="wrap">
                <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lat {spot.latitude.toFixed(4)}</Badge>
                <Badge variant="default" size="sm">Lng {spot.longitude.toFixed(4)}</Badge>
                {displayRating > 0 && <Badge variant="info" size="sm">{displayRating.toFixed(1)} avg</Badge>}
              </XStack>
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
            borderRadius="$4"
            borderWidth={1}
            borderColor="$borderColor"
            overflow="hidden"
          >
            <XStack justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" padding="$4" borderBottomWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
              <Text variant="heading4">Location on map</Text>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onPress={() => window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${spot.latitude},${spot.longitude}`, '_blank')}
                disabled={!hasValidCoordinates}
              >
                Open in Maps
              </Button>
            </XStack>

            <YStack height={220} backgroundColor="$muted" position="relative">
              {hasValidCoordinates ? (
                <div
                  ref={spotMapContainerRef}
                  style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
                  aria-label="Spot location map preview"
                />
              ) : (
                <YStack flex={1} alignItems="center" justifyContent="center" gap="$2">
                  <MapPinned size={28} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>Location coordinates are unavailable for this spot.</Text>
                </YStack>
              )}

              {spotMapError ? (
                <YStack
                  position="absolute"
                  inset={0}
                  alignItems="center"
                  justifyContent="center"
                  gap="$1.5"
                  backgroundColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.86)"
                >
                  <MapPinned size={22} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
                  <Text variant="caption" muted>{spotMapError}</Text>
                </YStack>
              ) : null}
            </YStack>
          </YStack>

          <YStack gap="$3">
            <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2">
              <RouteIcon size={18} color="var(--color-primary)" />
              <Text variant="heading3">Routes using this spot</Text>
            </XStack>

            {initialRoutes.length === 0 ? (
              <YStack
                backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
                borderRadius="$4"
                borderWidth={1}
                borderColor="$borderColor"
                padding="$5"
                gap="$2"
              >
                <Text variant="heading4">No routes yet</Text>
                <Text variant="body" muted>
                  This spot exists in the directory, but no public route is using it yet.
                </Text>
              </YStack>
            ) : (
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, 1fr)', gap: '16px' }}>
                {initialRoutes.map((route) => (
                  <RouteCard
                    key={route.id}
                    data={routeToCardData(route)}
                    onPress={() => router.push(`/routes/${route.id}`)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </YStack>
        </YStack>

        <YStack flex={1} minWidth={280} gap="$4">
          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
            borderRadius="$4"
            borderWidth={1}
            borderColor="$borderColor"
            padding="$4"
            gap="$4"
          >
            <Text variant="heading4">Quick actions</Text>

            <Button
              variant={isSaved ? 'outline' : 'solid'}
              theme={isSaved ? 'active' : undefined}
              size="md"
              icon={<Heart size={18} color={isSaved ? '#ff4757' : 'white'} fill={isSaved ? '#ff4757' : 'transparent'} />}
              onPress={handleToggleSave}
              disabled={isSaving}
            >
              {isSaving ? 'Updating...' : (isSaved ? 'Saved in Favorites' : 'Save this Spot')}
            </Button>

            <Button variant="outline" size="md" onPress={() => router.push('/spots')}>
              Browse More Spots
            </Button>
            <Button variant="solid" size="md" onPress={() => router.push('/routes/create')}>
              Create Route
            </Button>
          </YStack>

          <YStack
            backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong"
            borderRadius="$4"
            borderWidth={1}
            borderColor="$borderColor"
            padding="$4"
            gap="$4"
          >
            <Text variant="heading4">Community feedback</Text>
            <SpotRatingWidget
              spotId={spot.id}
              onRated={(score) => {
                if (displayRatingCount === 0) {
                  setDisplayRating(score)
                  setDisplayRatingCount(1)
                  return
                }

                const nextCount = displayRatingCount + 1
                const nextAverage = ((displayRating * displayRatingCount) + score) / nextCount
                setDisplayRating(parseFloat(nextAverage.toFixed(1)))
                setDisplayRatingCount(nextCount)
              }}
            />
          </YStack>
        </YStack>
      </div>
    </YStack>
  )
}

  { label: 'Explore', href: '/dashboard', Icon: Globe },

const EXPANDED_WIDTH = 220
const COLLAPSED_WIDTH = 64

export function AppSidebar({

  onToggle,

  userName?: string

  collapsed?: boolean

  const theme = useTheme()
  const activeNavIconColor = theme.primary?.get() ?? '#EA580C'
  const width = collapsed ? COLLAPSED_WIDTH : EXPANDED_WIDTH

  return (

      $md={{ display: 'none' }}

      style={{ transition: 'width 200ms ease' }}
    >
      <YStack gap="$1">
        {/* Logo + Toggle */}
        <XStack
          paddingHorizontal={collapsed ? '$2' : '$4'}

          alignItems="center"
          justifyContent={collapsed ? 'center' : 'space-between'}
          gap="$2"
        >
          <XStack alignItems="center" gap="$2" overflow="hidden">
            <Image src="/ant-logo.png" alt="" width={32} height={32} style={{ objectFit: 'contain', flexShrink: 0 }} />
            {!collapsed && <Text variant="heading4" color="$color">AntAPP</Text>}
          </XStack>
          {onToggle && !collapsed && (
            <XStack
              cursor="pointer"
              onPress={onToggle}
              hoverStyle={{ opacity: 0.7 }}
              padding="$1"
            >
              <PanelLeftClose size={18} color="currentColor" />
            </XStack>
          )}
        </XStack>

        {/* Collapsed toggle button */}
        {onToggle && collapsed && (
          <XStack
            paddingHorizontal="$2"
            paddingBottom="$3"
            justifyContent="center"
          >
            <XStack
              cursor="pointer"
              onPress={onToggle}
              hoverStyle={{ opacity: 0.7 }}
              padding="$1"
            >
              <PanelLeftOpen size={18} color="currentColor" />
            </XStack>
          </XStack>
        )}

        {/* Nav Items */}
        <YStack gap="$0.5" paddingHorizontal="$2">
          {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => {
            const isActive = item.href === '/'
              ? pathname === '/'

            return (

                <XStack

                  {!collapsed && (

              </Link>
            )
          })}
        </YStack>
      </YStack>

      {/* Bottom Section */}
      <YStack paddingHorizontal="$2" gap="$2">
        <Link href="/settings" style={{ textDecoration: 'none' }}>
          <XStack
            paddingHorizontal={collapsed ? '$0' : '$3'}
            paddingVertical="$2.5"

            paddingHorizontal={collapsed ? '$0' : '$3'}

FILE: web/src/components/spot-select.tsx
================================================
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { XStack, YStack, Text, Input, Button } from '@antapp/ui'
import { Search, MapPin, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { getSpots } from '@/features/spots/actions'
import type { SpotListItem } from '@/types/api'

interface SpotSelectProps {
    onSelect: (spot: SpotListItem) => void
    excludeIds?: string[]
}

export default function SpotSelect({ onSelect, excludeIds = [] }: SpotSelectProps) {
    const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
    const [spots, setSpots] = useState<SpotListItem[]>([])
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)

    useEffect(() => {
        const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
            if (query.length < 2) {
                setSpots([])
                setIsOpen(false)
                return
            }

            setLoading(true)
            try {
                const response = await getSpots({ search: query, pageSize: 5 })
                setSpots(response.data.filter(s => !excludeIds.includes(s.id)))
                setIsOpen(true)
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Failed to fetch spots:', error)
            } finally {
                setLoading(false)
            }
        }, 300)

        return () => clearTimeout(timer)
    }, [query, excludeIds])

    return (
        <YStack gap="$2" width="100%" position="relative">
            <XStack gap="$2" alignItems="center" backgroundColor="$backgroundStrong" paddingHorizontal="$3" borderRadius="$3" borderWidth={1} borderColor="$borderColor">
                <Search size={18} color="var(--color-mutedForeground)" />
                <Input
                    placeholder="Search spots by name (e.g. Hadrian's Gate)"
                    value={query}
                    onChangeText={setQuery}
                    borderWidth={0}
                    flex={1}
                    paddingVertical="$2"
                />
                {loading && <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" color="var(--color-primary)" />}
            </XStack>

            {isOpen && spots.length > 0 && (
                <YStack
                    position="absolute"
                    top="100%"
                    left={0}
                    right={0}
                    zIndex={100}
                    marginTop="$1"
                    backgroundColor="$background"
                    borderRadius="$3"
                    borderWidth={1}
                    borderColor="$borderColor"
                    elevation={5}
                    maxHeight={300}
                    overflow="scroll"
                >
                    {spots.map((spot) => (
                        <XStack
                            key={spot.id}
                            padding="$3"
                            hoverStyle={{ backgroundColor: '$muted' }}
                            cursor="pointer"
                            onPress={() => {
                                onSelect(spot)
                                setQuery('')
                                setSpots([])
                                setIsOpen(false)
                            }}
                            gap="$3"
                            alignItems="center"
                            borderBottomWidth={1}
                            borderBottomColor="$borderColor"
                        >
                            <YStack
                                width={32}
                                height={32}
                                borderRadius="$2"
                                backgroundColor="$primary50"
                                alignItems="center"
                                justifyContent="center"
                            >
                                <MapPin size={16} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                            </YStack>
                            <YStack flex={1}>
                                <Text variant="label" weight="semibold">{spot.name}</Text>
                                <Text variant="caption" muted numberOfLines={1}>{spot.description}</Text>
                            </YStack>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Add</Button>
                        </XStack>
                    ))}
                </YStack>
            )}

            {isOpen && query.length >= 2 && !loading && spots.length === 0 && (
                <YStack
                    position="absolute"
                    top="100%"
                    left={0}
                    right={0}
                    zIndex={100}
                    marginTop="$1"
                    backgroundColor="$background"
                    padding="$4"
                    borderRadius="$3"
                    borderWidth={1}
                    borderColor="$borderColor"
                >
                    <Text variant="body" muted textAlign="center">No spots found matching &quot;{query}&quot;</Text>
                </YStack>
            )}
        </YStack>
    )
}

export async function getCurrentUser(): Promise<CurrentUser> {
  return apiFetchData<CurrentUser>('/account/me')
}

export async function updateProfile(data: {

FILE: web/src/features/auth/actions.ts

'use server'

import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import type { AuthUser, RegisterActionState } from './types'
import {
  ACCESS_MAX_AGE,
  ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE,
  API_URL,
  REFRESH_MAX_AGE,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE,
} from './constants'
import { getLandingPathByRoles } from './roles'

function cookieOpts() {
  return {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'strict' as const,
    path: '/',
  }
}

function readBackendError(data: unknown): string | null {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return null
  const d = data as Record<string, unknown>

  // Try to get a direct message first
  const message = d['message'] ?? d['Message']
  if (typeof message === 'string' && message.length > 0) return message

  // If no direct message, check for ASP.NET Core Validation errors
  const errors = d['errors'] ?? d['Errors']
  if (errors && typeof errors === 'object') {
    const errorEntries = Object.entries(errors as Record<string, string[]>)
    if (errorEntries.length > 0) {
      // Return the first error message found
      const [field, messages] = errorEntries[0]
      if (Array.isArray(messages) && messages.length > 0) {
        return messages[0]
      }
    }
  }

  return null
}

async function parseError(res: Response): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const data = await res.json()
    return readBackendError(data) ?? 'Request failed'
  } catch {
    const text = (await res.text()).trim()
    return text || 'Request failed'
  }
}

async function setAuthCookies(accessToken: string, refreshToken: string) {
  const jar = await cookies()
  // By omitting maxAge/expires, they become session cookies that die when the browser closes.
  jar.set(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE, accessToken, cookieOpts())
  jar.set(REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE, refreshToken, cookieOpts())
}

async function clearAuthCookies() {
  const jar = await cookies()
  jar.delete(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE)
  jar.delete(REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE)
}

export async function login(
  _prevState: string | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<string | null> {
  const email = formData.get('email') as string
  const password = formData.get('password') as string

  let data: AuthUser & { refreshToken: string }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
    if (!res.ok) return await parseError(res)
    data = await res.json()
  } catch {
    return 'Network error'
  }

  await setAuthCookies(data.jwToken, data.refreshToken)
  const landingPath = getLandingPathByRoles(data.roles, data.userName)
  redirect(landingPath)
}

export async function register(
  _prevState: RegisterActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<RegisterActionState> {
  const email = formData.get('email') as string
  const userName = formData.get('userName') as string
  const password = formData.get('password') as string
  const confirmPassword = formData.get('confirmPassword') as string
  const userType = formData.get('userType') === 'business' ? 1 : 0

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/register`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        userType,
        email,
        userName,
        password,
        confirmPassword,
      }),
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, message: await parseError(res) }
    const resData = await res.json()
    const message = resData.message ?? (typeof resData === 'string' ? resData : 'Registration successful.')
    return { ok: true, message: message }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: 'Network error' }
  }
}

export async function logout() {
  const jar = await cookies()
  const accessToken = jar.get(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE)?.value
  try {
    await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/logout`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {}),
      },
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
  } catch {
    // Logout devam etmeli — network hatası cookie'leri silmeyi engellemez
  }
  await clearAuthCookies()

  // Try to use API route to send Clear-Site-Data header if we could, 
  // but in Server Actions redirect does it. To bust the Next.js RSC cache:
  const { revalidatePath } = await import('next/cache')
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout')

  redirect('/login')
}

export async function forgotPassword(
  _prevState: string | null | undefined,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<string | null | undefined> {
  const email = formData.get('email') as string
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/forgot-password`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
    if (!res.ok) return await parseError(res)
    return null // başarı
  } catch {
    return 'Network error'
  }
}

export async function resetPassword(
  _prevState: string | null | undefined,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<string | null | undefined> {
  const email = formData.get('email') as string
  const token = formData.get('token') as string
  const password = formData.get('password') as string
  const confirmPassword = formData.get('confirmPassword') as string

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/reset-password`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email, token, password, confirmPassword }),
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
    if (!res.ok) return await parseError(res)
    return null // başarı
  } catch {
    return 'Network error'
  }
}

export async function confirmEmail(userId: string, code: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }> {
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ userId, code })
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/confirm-email?${params}`, {
      cache: 'no-store',
    })
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, message: await parseError(res) }
    return { ok: true, message: 'Email confirmed successfully. You can now log in.' }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: 'Network error' }
  }
}

export async function refreshTokens(): Promise<string> {
  const jar = await cookies()
  const refreshToken = jar.get(REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE)?.value
  if (!refreshToken) throw new Error('No refresh token')

  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/auth/refresh`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Cookie: `${REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE}=${refreshToken}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken }),
    cache: 'no-store',
  })
  if (!res.ok) {
    await clearAuthCookies()
    throw new Error(await parseError(res))
  }

  const data: { jwToken: string; refreshToken: string } = await res.json()
  await setAuthCookies(data.jwToken, data.refreshToken)
  return data.jwToken
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { canAccessPath, getLandingPathByRoles } from './roles'
import { getServerSession } from './session'

export async function requireAuth(pathname: string) {
  const session = await getServerSession()
  if (!session) {
    redirect('/login')
  }

  if (!canAccessPath(pathname, session.roles, session.userName)) {
    redirect(getLandingPathByRoles(session.roles, session.userName))
  }

  return session
}

FILE: web/src/features/auth/jwt.ts
================================================
const ROLE_CLAIM_KEYS = [
  'roles',
  'role',
  'http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/role',
  'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/role',
]

type JwtPayload = Record<string, unknown> & {
  exp?: number
  uid?: string
  sub?: string
  email?: string
}

function base64UrlToBase64(input: string): string {
  const base64 = input.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')
  const padding = '='.repeat((4 - (base64.length % 4)) % 4)
  return `${base64}${padding}`
}

function decodeBase64(value: string): string {
  if (typeof atob === 'function') {
    return atob(value)
  }
  return Buffer.from(value, 'base64').toString('utf-8')
}

export function decodeJwtPayload(token?: string | null): JwtPayload | null {
  if (!token) return null

  const parts = token.split('.')
  if (parts.length !== 3) return null

  try {
    const payload = decodeBase64(base64UrlToBase64(parts[1]))
    return JSON.parse(payload) as JwtPayload
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function toStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map(String).filter(Boolean)
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0) {
    return [value]
  }
  return []
}

export function getTokenRoles(payload: JwtPayload | null): string[] {
  if (!payload) return []

  const roles = ROLE_CLAIM_KEYS.flatMap((key) => toStringArray(payload[key]))
  return Array.from(new Set(roles))
}

export function isJwtExpired(payload: JwtPayload | null, skewSeconds = 30): boolean {
  if (!payload || typeof payload.exp !== 'number') return true
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
  return payload.exp <= now + skewSeconds
}



================================================
FILE: web/src/features/auth/roles.ts
================================================
const ADMIN_ROLES = new Set(['Admin'])
const BUSINESS_ROLES = new Set(['BusinessUser', 'Admin'])

export function normalizeRoles(roles: string[]): string[] {
  return roles.map((r) => r.trim()).filter(Boolean)
}

export function canAccessAdmin(roles: string[], username?: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeRoles(roles)
  const hasAdmin = normalized.some((r) => ADMIN_ROLES.has(r))
  // Admin access: either has Admin role OR username is 'antadmin'
  return hasAdmin || username === 'antadmin'
}

export function canAccessBusiness(roles: string[]): boolean {
  return normalizeRoles(roles).some((r) => BUSINESS_ROLES.has(r))
}

export function getLandingPathByRoles(roles: string[], username?: string): string {
  if (canAccessAdmin(roles, username)) return '/admin'
  if (canAccessBusiness(roles)) return '/business'
  return '/dashboard'
}

export function canAccessPath(pathname: string, roles: string[], username?: string): boolean {
  if (pathname.startsWith('/admin')) return canAccessAdmin(roles, username)
  if (pathname.startsWith('/business')) return canAccessBusiness(roles)
  return true
}

FILE: web/src/features/auth/session.ts
================================================
import 'server-only'

import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import type { AuthUser } from './types'
import { ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE } from './constants'
import { decodeJwtPayload, getTokenRoles, isJwtExpired } from './jwt'
import { normalizeRoles } from './roles'

export async function getServerSession(): Promise<AuthUser | null> {
  const token = (await cookies()).get(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE)?.value
  const payload = decodeJwtPayload(token)
  if (!payload || isJwtExpired(payload)) return null

  return {
    id: String(payload.uid ?? ''),
    userName: String(payload.sub ?? ''),
    email: String(payload.email ?? ''),
    roles: normalizeRoles(getTokenRoles(payload)),
    isVerified: true,
    jwToken: token ?? '',
  }
}

'use client'

import { useState, useTransition, useEffect } from 'react'
import { YStack, XStack, Text, Button } from '@antapp/ui'
import { FolderOpen, Bookmark, Check, X, Plus } from 'lucide-react'
import { getCollections, addRouteToCollection, createCollection } from '@/features/collections/actions'
import type { Collection } from '@/types/api'

export function SaveToCollectionModal({
    routeId,
    isOpen,
    onClose,
    onSaved,
}: {
    routeId: string
    isOpen: boolean
    onClose: () => void
    onSaved: (collectionId: string) => void
}) {
    const [collections, setCollections] = useState<Collection[]>([])
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
    const [savingId, setSavingId] = useState<string | null>(null)
    const [savedIds, setSavedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
    const [, startTransition] = useTransition()

    // Create New state
    const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false)
    const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
    const [isCreatingLoading, setIsCreatingLoading] = useState(false)

    const fetchCollections = () => {
        setLoading(true)
        getCollections(1, 50)
            .then((res) => setCollections(res.data))
            .catch(() => setCollections([]))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false))
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!isOpen) return
        fetchCollections()
    }, [isOpen])

    const handleCreateAndSave = async () => {
        if (!newName.trim()) return
        setIsCreatingLoading(true)
        try {
            const newId = await createCollection({ name: newName.trim() })
            await addRouteToCollection(newId, routeId)
            setSavedIds((prev) => new Set([...prev, newId]))
            onSaved(newId)
            setIsCreating(false)
            setNewName('')
            fetchCollections()
        } catch {
            // Error handling
        } finally {
            setIsCreatingLoading(false)
        }
    }

    if (!isOpen) return null

    const handleSave = (collectionId: string) => {
        if (savedIds.has(collectionId) || savingId) return
        setSavingId(collectionId)
        startTransition(async () => {
            try {
                await addRouteToCollection(collectionId, routeId)
                setSavedIds((prev) => new Set([...prev, collectionId]))
                onSaved(collectionId)
            } catch {
                // Ignore – show error in future iteration
            } finally {
                setSavingId(null)
            }
        })
    }

    return (
        // Backdrop
        <div
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
                position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 1000,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)',
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
        >
            <div
                onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                style={{
                    background: '#fff', borderRadius: 16, padding: 24,
                    width: '100%', maxWidth: 440, maxHeight: '80vh',
                    display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, overflow: 'hidden',
                    boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                }}
            >
                {/* Header */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                    <Bookmark size={20} color="var(--color-primary)" />
                    <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 16, color: '#111827' }}>Save to Collection</p>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13, color: '#6B7280' }}>Choose which collection to add this route to</p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                        onClick={onClose}
                        style={{
                            background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
                            color: '#6B7280', padding: 4, borderRadius: 8,
                        }}
                    >
                        <X size={20} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 1, background: '#E5E7EB' }} />

                {/* Collection list */}
                <div style={{ overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
                    {loading && (
                        <p style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#6B7280', padding: '24px 0' }}>Loading collections...</p>
                    )}
                    {!loading && collections.length === 0 && (
                        <p style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#6B7280', padding: '24px 0' }}>
                            No collections yet. Create one first!
                        </p>
                    )}
                    {!loading && collections.map((col) => {
                        const isSaved = savedIds.has(col.id)
                        const isSaving = savingId === col.id
                        return (
                            <button
                                key={col.id}
                                onClick={() => handleSave(col.id)}
                                disabled={isSaved || !!savingId}
                                style={{
                                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12,
                                    padding: '12px 14px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1.5px solid',
                                    borderColor: isSaved ? '#EA580C' : '#E5E7EB',
                                    background: isSaved ? '#FFF7ED' : '#FAFAFA',
                                    cursor: isSaved || savingId ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                                    opacity: (!!savingId && !isSaving) ? 0.6 : 1,
                                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                                    textAlign: 'left',
                                    width: '100%',
                                }}
                            >
                                <div style={{
                                    width: 36, height: 36, borderRadius: 8,
                                    background: '#F3F4F6', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                                    flexShrink: 0,
                                }}>
                                    <FolderOpen size={18} color={isSaved ? '#EA580C' : '#9CA3AF'} />
                                </div>
                                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14, color: '#111827' }}>{col.name}</p>
                                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12, color: '#6B7280' }}>{col.routeCount} route{col.routeCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
                                </div>
                                {isSaved && <Check size={18} color="#EA580C" />}
                                {isSaving && <div className="loader" style={{ width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: '50%', borderWidth: 2, borderStyle: 'solid', borderColor: '#E5E7EB', borderTopColor: '#EA580C', animation: 'spin 0.8s linear infinite' }} />}
                                {!isSaved && !isSaving && (
                                    <Plus size={16} color="#9CA3AF" />
                                )}
                            </button>
                        )
                    })}
                </div>

                {/* Create New Inline */}
                <div style={{ padding: '4px 0' }}>
                    {isCreating ? (
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                            <input
                                autoFocus
                                value={newName}
                                onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                                placeholder="Collection name..."
                                style={{ flex: 1, padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 8, border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', fontSize: 14 }}
                            />
                            <Button size="sm" variant="solid" onPress={handleCreateAndSave} disabled={isCreatingLoading}>
                                {isCreatingLoading ? '...' : 'Create & Save'}
                            </Button>
                            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onPress={() => setIsCreating(false)}>
                                <X size={16} />
                            </Button>
                        </div>
                    ) : (
                        <button
                            onClick={() => setIsCreating(true)}
                            style={{
                                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
                                background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--color-primary)',
                                fontWeight: 500, fontSize: 14, cursor: 'pointer', padding: '4px 8px'
                            }}
                        >
                            <Plus size={16} />
                            Create New Collection
                        </button>
                    )}
                </div>

                {/* Footer */}
                <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, borderTop: '1px solid #E5E7EB' }}>
                    <button
                        onClick={onClose}
                        style={{
                            width: '100%', padding: '10px 0', borderRadius: 8,
                            background: savedIds.size > 0 ? '#EA580C' : '#F3F4F6',
                            color: savedIds.size > 0 ? '#fff' : '#374151',
                            border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14,
                            transition: 'background 0.2s',
                        }}
                    >
                        {savedIds.size > 0 ? 'Done' : 'Cancel'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <style>{`
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
      `}</style>
        </div>
    )
}

'use server'

import { apiFetchData, apiFetchPaged, publicApiFetchData, publicApiFetchPaged } from '@/lib/api'
import type { RouteListItem, RouteDetail, RouteStopItem, Tag, PagedApiResponse } from '@/types/api'

export type GetRoutesParams = {
  search?: string
  tagIds?: string[]
  sort?: 'rating' | 'newest' | string
  type?: 'official' | 'community' | 'sponsored'
  visibility?: 'public' | 'draft'
  authorId?: string
  page?: number
  pageSize?: number
}

function buildRoutesQuery(params: GetRoutesParams = {}) {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams()
  if (params.search) qs.set('search', params.search)
  if (params.tagIds?.length) qs.set('tagIds', params.tagIds.join(','))
  if (params.sort) qs.set('sort', params.sort)
  if (params.type) qs.set('type', params.type)
  if (params.visibility) qs.set('visibility', params.visibility)
  if (params.authorId) qs.set('authorId', params.authorId)
  if (params.page) qs.set('page', String(params.page))
  if (params.pageSize) qs.set('pageSize', String(params.pageSize))
  return qs.toString()
}

export async function getRoutes(params: GetRoutesParams = {}): Promise<PagedApiResponse<RouteListItem>> {
  const query = buildRoutesQuery(params)
  const path = `/routes${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`

  if (params.visibility === 'draft') {
    return apiFetchPaged<RouteListItem>(path)
  }

  return publicApiFetchPaged<RouteListItem>(path, { revalidate: 60 })
}

export async function getRouteById(id: string): Promise<RouteDetail> {
  return publicApiFetchData<RouteDetail>(`/routes/${id}`, { revalidate: 120 })
}

export async function getRouteStops(routeId: string): Promise<RouteStopItem[]> {
  return apiFetchData<RouteStopItem[]>(`/routes/${routeId}/stops`)
}

export async function addRouteStop(routeId: string, data: {
  spotId: string
  customTitle?: string
  customDescription?: string
  order?: number
}): Promise<string> {
  return apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${routeId}/stops`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  })
}

export async function updateRouteStop(routeId: string, routeStopId: string, data: {
  customTitle?: string
  customDescription?: string
  customPhotoUrl?: string
}): Promise<string> {
  return apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${routeId}/stops/${routeStopId}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  })
}

export async function deleteRouteStop(routeId: string, routeStopId: string): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${routeId}/stops/${routeStopId}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
  })
}

export async function reorderRouteStops(routeId: string, orderedStopIds: string[]): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${routeId}/stops/reorder`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ orderedStopIds }),
  })
}

export async function getTags(pageSize = 100): Promise<Tag[]> {
  const res = await publicApiFetchPaged<Tag>(`/tags?pageSize=${pageSize}`, { revalidate: 900 })
  return res.data
}

export async function getOwnRoutes(authorId: string, pageSize = 100): Promise<RouteListItem[]> {
  const [publicRoutes, draftRoutes] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getRoutes({ authorId, visibility: 'public', pageSize }),
    getRoutes({ authorId, visibility: 'draft', pageSize }),
  ])

  const items = [
    ...(publicRoutes.status === 'fulfilled' ? publicRoutes.value.data : []),
    ...(draftRoutes.status === 'fulfilled' ? draftRoutes.value.data : []),
  ]

  return items
    .filter((route, index, routes) => routes.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === route.id) === index)
    .sort((left, right) => new Date(right.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(left.createdAt).getTime())
}

export async function createRoute(data: {
  title: string
  description?: string
  thumbnailUrl?: string
  tagIds?: string[]
  spots: Array<{ spotId: string; customTitle?: string; customDescription?: string }>
}): Promise<string> {
  return apiFetchData<string>('/routes', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  })
}

export async function updateRoute(id: string, data: {
  title?: string
  description?: string
  thumbnailUrl?: string
}): Promise<string> {
  return apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${id}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  })
}

export async function deleteRoute(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
}

export async function publishRoute(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${id}/publish`, { method: 'POST' })
}

export async function unpublishRoute(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${id}/unpublish`, { method: 'POST' })
}

export async function forkRoute(id: string): Promise<string> {
  return apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${id}/fork`, { method: 'POST' })
}

export async function rateRoute(routeId: string, score: number): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/routes/${routeId}/rating`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify({ score }),
  })
}

export async function promoteRouteToOfficial(routeId: string): Promise<void> {
  await apiFetchData<string>(`/admin/routes/${routeId}/promote`, {
    method: 'POST',
  })
}

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { getSavedSpots } from '@/features/spots/actions'
import type { SpotListItem } from '@/types/api'
import { MapPin, Check, X, BookmarkCheck, Heart } from 'lucide-react'
import { Image } from '@antapp/ui'

export function SavedSpotsPickerModal({
    isOpen,
    onClose,
    onAddSelected,
    excludeIds = [],
}: {
    isOpen: boolean
    onClose: () => void
    onAddSelected: (spots: SpotListItem[]) => void
    excludeIds?: string[]
}) {
    const [savedSpots, setSavedSpots] = useState<SpotListItem[]>([])
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!isOpen) return
        setSelected(new Set())
        setLoading(true)
        getSavedSpots()
            .then((spots) => setSavedSpots(spots.filter((s) => !excludeIds.includes(s.id))))
            .catch(() => setSavedSpots([]))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false))
    }, [isOpen])

    if (!isOpen) return null

    const toggle = (id: string) => {
        setSelected((prev) => {
            const next = new Set(prev)
            if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id)
            else next.add(id)
            return next
        })
    }

    const handleAdd = () => {
        const picked = savedSpots.filter((s) => selected.has(s.id))
        onAddSelected(picked)
        onClose()
    }

    return (
        <div
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
                position: 'fixed', inset: 0, zIndex: 1000,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)',
                display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
        >
            <div
                onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                style={{
                    background: '#fff', borderRadius: 16, padding: 24,
                    width: '100%', maxWidth: 480, maxHeight: '80vh',
                    display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16,
                    boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                }}
            >
                {/* Header */}
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                    <Heart size={20} color="#EA580C" fill="#EA580C" />
                    <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 16, color: '#111827' }}>Pick from Saved Spots</p>
                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13, color: '#6B7280' }}>
                            {selected.size > 0 ? `${selected.size} selected` : 'Select spots to add as stops'}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                        onClick={onClose}
                        style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#6B7280', padding: 4, borderRadius: 8 }}
                    >
                        <X size={20} />
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: 1, background: '#E5E7EB' }} />

                {/* Spot list */}
                <div style={{ overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, flex: 1 }}>
                    {loading && (
                        <p style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#6B7280', padding: '32px 0' }}>Loading saved spots...</p>
                    )}
                    {!loading && savedSpots.length === 0 && (
                        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '32px 0' }}>
                            <BookmarkCheck size={40} color="#D1D5DB" style={{ margin: '0 auto 12px' }} />
                            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151' }}>No saved spots yet</p>
                            <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 13, color: '#6B7280' }}>
                                Like spots from the Spots page first!
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                    {!loading && savedSpots.map((spot) => {
                        const isSelected = selected.has(spot.id)
                        return (
                            <button
                                key={spot.id}
                                onClick={() => toggle(spot.id)}
                                style={{
                                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12,
                                    padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1.5px solid',
                                    borderColor: isSelected ? '#EA580C' : '#E5E7EB',
                                    background: isSelected ? '#FFF7ED' : '#FAFAFA',
                                    cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left',
                                    transition: 'all 0.12s ease',
                                }}
                            >
                                {/* Spot thumbnail or icon */}
                                <div style={{
                                    width: 42, height: 42, borderRadius: 8, overflow: 'hidden', flexShrink: 0,
                                    background: '#F3F4F6', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                                }}>
                                    {spot.photoUrl ? (
                                        <Image src={spot.photoUrl} alt={spot.name} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', display: 'block' }} />
                                    ) : (
                                        <MapPin size={18} color={isSelected ? '#EA580C' : '#9CA3AF'} />
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                                    <p style={{ margin: 0, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14, color: '#111827', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
                                        {spot.name}
                                    </p>
                                    {spot.description && (
                                        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12, color: '#6B7280', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }}>
                                            {spot.description}
                                        </p>
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                {/* Check indicator */}
                                <div style={{
                                    width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: '50%', flexShrink: 0,
                                    background: isSelected ? '#EA580C' : '#F3F4F6',
                                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
                                    transition: 'background 0.12s ease',
                                }}>
                                    {isSelected && <Check size={13} color="#fff" strokeWidth={3} />}
                                </div>
                            </button>
                        )
                    })}
                </div>

                {/* Footer */}
                <div style={{ paddingTop: 8, borderTop: '1px solid #E5E7EB', display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                    <button
                        onClick={onClose}
                        style={{
                            flex: 1, padding: '10px 0', borderRadius: 8,
                            background: '#F3F4F6', color: '#374151',
                            border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14,
                        }}
                    >
                        Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                        onClick={handleAdd}
                        disabled={selected.size === 0}
                        style={{
                            flex: 2, padding: '10px 0', borderRadius: 8,
                            background: selected.size > 0 ? '#EA580C' : '#F3F4F6',
                            color: selected.size > 0 ? '#fff' : '#9CA3AF',
                            border: 'none', cursor: selected.size > 0 ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                            fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 14, transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                        }}
                    >
                        {selected.size > 0 ? `Add ${selected.size} Stop${selected.size > 1 ? 's' : ''}` : 'Select spots first'}
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

import 'server-only'

import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE, API_URL } from '@/features/auth/constants'
import type { ApiResponse, PagedApiResponse } from '@/types/api'

type ApiFetchOptions = RequestInit & {
  includeAuth?: boolean
  revalidate?: number | false
}

async function request<T>(path: string, options?: ApiFetchOptions): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(options?.headers)
  const method = options?.method?.toUpperCase() ?? 'GET'
  const isGet = method === 'GET'

  if (!headers.has('Content-Type')) {
    headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
  }

  if (options?.includeAuth !== false) {
    const token = (await cookies()).get(ACCESS_TOKEN_COOKIE)?.value
    if (token) {
      headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`)
    }
  }

  const revalidate = options?.revalidate
  const cache = options?.cache
    ?? (isGet
      ? (typeof revalidate === 'number' ? 'force-cache' : 'no-store')
      : 'no-store')

  const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    headers,
    cache,
    ...(typeof revalidate === 'number' ? { next: { revalidate } } : {}),
  })

  if (!res.ok) {
    let message = `API error: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`
    try {
      const body = await res.json()
      if (body?.message) message = body.message
      else if (body?.errors && Array.isArray(body.errors)) message = body.errors[0]
    } catch {}
    throw new Error(message)
  }

  return res.json() as Promise<T>
}

export function apiFetch<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  return request<T>(path, { ...options, includeAuth: true })
}

export function publicApiFetch<T>(path: string, options?: Omit<ApiFetchOptions, 'includeAuth'>): Promise<T> {
  return request<T>(path, { ...options, includeAuth: false })
}

/** Unwraps Response<T> wrapper from backend and returns T */
export async function apiFetchData<T>(
  path: string,
  options?: RequestInit
): Promise<T> {
  const wrapped = await apiFetch<ApiResponse<T>>(path, options)
  return wrapped.data
}

export async function publicApiFetchData<T>(
  path: string,
  options?: Omit<ApiFetchOptions, 'includeAuth'>
): Promise<T> {
  const wrapped = await publicApiFetch<ApiResponse<T>>(path, options)
  return wrapped.data
}

/** Unwraps PagedResponse<T> wrapper from backend */
export async function apiFetchPaged<T>(
  path: string,
  options?: RequestInit
): Promise<PagedApiResponse<T>> {
  return apiFetch<PagedApiResponse<T>>(path, options)
}

export async function publicApiFetchPaged<T>(
  path: string,
  options?: Omit<ApiFetchOptions, 'includeAuth'>
): Promise<PagedApiResponse<T>> {
  return publicApiFetch<PagedApiResponse<T>>(path, options)
}

export function ensureMapLibreStyles() {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
  if (document.querySelector('link[data-maplibre-style="true"]')) return

  const link = document.createElement('link')
  link.rel = 'stylesheet'
  link.href = 'https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css'
  link.dataset.maplibreStyle = 'true'
  document.head.appendChild(link)
}

export async function loadMapLibre() {
  ensureMapLibreStyles()
  return import('maplibre-gl')
}

export function runWhenBrowserIdle(callback: () => void, timeout = 500) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return () => {}
  }

  type IdleCallbackHandle = number
  type IdleCallback = (deadline: { didTimeout: boolean; timeRemaining: () => number }) => void
  type IdleRequestOptions = { timeout?: number }

  const win = window as typeof window & {
    requestIdleCallback?: (cb: IdleCallback, options?: IdleRequestOptions) => IdleCallbackHandle
    cancelIdleCallback?: (id: IdleCallbackHandle) => void
  }

  if (typeof win.requestIdleCallback === 'function') {
    const id = win.requestIdleCallback(() => callback(), { timeout })
    return () => {
      if (typeof win.cancelIdleCallback === 'function') {
        win.cancelIdleCallback(id)
      }
    }
  }

  const id = window.setTimeout(callback, 150)
  return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
}

'use client'

import { NextThemeProvider } from '@tamagui/next-theme'
import { tamaguiConfig } from '@antapp/ui'
import { TamaguiProvider as TamaguiRootProvider } from 'tamagui'

export function TamaguiProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <NextThemeProvider
      forcedTheme="light"
      defaultTheme="light"
      enableSystem={false}
      skipNextHead
    >
      <TamaguiRootProvider
        config={tamaguiConfig}
        disableRootThemeClass
        defaultTheme="light"
      >
        {children}
      </TamaguiRootProvider>
    </NextThemeProvider>
  )
}

// Backend API response wrapper tipleri
// Response<T> → { succeeded, message, errors, data }
// PagedResponse<T> → { pageNumber, pageSize, totalRecords, totalPages, data }

export type ApiResponse<T> = {
  succeeded: boolean
  message: string | null
  errors: string[] | null
  data: T
}

export type PagedApiResponse<T> = {
  pageNumber: number
  pageSize: number
  totalRecords: number
  totalPages: number
  data: T[]
}
